### [1] [Smells and Refactorings for Software Environmental Sustainability: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03838)
*Ornela Danushi,Flavio Sampirisi,Jacopo Soldani,Stefano Forti,Antonio Brogi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过系统文献综述分析了66篇截至2026年3月的研究，识别出20种影响软件环境可持续性的"绿色坏味道"，并映射到相应的重构技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICT的环境影响持续增长，亟需通过减少高能耗软件系统的足迹来提升其环境可持续性，而软件中固有的结构性低效可通过识别"绿色坏味道"并重构来缓解生态影响。

Method: 对讨论绿色坏味道及其可能重构的文献进行系统文献综述，分析并分类66篇截至2026年3月发表的主要研究。

Result: 识别出20种影响软件环境可持续性的坏味道，每种坏味道均关联一种或多种可缓解其负面环境影响的重构技术。

Conclusion: 文献表明学界对解决影响软件系统的绿色坏味道具有浓厚兴趣。所编目的绿色坏味道及对应重构可为从业者的日常开发工作流提供实用价值，同时为研究者建立可持续软件工程的新研究方向提供起点。

Abstract: Context: The environmental impact of ICT is constantly growing. Enhancing its environmental sustainability requires dealing with energy-hungry software systems, by possibly reducing their footprint. Objective: To better frame the problem and its persistent nature, software can be viewed as carrying structural inefficiencies regardless of how advanced its functionality may be. Identifying these inefficiencies as "green smells" provides a basis for refactoring code to mitigate its ecological impact. We aim at identifying well-known green smells impacting environmental sustainable software and map them to corresponding refactoring aimed at reducing the impact therein. Method: In this article, we conduct a systematic literature review on the articles that discuss green smells and their possible refactorings. We analyse and classify 66 primary studies published up to March 2026. Results: We identify 20 smells impacting environmental sustainability of software. Each smell is associated with one or more refactoring techniques known to mitigate their negative effects on the environmental sustainability of software. Conclusions: The literature witnesses the interest in resolving the green smells affecting software systems. The catalogued green smells and the corresponding refactorings can provide pragmatic value for practitioners in their daily development workflows, while also offering researchers a starting point to establish new research directions in sustainable software engineering.

</details>


### [2] [Characterizing Open-Source Video Games from a Software Engineering Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03953)
*Henrique Mandelli Canella,Yohan Duarte,Cristiano Politowski,Vinicius Durelli,Andre Takeshi Endo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究从软件工程视角刻画了GitHub上491款源自itch.io的开源电子游戏，分析了其类型、流行度、仓库活跃度、实现特征与测试实践，发现类型集中、评分偏高、仓库多处于休眠或低维护状态、主要使用Godot或Unity、测试文档稀缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源游戏为软件工程实证研究提供了透明且通常在商业项目中难以获取的开发工件，但学界对开源电子游戏的整体开发特征缺乏系统刻画；同时独立开发者、小团队和单人开发者在预算受限条件下开发游戏，其工程实践值得关注。

Method: 从itch.io选取491款以开源形式发布在GitHub上的电子游戏，提取其元数据，并从软件工程角度分析游戏类型、流行度、仓库活动、实现特征（如游戏引擎）以及测试实践。

Result: 开源游戏类型主要集中在Puzzle、Action和Platformer等有限类别；玩家评分在可获得时普遍偏高，显示社区对此类游戏接受度较好；仓库大多处于休眠或极低维护状态；多数项目采用Godot或Unity作为游戏引擎；测试相关实践的文档很少被包含。

Conclusion: 研究揭示开源电子游戏的开发特征，可为面向小团队和独立游戏开发者的软件工程实践与工具设计提供参考与启示。

Abstract: Video games hold a prominent role in the entertainment industry, which constitutes a multibillion-dollar global market. Within this ecosystem, independent studios, small teams, and solo developers operate with constrained budgets while making their games available through platforms such as itch.io, where many projects are also available as open-source. Where even if the project is fully released, other developers can still have access to the development process through the source code, helping other developers to develop their own games. These open-source games also constitute a valuable corpus for empirical software engineering research, offering transparent access to development artifacts that are typically inaccessible in commercial projects. This study characterizes open-source video games from a Software Engineering standpoint, focusing on their genres, popularity, repository activity, implementation characteristics, and testing practices. To this end, we extracted metadata from 491 video games from itch.io, published as open-source projects in GitHub. The results indicate that open-source games predominantly fall within limited genres (Puzzle, Action, and Platformer), that player ratings, when available, tend to be high, bringing a perception that the community receives well those kind of games, that repositories are largely dormant or minimally maintained, that the majority of these projects adopt either Godot or Unity as their game engine, and that documentation of testing-related practices is seldom included. The results offer insights into the development of open-source video games and may contribute to advancing software engineering practices and tools designed for small teams and independent game developers.

</details>


### [3] [How Do Coding Agents Optimize Software and Report Performance Validation? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Open-Source Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03969)
*Huiyun Peng,Ricardo Calvo,Kelechi G. Kalu,James C. Davis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对比1130个AI智能体与1130个人工编写的性能优化PR，发现智能体PR合并率更低（54.4% vs 73.3%），策略与验证率相近，但更依赖静态推理而非基准测试，且整体量化证据不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体已开始向开源项目提交性能优化PR，但其改动是否符合成熟优化实践、是否充分支撑其声称的价值尚不明确，因此需要系统比较智能体与人类开发者的优化与验证行为。

Method: 在MSR 2026 Mining Challenge试点研究（407个性能PR）基础上，扩展到截至2026年6月采集的1130个智能体PR与1130个人工编写PR，对比两组的合并结果与补丁特征，并分析其优化策略与验证行为。

Result: 智能体PR合并率低于人工PR（54.4% vs 73.3%），但优化策略相似、报告验证的比例相当；智能体更依赖静态推理、较少使用基准测试（46.1% vs 57.2%），不过基准使用在研究末期趋于一致。智能体对代码坏味重构与资源优化均同样报告验证，人工则较少如此。两组中约一半已验证PR未报告量化性能指标，权衡也鲜有量化。

Conclusion: 智能体优化实践日益接近人类，但支撑证据仍不完整；确立智能体优化是否具备严谨、量化、多维证据仍是重要挑战，需建立衡量预期效果与相关成本的评估基础设施和评审标准，而非仅以是否验证作为充分条件。

Abstract: Software performance optimization requires identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities, and empirically evaluating the effects and trade-offs across performance objectives. Autonomous AI coding agents submit performance-oriented pull requests (PRs) to open-source projects, yet it remains unclear whether these changes reflect established optimization practices and adequately substantiate their claimed value. Extending our MSR 2026 Mining Challenge pilot study of 407 performance PRs, we analyze a sample of 1,130 agentic and 1,130 human-authored performance PRs collected through June 2026. We compare adoption outcomes and patch characteristics between the two groups, and examine their optimization practices and validation behaviors. The results show that agentic PRs are merged less often than human-authored PRs (54.4% vs. 73.3%), but the two groups use similar optimization strategies and report validation at comparable rates. Agentic PRs rely more on static reasoning and less on benchmarks (46.1% vs. 57.2%), although benchmark use converges by the end of the study period. Agentic PRs also report validation for code-smell refactorings as often as for resource-targeting changes, whereas human-authored PRs do so less often. Across both groups, about half of validated PRs report no quantitative performance metric, and relevant trade-offs are rarely quantified. Agentic optimization practice has become increasingly similar to human practice, but the supporting evidence remains incomplete. Establishing whether agent-proposed optimizations are supported by rigorous, quantitative, and multidimensional evidence remains an important challenge. These findings motivate evaluation infrastructure and review criteria that measure intended effects and relevant costs rather than treating the presence of validation alone as sufficient.

</details>


### [4] [World Requirement Model: Learning Requirement-Change Consequences from Typed Artifact Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04445)
*Yuanpeng He,Lijian Li,Dongming Jin,Huanyao Zhang,Fangjing Li,Linyu Li,Chung-ju Huang,Tianxiang Zhan,Qingsong Wen,Wenpin Jiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出World Requirement Model（WRM），将需求工程的工程语境编码为带类型的工件图，并在共享工件标识符处预测变更后果（影响、冲突、违规、缺陷风险）。在合成语料上，WRM的影响MAP达0.724，较哈希文本MLP（0.623）相对提升16.2%，并在多组对比中保持优势；但结果基于选中系统，且揭示了当前线性影响头的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求变更是需求工程的核心问题，其影响会波及关联的利益相关者、约束、组件与测试。现有方法往往难以显式建模这种分散在多类工程工件上的语境依赖关系，也缺乏对变更后果（影响、冲突、违规、缺陷风险）进行系统化预测与评估的手段。论文旨在把工程语境形式化为可计算的世界模型，从而支持对需求变更后果的预测与比较评估。

Method: 提出World Requirement Model（WRM）：1）将工程语境编码为带类型的工件图（typed artifact graph），在共享工件标识符处预测后果；2）利用关系感知注意力（relation-aware attention）与类型化传播（typed propagation）为节点提供语境；3）引入世界表示与决策表示以支持学习到的动态演化；4）采用共享读出（shared readouts）对影响、冲突、违规、缺陷风险打分；5）使用辅助目标监督后继邻接与潜在预测。

Result: 在六个领域、282个合成案例中评分28个案例：WRM影响MAP为0.724，哈希文本MLP为0.623，相对提升16.2%，配对差异0.101（条件95%区间[0.044,0.159]）。最低四分位平均AP提升32.4%，等域MAP提升13.3%。在扩展语料上的四组47案例对比中，MAP提升15.6–29.1%，五项报告指标均值均更高。优势在多种评分汇总与标注/训练设置下延续。检查点基于评分案例选取且骨干网络不匹配，因此结果刻画的是被选中的系统。

Conclusion: WRM提出了面向工件寻址的世界模型公式，为上下文化的后果评分提供了对比性证据，并明确了评估需求—世界预测的显式条件。分析同时给出了候选覆盖边界，并表明当前线性影响头无法在固定世界下跨决策对工件重排序，为后续研究指明了改进方向。

Abstract: Requirement changes can affect connected stakeholders, constraints, components, and tests. We present World Requirement Model (WRM), which encodes this engineering context as a typed artifact graph and predicts consequences at shared artifact identifiers. Relation-aware attention and typed propagation contextualize nodes; world and decision representations support learned dynamics. Shared readouts score impact, conflict, violation, and defect risk; auxiliary objectives supervise successor adjacency and latent prediction. On 28 scored cases from 282 synthetic cases in six domains, WRM obtains impact mean average precision (MAP) of 0.724 versus 0.623 for a hashed-text multilayer perceptron (MLP), a 16.2\% relative gain and paired difference of 0.101 (conditional 95\% interval [0.044,0.159]). Lowest-quarter mean AP improves by 32.4\%, and equal-domain MAP by 13.3\%. Four 47-case comparisons on an expanded corpus show MAP gains of 15.6--29.1\% and higher means on all five reported metrics. The recorded advantage thus extends across score summaries and annotation/training settings. Checkpoints were selected on scored cases, and backbones are unmatched, so these results characterize selected systems. Our analysis establishes candidate-coverage bounds and shows that the current linear impact head cannot rerank a fixed world's artifacts across decisions. WRM contributes an artifact-addressed world-model formulation, comparative evidence for contextual consequence scoring, and explicit conditions for evaluating requirement-world prediction.

</details>


### [5] [Noise-Resilient Testing of Quantum Programs Based on Output Dominance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04461)
*Yuechen Li,Yige Yang,Tao Yue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出Qomino，一种支配引导的量子软件测试方法，无需独立噪声估计或缓解阶段即可从含噪样本判定测试结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NISQ时代门、退相干和测量误差会扭曲输出，难以区分程序缺陷与噪声。现有噪声感知QST方法通常在应用测试预言前先缓解或建模噪声，成本高且依赖校准数据、模型训练或后端信息，适用性受限。

Method: Qomino结合分解感知的逆构造、将期望结果与最强观测竞争者进行比较，并对不确定判定进行有界重试。

Result: 在六个Qiskit程序的30个受控缺陷变体和六个模拟噪声后端上，与统计、量子专用和基于学习的六种基线比较，总体准确率85.65%，限定两程序评估达99.95%，显著优于对应基线；在评估设定下比量子专用和基于学习方法更快。消融与重试分析支持各主要组件的贡献。

Conclusion: Qomino无需独立噪声估计或缓解即可有效判定含噪量子程序测试，兼具更高准确率和更快速度，组件贡献得到验证。

Abstract: Quantum software testing (QST) is a central quality-assurance activity for checking whether quantum programs conform to their specifications. In the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, gate, decoherence, and measurement errors distort observed outputs, making it difficult to distinguish program defects from noise. The existing noise-aware QST literature typically mitigates or models noise before applying a test oracle. However, these strategies can incur substantial cost and depend on calibration data, model training, or backend-specific information, limiting their applicability. We present Qomino, a dominance-guided QST approach for judging tests from noisy samples without a separate noise-estimation or mitigation phase. The approach combines decomposition-aware inverse construction, comparison of the expected outcome with the strongest observed competitor, and bounded retries for inconclusive decisions. We evaluate Qomino on 30 controlled buggy variants from six Qiskit programs and six simulated noisy backends, comparing it with six baselines spanning statistical, quantum-specific, and learning-based methods. Qomino achieves 85.65% accuracy over all six programs and 99.95% in the restricted two-program evaluation, significantly outperforming the corresponding baselines. Across the evaluated programs and backends under the stated settings, Qomino is faster than the compared quantum-specific and learning-based methods. Ablation and retry analyses support the contributions of its main components.

</details>


### [6] [DreamTest: World-Model Surrogates for Search-Based Testing of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04494)
*Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Boxi Yu,Liting Lin,Lionel Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DreamTest是一种基于世界模型的替代测试方法，通过想象DML智能体的虚拟执行片段来预测测试失败，在多个任务上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部署前测试深度强化学习（DRL）智能体需要揭示多样化的失败情形，但每次仿真执行成本高昂。现有的替代测试方法将系统视为黑盒，直接预测"通过/失败"结果，忽略了测试过程的动态演化信息，导致预测精度和失败发现的多样性受限。

Method: 提出DreamTest——一种用于测试DRL智能体的世界模型替代器。该方法将循环状态空间模型适配为从智能体训练日志中学习智能体行为与环境动态。给定候选测试配置后，通过"想象rollout"生成失败分数，以指导搜索过程，而无需在仿真器或真实系统中执行每个候选配置。

Result: 在Parking、Humanoid和DonkeyCar三个任务上评估了失败预测、测试生成与失败多样性。平均AUPRC分别超过最强基线97%、12%和39%；在五个分布外测试集上增益分别达145%、29%和44%。在相同仿真验证预算下，最佳"DreamTest+搜索"组合平均多发现29%、22%和79%的新颖失败。在k=2-40的聚类中，DreamTest生成的失败覆盖了几乎所有k下最多的行为簇。

Conclusion: DreamTest通过建模测试过程的动态演化和想象rollout，显著提升了DRL智能体测试中的失败预测精度、搜索效率与失败多样性，优于将系统视为黑盒的现有替代方法。

Abstract: Testing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents in cyber-physical systems aims to uncover diverse failures before deployment, but each execution can be expensive. Surrogate-assisted testing reduces this cost by learning to predict which test configurations are likely to fail. Prior surrogates treat the system as a black box and predict pass or fail outcomes directly; we instead model how a test unfolds and estimate failure from an imagined episode.
  We introduce DreamTest, a world-model surrogate for testing DRL agents. DreamTest adapts a recurrent state-space model to learn agent behaviour and environment dynamics from the agent's training log. Given a candidate configuration, imagined rollouts produce a failure score that guides search without executing every candidate in a simulator or real system.
  We evaluate DreamTest for failure prediction, test generation, and failure diversity on Parking, Humanoid, and DonkeyCar. Mean area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) exceeds the strongest baseline by 97%, 12%, and 39%, respectively, and gains on five out-of-distribution test sets reach 145%, 29%, and 44%. Under the same simulator-validation budget, the best "DreamTest + search" combinations find 29%, 22%, and 79% more novel failures on average. Across clusterings with k = 2-40, failures generated with DreamTest cover the most behavioural clusters for almost all k, indicating that DreamTest consistently discovers behaviourally diverse failures.

</details>


### [7] [Practical Runtime Enforcement of First-Order Temporal Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04611)
*François Hublet,David Basin,Srđan Krstić*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种高效执行复杂时序需求（含义务）的算法与工具 EnfFlash，通过识别可低复杂度执行的 MFOTL 片段并编译为命令式程序，显著降低运行时延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行时执行器需保证系统始终满足其需求，但许多需求不仅约束当前行为，还对未来行为施加义务（如期限内删除个人数据）。在合规要求日益增多的背景下，系统可能面临数百项此类需求。然而现有支持复杂策略的执行机制对生产软件而言过慢，开发者退而使用非时序的访问控制与临时插桩，但这些方案随需求复杂度扩展性差。

Method: 1) 识别出 Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) 的一个片段，可在低运行复杂度下执行，同时支持包括义务在内的丰富实用需求；2) 为该片段设计执行算法，并实现为工具 EnfFlash；3) 通过将需求编译成命令式程序并高效解释执行来获得性能。

Result: EnfFlash 在标准基准上延迟比前最先进执行器 EnfGuard 低至多 44 倍，在 LLM 智能体安全策略上低至多三个数量级。集成到 Web 应用中，可执行长达 400 行、描述 GDPR 的 MFOTL 公式，每次页面浏览仅增加不到 15 毫秒延迟。

Conclusion: EnfFlash 能高效执行复杂时序需求（含义务），性能足以满足大多数交互式与实时应用，表明其可作为实用的运行时执行后端。

Abstract: Runtime enforcers observe a system's behavior and exert control over it to ensure that the system always adheres to its requirements. Many natural requirements not only formulate restrictions on the system's present behavior, but also impose obligations on its future behavior; for instance, agentic security may require personal data collected during a run to be erased by some deadline. In an ever-growing compliance landscape, real-world systems may be subject to hundreds of such requirements. However, existing enforcement mechanisms supporting complex policies are often too slow for production software; instead, developers may resort to non-temporal access control mechanisms and ad-hoc instrumentation, but these scale poorly with requirement complexity.
  To address this problem, we introduce an efficient algorithm and tool for enforcing complex temporal requirements and demonstrate its performance. Specifically, we identify a fragment of Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) that can be enforced with low runtime complexity while supporting a rich family of practically relevant requirements, including obligations. We then design an enforcement algorithm for this fragment and implement it in EnfFlash, a novel tool that enforces requirements with latency up to 44x lower than EnfGuard, the previous state-of-the-art enforcer, on standard benchmarks, and up to three orders of magnitude lower on security policies for LLM agents. This performance is achieved by compiling requirements into imperative programs that we efficiently interpret. We evaluate EnfFlash both standalone, on existing benchmarks, and integrated in web applications as an enforcement backend. We demonstrate that it can enforce a substantial 400-line MFOTL formula specifying the GDPR on a social network while adding under 15 ms to each page view, which is sufficient for most interactive and real-time applications.

</details>


### [8] [When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04639)
*Xiang Li,Aichun Huang,Mingming Zhang,Zheli Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次在同一攻击套件与判定标准下，比较LLM的"模拟模式"（S-mode，扮演协议实现）与"开发模式"（D-mode，编写被攻击的程序），并以知识探针为基线，评测15个模型在4种协议实现上的安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM既被用于模拟网络协议实现（如蜜罐），也被用于编写协议实现，但已有研究将两者分开评估，且没有研究把模型的"知识探针回答"与"同一模型写出的代码"进行对比，因此存在评估空白。

Method: 设计并实现一个统一的测试框架，用同一套攻击套件和同一判定标准同时评判S-mode、D-mode与知识探针，并在4种协议实现（重组、HTTP、防火墙、DNS）上评测15个LLM。

Result: 在完整安全规范下，重组、HTTP、防火墙实现的中位模型攻击成功率不超过4%；DNS则S-mode为13%、D-mode为15%。D-mode中补上缺失的DNS要求可将攻击从100%降至34%且只影响该项检查；删除已有规则则会削弱其他检查。事先询问模型无法预测程序是否具备某项检查：14个写DNS解析器的模型中13个会提到该检查，但42个程序全部缺失。S-mode能标出82%的真实DNS漏洞、96%的安全案例未被误报，但存在双向误差。

Conclusion: S-mode可作为初步过滤手段，但不能替代D-mode的实际测试；即使模型能背出安全要求，也应在规范中明确写下这些要求。

Abstract: LLMs are used both to simulate network protocol implementations, as honeypots do, and to write them. Prior work evaluates the two uses separately, from a model's answers or conversations in one case and from its generated code in the other. We observe that a knowledge probe (asking the model which security checks an implementation needs) and a conversation can credit security checks that the generated program lacks, but no study has compared them with the code the same model writes. To fill this gap, we present the first such comparison between simulation mode (S-mode), where the model plays the implementation in a conversation, and development mode (D-mode), where the model writes the program and the program is attacked, with a knowledge probe as a baseline. We design and implement a harness that judges all three with one attack suite and one oracle, and evaluate 15 LLMs on four protocol implementations. We find that with the full security specification, the median model's attack success is at most 4\% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13\% in S-mode and 15\% in D-mode on DNS. In D-mode, adding the missing DNS requirement to the specification cuts that attack from 100\% to 34\% and changes only that check, whereas deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too. Asking the model beforehand does not predict which checks a program has, since 13 of the 14 models that write a DNS resolver name the check, yet all 42 programs lack it. S-mode is a useful first filter, flagging 82\% of the real DNS vulnerabilities and leaving 96\% of the safe cases unflagged. It errs in both directions, over-reporting security checks that D-mode does not implement and under-reporting checks that D-mode does. S-mode can screen but not replace D-mode testing, and security requirements should be written down even when a model can recite them.

</details>

*Tairan Wang,Earl T. Barr*

Main category: cs.SE

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AI 编程代理普及，可读代码既便于人类审查代理生成结果，也有助于代理在有限上下文窗口内维护代码。然而现有可读性模型在不同数据集上与人类判断不一致，亟需更可靠、可解释的评估方法。

Conclusion: BTTF 兼顾最先进的基准性能、强变换鲁棒性与特征粒度的可解释性，为代码可读性评估提供了一种高效、透明且与人类判断更一致的方案。

Abstract: Code readability supports software understanding, review, and maintenance. As AI coding agents become more widely used, readable code helps both humans review agent-generated output and agents maintain code within limited context windows. Yet existing readability models do not consistently agree with human judgements across datasets.

Rather than using language models as black-box judges, BTTF uses them as measurement instruments. It combines traditional code measurements, embedding-based semantic organisation, and causal-LM predictability to capture source structure, semantic coherence, and contextual surprise.
  We evaluate BTTF on five publicly available human-rated readability benchmarks and our manually annotated MBJP development set, totalling 1,100 samples. BTTF improves average Spearman correlation over the strongest baseline by up to 0.101. Across 13 controlled readability-reducing transformations on production code, it achieves response rates of 93.8% in Java and 87.6% in Python, outperforming Dorn by 14% and 19.2%. It performs best among local models and trails the strongest cloud-LLM response by 1.7% in Java and 5.1% in Python. The direct-LLM baselines require an average of 1,083 prompt tokens per evaluation while remaining opaque. BTTF combines state-of-the-art benchmark performance and strong transformation robustness with feature-granular interpretability: every feature coefficient matches its theoretical directional effect across all evaluated model configurations.

</details>

Main category: cs.SE

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE, a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-REPAIR-BENCH, comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem-change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日志代码有助于调试与维护，但过度日志会带来噪声、运行时开销并掩盖诊断信息。已有研究多关注日志生成与修改，日志删除仍较少被探索。

Abstract: Logging code supports debugging, monitoring, and software maintenance, but excessive logging can add noise, impose runtime overhead, and obscure diagnostic information. While prior research has extensively studied logging code generation and modification, logging removal remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study developer logging removal practices and explore the use of coding agents for this task. We extract and manually validate logging removal cases from Python and Java repositories and derive 10 removal patterns and 11 removal reasons that characterize how and why logging code was removed in real-world software changes. We further construct LogRem, a dataset of 387 real-world cases covering direct logging statement removal, logging infrastructure removal, and logging replacement. We evaluate four coding agents with multiple model settings and compare their outputs with accepted real-world changes. Although 95.6% to 100.0% of outputs pass validity checks, only 11.1% to 19.6% remove the same logging code as the corresponding real-world change while preserving unrelated code. Agents differ through missed removals, extra removals, and unrelated code edits, with substantial variation across logging removal categories and trajectories. Execution cost varies widely, but higher cost does not consistently yield closer alignment. Commit messages and developer discussions provide the largest alignment gains, while taxonomy guidance consistently reduces runtime. Overall, our study establishes logging removal as a distinct software maintenance task and shows that reliable automation depends on accurately determining removal scope while preserving necessary code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to examine logging code removal from this perspective.

</details>

*Arjun Subramanian,George Xu,Nithilan Karthik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究并发AI编码代理的协调问题，提出"属性范围验证契约"与三轨基准MERGEGYM，并发现仅凭廉价信号（如文件集不相交）无法替代可执行检查器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并发AI编码代理会产生协调问题：廉价信号可用于排序或优先级判断，但只有可执行的检查器才能确立所声称的属性。论文旨在研究这种"信号"与"验证"之间的分离，并量化廉价代理信号的误配程度。

Method: 提出属性范围的验证契约与MERGEGYM三轨基准，覆盖开放时范围预测、重放条件下的冲突解决与调度。使用分层715对血缘集（含167个文本冲突），构建独立血缘并集规则、12特征逻辑回归模型和未调参随机森林，并进行补丁重建验证与冻结标签重放实验。

Result: 在715对中，79个冲突（47.3%）虽作者文件集不相交却仍冲突；独立血缘并集规则留出AUROC 0.877，逻辑回归0.882 [0.845, 0.917]、PR-AUC 0.661，随机森林0.902 [0.875, 0.928]、PR-AUC 0.701。33.3%重放预算下分别回收81.2%与82.9%冲突。48/79零重叠冲突补丁重建成功且全部转为干净，其余31例不确定。T1零样本LLM AUC 0.704、加元数据融合0.740；T3决策时门控在65.0%完工期通胀下去重叠中位91.7%的标签范围碰撞。

Conclusion: 由于本地git merge-tree重放成本极低（中位0.02秒），论文不主张血缘分诊能单独节省检查器成本——当精确重放足够廉价时应验证一切。所有实证保证仅限于文本可合并性或明确声明的冻结标签调度目标。

Abstract: Concurrent AI coding agents create a coordination problem in which cheap signals may prioritize work, but only an executable checker can establish the property being claimed. We study this separation through a property-scoped verification contract and MERGEGYM, a three-track benchmark for open-time scope forecasting, replay- conditioned conflict resolution, and scheduling. On a stratified 715-pair lineage set (167 textual conflicts), 79 conflicts (47.3%) occur despite disjoint authored file sets. This is an operationally important proxy mismatch expected from three-way merge: authored PR diffs are measured against PR-specific bases, whereas the checker compares both heads to their common merge base. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches held-out AUROC 0.877; a 12-feature logistic model reaches 0.882 [0.845, 0.917] with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same decision-time features reaches 0.902 [0.875, 0.928] with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% held-out replay budget, the logistic and random-forest models recover 81.2% and 82.9% of conflicts, respectively. Patch reconstruction succeeds for 48/79 zero- overlap conflicts and all 48 become clean; the other 31 cases are inconclusive, so this check validates the expected three-way-merge explanation rather than claiming a new Git mechanism. In T1, a zero-shot LLM reaches AUC 0.704 and LLM-plus- metadata fusion 0.740. In T3, a decision-time gate de-overlaps a median 91.7% of labeled scope collisions at 65.0% makespan inflation under frozen-label replay. Because local git merge-tree replay is already cheap in our logs (median 0.02 s), we do not claim that lineage triage saves this checker alone: when exact replay is cheap, verify everything. All empirical guarantees in this paper remain limited to textual mergeability or the explicitly stated frozen-label scheduling target.

</details>


### [13] [Agent Skill Evolution: How Revisions Affect Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04832)
*Jiajie Wang,Yutong Zhao,Tianlin Li,Huashan Chen,Jinfu Chen,Kebin Peng,Sen He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究分析了3,159个Agent Skills的2,608对修订，发现多数修订改变规则或流程，且新增规则能显著提升模型与智能体的合规率和正确性，但按需加载会削减收益，并带来输入token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skills（SKILL.md文件）像代码一样被反复修订，但修订对LLM编码智能体行为的影响尚不清楚，本文旨在刻画Skills的演化、给出可量化规则修订的效果与成本。

Conclusion: Skill修订是影响智能体行为的有效杠杆，尤其当新增规则给出具体命令或路径时能明显提升合规与正确性，但真实按需加载会稀释收益，且加载正文带来显著token开销，需在效果与成本间权衡。

Abstract: Agent Skills, the SKILL.md files that tell an LLM coding agent how a project works, are revised like code, yet what a revision does to the agent is unknown. From 2,608 first/last revision pairs of 3,159 Skills, we characterize how Skills evolve and how they change together with the configuration of the agent's harness. We then focus on rule changes, revisions that add or remove a rule we can check automatically, such as "run allium check". We measure their effect on 21 models in single answers and on four agents in a sandbox, and their cost on 20 of these models and the four agents. Most revisions (55%) change a rule or procedure, and commits that revise a Skill change harness files such as CLAUDE.md more often than other commits of the same size. Across 16 open-weight models, an added rule raises compliance in a single answer by +0.41 on average. Across the four agents, the rate at which the agent takes the required action rises by +0.23 on average (+0.16 to +0.36), and for the three agents that blind judges assessed, final correctness rises by +0.10 on average (+0.06 to +0.14). The gain comes mainly from rules that name a command or path the old Skill did not mention. Real tools load a Skill's body only when the agent decides it needs it. In that setting the four agents keep about half of the action gain on average (51%), and the three open models about 38%. A revision adds 18-19% input tokens to a single answer and no detectable cost to an agent episode, while loading a Skill's body raises the tokens of an episode by 50% on average.

</details>


### [14] [CARET: Training-Free Test-Time Scaling for Repository-Level Code Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04837)
*Jiajie Wang,Yutong Zhao,Kebin Peng,Sen He,Qing Guo,Tianlin Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CARET 是一种免训练方法，同时改进检索增强生成中的检索（R）与生成（G）两个阶段，在 18 个模型-数据集组合上平均提升精确匹配 10.8 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码补全工作主要关注检索阶段，忽视了生成阶段的改进潜力；作者认为检索与生成可以协同优化，尤其生成阶段可受益于测试时扩展（test-time scaling）。

Method: 针对 R：利用模型自身多次采样的"一致性"在多个检索上下文之间做路由，当样本分散时级联切换到备选上下文。针对 G：在缓存的 prompt 前缀上采样候选，使长检索上下文只编码一次；再用"反向上下文似然"选择最终补全——正确补全应让光标之后的代码更可能，即模型通过"向后阅读"给自己打分。

Result: 在 CrossCodeEval、RepoEval-Line、RepoEval-API 与 6 个代码模型（1.1B–7B，四个系列）上，18 个组合全部提升，平均超贪心解码 10.8 分、超 self-consistency@10 5.3 分；token 级计算约为单次生成的 1.45 倍（实测墙钟 1.3–2.9 倍，随生成器规模增大）。

Conclusion: 同时改进检索与生成比只改进检索能带来更准确的代码补全，且预算接近单次前向计算。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) dominates repository-level code completion: it retrieves cross-file context (R), then decodes one greedy completion (G). Existing work mainly focuses on retrieval and stops there. We argue both stages can be improved together, with generation in particular gaining from test-time scaling. We present CARET, a training-free method. For R, CARET routes among retrieval contexts using the agreement among its own samples, cascading to an alternative context when the samples scatter. For G, it samples candidates over a cached prompt prefix, so the long retrieved context is encoded once rather than once per sample. It then selects the final completion by reverse-context likelihood: a correct completion makes the code after the cursor more probable, so the same model grades its own candidates by reading ahead. Across CrossCodeEval, RepoEval-Line, and RepoEval-API with six code models (1.1B to 7B, four families), CARET improves exact match in all 18 combinations by 10.8 points on average over greedy decoding and 5.3 over self-consistency@10. Token-level compute stays near 1.45 times one generation (measured wall-clock 1.3-2.9 times, growing with generator size). Improving retrieval and generation together yields more accurate code than improving retrieval alone, at a budget that stays close to a single pass.

</details>


### [15] [Complex Agents, Shallow Tests: Demystifying and Enhancing Test Adequacy of Agent Harness in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04921)
*Yifan Xiong,Jingyi Ge,Zhenpeng Chen,Yiling Lou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 首次系统研究真实agentic系统中harness的测试充分性，发现LLM依赖型harness(LDH)代码严重缺乏测试，提出HarnessTester进行面向harness的测试生成，显著提升覆盖率与变异分数，并检测出122个真实缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的agentic系统正成为新软件范式，由骨干LLM与harness（承载agent执行的软件基础设施）组成。随着harness日益复杂，其实现缺陷带来可靠性隐患，但其测试充分性尚缺乏系统研究。

Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are emerging as a new software paradigm. Abstract: Agentic machine learning engineering (MLE) is an emerging AI4SE application for complex ML tasks and a step toward recursive self-improvement of AI systems. Abstract: Software agents increasingly depend on open-source components when executing tools and interacting with external systems. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used through terminal user interfaces (TUIs), yet task completion alone does not capture how difficult an interface is to understand and operate. Abstract: Formal specifications are essential for deductive program verification, providing semantic abstractions for compositional verification of complex software.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体依赖存储的操作记录作为后续行动前提，但环境或需求变化会使这些记录失效，而现有的动作审查、溯源追踪和澄清机制无法修正底层持久状态，导致任务失败和不安全修改。

Abstract: LLM agents combine reasoning, tool use, and persistent memory to support work across tasks by reusing stored operational records as premises for later actions. However, environmental or requirement changes can invalidate these records, while existing action review, provenance tracking, and clarification mechanisms may leave the underlying persistent state uncorrected. Our audit of coding-agent trajectories identifies candidate failure chains in which invalid records are reused, leading to task failures and unsafe modifications. We propose StateWise, a framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state before action execution. StateWise uses record-level counterfactual replanning to identify decision-critical records, then establishes their current validity through reliability checks, read-only verification of machine-observable facts, and targeted clarification of developer-owned intent. Typed evidence grounding binds evidence to specific records and scopes, enabling persistent corrections with repair lineage. The agent then replans from the repaired state, followed by an independent state-action check before execution. We evaluate StateWise on 150 executable coding-agent cases across diverse runtime environments, workspace configurations, and repository settings, complemented by cross-model evaluations. Under corrupted persistent state, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness, compared with 38.7% for the baseline agent, with no unsafe actions. Component ablations, multi-task experiments, and transfer evaluations further demonstrate effective recovery, persistent corrections, and transferability across repositories and tool interfaces.

</details>

Main category: cs.SE

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码语言模型需随库演化而维护：库更新后模型仍按训练时接口生成代码。修复模型本身可使一次修正惠及所有下游用途。现有修复方法假设"归因神经元即需修补神经元"且"通用更新适配所有失败"，但这两假设未被检验。

Result: 对比语义在6个设置中的3个显著选出更好的载体神经元，其余相当。ASTRA平均Pass@1为66.7%，而最佳基线（AlphaEdit、STAR、低秩适应）为48.4%，单样本修复耗时2.7秒。在全部6个设置及每种API变更类型上均最优，且在测试提示的未见改写下优势保持。对大模型副作用小，对小模型副作用较大。

Conclusion: 现有模型修复流程存在定位与定制两大缺口。ASTRA通过对比语义定位与闭式线性系统定制补丁同时解决二者，在API演化任务上全面超越现有方法，验证了归因与修补需分别处理的有效性，但小模型上的副作用仍需关注。

Abstract: Code language models must be maintained like the software around them: when a library evolves, a model keeps writing the interface that it saw during training. Repairing the model itself lets one correction reach all downstream uses. Existing repair methods attribute a failure to neurons, select the highest-ranked ones, and apply a generic update. This pipeline assumes that the attributed neurons are the ones to patch and that a generic update fits every failure, and neither assumption has been examined. We examine both on executable API evolution tasks in Python and Rust with three code models and identify two gaps. The targeting gap separates the neurons that failure attribution targets from the neurons that can carry a patch: their top sets have a Jaccard overlap of only 0.15 to 0.20. The tailoring gap separates a generic update from a patch built for the failure: the patches that different carrier neurons need are nearly orthogonal. To address both gaps, we propose ASTRA. It targets neurons by contrastive semantics, an attribution that scores a neuron by its contribution to the logit contrast between the target token and the produced token. It then tailors the patch by solving one small linear system in closed form, which corrects all failing tokens of a sample jointly and needs neither an optimizer nor a backward pass. Contrastive semantics selects significantly better carrier neurons than gradient-based attributions in 3 of 6 settings and comparable ones in the others. On average, ASTRA reaches 66.7 percent Pass@1, against 48.4 percent for the best of AlphaEdit, STAR and low-rank adaptation, and repairs a sample in 2.7 seconds. It is the best method in all 6 settings and for every type of API change, and this advantage persists under an unseen phrasing of the test prompt. Its side effects on unrelated code are small on the large models and larger on the small one.

</details>

Abstract: AI agents increasingly rely on tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to complete user tasks. Hundreds of thousands of MCP servers are listed across marketplaces, yet they are organized only by coarse, marketplace-specific server categories. This makes it difficult for agents and users to identify tools for a given operation, find functional alternatives, and assess how those alternatives differ. We present MCPacific, the largest tool-level, cross-marketplace map of the MCP ecosystem. MCPacific collects 368,754 MCP server listings corresponding to 124,267 unique servers across 17 marketplaces, statically extracts 1,328,233 tool specifications from these servers in seven languages, and organizes them into a hierarchical functional taxonomy of 58,915 capabilities. We construct the taxonomy through an iterative LLM-driven design-test-refine process and map the full corpus to it using calibrated embedding routing. Our study reveals that MCP extends well beyond developer tooling, with 85% of tools serving other domains. Functional alternatives are widespread but unevenly distributed: 98.5% of tools have at least one alternative, yet nearly a quarter of capabilities are supported by only one tool. Functionally comparable tools also differ in security alerts, code complexity, and project maintenance, with complexity differing by more than 2.5x in 41% of comparable tool pairs. Finally, presenting candidate tools through the taxonomy rather than a flat list improves task completion rate across all four evaluated models, with gains of up to 12 percentage points in Pass@0.75 for crowded candidate sets.

</details>

TL;DR: 本文提出 AFCRA（自适应反馈引导代码修订攻击），实证研究攻击者能否利用 AI 代码审查反馈"修复"被指出的问题、同时保留漏洞以骗取 PR 通过。基于 159 个已披露漏洞构建含可执行利用的 AFCRA-Bench，与 Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5.5 审查者五轮交互，攻击成功率分别为最强文本/评论类攻击的 2.5 倍与 12.5 倍，揭示 AI 辅助 PR 审查的新威胁并给出针对性建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PR 审查是代码进入用户前的安全防线，AI 智能体越来越多地承担此职责，并会说明需修复的问题。但对提交漏洞代码的攻击者而言，这些反馈恰好暴露了如何修改才能获批。现有 PR 攻击多依靠说服性文本或评论、保持可执行代码不变，因此尚不清楚攻击者能否利用反馈"修复"所报问题、同时在修订代码中保留漏洞。

Method: 提出 AFCRA（自适应反馈引导代码修订攻击）并开展实证研究。为区分成功攻击与真实修复，基于 159 个已披露漏洞构建 AFCRA-Bench，并配备可执行利用（exploit）以验证代码中的漏洞。随后与 Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5.5 审查者进行五轮交互测试。

Result: 在与 Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5.5 审查者的五轮交互中，AFCRA 成功率分别达到最强文本或评论类攻击的 2.5 倍和 12.5 倍。成功案例显示审查者会接受对已报问题的修复，却忽略了仍然存活的漏洞。

Conclusion: 反馈引导的代码修订构成对自动化 PR 审查的现实威胁。作者据此为研究者、AI 提供方、PR 审查者和 PR 作者提出可操作的建议，以保障 AI 辅助开发的安全。

Abstract: Pull-request review protects software before new code reaches users, helping prevent vulnerabilities that could expose users to attacks. AI agents increasingly perform these reviews and explain which problems need fixing. However, for an attacker submitting vulnerable code, this feedback also reveals what changes may secure approval. Existing PR attacks seek such approval through persuasive text and comments while keeping executable code fixed. This leaves unclear whether an attacker can use the feedback to repair the reported problem while preserving a vulnerability in the revised code. We therefore conduct an empirical study of this threat using AFCRA (Adaptive Feedback-guided Code Revision Attack). To distinguish successful attacks from genuine repairs, we construct AFCRA-Bench from 159 disclosed vulnerabilities, with executable exploits to verify vulnerabilities in code.
  Across five-round interactions with Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.5 reviewers, AFCRA reaches success rates 2.5x and 12.5x those of the strongest evaluated text- or comment-based attack. Case studies of these successes show how reviewers accept repairs of reported problems while overlooking surviving vulnerabilities. These findings establish feedback-guided code revision as a threat to automated PR review. To address this threat, we derive actionable implications for researchers, AI providers, PR reviewers, and PR authors on securing AI-assisted development.

</details>


### [27] [UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05622)
*Dolly Sah,Tanmay Sah,Harshul Jain,Tanya Sah*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 UndoBench 基准，通过反事实配对试验将 AI 智能体的"任务能力"与"故障恢复能力"解耦评估，发现名义完成率高但恢复成功率骤降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具型 AI 智能体基准主要评估名义任务完成情况，将基础规划能力与运行期故障恢复能力混为一谈，掩盖了智能体在故障恢复方面的真实脆弱性。

Method: 构建 UndoBench，覆盖 8 个企业领域的 36 个基础工作流与 36 个故障场景；在相同随机种子下用反事实配对试验，并引入线级效应历史与环境状态 oracle 来解耦任务能力与恢复能力。在 12 个留出测试工作流上，跨 2 个开源权重模型、2 个框架、3 种恢复范式进行 5,760 次执行（2,880 配对试验），并扩展至商用 API 模型与其他执行边界。

Result: 在冻结的 lost-acknowledgment 研究中，名义能力达 83.54%，而条件恢复成功率（CRSR）降至 46.72%；朴素重试在 53.33% 的试验中产生重复外部效应。商用 API 模型重现了能力—恢复分离现象。恢复具有阶段依赖性：变更前各方法表现相近；部分变更期间，朴素重试、逐调用幂等与零权限日志方法在复合工作流上失效；提交后但确认前，验证与服务端幂等显著提升安全性。

Conclusion: 仅评估名义任务完成会掩盖自主智能体中关键的、阶段依赖的恢复脆弱性，需将恢复能力作为独立维度进行评估。

Abstract: Tool-using AI agents are increasingly deployed across enterprise software systems, yet widely used benchmarks primarily evaluate nominal task completion, conflating baseline planning competence with operational fault recovery. We introduce UndoBench, a benchmark spanning 36 base workflows and 36 fault scenarios across 8 enterprise domains, decoupling task competence from recovery capability via counterfactual paired trials under identical seeds alongside wire-level effect-history and environment-state oracles. On 12 held-out TEST workflows across two open-weight models, two frameworks, and three recovery paradigms (5,760 executions / 2,880 paired trials) in the frozen lost-acknowledgment study, nominal competence reached 83.54% while conditional recovery success rate (CRSR) fell to 46.72%, with naive retry producing duplicate external effects in 53.33% of trials. Extensions to commercial API models reproduced this competence-recovery separation. Evaluations across complementary execution boundaries show that recovery is phase-dependent: before mutation, methods perform similarly without duplicate effects among capable trials; during partial mutation, naive retry, per-call idempotency, and zero-privilege journaling collapse on the evaluated composite workflows; after commit but before acknowledgment, verification and server-side idempotency substantially improve safety. These findings demonstrate that evaluating nominal completion alone masks critical, phase-dependent recovery vulnerabilities in autonomous agents.

</details>


### [28] [Finite State Machine-Based Traffic Orchestration for Multi-Engine Analysis Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05788)
*Ankit Kumar,Thirumoorthi Thangamani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种流量编排方法，将多个安全引擎的流量需求建模为单个复合有限状态机（FSM），运行时仅需查表即可决定转发配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代应用安全平台需将单一代理的实时流量分发给多个独立分析引擎（行为异常检测、认证分析、资源发现、访问控制检查等）。各引擎对流量的需求按各自节奏变化，但代理对每个资源只能执行一条转发指令，因此需要协调这些相互冲突的需求。

Method: 将全部引擎的组合需求建模为一个复合FSM，其状态空间为各引擎状态的笛卡尔积；每个可达的复合状态预先映射到一种转发配置，使运行时由协商降级为查表。并引入两项改进：把基于时间的过期作为一等FSM转移，实现声明式流量衰减；以及按状态的多层级输出，使单一机器可服务所有服务等级。设计完全声明式、引擎无关，可扩展至N个引擎而无需重构架构。

Result: 通过预映射可达复合状态到转发配置，运行时无需协商，仅需查询即可完成转发决策；时间过期与多层级输出两项改进分别支持声明式流量衰减和单机多服务等级。

Conclusion: 该流量编排方法具声明式、引擎无关特性，能扩展到N个引擎而无需架构重构，可有效解决多引擎流量需求冲突下的转发协调问题。

Abstract: Modern application-security platforms route live traffic from a single proxy into several independent analysis engines -- behavioral anomaly detection, authentication analysis, resource discovery, access-control inspection, among others. Each engine's appetite for traffic changes on its own schedule, yet the proxy can honor only one forwarding instruction per resource. We present a traffic-orchestration method that models the combined needs of all engines as a single composite finite state machine (FSM) whose state space is the Cartesian product of per-engine states. Every reachable composite state pre-maps to one forwarding configuration, so runtime reduces to a lookup rather than a negotiation. We add two refinements: time-based expiry treated as a first-class FSM transition enabling declarative traffic decay, and per-state multi-tier outputs that let one machine serve every service level. The design is fully declarative, engine-agnostic, and scales to N engines without re-architecture.

</details>


### [29] [PreMaQ: Predicting Maintainability-Related Quality of LLM-Generated Code Before Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05858)
*Taiki Wakamatsu,Yuta Ishimoto,Masanari Kondo,Yasutaka Kamei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 PreMaQ，在代码生成之前从大模型内部表征中预测所生成代码的 Code Smell Score 和 Maintainability Index，用以及早评估可维护性质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型生成的代码除功能正确性外，还需关注可维护性质量。若能在生成前预估质量，开发者可避免生成、审查和丢弃低质量代码的成本。已有工作证明功能正确性可提前预测，但可维护性相关质量是否同样可预测尚不明确。

Method: 提出 PreMaQ（Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction），利用 LLM 生成前的内部表征预测所生成代码的 Code Smell Score（CSS）和 Maintainability Index（MI）。在 4 个开放权重 LLM 和 4 个 Python 代码生成基准上评估，共 2,695 个任务。

Result: 在全部 16 个模型-基准组合中，预测的 CSS 和 MI 与观测值一致相关，平均 Spearman 秩相关分别为 0.57 和 0.65。用于模型选择时，在多个模型均生成功能正确代码的任务上，PreMaQ 可达到理想可维护性选择器相对随机选择所能获得质量提升的 59.5%；结合提示嵌入后提升至 60.7%，说明两种信号互补。

Conclusion: PreMaQ 能够在生成前预测并改善 LLM 生成代码的可维护性相关质量。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable of code generation, adopting generated code in software development requires assessing not only its functional correctness but also its maintainability-related quality. If such quality could be estimated before generation, developers could avoid the cost of generating, reviewing, and discarding low-quality code. Although prior work has shown that the functional correctness of the LLM-generated code can be predicted in advance, it remains unclear whether maintainability-related quality is similarly predictable. We introduce Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction (PreMaQ), which predicts the Code Smell Score (CSS) and Maintainability Index (MI) of generated code from the internal representations of LLMs before generation. Our evaluation covers four open-weight LLMs and four Python code generation benchmarks, comprising 2,695 tasks in total. Our results show that predicted CSS and MI consistently correlate with their observed values across all 16 model-benchmark combinations, achieving mean Spearman rank correlations of 0.57 and 0.65, respectively. When used for model selection, PreMaQ achieves 59.5% of the maintainability-related quality improvement attainable by an ideal maintainability-based selector over random selection on tasks for which multiple models generate functionally correct code. Combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings increases this proportion to 60.7%, indicating that the two signals are complementary. These findings suggest that PreMaQ can be used to predict and improve the maintainability-related quality of LLM-generated code.

</details>


### [30] [Adopting InnerSource in a Public Sector Organization: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05947)
*Muhammad Usman,Johan Linåker,Deepika Badampudi,Hannes Salin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究了瑞典某公共部门组织中内源（InnerSource）的采纳情况，通过九次半结构化访谈和一次13人参加的内部研讨会，分析了其动机、挑战与改进策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内源被视为改善大规模软件开发的有效方式，但其在公共部门组织中的应用证据仍然有限，亟需实证研究加以补充。

Abstract: Trust is crucial in the digital world, particularly in the age of systems based on artificial intelligence. Therefore, external stakeholders need to trust a system throughout its operation. To address this challenge, we propose the concept of continuous trust. In this paper, we present a detailed explanation of this concept, based on a running example of a business's refund department. The paper concludes with a discussion of related work, such as compliance checking and certification, as well as an outlook on further questions regarding the formalization and the necessary tool support.

</details>


### [33] [AgentSpy: Making AI Agent Behavior Observable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06001)
*Christoph Bühler,Matteo Biagiola,Luca Di Grazia,Guido Salvaneschi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 AgentSpy，从外部监控 LLM 智能体执行过程的系统调用与网络流量，支持一致性（义务）与安全性（禁止）两类分析，并在 77 个任务与安全攻击检测上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体以用户权限运行 shell 命令、读写文件并访问网络，但其执行过程难以理解：测试只断言结果，智能体轨迹仅记录其自我报告内容，可能遗漏子进程行为。因此需要从外部观测智能体真实行为。

Abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network, typically with their user's privileges. However, what an agent does during an execution is difficult to understand: tests assert on the result, and the agent's trajectory records only what the agent reports about itself, which may omit behavior executed by its subprocesses. We present AgentSpy, an approach that observes an agent from outside the agent. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment, configured by a declarative specification, and records the system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it executes. Based on this monitoring, AgentSpy supports two families of analyses: conformance analyses, which measure obligations, i.e., what an agent execution should do, and safety analyses, which check prohibitions, i.e., what an agent execution must never do. We instantiate one analysis of each family. The reliability analysis uses rules to summarize each run by the environment resources the agent uses: the commands it executed, the files it accessed, and the hosts it contacted. The security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an execution. For reliability, we evaluated AgentSpy on 77 tasks with the codex harness and three recent LLMs, executing each task three times. Sets of repeated runs of the same task are more similar than sets that include runs of another task in 92.2% of the comparisons. Among tasks for which all three runs pass outcome-based tests, the agent performs task-unrelated activities in 18% of the cases, reads the grading files in 7%, and does not use the developers' guidance in 17%. For security, the generic rules of AgentSpy detect four of five attack categories we considered, with no false positives across 50 runs.

</details>

Abstract: Small independent (indie) game startups face fierce competition when developing games with limited time, budget, and resources. Such continuous experimentation (CE) requires access to users and user data, which is often very limited in the early stages of development, both in general and, in particular for indie game companies. We provide insights and recommendations on how to perform experimentation and game testing in pre-release stages of indie game development based on an exploratory interview survey with 10 independent game developers from different companies. We provide a framework for CE that highlights key parts to consider when planning and implementing an experiment. Current practices for experimentation within indie game development are also described for the early development stages of ideation, preproduction, feature production, and content production. Our empirical findings offer insights and recommendations into how to conduct experiments during pre-release stages of game development, specifically for Indie game companies. Abstract: Agentic AI assistants increasingly act on developers' behalf by modifying files, executing commands, and accessing external resources. These actions often require permission, yet little is known about how practitioners make permission decisions while still benefiting from agent autonomy. To address this gap, we conducted a sequential mixed methods study, interviewing 18 practitioners who use AI agents and then surveying 115 practitioners based on the interview findings. We find that practitioners often understand agent behaviour through what they can directly observe and review, while decisions, data use, and other activity behind the scenes remain less clear. This uncertainty also shapes permission decisions, which depend on the scope and risk of an action, whether it fits the task, familiarity with the agent, and the environment in which it operates. Practitioners respond by adjusting how closely they oversee agents, from setting limits in advance to monitoring execution and reviewing work afterwards. How much scrutiny they apply depends on factors such as trust, task importance, time pressure, and the consequences of an action. Our findings suggest that permission systems should make consequential actions easier to review, distinguish what an agent is allowed to do from what the user intended, make reversibility clearer, avoid treating repeated approvals as stable preferences, and distinguish rejecting a single action from rejecting an entire approach.

</details>


### [36] [Where Does the Budget Go? Structural Concentration in Learning-Based Mutant Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06055)
*Taha Rostami,Jeongju Sohn,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究基于学习的变异体选择方法的分布风险，提出 LinePool 分层策略将选择分散到各源码行，以提升行为多样性与缺陷发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学习的变异体选择虽在缺陷发现和子包含变异体选择上潜力巨大，但其被选变异体在代码位置上的分布、该分布对行为多样性和缺陷发现的影响尚不清楚；初步发现该方法会集中于少数代码位置，可能造成"盲点"，使缺陷逃逸。

Method: 提出 LinePool：一个简单、与模型无关的分层（stratification）步骤，在保留底层排序信号的同时将选择分散到各源码行。在 2% 与 5% 两种预算、两个数据集上进行评估，并与聚类及既有多样化方法对比。

Result: 学习型选择将预算集中于少数代码位置；在较大程序上被选变异体的杀死行为重叠度高。LinePool 显著提升空间覆盖、降低杀死集重叠，在紧预算下提升缺陷发现，并使选择对不完美或偏移的排序信号更鲁棒。与聚类及既有多样化方法相比，无方法能在所有数据集上稳定优于 LinePool。

Conclusion: 设计并评估变异体选择方法时，应在有效性之外同时考虑行为多样性；利用程序的结构元素是实现这种多样性并保持有效性的简单途径，LinePool 可作为通用、简单的多样化步骤。

Abstract: Learning-based mutant selection is used to reduce the cost of mutation testing by ranking and selecting the mutants that seem to be the most promising. Prior work has shown great potential for this approach in fault revelation and subsuming-mutant selection. However, the risks and benefits of these approaches -- especially the distribution of selected mutants across code locations and how that distribution affects behavioral diversity and fault revelation -- remain unclear. We investigate this distribution and its effects, and introduce LinePool, a simple, model-agnostic stratification step that distributes selections across source lines while retaining the underlying ranking signal. Across two datasets and budgets (2% and 5% of the mutants), we find that learning-based selection concentrates the budget on a few code locations, and may thereby systematically introduce 'blind spots', untested code areas, allowing faults to escape detection. On larger programs, the selected mutants also exhibit substantial overlap in kill behavior. LinePool substantially increases spatial coverage and reduces kill-set overlap. It also improves fault revelation at tight budgets and makes selection more robust to imperfect or shifted ranking signals. Comparisons with clustering and established diversification methods show that none consistently outperforms LinePool across datasets, supporting its use as a simple diversification step. In general, our results suggest that behavioral diversity should be considered alongside effectiveness when designing and evaluating mutant-selection methods, and that exploiting structural elements of the program is one simple way to obtain such diversity while maintaining effectiveness.

</details>

*Hai Dang Truong,Rayner Goh,Thanh Le-Cong,Yintong Huo*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅用单元测试评估补丁，无法衡量代理是否遵守仓库特定的贡献政策（风格、git、测试流程等），导致代理贡献能否被合并、是否可维护仍是未知。

Abstract: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering. We develop a semi-automated pipeline that converts developer documentation across 12 open-source repositories into 823 machine-checkable atomic policies. SWE-CC introduces two features: 1) lightweight, deterministic checker functions that represent each policy, 2) a comprehensive auditing mechanism that inspects both agent runtime behaviors and final deliverables. We evaluate the compliance of agent workflows in 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified. Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1 percent of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps. These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.

</details>


### [38] [LLM Non-Determinism in Deterministic Processes: A Controlled Variation Space for Constraining the Propagation of Non-Determinism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06255)
*Paul Darius Mandl,Peter Mandl,Martin Häusl*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"受控非确定性"(Controlled Non-Determinism)方法，通过确定性包络(Deterministic Envelope)将LLM处理限定在受控变异空间内，使不同运行可产生不同但可接受的结果，而向权威状态的转移依然可控。


<details>

Computationally efficient machine learning methods, such as random forest, provide the largest net savings on smaller buildings, whereas more resource-intensive approaches, such as fine-tuned large language models, become advantageous as building size increases. On the hard side, for every fixed $k \ge 4$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$, there is a fixed sentence $\varphi_\varepsilon$ in $\mathrm{PP}^{k}$ over a single binary relation symbol, depending on $\varepsilon$ but not on the input structure, whose evaluation cannot be performed in $O(m^{k-\varepsilon})$ time. Abstract: We present Guanaco, an algorithm for performing conjunctive query evaluation where, for each Boolean conjunctive query, and positive epsilon, the algorithm achieves polynomial time with exponent equal to the submodular width plus epsilon. Abstract: Protocol choices can change the conclusions drawn from log anomaly detection benchmarks even when detector settings are fixed. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. Conclusion: 通过部分求值与分组遍历，TreeWalker 在不改变训练的前提下显著加速共享特征值的树集成推理，并保持数值精度，适用于生存分析、CTR 预测和情景分析等场景。

Abstract: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. Method: 在过参数化线性化框架下，分析投影梯度下降的收敛解 Δ_P=PJ^⊤(JPJ^⊤)^{-1}r，推导平方位移膨胀与保留拟合容量 c_P(r) 的倒数关系；将终端旧任务二次比率分解为 1/[c_P(r)G_end(P,r)]，其中 G_end 比较端点方向的曲率；在秩一情形分析 G_end 与单步探针增益的关系；提出终端零空间校正方法，并在 Permuted MNIST 和 Split CIFAR-100 上进行受控验证。

Abstract: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. Abstract: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. In unconditional sequence generation, PLLM reduces the fraction of samples below a heuristic 1.5-bit residue-composition entropy threshold by 54% relative to the amino acid model across sampling temperatures. For sequence-to-structure prediction, replacing the original GCP-VQVAE Lite tokenizer with SLL reduces best validation perplexity by 34% under matched training. For long proteins, latent-token sampling is approximately 1,000 times faster than MSA-based AlphaFold2 in our measurements. In backbone generation, SLLM compares favorably with other generative models on diversity and novelty. We also observe early signs that using SLLM's internal token confidence for inference-time sampling can improve sequence-to-structure prediction quality beyond a single decoded sample. These results position learned latent protein languages as a promising substrate for autoregressive transformer scaling and inference-time sampling in protein generation.

TL;DR: 本文研究带对抗性凸损失和约束的在线凸优化问题（COCO）。作者提出一种结合连续Hedge与收缩可行集上消除策略的在线算法，实现 O(√(T log T)) 遗憾和 O(log² T) 累积约束违反，将约束违反从多项式级降至多重对数级，同时保持近最优遗憾。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 方法结合连续Hedge与在收缩可行集上的消除机制。关键观察是：当Hedge分布的均值违反约束时，Grünbaum不等式保证常数比例的Hedge概率质量被消除。作者使用自适应学习率调度，并构造一个将存活体积与学习率耦合的势函数，把概率质量削减转化为CCV的界。

Result: 算法实现 O(√(T log T)) 遗憾和 O(log² T) 的CCV，将CCV从多项式级降至多重对数级，并保持近最优遗憾。

Conclusion: 该在线策略表明，在对抗性凸损失与约束下可同时获得近最优遗憾和多重对数级累积约束违反，优于现有 O(√T) 遗憾与 Õ(√T) CCV 的结果。

Abstract: We study constrained online convex optimization with adversarial convex losses and constraints ($\mathsf{COCO}$). At each round \(t\in[T]\), a learner selects \(x_t\) from a \(d\)-dimensional convex decision set \(\mathcal X\), after which an adaptive adversary reveals a convex cost function \(f_t\) and constraint function \(g_t\). Consequently, the learner incurs cost \(f_t(x_t)\) and constraint violation \(\max\{0,g_t(x_t)\}\), and aims to simultaneously minimize regret and cumulative constraint violation ($\mathsf{CCV}$) over the entire horizon. Existing algorithms achieve \(O(\sqrt{T})\) regret and \(\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})\) $\mathsf{CCV}$. We show that an online policy can achieve \(O(\sqrt{T\log T})\) regret and \(O(\log^2 T)\) $\mathsf{CCV}$, reducing the $\mathsf{CCV}$ from polynomial to polylogarithmic while retaining near-optimal regret. Our approach combines continuous Hedge with elimination on shrinking feasible sets. The key observation is that whenever the mean of the Hedge distribution violates a constraint, Grünbaum's inequality guarantees that a constant fraction of the Hedge probability mass is eliminated. We use an adaptive learning-rate schedule and a potential function coupling the surviving volume with the learning rate to convert this probability-mass reduction into a bound of \(O(\log^2 T)\) on the $\mathsf{CCV}$.

</details>

*Eeham Khan,Abdulmoumen Al-Atrash,Ali Ayub*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出选择性反向传播（SBP），一种确定性参数预算框架，将梯度更新限制在预分配的参数子集上，在FSCIL中实现接近朴素微调的训练成本、优于先前SOTA的效率和良好的稳定性-可塑性平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FSCIL方法面临难以调和的权衡：简单微调计算高效但存在灾难性遗忘；基于回放的方法虽缓解遗忘，但计算和内存开销大；无样本方法多通过冻结大部分骨干网络来减少遗忘，效率提升却牺牲了适应性。因此需要一个能同时兼顾稳定性、可塑性与效率的方案。

Method: SBP将梯度更新限定在一个预先分配好的网络参数子集上，冻结过去的知识并为未来学习保留无偏容量，从而避免昂贵的掩码优化即可实现快速适应。此外，作者在跨域设置以及80个会话的ImageNet-1K流上评估FSCIL方法。

Result: SBP在标准FSCIL基准上取得强劲表现，训练时间接近朴素微调，且显著低于先前SOTA方法。实验还揭示了标准FSCIL评估的局限：在短且分布一致的基准上的表现未必能预测分布偏移或更长学习周期下的行为。在跨域和有80个会话的ImageNet-1K流场景下，SBP仍保持强劲且训练成本低。

Conclusion: SBP提供了一个在稳定性、可塑性与效率之间取得良好权衡的FSCIL方案，同时指出标准FSCIL评估的不足，呼吁采用跨域与长会话场景进行更全面的评测。代码已开源。

Abstract: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) requires models to continuously learn new classes from limited samples while retaining prior knowledge, under strict constraints on compute and memory. Existing approaches lie along a difficult trade-off: simple fine-tuning is computationally efficient but suffers from catastrophic forgetting, replay-based methods mitigate forgetting at the cost of substantial compute and memory, and exemplar-free methods often reduce forgetting by freezing most of the backbone, improving efficiency at the expense of adaptability. We propose Selective Backpropagation (SBP), a deterministic parameter budgeting framework that bridges this gap. SBP restricts gradient updates to a pre-allocated subset of network parameters, freezing past knowledge and preserving unbiased capacity for future learning, enabling rapid adaptation without costly mask optimization. We show that SBP achieves strong performance across standard FSCIL benchmarks while requiring training time close to that of naive fine-tuning and substantially lower training time than prior SOTA methods. Crucially, our experiments expose a limitation of standard FSCIL evaluation: performance on short, distribution-consistent benchmarks does not necessarily predict behavior under distribution shift or over substantially longer learning horizons. We therefore evaluate FSCIL methods in cross-domain settings and over an 80-session ImageNet-1K stream. SBP remains strong across these regimes while maintaining low training cost, providing a favorable stability-plasticity-efficiency trade-off. Our code is available at https://github.com/PaInt-Lab/sbp-main-public.

</details>


### [66] [Slaying the Hydra: Interaction-Aware Circuit Discovery in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04017)
*Sankaran Vaidyanathan,Rafal Urbaniak,Emily Bunnapradist,Michelangelo Naim,Daniel Waxman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WISE因果估计量族与JuntaLearner电路发现方法，解决现有组件打分方法忽略上下文依赖交互、排名不准的问题，并在多任务多模型上取得更优的电路识别表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制可解释性希望将模型行为定位到具体组件，但逐个给组件打分会忽略上下文依赖效应：主组件可能抑制备份组件激活，导致组件排名失真。实际因果关系虽可用"witness"变量刻画这类交互，但传统估计需组合枚举，实际不可行。

Result: 在多个任务和规模递增的模型上，JuntaLearner在所有指标上的平均CRS均高于归因基线方法。其计算成本不随候选组件数量增长，因此可扩展到大型模型，同时兼顾集合级交互并避免一阶近似。

Conclusion: 通过在估计中引入并期望化witness机制，可在计算可行前提下捕捉组件间的上下文依赖交互，JuntaLearner可扩展且优于归因基线，为机制可解释性中的电路发现提供了更有效的方案。

Abstract: Localizing behavior to individual components of a language model is a central goal of mechanistic interpretability. However, scoring components one at a time misses context-dependent effects: a primary component can inhibit the activation of a backup, leading to issues with ranking components. Actual causality studies the structure of such interactions via witnesses: variables that provide contextual information to resolve interaction terms. However, estimation with witnesses typically requires combinatorial enumeration and is infeasible in practice. We introduce the witness-integrated set effect (WISE), a family of causal estimands that build on the witness mechanism while taking expectations over sets of causes and witnesses to remain computationally feasible. Building on this approach, we introduce JuntaLearner, a gradient-based circuit discovery method that learns to rank components by their causal impact across varying-sized sets of components and witnesses. Alongside faithfulness metrics, we introduce measures of necessity and task specificity, and the circuit recognition score (CRS) to summarize each metric across circuit sizes while emphasizing effects achieved by small circuits. Across tasks and models of increasing size, JuntaLearner achieves higher mean CRS compared to attribution baselines on all metrics. Since its cost does not grow with the number of candidate components, JuntaLearner scales to large models while accounting for set-level interactions and avoiding first-order approximations.

</details>

Abstract: Gastric Adenocarcinoma is a leading cause of cancer mortality. Abstract: Data assimilation combines model forecasts with noisy, incomplete observations to estimate the evolving state of a dynamical system. Existing methods face two compounding challenges: high-dimensional nonlinear dynamics make repeated forward simulation computationally expensive, while sparse observations provide limited direct information about the full state. To address these challenges, we propose the Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filter (LD-EnFF), a sequential Bayesian filtering framework that performs both forecast propagation and filtering updates in a compact latent space. LD-EnFF combines a latent dynamics surrogate for ensemble propagation with a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based observation model that evaluates a state-dependent observation likelihood in latent space. At each assimilation step, an ensemble filtering update based on flow matching uses the forecast ensemble and this likelihood to generate posterior samples, jointly updating latent states and uncertain parameters. This design avoids repeated full-state simulation during forecasting and full-field reconstruction during likelihood evaluation. LD-EnFF substantially outperforms a broad range of data assimilation algorithms on benchmarks spanning Kolmogorov flow, tsunami propagation, and atmospheric modeling, all featuring complex dynamics and sparse, noisy observations.

</details>


### [69] [Cut Binary Cross Entropy: Efficient Large-Vocabulary Loss and Gradient Kernels for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05559)
*Yaoyiran Li,Haowen Ning,Mohamed Hammad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CutBCE 是一种精确、硬件加速的 JAX/Pallas 多标签 BCE 损失与梯度算子，通过融合重排公式与自定义 VJP 避免在 HBM 中物化 [B,N,V] logits，从而消除 OOM 并显著提升大规模推荐训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级序列推荐涉及 10^5–10^7 规模的物品目录，多标签模型使用全词表 BCE 损失，标准 BCE 会在 HBM 中物化密集 [B,N,V] logits，导致 O(BNV) 内存开销和致命 OOM。尽管 LLM 的 Softmax 交叉熵已有分块优化，但大规模多标签 BCE 优化在深度学习生态中仍属空白。

Method: CutBCE 采用四项关键技术：(1) 精确融合重排，将损失分解为密集背景损失与稀疏目标修正；(2) 自定义 VJP 与专用 Pallas TPU 反向核，在正反向两遍中片上计算 logit 分块，使 logits 及其梯度从不驻留 HBM；(3) 动态 VMEM 预算与分片感知的集合通信提升，适配分布式网格；(4) 基于计数的零开销训练指标。

Result: 在单芯片 TPU v5e/v6e 小规模基准上，CutBCE 消除 OOM 并实现最高 91.9% 加速；在 8 芯片 TPU 切片、876k 物品（Yambda-50M）的多标签 SASRec 训练中，峰值 HBM 降低 65.7%（每芯片节省超 14 GiB），训练速度提升 225.9%，精度相当。

Conclusion: CutBCE 为大规模多标签 BCE 提供了精确且硬件高效的系统级解决方案，在不损失精度的前提下显著降低显存占用并加速训练，并已开源，可推广至工业推荐场景。

Abstract: Industrial sequential recommender systems operate over massive item catalogs (e.g., 10^5--10^7 items). Multi-label recommendation models are trained with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss over the full vocabulary, but standard BCE materializes a dense [B, N, V] logits tensor in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), incurring prohibitive $O(BNV)$ memory and fatal Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors. While chunked loss optimizations exist for Softmax Cross-Entropy in LLMs, large-scale multi-label BCE optimization remains unexplored across deep learning ecosystems.
  We propose CutBCE, an exact, hardware-accelerated BCE loss and gradient operator implemented in JAX and Pallas for large-vocabulary workloads. CutBCE introduces (1) an exact fused reformulation evaluating dense background loss and sparse target corrections; (2) a custom Vector-Jacobian Product (VJP) with a dedicated Pallas TPU backward kernel computing logit tiles on-chip in both passes so logits and their gradients never reside in HBM; (3) dynamic VMEM budgeting and sharding-aware collective hoisting for distributed meshes; and (4) count-based zero-overhead training metrics. On single-chip TPU v5e/v6e mini-benchmarks, CutBCE eliminates OOM errors with up to 91.9% speedup. On 8-chip TPU slice training for multi-label SASRec with 876k items (Yambda-50M), CutBCE reduces peak HBM by 65.7% (>14 GiB saved per chip) and increases training speed by 225.9% with comparable accuracy. CutBCE is open-sourced at https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/RecML/blob/main/recml/core/ops/binary_cross_entropy_ops.py.

</details>


### [70] [Protecting Sensitive Data in Image Synthesis via PAC-Private Adaptation for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04038)
*Boming Miao,Tao Zhang,Netanel Raviv,Murat Kantarcioglu,Bradley A. Malin,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于PAC隐私的扩散模型适配方法，直接实现重构隐私（RP），在相同重构隐私水平下比DP方法更好地保持主体身份、生成质量和下游分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据常被用来替代共享敏感记录，但基于扩散模型的合成数据并不保证隐私，攻击者仍可进行重构攻击。现有DP方法（如DP-SGD）虽能实现可证明的隐私训练，但其隐私保证（DP）与重构隐私（RP）之间的关系是间接的：DP通过限制输出对个体记录变化的敏感度来提供保证，而RP直接定义为限制攻击者关于敏感数据的后验分布与先验的差异。这种间接性导致显著的效用损失。因此作者希望直接针对RP设计隐私机制。

Method: 作者提出一种PAC隐私的扩散模型适配方法以实现重构隐私。由于PAC隐私直接以后验相对于先验的优势来定义，与RP直接相关。为在高维下实现可扩展的PAC私有化，方法分两步：首先使用LoRA或Textual Inversion学习一个紧凑的、依赖数据的扩散模型组件；然后从重复机制输出的协方差中校准各向异性高斯噪声。与DP-SGD不同，该方法在优化后仅对学习到的组件扰动一次，从而避免了跨梯度更新的隐私组合。

Result: 在少样本概念个性化（few-shot concept personalization）和全数据集图像合成任务上进行评估。结果显示，在达到相同重构隐私水平的情况下，所提方法比DP方法更好地保持了主体身份（subject identity）、生成质量以及下游分类精度。

Conclusion: 直接针对重构隐私的PAC隐私适配方法优于基于DP的扩散模型训练，能在保证同等重构隐私的同时显著减少效用损失，适用于少样本个性化与整体图像合成等场景。

Abstract: Synthetic data are increasingly used as an alternative to sharing sensitive records. However, synthetic data generation does not guarantee privacy, as diffusion models trained or adapted on sensitive data remain susceptible to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, while approaches that use differential privacy (DP), such as DP-SGD, achieve provably private diffusion model training, the repeated gradient clipping and noise injection they require result in significant utility loss. An important limitation of DP-based privacy is that, although it has a provable relationship to reconstruction privacy (RP), that relationship is indirect. RP is defined in terms of limiting how much an adversary's posterior distribution over sensitive data differs from the prior, whereas DP provides guarantees by bounding the sensitivity of outputs to changes in individual records. This indirection is an important source of the utility loss. To address this, we propose a PAC-private diffusion model adaptation to achieve reconstruction privacy. Since PAC-privacy is defined directly with respect to posterior advantage over the prior, it directly implicates RP. To obtain scalable PAC privatization in high dimensions, we first learn a compact data-dependent diffusion model component using LoRA or Textual Inversion, and then calibrate anisotropic Gaussian noise from the covariance of repeated mechanism outputs. Unlike DP-SGD, our method perturbs the learned component only once after optimization, thereby avoiding privacy composition across gradient updates. We evaluate the framework on few-shot concept personalization and full-dataset image synthesis, and show that the proposed approach better preserves subject identity, generation quality, and downstream classification accuracy than DP while achieving the same reconstruction privacy.

</details>


### [71] [PACMI: Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation for Long-Term LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05732)
*Yiqi Wang,Jiaqi Liu,Jiaqi Zhang,Zhangkai Wu,Yiqun Duan,Mingkai Zheng,Taotao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PACMI框架，用溯源图与类型化依赖边管理长期记忆的失效传播与历史保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务中依赖长期记忆，但新观察或领域证据会令旧记忆过时；这类记忆仍语义相关、影响下游记录并具历史价值，因此需要依赖追踪与历史保留两种能力。

Method: PACMI将记忆与新证据表示为溯源图中的节点，使用类型化依赖边；为记录分配四状态有效性格，将有效性变化传播至依赖记忆，并利用所得状态进行检索与陈旧前提检测。同时构建含5个领域、100个案例、300条查询的诊断基准，分节点级、上下文级与答案级评估。

Result: PACMI在该基准上取得最高最终答案准确率，与最强基线的配对差异在精确McNemar检验下显著；前提检查器在受控查询分布上精确率、召回率和F1均为完美；移除级联传播使最终答案错误从3增至11，但配对差异未达0.05显著阈值。

Conclusion: PACMI通过溯源感知的级联失效机制提升了记忆状态正确性与最终答案准确率，级联传播主要改善记忆状态正确性；代码与数据将公开。

Abstract: LLM agents rely on long-term memory to retain and reuse information when performing tasks over long horizons. Existing methods provide limited support for handling memories that become outdated as new observations or domain evidence arrive. Such outdated memories may remain semantically relevant, continue to affect dependent records, and retain value as historical evidence. This calls for two capabilities: dependency tracking to identify downstream effects and historical preservation to retain useful past records. We propose Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI), a framework that represents memories and new evidence in a provenance graph with typed dependency edges. PACMI assigns records to a four-state validity lattice, propagates validity changes to dependent memories, and uses the resulting states for retrieval and stale-premise detection. We also introduce a diagnostic benchmark with 100 cases and 300 queries across five domains. The evaluation separates node, context-, and answer-level performance. PACMI achieves the highest final-answer accuracy on this benchmark, and its paired difference from the strongest baseline is significant under an exact McNemar test. The premise checker achieves perfect precision, recall, and F 1 on the controlled query distribution. Cascading propagation primarily improves memorystate correctness: removing it increases final-answer errors from 3 to 11, but the paired difference does not reach the 0.05 significance threshold. Code and data will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [72] [Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04093)
*Jafar Badour,Maurice van Keulen,Elena Mocanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SNACK 提出一种真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接，并配套 SNACK-COO CUDA 内核，在 90%-99% 稀疏度下显著超越掩码稠密基线，降低显存与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络参数量不断增长，推高 GPU 训练与推理成本。稀疏神经网络与动态稀疏训练虽有望降本，但多数实现依赖稠密张量上的二值掩码，几乎无法兑现理论上的计算、显存和能耗节省。

Method: 提出 SNACK——真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接，提供简洁 PyTorch API 在稀疏范式下重构连接与反向传播；并给出 SNACK-COO 自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，采用批到流多处理器映射，针对大模型训练和单流推理中小批量、高稀疏的场景优化。

Result: 内核层面，95% 稀疏度下 SNACK 比 Dense+Mask 快达 7 倍，与 cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse 相当；90% 稀疏度下单层训练相比 Dense+Mask 和全稠密层分别加速 8 倍和 3.7 倍，推理加速 4 倍和 2 倍，显存比稠密少 72% 且能耗显著更低。端到端上，99% 稀疏度时 GPT-2 峰值训练显存最多降低 40%，图式推理延迟相比 Dense+Mask 降低 4.8 倍。

Conclusion: SNACK 通过真正的稀疏存储与计算，在高稀疏度下大幅提升速度、显存和能耗效率，为大规模模型训练与推理提供可行的稀疏化方案。

Abstract: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections.
