SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

</details>


### [73] [On architectural choices for interpretability and thermodynamic consistency in Physically Recurrent Neural Networks in the low-data regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04067)
*M. A. Maia,K. A. Meyer,A. M. C. M. van Gils,I. B. C. M. Rocha,F. P. van der Meer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究不同解码器架构对物理循环神经网络潜空间可解释性的影响，提出一种新的权重归一化约束以实现低数据下的稳健训练，并通过伴随编码器-解码器结构保证热力学一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望揭示解码器架构设计如何影响Physically Recurrent Neural Network潜空间的可解释性，并解决低数据训练与物理一致性（能量一致、非负耗散）的问题。

Method: 引入新的权重归一化约束作为正则化手段；通过视觉化探索潜空间与虚拟应力对齐真实RVE状态；采用多任务方法利用微观信息且不增加参数量；并设计伴随编码器-解码器结构（含正标量贡献）以强制热力学一致。

Result: 新的权重归一化约束提升了低数据下的训练稳健性；虚拟应力无需显式训练即可对齐真实RVE状态；多任务方法无需额外参数或更大训练集即可融合微观信息；伴随结构实现了跨尺度能量一致与非负耗散，并进一步降低训练需求。

Conclusion: 通过根植于底层物理的谨慎架构选择，可同时提升可解释性、归纳偏置与热力学一致性，并改善数据效率。

Abstract: In this paper, we unravel the effect of different decoder architectures on the interpretability of the latent space of the Physically Recurrent Neural Network. Particular emphasis is given to a new weight normalization constraint, which acts as a regularization technique and enables robust training in the low-data regime. A brief visual exploration illustrates how these changes impact the latent space and how the fictitious stress can align with the true state of the RVE without explicit training. Reaping the benefits of a meaningful latent space, a case study illustrates how information from the microscopic level can be retrieved and incorporated into a multi-task approach that does not require extra parameters or larger training sets. Another key contribution shows that a specific architectural choice can naturally lead to a thermodynamically consistent formulation. By enforcing an adjoint encoder-decoder structure with positive scalar contributions, this modification ensures energy consistency across scales and non-negative dissipation, leading to even lower training requirements. This alternative completes the study on interpretability, inductive bias, and thermodynamic consistency, and demonstrates that data efficiency can be improved with careful architectural choices rooted in the underlying physics.

</details>


### [74] [PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04537)
*Seoyoon Yum,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PhaseGate利用LLM推理的prefill/decode阶段作为准入信号，为CPU检索任务动态分配并发度，在保证LLM延迟的前提下大幅提升检索吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在统一内存系统上，GPU LLM推理与CPU检索并发运行。饱和的本地检索负载会显著抬高decode延迟（p95升高60-61%），而对prefill延迟影响很小（5.7-6.9%），说明检索并发对不同LLM阶段的干扰不对称，需要精细的准入控制。

Method: 将LLM推理阶段（prefill/decode）作为准入信号，提出PhaseGate：分别对prefill和decode校准独立的检索并发上限（在基础M4配置上分别为4和1）。设置对照TimeGate——使用相同的两个上限但按校准得到的固定调度运行，不观测LLM阶段。

Result: 在积压队列下，PhaseGate的聚合检索吞吐达到最佳可行固定策略的2.0倍，且所有7次留出运行中两个p95 LLM延迟指标均不超过无检索基线的1.25倍。TimeGate吞吐相近但每次运行都违反输出token延迟限制。M2与M2 Pro Mac mini复现了策略排序；输出长度扫描显示，随着decode占比增加，优势收窄。

Conclusion: 利用LLM阶段感知进行检索准入控制，能有效协调统一内存上CPU检索与GPU LLM推理的资源竞争；阶段盲的固定调度虽吞吐相当但无法保证延迟SLA，且优势随decode占比上升而减弱。

Abstract: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

</details>


### [75] [Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04071)
*Thanushi Withanage,Carol Espy-Wilson,Elizabeth Redcay,Desi Jones,Noah Sasson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种说话人无关的框架，利用声学到发音反演与协调复杂度指标，量化自闭症与非自闭症成人自发对话中的发音同步，发现非自闭症配对同步增强、自闭症配对中等、混合配对最弱，且同步性与对话成功感正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发音同步（发音器官协调随互动而调整）在自发对话中研究不足，尤其缺乏对自闭症说话者的探讨。以往研究多依赖任务导向、音素层面分析和侵入式测量手段，难以反映自然互动中的发音协调动态。

Method: 采用说话人无关框架，对自闭症与非自闭症成人组成的二人组自发对话进行分析；通过声学到发音反演获取发音运动信息，并使用协调复杂度指标，考察互动过程中发音协调的时间变化。

Result: 非自闭症配对的协调复杂度随时间增加、同步更强；自闭症配对呈现中等效应；混合配对（自闭症与非自闭症）对齐程度最低。发音同步越强，与自我报告的对话成功感越高相关。

Conclusion: 协调复杂度的提升可作为有效社会互动的标志；发音同步在自然对话中具有社会功能，且不同神经类型配对间存在差异，为理解自闭症社交互动提供了新视角。

Abstract: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics. We examine temporal changes in articulatory coordination across interaction. Non-autistic dyads exhibit increasing coordination complexity and stronger entrainment over time, autistic dyads show moderate effects, and mixed dyads demonstrate the least alignment. Greater articulatory entrainment correlates with higher self-reported conversational success, indicating increase in coordination complexity as a marker of effective social interaction.

</details>


### [76] [Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05458)
*Erland Hilman Fuadi,Chong Tian,Xiaosong Ma,Qirong Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 相同语言模型在不同GPU厂商上运行会产生logits差异，作者从位级、logit、top-K、token与任务准确率五个方面系统分析了这种跨厂商不一致的成因与缓解手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型权重和输入完全相同，但在不同GPU厂商（如AMD与NVIDIA）上运行同一语言模型却会产生不同的logits。这种跨厂商不匹配会影响可复现性、评测可比性乃至蒸馏训练，作者希望定位其来源并评估常见缓解方案（FP32上采样、LoRA等）的实际代价与收益。

Method: 对两个稠密模型和两个MoE模型，用五类指标（位级相等、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致率、任务准确率）测量跨厂商差异；将差异溯源到厂商矩阵指令内部的累加顺序；比较FP32上采样、仅MLP保持BF16、FP16、输出头LoRA等方案；并做跨厂商师生蒸馏实验。

Result: FP32上采样把稠密模型logit误差降低43%，但运行时间增至3倍；仅MLP保持BF16可保留94%的收益而只需1.3倍时间。MoE模型中FP32和FP16都降低概率误差却抬高logit误差并改变专家选择，FP16在稠密模型中失效，输出头LoRA也无效，因为最终隐状态无法预测该不匹配。训练阶段同样受影响：种子全部固定时，从AMD教师蒸馏的学生与从NVIDIA教师蒸馏的学生在MMLU上有431题答案不同。FP32上采样下位级相等几乎不变，而输出分布却大部分移向参考，说明用单一指标判断跨厂商一致性会同时误判成本与收益。

Conclusion: 跨厂商不匹配主要源于矩阵指令的累加顺序；完全FP32上采样代价高而收益可按需取舍（仅MLP BF16最划算），且该差异会传导到蒸馏训练结果。评估时应使用多指标，不能用单一度量判断一致性。

Abstract: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at https://github.com/crova-project/crova.

</details>


### [77] [DUET: Co-Evolving Solver and Grader Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04087)
*Fengyu Gao,Sourav Pal,Austin Z. Henley,Arjun Radhakrishna,Gustavo Soares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DUET框架，联合优化求解智能体（solver）与评分智能体（grader），将评估从固定反馈源转变为一等优化目标，在四个基准上同时提升两者性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作流在技术、金融、企业运营等领域广泛应用，持续改进智能体成为关键需求。但存在两个耦合难题：一是智能体应如何演化，需要有效评估来提供优化反馈；二是智能体演化后行为与失效模式会变化，固定评估器逐渐失效，那么又该如何评估不断演化的智能体。这两个问题相互影响。

Method: DUET采用迭代循环：选择训练任务，由solver执行，由grader评估结果，再用具备工具使用能力的更新模块修订solver与grader，并在多轮中交替更新二者。通过在优化循环内更新grader，使评估器与solver同步自适应。

Result: 在四个智能体基准上的实验表明，DUET同时提升了solver与grader的性能，并持续优于使用固定grader优化solver的基线方法。

Conclusion: 将评估器纳入优化循环、使其与solver协同演化，是提升智能体系统整体表现的有效途径。

Abstract: Agentic workflows are increasingly used across domains such as technology, finance, and enterprise operations. As these agents become more widely deployed, continually improving them becomes increasingly important. This raises an immediate challenge: How should the agent evolve? This evolution requires effective evaluation that can assess outcomes and provide useful feedback for optimization. As the agent evolves, its behaviors and failure modes may also change, making a fixed evaluator increasingly inadequate. Another fundamental question: How should we evaluate an evolving agent? These two challenges are inherently coupled; changes in agent behavior can expose limitations of the current evaluator, while a stronger evaluator provides more informative feedback for improving the agent. Motivated by this interaction, we introduce DUET, a framework that jointly optimizes a solver agent and a grader agent to improve both. DUET iteratively selects training tasks, executes them with the solver, evaluates the resulting outcomes with the grader, and uses a tool-using update module to revise the solver and the grader, alternating between the two across rounds. By updating the grader within the optimization loop, DUET turns evaluation from a fixed source of feedback into a first-class optimization objective that adapts alongside the solver. Experiments across four agent benchmarks show that DUET improves both solver and grader performance and consistently outperforms baselines that optimize the solver with a fixed grader.

</details>


### [78] [When the Cross-Silo Federation Goes Offline: Continual Learning for Site Onboarding with Limited Unlabeled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05598)
*Ahmadreza Eslaminia,Klara Nahrstedt,Chenhui Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种在加入站点本地自主扩展联邦学习模型的三阶段方法，无需标签即可同时保留旧类并识别新条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨孤岛联邦学习通常预先固定参与站点与可预测类别，部署后新站点晚加入、旧站点已离线、数据无标签，导致遗忘风险与类别扩展难题。

Method: 三阶段自主流程：重建专家筛选新颖样本，聚类将标记记录分离为候选条件，类均值描述旧类，均在同一共享表示内完成；证据可来自联邦持有的原型或加入站点的记录。

Result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集端到端无标签运行：两种来源旧类准确率≥0.868，遗忘≤0.063，差异仅0.021；在每新条件仅6条标注、每旧类保留3条时仍保持平衡，优于蒸馏与正则化基线。

Conclusion: 该方法让配置可依据披露限制而非精度选择，同时平衡新旧类性能，在极少标签下依然有效。

Abstract: An organization often holds too little labeled data to train a model that generalizes, and the records that would supply the rest sit with organizations that cannot release them. Cross-silo federated learning offers a way through, since participants exchange model parameters rather than records, but it ordinarily settles two aspects of the arrangement in advance, the participating sites and the classes the model can predict, and deployment can breach both. A new site joins after training, once the established sites have finished their engagement and gone offline, and its records arrive unlabeled, mixing conditions the model already recognizes with conditions no participant has observed. We present an autonomous three-stage procedure that expands the model entirely at the joining site: reconstruction experts screen for novelty, clustering separates the flagged records into candidate conditions, and class means describe the old classes, all inside one shared representation. Those classes were learned from records that never leave their owners, so the usual defenses against forgetting are unavailable, and the procedure supplies the evidence they would have carried from either of two dissimilar sources, prototypes held by the federation or records held by the joining site. On a real industrial condition-monitoring dataset, run end to end with no label consulted, either source holds old-class accuracy at 0.868 or above with forgetting at most 0.063, and the two differ by 0.021, so a configuration can be chosen by the disclosure it permits rather than the accuracy it delivers. Both keep old- and new-class accuracy in balance where every alternative we measure gives up one for the other, and both retain more of the old classes than distillation- and regularization-based baselines. The balance still holds with only 6 labeled records per arriving condition and 3 retained per old class.

</details>


### [79] [Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04089)
*Abhinav Rajput,Acey Vogelstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将代码智能体的澄清行为建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在期望提问预算约束下优化代码准确率，发现未调优的澄清行为是帕累托低效的，训练后策略能在更少提问的同时获得更高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码智能体在指令或提示模糊时需决定是提问澄清还是直接作答。澄清虽可提升解的准确性，但每次交互都会带来用户与系统成本，形成准确率与效率之间的权衡。现有研究虽考察了澄清行为，却未在可强制执行的澄清预算下训练策略；基于惩罚的方法通常还需针对各预算水平分别调参，成本高昂。

Method: 将澄清问题形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），以期望提问预算为约束、以代码准确率为目标，采用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练；在HumanEvalComm数据集上、以GPT-4o-mini作为oracle模拟器进行评估。

Result: 未调优的澄清行为呈帕累托低效：受预算约束的策略可同时取得比基线更高的准确率和更低的澄清率。跨预算水平呈现对数形帕累托前沿，额外澄清的边际收益递减。收益并非来自整体提问更多，而是来自提问目标更精准以及在模糊情境下代码生成更好；且在无显式监督下，策略学会非均匀分配澄清预算，在更难（多重退化）任务上提问更频繁。

Conclusion: 结果表明，缺少约束的交互式LLM系统可能系统性地低效使用澄清。将澄清决策纳入带预算约束的强化学习后训练，是提升交互式代码智能体准确率与效率权衡的一种有效途径。

Abstract: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

</details>


### [80] [Robust blind unmixing: A geometric approach to overcoming basis variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04091)
*Dumitru Mirauta,Vladimir V. Gusev,Michael W. Gaultois,Matthew J. Rosseinsky,Yannis Goulermas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于度量空间视角的几何方法解决信号解混问题，利用最优传输距离捕捉基函数变化，并通过最小化候选解类内方差驱动优化，在多个解混任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信号解混在科学中很常见，如衍射或光谱识别混合物成分。最简情况下测量信号是基模式的线性组合，解混目标是从不同混合物的测量中推断基模式及组分丰度。核心挑战在于基函数会因噪声和测量物理过程在混合物间发生变化。现有方法多采用定制的基于模型和参数化方法，受假设限制仅适用于特定应用领域，缺乏通用性。

Method: 提出一种新颖的几何方法，将测量数据生成过程置于度量空间视角，把关注点从参数化模型转向基变换与相应几何之间的通用关系。利用最优传输距离来捕捉常见的基函数变化，并通过最小化候选解的类内方差来驱动优化。特别关注一维情形，因其实际重要性及高效的距离和传输映射算法的可用性。

Result: 在随机高斯混合模型、模拟粉末X射线衍射以及实验室高光谱成像数据集等一系列解混任务上，该方法的有效性得到验证。

Conclusion: 所提几何方法通过度量空间视角和最优传输距离，为信号解混提供了一种不依赖特定参数化假设的通用框架，并在多种实际解混任务中展现出良好效果。

Abstract: Signal separation problems are common in science. A prominent example of this occurs during the use of diffraction or spectroscopy to identify the individual components of a mixture by measuring it. In the simplest case, the measured signal is a linear combination of basis patterns corresponding to the constituent parts. The unmixing problem is to infer all or some of these basis patterns and abundances of components from measurements of distinct mixtures. One of the core challenges of this task is the variation of the basis from mixture to mixture due to noise and the exact physics of the measurement process. This is usually addressed with tailored model-based and parametric methods that are then limited in use to specific application domains by the nature of the assumptions made. We propose a novel geometric approach to unmixing problems which views the generation of data during measurement through a metric space lens, thereby shifting the focus from parametrised models to a general relationship between basis transformations and the corresponding geometry. We take advantage of the optimal transport distances to capture commonly occurring basis variations, and use minimisation of in-class variance of candidate solutions to drive the optimisation. We pay special attention to the one-dimensional case due to its practical importance and availability of efficient distance and transport map routines. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a range of unmixing tasks using random Gaussian mixture models, simulated powder X-ray diffraction, and laboratory hyperspectral imaging datasets.

</details>


### [81] [Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04100)
*Adil Mubashir Chaudhry,Osama Ahmad,Zubair Khalid,Murtaza Taj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一的渐进式多祖先位深蒸馏框架PMABD，通过多阶段、多祖先教师逐步压缩网络，稳定超低位量化训练，在多个数据集上超越现有压缩框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法同时进行FP32到INT4的转换与蒸馏，导致训练不稳定且预测性能严重下降。为克服这些限制，需要一种渐进式压缩与知识迁移的统一框架。

Method: PMABD生成一系列中间教师模型，每个中间教师从所有更高精度的祖先教师学习，并共同监督最终目标学生模型；采用多祖先、多阶段设计降低训练过程中的量化噪声轮廓，保证稳定量化，并引入基于饱和度的停止准则。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-20/32/18）及Tiny-ImageNet（MobileNetV2）上，PMABD优于现有最先进压缩框架，W2A2（ResNet-18/CIFAR-100）学生模型性能提升1.06%。饱和度停止准则有助于提升最终学生模型性能。

Conclusion: PMABD通过渐进多祖先位深蒸馏有效稳定超低位量化训练并提升压缩模型性能，饱和度停止准则进一步改善最终学生模型表现。

Abstract: Model compression strategies are widely employed to reduce memory footprint and network complexity, particularly for devices with constrained computational, memory, and energy resources. Prior works that rely on simultaneous conversion from floating-point high-precision (FP32) to integer low-precision (INT4) representations and distillation into smaller models suffer from unstable training and drastic degradation of prediction performance. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework, known as \textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}ncestor \textbf{B}it-depth \textbf{D}istillation (PMABD), that progressively compresses the network while transferring knowledge through a growing pool of higher-precision ancestor teachers. PMABD generates a sequence of intermediate teachers that each learn from all higher-precision ancestors and jointly supervise the final target student. This multi-ancestor, multi-stage design stabilizes ultra-low-bit quantization by lowering quantization noise profiles across training and ensuring stable quantization. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-20/32/18, and Tiny-ImageNet with MobileNetV2 show that PMABD outperforms state-of-the-art compression frameworks, results in 1.06$\%$ increase in performance of W2A2 (ResNet-18/CIFAR-100) student model. We show that a saturation-based stopping criterion contributes to improve the performance of our final student.

</details>


### [82] [Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04108)
*Lufang Chiang,Jiachen Yao,Thomas Y. L. Lin,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将混沌系统长期行为预测建模为学习系统的时间不变演化算子，通过推导一致性方程实现单次大步长跳转，在五个混沌系统上验证了精度与效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖数值求解器或自回归模型，每次只能推进一小步，导致长期预测的计算成本极高。因此需要一种能在单次评估中跨越长时间跨度的方法。

Method: 将问题转化为学习系统的时间不变演化算子，推导该算子必须满足的一致性方程，包含物理时间上的微分目标与复合目标；这些方程还建立了学习算子与物理即时动力学的联系，从而实现物理嵌入的一致性学习（物理蒸馏一致性）。

Result: 在五个混沌系统上，物理蒸馏一致性使短期轨迹和长期统计量都更加准确；学习到的算子能够通过时间外推测试，且所需评估次数仅为自回归推演方法的十分之一。

Conclusion: 学习时间不变演化算子为混沌动力学长期模拟提供了一条高效途径，兼顾精度与计算效率。

Abstract: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as many evaluations as autoregressive rollout, offering an efficient route to long-term simulation of chaotic dynamics.

</details>


### [83] [SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04109)
*Mingtian Tan,Palash Goyal,Mihir Parmar,Sarkar Snigdha Sarathi Das,Chun-Liang Li,Nanyun Peng,Thomas Hartvigsen,Jinsung Yoon,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SEER闭环框架，通过自进化的事件推理与检索优化事件条件，提升时间序列预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实时间序列常受外生事件和结构性变化驱动，仅靠历史数值观测的传统预测方法不足。语言模型虽能检索外部新闻，但标准检索增强方法面临噪声高、信号缺失、无法对事件影响进行因果推理等问题。

Method: SEER将预测误差转化为两种解耦的反馈机制：(i)反思式检索记忆，用于优化后续搜索查询并过滤虚假噪声；(ii)持久因果知识库，用于提炼可迁移的领域动态。同时，在事件检索与反思中严格实施时间顺序边界，防止前视偏差与数据泄漏。

Result: 在六个高波动时间序列基准上，SEER持续优于最先进的时间序列基础模型和语言模型基线。

Conclusion: SEER通过闭环、自进化的事件推理与检索，有效利用外生事件信息并避免数据泄漏，在时间序列预测任务中展现出优越性能。

Abstract: Real-world time series are frequently driven by exogenous events and structural shifts, rendering conventional forecasting based solely on historical numerical observations insufficient. While language models can retrieve external news, standard retrieval-augmented approaches struggle with high noise, missing signals, and an inability to reason causally about event impacts. We propose SEER (Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval), a closed-loop framework that dynamically optimizes event conditioning for time series forecasting. SEER translates prediction errors into two decoupled feedback mechanisms: (i) a reflective retrieval memory that refines subsequent search queries and filters spurious noise, and (ii) a persistent causal knowledge base that distills transferable domain dynamics. SEER enforces strict chronological boundaries across both event retrieval and reflection, preventing look-ahead bias and data leakage. Across six volatile time-series benchmarks, SEER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art time series foundation models and language model baselines.

</details>


### [84] [Sharp Convergence and Sample Complexity of Policy Mirror Descent for Average-Reward MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04117)
*Enes Arda,Atilla Eryilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在遍历平均奖励MDP中给出了策略镜像下降(PMD)的有限时间、有限样本分析，基于一个统一的主递归，得到了线性收敛率、超线性情形及 $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ 的样本复杂度，并证明该复杂度在表格与线性函数逼近两种设定下均最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PMD 在折扣 MDP 中已有成熟的有限时间理论，但在许多控制应用更自然的平均奖励设定下了解较少，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 围绕一个支配任意评论家(critic)收敛的单一主递归，在不使用外部正则化的情况下对遍历平均奖励 MDP 中的 PMD 进行分析，并推广到精确、非精确表格及线性函数逼近(LFA)更新。

Result: 主递归的特化给出精确、非精确表格与 LFA 更新的线性收敛率，精确 PMD 呈超线性；端到端样本复杂度在表格(依赖 $|S||A|$)与 LFA(依赖 $d$)下均为 $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$。LFA 样本复杂度将先前最优的 $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$ 混合依赖改进为 $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$。

Conclusion: 匹配的信息论下界表明，评论家的 $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ 样本复杂度在两种设定下均不可改进，确立了该问题的样本复杂度最优性。

Abstract: Policy mirror descent (PMD) has a mature finite-time theory in discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs), but less is known in the average-reward setting, a more natural objective for many control applications. We give a finite-time, finite-sample analysis of PMD in ergodic average-reward MDPs built around a single master recursion that governs convergence for any critic, without external regularization. Its specializations yield linear rates for exact, inexact-tabular, and linear function approximation (LFA) updates, with a superlinear regime for exact PMD. We complement these convergence results with end-to-end sample complexities of order $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ in both tabular ($|S||A|$-dependent) and LFA ($d$-dependent) settings. Our LFA sample complexity sharpens the prior best $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$ mixing dependence to $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$, and matching information-theoretic lower bounds establish that the critic's $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ sample complexity is unimprovable in both settings.

</details>


### [85] [Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04137)
*Som Sagar,Shasha Li,Hejie Cui,Ransalu Senanayake,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHIFT 将执行从逐查询搜索循环中移出，通过本地LLM学习harness构建策略与价值函数，用MCTS为每个查询构建harness，在六个基准9193任务上取得约80%最高平均准确率，超越17个基线最多7.2个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: agent harness（角色、指令、工具、通信结构）应随查询而变，但设计选择的价值只能通过执行观察，导致要么在推理时执行备选方案、要么人工设计成本高。因此需要一个不必在每次查询时反复执行搜索就能定制harness的方法。

Method: SHIFT 把执行移出逐查询搜索循环：本地LLM架构师从搜索中学习harness构建动作的策略，并学习一个价值函数，基于已测量的执行结果预测兼顾准确率与执行成本的效用；对每个查询，用蒙特卡洛树搜索依据这些预测来构建harness。

Result: 在六个基准（数学、文档、通用助手等）共9193个任务上，使用 Gemini 3.5 Flash 执行器，SHIFT 取得最高平均准确率约80%，超过17个涵盖提示、提示优化与工作流搜索的基线，比最强基线高7.2个百分点；更便宜的模式在用32%更少执行token的情况下仍比所有基线平均准确率高。联合选择结构、指令与工具比仅选指令或仅选工具最多提升9.1个百分点；学习到的价值选择能从候选池中挑出更准确且执行成本更低的harness。

Conclusion: 通过将执行开销前置到离线学习、在线仅用预测驱动MCTS构建harness，SHIFT 能以更低成本获得更高准确率，并说明结构、指令、工具需联合优化。

Abstract: Agent harnesses specify the roles, instructions, tools, and communication structure used to solve a task, and the right harness depends on the query. Because the value of each design choice is observable only through execution, tailoring a harness to each query has required either executing alternatives at inference time or costly manual design. We introduce SHIFT, which moves execution out of the per-query search loop. A local LLM architect learns a policy over harness-building actions from search, and a value function that predicts, from measured executions, a utility balancing accuracy against execution cost. For each query, Monte Carlo tree search uses these predictions to construct a harness. Across 9,193 tasks in six benchmarks, from math to document and general-assistant tasks, with a Gemini 3.5 Flash executor, SHIFT attains the highest mean accuracy, about 80%, outperforming 17 baselines that span prompting, prompt optimization, and workflow search, and exceeding the strongest baseline by 7.2 percentage points. A cheaper mode of SHIFT also attains a higher mean accuracy than every baseline while using 32% fewer execution tokens than the strongest baseline. We further show that choosing structure, instructions, and tools jointly beats choosing only instructions or only tools by up to 9.1 percentage points, and that learned value selection identifies more accurate harnesses with lower execution cost from candidate pools.

</details>


### [86] [Dual-Scale Relational Graph Transformers for Ecosystem-Aware Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04138)
*Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi,Xinrou Li,Yao Xiao,Zijun Yao,Xin Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HERMES 是一种双尺度图 Transformer 编码器，联合建模局部异构图结构与全局欺诈生态状态，用于数字银行账户接管（ATO）欺诈检测，在超 1.3 亿高风险的交易会话上显著优于生产系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ATO 欺诈对数字银行威胁日益严重，需在检测效果与客户体验之间取得平衡。现有生产系统多用表格模型孤立地为会话打分，丢弃了交互网络的关系结构；而图模型虽利用关系，但主要局限于局部邻域，只能捕捉问题的一部分。欺诈风险同时依赖会话周边的局部关系结构与不断演变的全局欺诈生态状态。

Method: 提出 HERMES 双尺度架构：Micro-GT 在时间安全的会话邻域上通过结构化、关系感知的注意力捕捉局部异构图表结构；Macro-GT 使用非前瞻性的"气候 token"汇总欺诈动态、平台变化与基础设施复用等生态级上下文，并结合自适应类别原型随时间追踪代表性欺诈与正常会话模式。

Result: 在来自美国某领先金融机构的超过 1.3 亿条高风险的交易会话上评估，HERMES 持续优于生产系统及强图基线，客户摩擦相对降低 44.44%，欺诈召回率相对提升 24.66%。消融与时间稳定性分析进一步表明，局部关系建模与全局生态上下文在不同欺诈态势下均带来互补收益。

Conclusion: 联合建模局部关系结构与全局欺诈生态上下文可有效提升 ATO 欺诈检测性能并降低客户摩擦，且在不同欺诈模式下具有稳健的时间稳定性，具备实际生产部署价值。

Abstract: Account takeover (ATO) fraud is a growing threat to digital banking, requiring effective detection while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Production systems predominantly rely on tabular models that score sessions in isolation, discarding the relational structure of the underlying interaction network. Although graph-based models exploit relationships among sessions and network entities, they primarily reason over local neighborhoods and therefore capture only part of the problem: fraud risk depends jointly on the local relational structure surrounding a session and the evolving global state of the fraud ecosystem. We present HERMES (HEterogeneous Relational Micro--macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions), a dual-scale architecture that jointly models these complementary scales of information. Micro-GT captures local heterogeneous graph structure through structured, relation-aware attention over a temporally safe session neighborhood. Complementing this local representation, Macro-GT models ecosystem-level context using non-anticipative climate tokens that summarize fraud dynamics, platform shifts, and infrastructure reuse, together with adaptive class prototypes that track representative fraud and benign session patterns over time. Evaluated on more than 130 million high-risk transaction sessions from a leading U.S. financial institution, HERMES consistently outperforms production and strong graph-based baselines, achieving a 44.44% relative reduction in customer friction and a 24.66% relative improvement in fraud recall over the production system. Ablation and temporal-stability analyses further demonstrate complementary gains from local relational modeling and global ecosystem context across changing fraud regimes.

</details>


### [87] [ExpertMuon-Compass: Alignment-Guided Step Sizes for Mixture-of-Experts Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04140)
*Omatharv Bharat Vaidya,Ashwin Vinod,Pedram Akbarian,Aditya Sai Ellendula,Connor T. Jerzak,Nhat Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ExpertMuon-Compass（Compass），通过为每个专家的 Muon 更新乘以"家族因子"和"半径标量"两个系数来调整更新步长，在保持 Muon 更新方向和动量缓冲的同时，使 MoE 语言模型预训练表现优于或持平 Muon、NorMuon 等优化器，尤其在专家所见数据随训练变化时效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 语言模型将每个 token 发送给少量专家，因此每个专家在不同数据子集上训练，且该子集随训练变化。在共享学习率下，Muon 对相同形状的专家矩阵施加规模相近的更新，即便某专家的更新与其当前梯度对齐很差，也缺乏区分性。作者希望针对这一不匹配问题改进 MoE 优化。

Method: 提出 ExpertMuon-Compass（Compass）：将每个专家的 Muon 步长乘以两个因子。其一是"家族因子"，比较该专家正交化更新与其梯度之间的余弦，与同层其他专家的对应余弦值进行比较；其二是"半径标量"，将更新与梯度对应行之间的对齐度聚合成一个步长乘子。Compass 保留 Muon 的更新方向和动量缓冲。作者还证明了这两个因子的扰动界。

Result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 预训练中，对所有矩�阵使用 Nesterov 动量的 Compass 表现与 Muon、NorMuon 及其他优化器相当或更好，较长训练中权重衰减与 NorMuon 匹配。将这两个因子加入 NorMuon 后，损失与 NorMuon 相当或更低。Compass 在训练期间每个专家所见数据发生变化时效果最佳，例如多语言语料中不同语言分块到达时。使用 Compass 后专家负载保持均衡，路由器更果断地将 token 分配给专家。

Conclusion: Compass 通过按专家、按行细粒度地调节 Muon 步长，有效解决了 MoE 中共享学习率导致的更新对齐不匹配问题，在标准预训练上不劣于现有优化器，且在专家数据分布动态变化（如多语言分块）场景下优势明显，同时保持专家负载均衡并提升路由决策质量，并配有理论扰动界支撑。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models send each token to a few experts, so each expert is trained on a different part of the data, and this part changes during training. With a shared learning rate, Muon applies updates of roughly the same size to expert matrices of the same shape, even when an expert's update is poorly aligned with its current gradient. We here propose ExpertMuon-Compass (Compass), which multiplies the Muon step of each expert by two factors. A family factor compares the cosine between the expert's orthogonalized update and its gradient with the same cosine for the other experts in its layer. A scalar radius aggregates the alignment between corresponding rows of the update and gradient into one step-length multiplier. Compass keeps the update direction and the momentum buffer of Muon. In pretraining on FineWeb-Edu, Compass with Nesterov momentum on all matrices performs as well as or better than Muon, NorMuon, and other optimizers, with weight decay matched to NorMuon in the longer runs. Adding its factors to NorMuon gives the same or a lower loss than NorMuon. Compass is the most effective when the data seen by each expert varies during training, for example, as when the languages of a multilingual corpus arrive in separate blocks. With Compass, the expert load stays balanced, and the router assigns tokens to experts more decisively. We also prove a perturbation bound for the two factors.

</details>


### [88] [Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04940)
*Tongli Su,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao,Bowen Zhu,JayaSai Somasundaram,Hasibul Haque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出软件世界模型SWM，通过探索-学习-行动三阶段预测代码变更的爆炸集（会被破坏的下游组件），在合成系统上将F1从0.431提升至0.571，并改善排序与迁移决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理修改一个仓库时，可能悄然破坏依赖它的下游服务、库或数据存储。每次操作后都跑完整集成测试不现实，因此代理需在执行前预测失败。现有软件世界模型只预测代理自身观测，静态变更影响分析只定位传播范围，均不足以预测爆炸集。

Method: SWM分三阶段：Explore（从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先探索观测失败与依赖图矛盾的区域）、Learn（在这些执行结果上微调语言模型以预测下游破坏）、Act（将采样预测转化为每个消费者的破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移及判断是否值得再次执行）。

Result: 在留出的合成系统上，爆炸集F1从静态可达性的0.431提升到0.571±0.037，排序regret减少一半以上，并在全部九个评估检查点改善迁移回报。两方法互补：可达性在图中有表示的依赖上更强，SWM能恢复图遗漏的耦合导致的失败。在真实库上，预测结构化失败结果而非仅标量风险对下游决策质量很重要。

Conclusion: SWM通过建模更广泛的受影响系统并预测爆炸集，弥补了观测预测与静态可达性分析的不足，且结构化失败预测对下游决策至关重要。

Abstract: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

</details>


### [89] [Ideal Paths for Approximating Logistic Gradient Descent Trajectories at Large Initialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04142)
*Junjie Xiao,Huiwen Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了从已有模型初始化出发的全批量逻辑回归梯度下降轨迹，通过几何近似给出显式理想路径，并证明了轨迹随初始化尺度R增大的一致收敛性及损失渐近公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代训练常从预训练模型出发而非从零开始，因此初始化如何影响后续训练轨迹成为关键问题。经典隐式偏置结果只刻画长时间训练选定的方向，无法说明中间过程的行为，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 针对严格线性可分数据上的全批量逻辑回归梯度下降，考虑大尺度R初始化。利用最小范数投影规则，从任意极限归一化初始位置构造出由有限个线性段组成的唯一连续理想路径，该路径分为负间隔修正与最小间隔增长两个阶段，并进行两阶段时间重参数化。

Result: 证明了固定步长GD轨迹除以R后在每个固定参数区间上一致收敛到理想路径（R→∞），并给出包含初始化扰动与阶段转换的定量误差界；导出峰值评估损失与累计训练损失的渐近公式，发现即使两端损失趋零，峰值评估损失仍可随R线性增长；修正阶段与间隔增长阶段的累计损失分别以R^2和R归一化后收敛到显式极限。

Conclusion: 该几何近似刻画了从预训练初始化出发的GD中间轨迹，揭示峰值评估损失可能随初始化尺度线性增长的隐式偏置现象，并在受控几何与固定图像特征实验中验证了理论结果。

Abstract: Modern training on a new task often starts from a previously trained model rather than from scratch, raising the question of how this initialization affects the subsequent training trajectory. Classical implicit-bias results characterize the direction selected by prolonged training, but this direction alone does not provide information regarding the intermediate behavior. We address this question through a geometric approximation of full-batch logistic gradient descent (GD) trajectories on strictly linearly separable data, with large initialization of scale $R$ motivated by prior training. From any limiting normalized initial position, we use minimum-norm projection rules to construct a unique continuous ideal path consisting of finitely many linear segments. The path has two stages: negative-margin correction followed by minimum-margin growth. We prove that, after an explicit two-stage time reparameterization, the fixed-step GD trajectory divided by $R$ converges uniformly to this path on every fixed parameter interval as $R\to\infty$. Further, our quantitative error bounds account for initialization perturbations and the transition between stages. This approximation provides asymptotic formulas for peak evaluation loss and cumulative training loss. In particular, peak evaluation loss can grow linearly in $R$ even when both endpoint losses tend to zero. The cumulative losses in the correction and margin-growth stages, normalized by $R^2$ and $R$, respectively, converge to explicit limits. Experiments on controlled geometries and fixed image features complement our theoretical results.

</details>


### [90] [GNN-CB: A Graph Neural Network Competition Benchmark for Human and LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05387)
*Murad Hossen,Tasneem Selim,Gurur Gamgam,Tuga Yousif,Abderrahmane Kasmi,Ikram Aissiou,Mubaraq Onipede,Faran Taimoor Butt,Sanae Zrigui,Rosa Y. G. Paccotacya-Yanque,Ignatius Balayo,Ikram Elhouiti,Hadil Affes,Bijay Adhikari,Sargam Goyal,Muhammad Ibrahim Isah,Mohammad Idrees Bhat,Samuel Kangoni Matia,Peguy Kem-Meka Tiotsop Kadzue,Maha Trabelsi,Emmanuel Owusu,Vinit,Nour Majdoub,Tamiru Alemnew,Islem Rekik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GNN-CB，首个面向人类与大语言模型的GNN编码竞赛基准，包含18个覆盖节点、边、图级预测任务的竞赛，采用隐藏测试集与统一自动化评分，结果显示LLM总体难以匹敌人类顶尖表现且跨任务稳定性较差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在编码与推理基准上表现优异，但其求解图结构机器学习问题的能力尚缺乏系统评估，尤其缺少在真实竞赛条件下端到端求解GNN编码任务的基准。

Method: 构建GNN-CB基准，涵盖18个竞赛，覆盖节点级、边级、图级预测及多样图类别、领域与难度层级；所有提交经统一自动化流水线、隐藏测试集与标准化评分评估。人类在受控竞赛约束下解题；LLM采用冻结的零样本提示协议，基于"先规划后编码"范式并配有有界执行-修复循环，同时支持非智能体与自主智能体评估。

Result: 在所评估协议下，LLM很少能达到人类顶尖水平，跨竞赛表现不稳定；无单一模型占优，仅有少数竞赛由LLM获胜，多数任务最高分仍由人类保持。

Conclusion: GNN-CB作为持续更新的基准发布，提供自动化评估基础设施、动态排行榜与可复现执行流水线，为研究多样化图学习任务的GNN实现提供实践导向资源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks; however, their ability to solve graph-structured machine learning problems remains largely unexplored. In particular, no benchmark currently evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously solve end-to-end Graph Neural Network (GNN) coding tasks under realistic competition settings. To address this gap, this paper introduces GNN-CB, the first competition-based benchmark for evaluating both humans and LLMs on GNN coding tasks. GNN-CB consists of 18 curated competitions spanning node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction across diverse graph categories, domains, and difficulty tiers. All submissions are evaluated through a unified automated pipeline with hidden test sets and standardized scoring. Human participants solve tasks under controlled competition constraints, while LLMs are evaluated using a frozen zero-shot prompting protocol based on a plan-then-code paradigm with bounded execute-and-repair loops. The benchmark additionally supports both non-agent and autonomous agent-based evaluation within the same protocol. Under our evaluated protocol, LLMs rarely match Human Top performance and show less stable performance across competitions. No single model dominates: a few competitions are won by LLMs, yet humans still hold the top score on most tasks. We release GNN-CB as a living benchmark with automated evaluation infrastructure, dynamic leaderboards, and reproducible execution pipelines. Beyond benchmarking, GNN-CB provides a practice-oriented resource for studying GNN implementation across progressively diverse graph-learning tasks. The benchmark and evaluation framework are publicly available at https://basiralab.github.io/GNN-CB/.

</details>


### [91] [Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04143)
*Junjie Xiao,Huiwen Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"考量电路"(CC)，用有向无环图组织的多项Logit单元构建多阶段特征选择模型，在理论上揭示了深度与范数之间的分离现象，并在实验中验证其性能优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数基于特征的（经典与深度）选择模型对每个项目打分后仅施加一次softmax，表达能力受限。在含有固定非共线特征的三项折衷任务上，与菜单无关的随机效用模型（包括单个MNL单元）的误差存在远离零的下界，因此需要多阶段架构来突破这一限制。

Method: 提出考量电路（CC）：由多项Logit（MNL）单元组成的有向无环图定义的多阶段选择模型。源单元为菜单项目分配概率，内部单元利用由概率加权特征摘要计算出的MNL权重来组合前驱分布。研究深度-范数分离，刻画逼近任意确定性选择表的两个几何条件，并进行实验对比。

Result: 在折衷任务上，CC呈现尖锐的深度-范数分离：深度从2增到3，达到误差ε所需的最优最大口味向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降至Θ(log(1/ε))。深度2的下界对任意宽度和与菜单无关的路由偏置均成立，而含零路由偏置的五节点深度3电路可达到对数速率。更一般地，刻画了逼近有限菜单族上任意确定性选择表的两个充要几何条件：满足时深度3即足够，若菜单族包含非单元素菜单则深度4可达到最优对数范数缩放。实验中，参数量少于600的独立树电路在四个固定池基准和Expedia时间分割上取得最低平均测试NLL；作为输出头，CC推广了线性MNL读出，在Expedia和Trivago上为每个测试编码器降低平均测试NLL。

Conclusion: CC通过多阶段DAG结构显著提升特征选择模型的表达能力，用深度换取范数效率，理论上给出了深度-范数分离与几何充要条件，实验上以极少参数达到更低NLL，可作为通用输出头推广线性MNL读出。

Abstract: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $ε$ from $Θ(\log(1/ε)/ε)$ to $Θ(\log(1/ε))$. The depth-$2$ lower bound holds for arbitrary width and menu-independent routing biases, while a five-node depth-$3$ circuit with zero routing biases attains the logarithmic rate. More generally, we characterize two geometric conditions that are necessary and sufficient for approximating arbitrary deterministic choice tables on finite menu families. Under these conditions, depth $3$ suffices, while depth $4$ achieves optimal logarithmic norm scaling whenever the family contains a non-singleton menu. In experiments, standalone tree circuits with fewer than $600$ parameters attain the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (NLL) among the evaluated models on four fixed-pool benchmarks and the Expedia temporal split. As output heads, CC generalize the linear MNL readout and lower mean test NLL for every tested encoder on Expedia and Trivago.

</details>


### [92] [Disentangling Task Difficulty from Run-Level Failure in Agent Failure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05572)
*Mohsen EsfandyariDoulabi,Lawrence Arkoh,Biruk Tadesse,Vaishvi Patel,Mehul Sharma,Marcelo d'Amorim,Wesley Assunção*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出当前LLM智能体失败预测的高AUROC（0.85–0.94）主要来自任务间难度差异而非同任务内运行级区分，主张评估应区分跨单元与同单元比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有失败预测方法报出强预测性能，但训练时混合了众多任务的运行数据，作者怀疑性能部分源于识别"任务更难"而非"当前运行正走向失败"。这一区分很重要：任务级难度支持计算资源分配决策，运行级预测才能决定是否干预进行中的轨迹。

Method: 选取同一智能体对同一任务重复尝试的基准，将跨单元比较与同一模型-任务单元内成功/失败运行的比较分离开来，并分析正负样本对的构成、难度神谕、轨迹预测器、已发布监测器与隐状态探针的表现。

Result: 在评估语料中，超过99.93%的正负样本对属于跨单元。从不观察当前运行的预测器也能取得高池化性能，难度神谕AUROC最高达0.945，但在任务内仅为随机水平。早期运行级判别普遍很弱，仅在执行后期改善，且对较弱智能体更强。固定token预算下，任务级分配优于仅中止策略；只有当任务内AUROC达到约0.84–0.93时早停才有益，远高于早期监测器0.50–0.55的范围。

Conclusion: 失败预测的评估不应只看结果准确率，还应看所捕获的信号是否支持预期的部署决策；现有高AUROC大多无法支撑运行级干预。

Abstract: Predicting whether an LLM agent will fail has emerged as a promising direction for supporting intervention during execution. Recent approaches report strong predictive performance, often with AUROC values between 0.85 and 0.94. However, predictors are typically trained by pooling runs from many tasks. We hypothesize that part of this performance comes from recognizing that some tasks are harder than others, rather than detecting whether a particular run is heading toward failure. This distinction matters because task-level difficulty supports decisions about where to allocate computation, while run-level prediction is needed to decide whether to intervene in an ongoing trajectory. We study benchmarks with repeated attempts of the same task by the same agent and separate cross-unit comparisons from comparisons between successful and failed runs of the same model-task unit. Across the evaluated corpora, more than 99.93% of the positive-negative pairs underlying pooled AUROC are cross-unit. Accordingly, predictors that never observe the current run can achieve high pooled performance, including a difficulty oracle with AUROC up to 0.945, while remaining at chance within task. Early run-level discrimination is consistently weak across trajectory predictors, released monitors, and hidden-state probes, although it improves later in execution and is stronger for weaker agents. Under fixed token budgets, task-level allocation outperforms abort-only strategies, while early stopping becomes beneficial only when within-task AUROC reaches about 0.84-0.93, far above the 0.50-0.55 range observed for early monitors. These results show that failure prediction should be evaluated not only by outcome accuracy, but by whether the captured signal supports the intended deployment decision.

</details>


### [93] [You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04147)
*Jason Chuan-Chih Chou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现主流框架中Inception crop的裁剪尺度采样分布存在实现差异（TF/JAX用f(A)∝1/√A，PyTorch用原始描述），通过大规模实验（522个ViT-S/16模型）研究裁剪尺度分布对训练的影响，并基于发现重新审视Beta crop的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Inception crop已成为深度视觉模型训练的标准数据增强方法，但TensorFlow/JAX生态系统的标准实现与PyTorch实现存在裁剪尺度采样分布的差异（前者用f(A)∝1/√A，后者遵循原始描述）。作者受此差异启发，希望系统研究裁剪尺度分布对训练的影响。

Method: 在ImageNet-1k数据集上，用不同训练预算（budgets）和裁剪尺度分布训练522个ViT-S/16模型，并通过AdamW和Scion优化器验证结论的普适性。

Result: 在90个epoch训练预算下达到78.78±0.09的top-1验证准确率。主要发现：1. 更高的训练预算需要更强的增强；2. 裁剪尺度分布的下尾（lower tail）决定Inception crop的增强强度；3. 更高训练预算训练的模型表现出更稀疏的显著性（sparser saliency），与裁剪尺度分布或权重衰减无关。此外，基于发现2重新审视了Beta crop的性能。

Conclusion: 裁剪尺度分布的下尾是决定增强强度的关键。Beta crop因其更柔和的截断，能在不同训练预算下以更小的代价优化模型性能。结果在AdamW和Scion两种优化器下均得到复现，表明结论可能具有普适性。

Abstract: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.

</details>


### [94] [Technical Report on the Turba Fertilizer Machine Learning Stack in Morocco](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05949)
*Abdelghani Belgaid,Zakaria Mahmoud,Fahd Chibani,Oumnia Ennaji,Younes Boudoul,Dounia Rachid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本技术报告提出Turba肥料机器学习栈，一个面向摩洛哥的可复现站点特定施肥推荐三层开源实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有站点特定施肥推荐系统虽能根据位置、土壤、作物和目标产量定制施肥建议，但推荐函数主要以交互界面形式开放，输出缺乏版本管理，训练得到的近似模型无法被独立加载或基准测试，限制了科学复用。

Method: Turba采用三层架构：turba-client提供对站点档案、作物目标产量空间及N、P₂O₅、K₂O推荐流程的编程访问；turba-data分发可分析的快照数据；turba-models打包作物特定的推荐输出机器学习代理模型。基于44,096个ESA WorldCereal唯一位置构建首个数据集，在中目标产量设定下生成132,017条作物-位置推荐请求，形成含22个变量、覆盖10个地区、66个省和1,149个乡镇的数据集。在固定确定性80/20协议下评估九类回归模型。

Result: 数据集覆盖10个地区、66个省、1,149个乡镇，包含132,017条推荐请求和22个变量；九类回归模型经评估后，当前版本打包了五个表现最佳的作物特定模型。

Conclusion: 该栈为空间与时间验证、不确定性估计、田间试验比较以及未来数据集成提供了可复现基础。需注意，其机器学习任务是对推荐函数的仿真，而非对观测作物响应的预测。

Abstract: Site-specific fertilizer recommendation systems adapt nutrient advice to location, soil properties, crop type, and production targets, but scientific reuse is constrained when recommendation functions remain accessible mainly through interactive interfaces, outputs are not versioned, and trained approximations cannot be independently loaded or benchmarked. This technical report presents the Turba fertilizer machine learning stack, a three-layer open-source implementation for reproducible site-specific fertilizer recommendation in Morocco. \texttt{turba-client} provides programmatic access to publicly accessible site profiles, crop-specific target-yield spaces, and N, P$_2$O$_5$, and K$_2$O recommendation workflows; \texttt{turba-data} distributes analysis-ready snapshots; and \texttt{turba-models} packages crop-specific machine learning surrogates of recommendation outputs. The architecture links upstream retrieval, versioned analytical snapshots, reproducible cross-model benchmarking, and loadable offline surrogates while preserving the distinction between recommendation-system outputs, observed agricultural data, and model-generated predictions. The first dataset was constructed from 44,096 unique ESA WorldCereal locations. Scenario expansion across supported cereal workflows generated 132,017 crop-location recommendation requests under a medium target-yield setting. The resulting 22-variable dataset spans 10 regions, 66 provinces, and 1,149 communes. Nine regression families were evaluated under a fixed deterministic 80/20 protocol, and the current release packages five best-performing crop-specific models. The machine learning task is recommendation-function emulation rather than prediction of observed crop response. The stack provides a reproducible basis for spatial and temporal validation, uncertainty estimation, field-trial comparison, and future integration with additional data.

</details>


### [95] [How RL Reshapes LLM Reasoning: Transferability, Coverage, and Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04158)
*Ziheng Cheng,Yixiao Huang,Hanlin Zhu,Somayeh Sojoudi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论与实验重新审视RL对LLM推理边界的影响，提出两阶段自回归策略模型，揭示RL通过隐式偏置改变策略选择而非扩展策略空间，并解释跨域迁移、覆盖变化与计算缩放规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期关于强化学习提升LLM推理的研究存在看似矛盾的现象：数学训练能提升其他领域表现，但Pass@1提升的同时Pass@N可能低于基座模型。核心疑问是：RL究竟扩展了LLM的推理边界，还是仅对已有推理空间重新加权。

Method: 作者在Qwen与Gemma模型家族上复现上述现象；分析RL前后解题轨迹；提出两阶段自回归策略模型，将"策略选择"与"问题特定执行"分离；在此框架下证明RL隐式偏置如何重塑策略偏好；并为log-sigmoid与log-linear计算缩放律提供理论依据并评估其预测力。

Result: 观察到跨域收益与遗忘并存；大采样预算下覆盖率在部分任务上升、部分任务下降；RL前后解题轨迹表明模型所用推理策略发生转移；理论证明RL隐式偏置可在不扩展策略支持的情况下扩大或收窄给定采样预算下的覆盖率。

Conclusion: RL主要改变策略选择而非扩展推理边界，这一机制统一连接了跨域迁移、推理覆盖率变化与计算缩放规律。

Abstract: Recent studies on reinforcement learning (RL) report seemingly conflicting evidence about large language model (LLM) reasoning. Training on mathematics can improve performance in other domains, yet gains in Pass@1 can coincide with lower Pass@$N$ than the base model. This raises a fundamental question: does RL expand an LLM's reasoning boundary, or merely reweight its existing reasoning space? We revisit these phenomena across Qwen and Gemma model families, showing both cross-domain gains and forgetting, while coverage at large sampling budgets increases on some tasks and decreases on others. Detailed analysis of solution traces before and after RL indicates a shift in the reasoning strategies the model employs, motivating a two-stage autoregressive policy model that separates \emph{strategy selection} from problem-specific execution. Within this framework, we prove how RL's implicit bias reshapes strategy preferences, allowing gains on some tasks while suppressing strategies required by others. This mechanism can also broaden or narrow coverage at a given sampling budget even without expanding strategy support. We further provide theoretical justifications for log-sigmoid and log-linear scaling laws in RL compute, and evaluate their predictive power. Together, these results connect changes in strategy selection to cross-domain transfer, reasoning coverage, and compute scaling.

</details>


### [96] [Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04162)
*Xuchen Gong,Junfei Sun,Tian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为top-k选择模块提出一个有原则的训练目标，其梯度自然给出兼具监督梯度与策略梯度的混合信号，算法以O(1/√T)收敛，并在合成回归、RAG和MoE任务上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大语言模型系统中的关键组件（如RAG的文档选择、MoE的专家路由）都需从m个候选中选出最优k个，但训练这类选择模块面临梯度信号弱、探索-利用权衡不佳的问题，且已有工作多依赖启发式，缺乏对top-k选择问题进行显式建模与求解的原则性目标和方法。

Method: 作者提出一个有原则的选择模块训练目标，其梯度天然以混合形式提供更丰富的训练信号：包含一个监督梯度分量和一个策略梯度分量。同时从理论上分析选择问题的难度随m增大而上升，并证明所提算法以O(1/√T)速率收敛，其最优上界通过偏差与方差的平衡实现。

Result: 在合成回归问题、检索增强生成（RAG）以及专家混合（MoE）系统等一系列涉及top-k选择的任务上，所提方法在下一词预测困惑度和问答准确率上均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为top-k选择提供了原则性目标与理论保证，兼具监督与策略梯度优势，在多种大模型选择任务中取得一致改进。

Abstract: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.

</details>


### [97] [Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nyström Sketching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04204)
*Beheshteh T. Rakhshan,Sahar Rajabi,Maziar Sargordi Shikai Fang,Guillaume Rabusseau,Sirisha Rambhatla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Clean通过随机Nystrom方法将SOAP的全曲率预条件器近似为线性内存，并结合非子空间分量与低精度变体Q-Clean，实现高效的大模型优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型训练存在内存与收敛速度的权衡：Adam等内存高效优化器丢弃跨参数曲率信息，而SOAP等全曲率方法虽加速收敛但内存开销过高。

Method: 提出Clean优化器，利用随机Nystrom方法近似SOAP的左右预条件器，将内存复杂度从模型维度的二次降为线性；随后重新整合非子空间分量以捕获低秩近似之外的曲率信息；并进一步提出低精度变体Q-Clean，激进压缩优化器状态。

Result: 预训练LLaMA-1.3B时，Q-Clean相比Muon减少超过50%的优化器内存，同时保持强且有竞争力的预测性能；Clean的优化器状态占用小于标准AdamW，且达到AdamW最终性能的墙钟时间快26%；方法还首次支持在单张80GB GPU上预训练13B参数模型。

Conclusion: Clean与Q-Clean在保持全曲率信息的同时显著降低内存，为大规模模型优化提供了可扩展、高效且易获取的方案。

Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by \textbf{over 50\%} compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance \textbf{26\% faster} in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.

</details>


### [98] [FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04212)
*Xiaomin Zhang,Boyue Wang,Junbin Gao,Yongli Hu anbd Baocai Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FTD-GNO，用张量分解（CP、TT、Tucker）将积分核分解为低维模态函数，避免显式物化边级核张量，从而降低内存与计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准图神经算子（GNO）用单一神经网络参数化积分核并在图边上评估核交互，在高分辨率或大邻域下产生显著的算力与内存开销。为此需要一种内存高效的GNO框架。

Method: 提出功能张量分解图神经算子（FTD-GNO）：将高维连续积分核解耦为低维模态函数，采用经典张量分解格式（CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker）实例化核，实现积分算子的代数重构，无需显式物化完整的边级核张量，同时保留GNO的连续算子学习结构。

Result: 理论复杂度分析表明FTD-GNO大幅降低高维核构建相关的参数量与激活内存成本。实验显示峰值内存低于对应的未分解图积分基线，训练时间更短；傅里叶-图实验进一步表明FTD能提升混合算子中图积分层的效率，并具有良好可扩展性。

Conclusion: 通过张量分解对积分核进行因子化，FTD-GNO在保持连续算子学习能力的同时显著降低内存与计算开销，是内存高效的GNO框架。

Abstract: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.

</details>


### [99] [PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04226)
*Yuxuan Li,Fanhu Zeng,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示LoRA持续学习中固定小学习率启发式的局限，推导出随历史知识有效秩自适应变化的最优梯度缩放规律s*=√(R/c)，并提出PaLoRA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LoRA持续学习方法普遍将小学习率作为限制梯度缩放的经验性启发式手段，缺乏关于该限制强度应随任务累积如何演化的理论指导，导致随历史知识有效秩增长而遗忘累积加剧。

Method: 论文指出即使有零空间投影等方向约束，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄漏到累积先验知识的子空间。在各项异性泄漏模型下推导出最优缩放节律s*=√(R/c)，其中R为过去更新的有效秩。基于此提出PaLoRA，包括自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识、将梯度投影到先前任务零空间、以及秩感知的自适应节律。

Result: 实验表明PaLoRA持续优于先前方法，在长时程场景中表现尤为突出，在具有挑战性的50任务ImageNet-A和ImageNet-R基准上取得4%准确率的显著提升。

Conclusion: 最优的梯度幅度限制应随历史知识有效秩自适应增大，以平衡稳定性与可塑性，即保护旧知识的同时获取新任务信息，PaLoRA验证了该理论洞见的有效性。

Abstract: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

</details>


### [100] [Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04241)
*Pengqing Shi,Liming Zhang,Tao Qian,Stephen Tierney,Jie Yin,Junbin Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAFDNO，用自适应Takenaka-Malmquist正交系统替代FNO的固定傅里叶基，在九个PDE基准上取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FNO依赖固定Fourier基与硬性频率截断，难以建模非周期、局部化及细尺度解结构，需要更灵活的谱表示。

Method: 用基于随机自适应Fourier分解（SAFD）的TM正交系统替换预定义Fourier模态；通过神经极点预测器摊销随机极点选择，避免昂贵的贪心极点搜索，从隐特征直接构造自适应TM系统，并在Hardy空间对解析分支系数做学习式滤波。

Result: 在九个PDE基准中，六个规则网格问题上优于强神经算子基线，在Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes上提升尤为明显；零样本超分辨率表现更强，在更细离散化下性能退化更小。

Conclusion: 输入自适应的TM系统为神经算子学习提供了替代固定谱表示的有前景方案。

Abstract: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

</details>


### [101] [Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04249)
*Mahalakshmi Sabanayagam,Simon Lucey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过统一的奇异模式动力学框架，研究了优化器几何与深度如何共同决定深度矩阵分解中的谱偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩阵与曲率优化器的成功引发了对更新几何如何塑造学习的关注；深度矩阵分解中梯度下降的几何会通过延迟小奇异模式的出现在一定程度上偏向低秩解，而当归一化或曲率修正削弱这种减速时，该谱偏置会如何变化尚不清楚。

Method: 在显式平衡与对齐假设下，建立奇异模式动力学的统一分析框架，推导欧氏梯度下降、SignGD与瞬时Adam近似的坐标更新、Muon与累积Shampoo的谱更新，以及K-FAC块曲率模型的诞生、饱和与衰减规律。

Result: 结果显示并非简单的低秩偏置强弱排序：SignGD与理想Muon消除了发散的诞生障碍并有限时间驱动无支撑模式归零；累积Shampoo先保留GD的深度依赖障碍，随后出现追赶阶段并使活跃模式更持久；无阻尼K-FAC取消分解诱导的减速但保留目标奇异值排序，正阻尼则引入谱阈值使慢GD规律重现。

Conclusion: 归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度可被直接解释为控制模式在训练中何时出现、持续和消失的因素。

Abstract: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

</details>


### [102] [A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04256)
*Dimitrios Myrisiotis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为ReLU网络精确计算最大值函数所需的深度给出了一个六输入情形的显式"六边形恒等式"，并用手工可验证的解析证明确立了两层隐藏层即足够的深度上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确计算最大值函数是研究ReLU网络深度的标准测试案例。已知两层隐藏层对最多十二个输入足够，但此前的结论多依赖计算机辅助构造，缺乏可独立检验的解析证明。作者希望为六个实数输入提供一个自包含、可手工验证的证明。

Method: 作者通过计算机辅助搜索发现一个六边形恒等式，该恒等式的局部结构可导出显式解析证明。证明通过显式消项完成，完全可手工检验，无需运行验证程序。该恒等式还用于构造一个显式网络。

Result: 给出六输入情形两层隐藏层足够的自包含解析证明，对应显式网络的隐藏层宽度为17和41，偏置为零，权重为有理数。

Conclusion: 该工作将六输入的深度上界证明从计算机辅助构造提升为可手工检验的解析证明，并给出零偏置、有理权重的显式网络构造。

Abstract: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

</details>


### [103] [Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04260)
*Xingyu Zhao,Yiqiao Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究潜意识学习中的跨特质迁移，提出有向特质迁移矩阵量化教师特质对学生其他偏好的影响，发现特质可聚类、存在相似但不同的迁移，且学习动态从广泛共享转变到特质特异性迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜意识学习中特质传递依赖生成数据中的弱统计模式，机制微妙。作者希望理解教师-学生配对间的特质传递，特别是某一教师特质下的数据如何改变学生对其他特质的偏好，即跨特质迁移。

Method: 引入有向特质迁移矩阵，用学生答案的对数概率增益量化跨特质效应；用输出分布指标和表示指标刻画迁移结构；分析学习动态及多特质交互实验。

Result: 特质迁移矩阵揭示相关特质的聚类，学生有时会偏好与教师特质相似但不完全相同的特质；输出分布与表示指标可部分捕捉该结构；学习动态从广泛共享偏移发展到更特质特异的迁移；对立特质可增强这种分化。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了特质迁移与竞争中的显著统计结构，为理解潜意识学习中隐藏偏好如何传递提供了更广阔的视角。

Abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

</details>


### [104] [Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04264)
*Aoran Zhang,César A. Uribe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自适应KL-BAPG（A-KL-BAPG），通过受限惩罚策略消除BAPG固定惩罚松弛的可行性缺口，并给出收敛性与平稳性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein问题非凸且边际约束耦合，计算困难；Bregman交替投影梯度（BAPG）虽更新廉价，但固定惩罚松弛导致持续存在的可行性缺口，且其平稳性保证仅针对松弛问题而非原始GW问题。

Method: A-KL-BAPG结合有限固定惩罚预热阶段与带守卫的递增惩罚阶段。尾部迭代复用BAPG的交替更新，并回溯延迟幂步长，直到满足受Sinkhorn启发的投影直径保护条件。

Result: 证明每次迭代回溯有限终止且可行性缺口渐近消失；建立加权平方修正残差的最佳迭代O(1/log N)界，并在支撑正则条件下证明原GW问题存在平稳聚点。实验中相较固定惩罚KL-BAPG，边际可行性缺口降低62-99%，投影平稳残差降低28-98%，同时保持相当的精度与目标值。

Conclusion: A-KL-BAPG在精度、目标值、可行性与平稳性之间取得良好平衡，优于BAPG变体、投影类方法及任务特定基线，且给出针对原GW问题而非松弛问题的平稳性保证。

Abstract: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

</details>


### [105] [Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04269)
*Zixuan Wang,Hao Li,Fengyu Gao,G. Edward Suh,Yi Zeng,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Ning Zhang,Chaowei Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自反思微调（SRFT）训练框架，让LLM智能体从自身在对抗攻击下的失败经验中学习，以提升对提示注入攻击的鲁棒性，并构建了SR-Agent。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在工具增强环境中依赖外部输入，易受提示注入攻击而劫持任务目标；现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式。

Method: SRFT不被动模仿专家行为，而是将智能体暴露于经注入攻击构造的被破坏轨迹中，并借助专家模型生成结构化的自反思推理，对比不安全与最优动作。这种反思监督教导智能体识别恶意指令、推理其后果并保持与原始用户意图的一致。基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B实例化为SR-Agent。

Result: 在静态和自适应提示注入基准上评估，SRFT显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能，并在自适应攻击下展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过自反思从失败中学习，是构建稳健且安全的LLM智能体的一条有前景的方向。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.

</details>


### [106] [Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04272)
*Roy Xie,Dan Friedman,Feng Nan,Yukun Huang,Zhichao Xu,Chengjiu Zhang,Jun Xu,Manaal Faruqui,Vivek Rathod,Bhuwan Dhingra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)相比离线策略方法(如SFT)的精度优势主要来源于训练设计选择与超参数调优，而非算法本身；简单调优的离线基线可达几乎相同的精度，且训练成本低14.8–23.1倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)在近期前沿语言模型后训练中被认为优于传统离线策略方法，但其推理与环境交互成本更高。作者希望厘清MOPD的精度增益究竟来自算法本身，还是来自训练设计与超参数优化。

Method: 在两种多教师设置、4个模型、11个基准上进行受控的自蒸馏研究，对比离线方法(SFT、软标签蒸馏)与混合教师前缀蒸馏及MOPD；并重新审视4篇已发表的在线/离线策略蒸馏对比，在SFT基线使用拒绝采样教师轨迹并独立调参的条件下重估结果；同时测试免训练的权重合并方法作为替代方案。

Result: 四种方法精度几乎相同，但MOPD消耗SFT训练GPU小时的14.8–23.1倍；重新审视的4项研究中，在线策略增益在公平基线(拒绝采样轨迹+独立调参)下大幅缩小；权重合并仅需数分钟CPU即可恢复专家能力，但在模型变小、任务干扰增大时精度下降。

Conclusion: 近期MOPD报告的增益值得质疑，其优势多来自调参与设计而非算法；精心调优的高效离线策略基线是可行替代方案，简单权重合并也可在低成本下恢复能力。

Abstract: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.

</details>


### [107] [Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04273)
*Yue Liu,Ben Liang,Ali Tizghadam,Ilijc Albanese*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IICN，将缺失值填补与分类联合训练，通过对抗方式让填补器与(n+1)类判别器协同优化，理论证明全局最优时实现缺失坐标的边缘化并得到贝叶斯最优分类器，在多个数据集上优于传统"先填补后分类"流程和生成式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有处理缺失特征的方法通常将填补与分类解耦，得到的填补值虽然看似合理，但对预测任务可能缺乏信息量，导致分类性能次优。作者希望让填补过程直接服务于分类目标。

Method: 提出IICN（Integrated Imputation and Classification Network），用一个单一的分类监督目标联合对抗训练填补器和(n+1)类判别器，其中判别器需区分n个真实类别和一个额外的"填补"类别。
