Result: 在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10以及天然存在缺失的表格数据集上评估，IICN优于经典"先填补后分类"流程和近期生成式基线，在困难场景下表现出较强的鲁棒性和准确率。

Conclusion: 理论上证明在全局最优时，填补器与判别器共同实现缺失坐标上的边缘化，从而给出贝叶斯最优分类器；实验验证了联合对抗式填补与分类在缺失特征监督分类问题上的有效性。

Abstract: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

</details>


### [108] [Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04278)
*Manh Hien Nguyen,Ngoc Thanh Nguyen,Isabella Mendoza Cortes,Tam Khuat,Thanh Pham,Nhat Quang Tran,Ushik Shrestha Khwakhali,Loan Do*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在NASA C-MAPSS（FD001/FD003）上训练1D CNN、LSTM与小型Transformer，并对比Integrated Gradients、occlusion与末层注意力三种归因图的忠实性、噪声稳定性、跨种子一致性与RUL分段内余弦一致性，主张工程报告应使用occlusion或IG，注意力权重仅作可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: C-MAPSS上的深度RUL模型与传感器-时间步热图已很常规，但"看起来像机理"的热图并不等于工程师可据以行动的可靠解释；XAI-for-PdM文献对忠实性、噪声稳定性、跨训练种子一致性等检验仍报告不足。论文旨在补齐这些评估，回答哪种解释方法真正驱动RUL输出、哪种能经受输入扰动与重训练。

Method: 采用官方FD001和FD003划分，使用分段RUL上限125循环与官方PHM08非对称评分；训练1D CNN、LSTM与小Transformer编码器三种标准架构，并附加三种归因图（Integrated Gradients、occlusion、末层注意力）。评估维度包括删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声下Spearman稳定性、跨训练种子一致性、RUL分箱内余弦一致性；预测误差仅作为前提而非结论。另在AI4I 2020故障数据集上做表格特征重要性（树模型）的补充检验。

Result: 在LSTM上，Integrated Gradients与occlusion的忠实性相近；Transformer注意力计算便宜且时间上平滑，但忠实性较弱。三种归因图在5%输入噪声下几乎不变，然而IG与occlusion在两个LSTM种子间的跨种子一致性仅为中等——对传感器抖动的稳定性不等于对重训练的稳定性。AI4I 2020的树重要性呈现相同的删除模式。

Conclusion: 建议任何面向维修工程师的C-MAPSS类报告使用occlusion或Integrated Gradients，原始注意力权重仅作为可视化用途，不应当作可解释性证据。

Abstract: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

</details>


### [109] [First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04283)
*Sri Pranav Kunda,Alexander Kurz,Tomas Dominik,Uri Maoz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 First-Order Steering 与 HeRD-Merging，将激活引导表述为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，从而生成可组合、更精准的引导向量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导虽能在推理时操控模型行为，但将多个引导向量组合以同时实现多种目标行为仍具挑战；而模型合并领域的研究表明，学习到的权重调整所代表的目标行为可以高精度地组合。

Method: 提出 First-Order Steering，作为由引导强度向量参数化的权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，并给出近似误差的理论界；进而提出模型合并方法 HeRD-Merging，通过最小化一阶近似误差项来提升一阶引导精度。

Result: 所生成引导向量在控制单一及组合行为方面比现有激活引导方法更准确；HeRD-Merging 在性能上匹配传统模型合并基线，同时产生可支持更精准一阶引导向量的权重调整。

Conclusion: 将权重调整转化为激活引导向量，可结合模型合并与激活引导的优势，实现更准确的同时推理时行为控制。

Abstract: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.

</details>


### [110] [Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04299)
*Jinyuan Li,Chengsong Huang,Langlin Huang,Donghong Cai,Shiping Gao,Yuyi Yang,Jiaxin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析自演化推理模型性能崩溃原因，提出R-Quest方法，通过问题有效性与新颖性反馈指导自演化，在12个基准上表现最优并保持十轮稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化推理模型通过自我生成问题学习，但反复自训练会导致性能崩溃。作者希望探究性能随轮次退化的原因，并找到维持自演化的方法。

Method: 分析发现两类问题：无效问题随轮次增多，且答案一致性过滤会提高其比例；基于词汇相似度的多样性控制会漏掉数学等价但表述不同的问题，导致后期多样性崩溃。据此提出R-Quest：先训练求解器识别并拒绝无效问题，用其判断指导提问者奖励并过滤训练数据；再用冻结基模型比较采样问题对，提供新颖性反馈以避免重复。

Result: 在两个模型家族的数学推理、通用领域推理和代码生成共12个基准上，方法持续取得最高平均性能；在十轮自演化中保持稳定增益，最后一轮达到峰值，比R-Zero高17.32分。

Conclusion: 通过引入问题有效性和新颖性反馈，可缓解自演化中的性能崩溃，实现长期稳定的自我进化。

Abstract: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

</details>


### [111] [What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04303)
*Peilin Wang,Feng Shiyang,Hongfu Gao,Cencheng Zhao,Di Yuan,Hui Chen,Guiguang Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出递归预测闭包原则，将局部预测充分性转化为可训练约束，通过预测灵敏度构建半空间约束并在必要时投影优化器更新，在四类递归压缩任务中匹配或提升宿主模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归计算反复压缩或复用中间状态，导致需在较长递归路径上保持有用的信息面临更多丢失风险。现有重构或局部预测目标虽可提供可处理监督，但无法保证保留下来的信息足以支撑后续递归计算。

Method: 提出“递归预测闭包”原则：控制各局部接口的预测缺陷即可控制根节点处的偏差。从变分刻画出发，导出有限预测检验与经验预测缺陷，度量跨压缩保留的预测价值；其预测灵敏度定义松弛间隔的半空间约束，仅当预测保持将被破坏时，将宿主优化器的更新投影到这些约束的交集上。

Result: 在时间图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作控制与递归自我改进四类任务上，在相同压缩预算下匹配或优于对应宿主模型；递归或记忆需求越重，增益越大，同时更好地在连续变换间保留预测信息。

Conclusion: 同一任务无关的预测保持原则通过宿主兼容干预在四种设定中实例化，且保持端点任务、骨干网络与评测协议不变，表明递归接口处的预测保持是递归压缩的通用训练原则。

Abstract: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.

</details>


### [112] [Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04310)
*Christian Cianfarani,Aloni Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究用户在行使"被遗忘权"时的行为如何影响模型删除效果，定义了适应性（adaptivity）和集体性（collectivity）两类行为，并从理论与实验两方面揭示其影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI模型广泛应用，用户希望行使"被遗忘权"删除自身数据。然而现有研究多关注删除技术本身，较少探讨用户行为策略（如是否适应性请求、是否集体行动）对模型行为的实际影响，这一视角缺失促使作者展开研究。

Method: 作者将用户目标与随机优化理论相联系，定义并区分了适应性（adaptivity）和集体性（collectivity）两种用户行为；随后引入数据估值（data valuation）技术，设计能够显著改变模型行为的删除请求者（deletion requesters）；并在计算机视觉任务上进行实验，尝试分离两种行为各自的贡献。

Result: 理论分析表明，展现与不展现上述行为的用户群体，其删除请求对模型的影响存在显著差距；借助数据估值设计的删除请求者能在现实场景中显著改变模型行为；实验显示不同用户行为模型产生差异化效果，并初步分离出适应性与集体性的独立影响。

Conclusion: 用户在行使删除权时的行为策略（适应性与集体性）会实质性影响机器学习模型的最终行为，数据估值技术可被用于设计具有更强影响力的删除请求，这为"被遗忘权"的实际有效性和治理政策提供了新的分析视角。

Abstract: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

</details>


### [113] [LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04326)
*Minseon Gwak,Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Danielle C. Maddix,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LyapuFlow，用 Lyapunov 反馈控制实现预训练流模型的测试时约束满足，在科学机器学习与图像逆问题中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练流模型被广泛用作生成先验，需要在不重训练的前提下于推理阶段施加约束。现有方法依赖投影、后验采样或对生成轨迹的迭代优化，各有局限，作者希望提供一种基于控制理论的新替代方案。

Method: 在每个采样步，先预测当前流所趋向的终端样本，并在该预测上评估约束违反程度；随后求解满足给定 Lyapunov 下降条件的最小范数控制量。当无控动力学本身已按指定速率降低约束违反时，控制保持不激活；否则在反馈信任域内施加修正更新，避免控制主导预训练动力学。

Result: 在数据空间与潜空间均进行了验证，在科学机器学习和图像逆问题中，性能优于采用不同机制的测试时约束施加替代方法。

Conclusion: Lyapunov 反馈控制为流模型的测试时约束满足提供了有效且通用的框架，可跨数据与潜空间应用。

Abstract: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.

</details>


### [114] [S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04338)
*Fan Yan,Chen Hui,Weisi Lin,Haiqi Zhu,Feng Jiang,Sun-Yuan Kung,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 S³N，用 L2Proj 双向投影与螺旋状态空间扫描解决 HEALPix 网格映射误差和跨面通信问题，在中长期天气预报中表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HEALPix 网格可避免经纬网格极区面积畸变，但现有方法多用逐点映射并仅在独立基面或局部窗口处理像素，导致重建误差，且跨面信息交流依赖手工边界处理或偏移窗口。

Method: S³N 包含两部分：L2Proj 通过连续有限元表示的 L² 投影，在 LL 与 HP 网格间双向映射大气场；AQSS 模块用跨纬度注意力引导沿四条全球极到极螺旋路径的选择性状态空间更新。

Result: 在 4、7、10 天预报时效上取得更好结果，长程预报中误差增长更慢。

Conclusion: S³N 同时缓解了映射误差与跨面通信问题，无需额外边界处理机制，提升了机器学习天气预报的精度与长期稳定性。

Abstract: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.

</details>


### [115] [Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04344)
*Qi Yu,Ruizhong Qiu,Zhichen Zeng,Xuying Ning,Yanjun Zhao,Dongqi Fu,Yinglong Xia,Hong Li,Hanghang Tong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出HarA，一种用于基于组的RLVR方法的分层信用分配方法，通过语义新颖性信号重加权token级优势以增强LLM探索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于组的RLVR方法（如GRPO）对同一结果的所有token赋予统一优势，而现有改进多依赖token位置或熵等局部信号，无法捕捉推理行为相对于当前策略的全局语义新颖性。

Method: HarA将每个采样rollout表示为token隐状态与位置的分布，计算同一结果下所有rollout的Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenter以捕捉潜在空间中的内部推理模式；用推理元素对当前rollout与barycenter之间FGW距离的贡献度量语义新颖性。为降低FGW求解开销，引入anchor-guided linearization将其转化为可用Sinkhorn算法高效求解的Wasserstein形式，并据此重加权token级优势，支持灵活粒度的新颖推理行为强调。

Result: 在三种基于组的RLVR方法上进行大量实验，该即插即用方法有效增强LLM探索能力，在多种推理基准上优于现有方法。

Conclusion: HarA通过全局语义新颖性驱动的分层信用分配，改善了组级RLVR的细粒度探索，具有即插即用、跨方法通用的优势。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [116] [Checkable NTK Positivity and Finite-Width Gradient Descent for Scalar- and Vector-Valued PINNs with Strong-Form, Weak-Form, and Nonlocal Linear Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04357)
*Zifan Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为带线性约束的PINN给出了可检验的极限NTK正定性判据，以及有限宽度梯度下降的高概率收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN训练常依赖梯度下降，但其收敛性缺乏理论保证；尤其在线性约束（微分方程、初边值、弱形式、非局部观测等）下，极限NTK是否正定、有限宽度下能否几何收敛尚不清楚。论文旨在提供训练前即可计算的可检验证书，检测结构性零模态并给出有限宽度收敛条件。

Method: 针对标量或向量值、带线性约束的PINN：约束可为任意固定有限阶强形式微分行（含耦合系统）、任意线性初边值条件、弱形式残差与边界泛函，或有限测度非局部观测（积分、非局部扩散、Dirac数据行），适用于任意维度。证明每类约束下极限NTK正定等价于固定设计的有限系数矩阵、泛函矩阵或矩矩阵的秩条件，从而给出训练前可计算的结构性零模态检测证书。模型为普通两层PINN、光滑非多项式激活、有界对称初始化（如均匀初始化的tanh）。在证书成立时，给出显式宽度与步长条件，使经验NTK以高概率保留至少一半极限间隙，且全批量梯度下降每次迭代训练损失几何下降。

Result: 建立了极限NTK正定性的秩条件等价刻画（作为可计算证书），并在满足该证书时证明：显式宽度与步长条件下，经验NTK以高概率保留至少一半极限谱间隙，全批量梯度下降使训练损失几何衰减。受控实验验证了证书的有效性与有限宽度机制。

Conclusion: 该工作将NTK理论扩展到带广泛线性约束的PINN，提供训练前可检验的正定性证书与有限宽度梯度下降收敛保证，统一覆盖强形式、弱形式及非局部观测约束，并由实验验证。

Abstract: We give checkable positive-definiteness criteria for the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK) and high-probability finite-width gradient-descent guarantees for scalar- or vector-valued physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with linear constraints. The constraints may be strong-form differential rows of any fixed finite order, including coupled systems, with any linear initial or boundary conditions; weak-form residual and boundary functionals; or finite-measure nonlocal observations such as integral, nonlocal-diffusion, and Dirac-data rows, all in any dimension. For each class, positive definiteness of the limiting NTK is equivalent to a rank condition on a finite coefficient, functional, or moment matrix of the fixed design: a certificate computed before training that detects structural zero modes. The model hypotheses are those of an ordinary two-layer PINN, a smooth nonpolynomial activation with bounded symmetric initialization, and are met by standard choices such as $\tanh$ with uniform initialization. Given a certificate, explicit width and step-size conditions ensure, with high probability, that the empirical NTK retains at least half the limiting gap and that full-batch gradient descent decreases the training loss geometrically at every iteration. Controlled experiments check the certificates and the finite-width mechanism.

</details>


### [117] [A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04364)
*Logan Mondal Bhamidipaty,Lauren Robson,Linda Petrini,Shengrui Lyu,Kamal Ndousse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BIRD 基准，将基于 LLM 的迭代奖励设计方法统一到相同配置与评测空间，从而可公平比较、消融并原型化新组件，并发现一组简单设计选择即可显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在强化学习中设计有效的奖励函数通常需要大量专业知识和反复试错。近期工作用基于 LLM 的系统自动生成并迭代改进奖励代码，但这些方法因实现细节、反馈假设和评测环境不同而难以直接比较，因此需要统一的基准来支撑公平对比与设计分析。

Method: 作者提出 BIRD（Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design），把既有方法表达在统一的配置与评测空间中，使其可在匹配的反馈条件和策略训练预算下直接比较算法、消融单个设计选择，并原型化新组件。实验覆盖 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax 和 HumanoidBench。

Result: 在四个基准环境中，作者识别出一小组简单设计选择可以持续提升性能，将这些选择组合后，性能显著优于所评估的先前方法。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了简单基线的强度，并激励进一步研究何时增加算法复杂度才能真正改善迭代奖励设计。代码已开源。

Abstract: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.

</details>


### [118] [A multi-stage probabilistic framework to estimate gas-fired generator performance during extreme winter weather](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04368)
*Sajjad Uddin Mahmud,Anamika Dubey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个三阶段贝叶斯概率框架，利用公开天气与电力需求数据及NERC匿名机组故障记录，估计冬季极端天气下发电机组的故障概率、可用容量与事件持续时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端冬季天气反复扰乱美国燃气发电，但系统量化停运风险所需的机组级数据多为专有数据，难以获取，因此需要一种基于公开数据的可迁移评估方法。

Method: 构建三阶段贝叶斯概率框架，依次估计：故障事件的每小时概率、事件发生条件下的预期净可用容量、以及事件持续时间。数据来源为公开天气与电力需求数据及NERC匿名机组故障记录，应用于纽约州2013--2022年。

Result: 更冷条件和更高电力需求对应更高的故障概率、更低的保留容量和更长的事件持续时间。最严重压力条件下，估计平均每小时事件概率达24%，预期平均净可用容量降至额定容量的13%。完全停运事件中位持续时间为12.7小时，部分降额事件持续时间随容量损失严重程度从2.4小时增至7.1小时。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个可迁移的基线，拥有机组级记录的公用事业公司可直接扩展以获得更精确的可靠性估计，用于运营规划和资源充裕性评估。

Abstract: Extreme winter weather has repeatedly disrupted gas-fired power generation in the United States, yet the plant-level data needed to systematically quantify outage risk remain proprietary. Using publicly available weather and electricity demand data together with anonymized generator contingency records from the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), we develop a three-stage Bayesian probabilistic framework for estimating winter-driven generator performance. Applied to New York State (2013--2022), the framework sequentially estimates: the hourly probability of a generator contingency event, the expected net available capacity conditioned on an event occurring, and the event duration. Colder conditions and higher electricity demand are associated with higher failure probability, lower retained capacity, and longer event duration. Under the most severe observed stress conditions, estimated mean hourly event probability reaches 24\% , while expected mean net available capacity falls to 13\% of nameplate rating. Full outage events have a median duration of 12.7 hours, while partial derating event duration increases from 2.4 to 7.1 hours with capacity loss severity. The proposed framework establishes a transferable baseline that utilities with access to plant-level records can directly extend to obtain more precise reliability estimates for operational planning and resource adequacy assessment.

</details>


### [119] [CEENs: Causality-enforced evolutional networks for solving time-dependent partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04405)
*Jeahan Jung,Heechang Kim,Hyomin Shin,Minseok Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将时间因果性融入训练的物理信息神经网络方法，通过划分时间子区间并为每个子区间分配独立网络，按时间顺序训练，显著提升长时间PDE求解的精度和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始PINN在长时间积分求解PDE时效果受限，其原因在于原公式未考虑时间因果性，导致模型偏向先满足后期时间的控制方程而忽略初始条件，从而产生错误解。

Method: 借鉴经典数值方法中体现时间因果性的思想，将时间域划分为不重叠的子区间，为每个子区间分配一个独立的神经网络，并基于子区间内PDE的积分形式构建损失函数；网络从初始时间步开始进行顺序训练。此外提供并行化算法。

Result: 在多个PDE问题的长时间模拟中，该方法精度显著优于原始PINN（后者失败），且相比PINN需要更少的计算成本和内存；并行化算法进一步提升了求解效率，取得显著加速。

Conclusion: 通过将时间因果性融入训练，该方法有效解决了PINN长时间积分PDE的难题，兼顾精度、计算成本与内存优势，并具备良好的并行加速潜力。

Abstract: Despite the growing popularity of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), their applicability in the long-time integration of partial differential equations (PDEs) remains constrained. We argue that this problem stems from the lack of consideration of temporal causality in the original PINN formulation, resulting in a bias towards satisfying governing equations at later times before learning the initial condition and hence leading to erroneous solutions. To this end, we propose a novel method that seamlessly integrates temporal causality into the training process. Drawing inspiration from classical numerical methods where the temporal causality is reflected, we divide the time domain into nonoverlapping subintervals, assign a unique neural network to each subinterval, and construct a loss function founded on the integral form of PDEs within these subintervals. The proposed networks undergo sequential training, beginning with the initial time step. Our method demonstrates significant improvement in accuracy for long-time simulations of various PDE problems where the original PINN method fails while it requires less computational cost and memory compared to the PINN method. A parallelization algorithm is provided to further enhance the computational efficiency, showing a significant speedup for solving time-dependent PDEs.

</details>


### [120] [Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04413)
*Yanglin Zhang,Anneke von Seeger,Gilad Lerman,Ron Levie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个原则性框架，构建其参数实现可被显式算法解释的神经网络：将数据建模为类相关随机过程，用统计量作为判别依据，并让网络初始参数精确实现估计这些统计量的算法，再在限制偏离初始化的条件下微调，从而保持可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"算法启发式"架构虽能解释网络的计算结构，但经标准训练后，学习到的参数与原始启发算法之间往往不再有清晰关系，导致可解释性丧失。论文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。

Method: 1) 将每个数据点建模为类相关随机过程的样本，假设其统计量可从单样本估计且足以区分类别；2) 构造初始参数精确实现该统计量估计算法的神经网络，使网络完全可解释；3) 针对理想模型与真实数据的失配，在控制偏离算法初始化的约束下微调网络；4) 用PAC-Bayes分析给出泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径缩放；5) 以散射变换估计判别统计量，实例化于纹理分类任务。

Result: PAC-Bayes分析得到一个均匀泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径变化，为该"受限微调"方法提供了统计动机；并将框架实例化到基于散射变换的纹理分类任务。

Conclusion: 通过算法初始化+受限微调，训练后的网络能大致保留初始网络的可解释性，同时兼顾真实数据上的性能，且理论分析支持该设计的泛化优势。

Abstract: We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.

</details>


### [121] [MaDeL: Manifold-Decomposed Feature Losses for Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04419)
*Beomsu Kim,Jong Chul Ye,Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MaDeL损失：通过从含噪观测学习互补表示，分别捕捉流形切向与法向变化，实现对内在变化与离流形偏差的各向异性度量，无需显式估计流形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型常用各向同性损失（如MSE），对于集中在低维流形附近的数据，这类损失无法区分沿流形的位移（有效变化）与离开流形的位移（产生无效样本）。在稀疏、高约束领域尤为严重，环境空间回归会鼓励离流形插值。

Method: MaDeL（流形分解特征损失）：从损坏观测中学习两个互补表示，一个恢复干净样本，另一个恢复损坏项。在特征瓶颈下，证明二者雅可比矩阵分别对齐切空间与法空间（线性流形上精确成立，光滑流形上局部成立）。由此定义各向异性目标，分别度量内在变化与离流形偏差，无需显式估计流形。

Result: 在合成数据、地球与气候科学、扭转角基准上，MaDeL在单步采样下提升了支撑恢复与平均角度Wasserstein距离；在蛋白质骨架上，减少了一步及少步采样预算下的立体冲突。

Conclusion: MaDeL可在不显式估计流形的情况下，直接从数据区分流形平行与流形正交变化，提供有效的各向异性生成目标，并在多领域基准上显著优于各向同性损失。

Abstract: Generative models are often trained with isotropic objectives such as mean-squared error. For data concentrated near a low-dimensional manifold, however, such losses conflate displacement along the manifold, which may represent valid variation, with displacement away from it, which produces invalid samples. This mismatch is especially problematic in sparse, highly constrained domains, where ambient-space regression can encourage off-manifold interpolation. We ask whether a generative objective can distinguish manifold-parallel variation from manifold-orthogonal deviation directly from data, without explicitly estimating the manifold. We introduce a manifold-decomposed feature loss (MaDeL) that learns complementary representations from corrupted observations: one is trained to recover the clean sample, while the other is trained to recover the corruption. We show that, under a feature bottleneck, their Jacobians align with the tangent and normal spaces, exactly for linear manifolds and locally for smooth manifolds. Together, these representations define an anisotropic objective that separately measures intrinsic variation and off-manifold deviation. Across synthetic, Earth and climate science, and torsion-angle benchmarks, MaDeL improves support recovery and average angular $W_1$ under single-step sampling; on protein backbones, it reduces steric clashes across one- and few-step sampling budgets.

</details>


### [122] [Measuring Effective Data Resolution in Guided Diffusion Posteriors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04422)
*Ridham Patel,Defu Cao,Jiacheng Pang,Yan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"有效数据分辨率"概念，用于衡量黑盒生成式后验中采样器实际利用了观测数据中的多少信息，并通过扰动估计器量化采样器实现的分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引导扩散采样器被广泛用于从稀疏观测重建物理场，但标准诊断方法无法说明重建结果中有多少真正由数据决定。

Method: 引入有效数据分辨率：比较逆问题所要求的自由度 dof_ref 与采样器实际实现的自由度 dof_samp；用扰动估计器仅通过查询采样器来测量 dof_samp 及空间映射 R(x,x)。

Result: 估计器经精确参考验证；测量显示引导权重会强烈改变表观信息传递，即使先验与得分函数精确，均值、离散度与分辨率也无法由单一权重同时校正；分辨率保真度并不随引导规则表观上的"原理性"而可靠提升。

Conclusion: 引导扩散中的信息传递需要显式的分辨率诊断，不能仅凭引导规则的理论优雅性判断其重建可靠性。

Abstract: Guided diffusion samplers are increasingly used to reconstruct physical fields from sparse observations, but standard diagnostics do not say how much of the reconstruction was actually determined by the data. We introduce effective data resolution for black-box generative posteriors: a comparison between the resolution warranted by the inverse problem, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{ref}}$, and the resolution realised by the sampler, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$. A perturbation estimator measures $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$ and the spatial map $R(x,x)$ from sampler queries alone. We validate the estimator against exact references and use it to study guided diffusion. The resulting measurements show that guidance weight can strongly alter apparent information transfer, that mean, spread and resolution are not jointly corrected by one weight even with an exact prior and score, and that resolution fidelity does not follow reliably from the apparent principledness of a guidance rule.

</details>


### [123] [On the Trade-off Between Information Loss and Generalization in Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04424)
*Zhongqi Fan,Zheng Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对稀疏注意力机制进行理论分析，刻画其JS散度近似误差与泛化间隙，揭示稀疏性在信息保真度与泛化能力之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏注意力虽在缓解Transformer二次复杂度瓶颈上取得广泛经验成功，但其理论研究仍较零散。两个基本问题尚不清晰：(1)稀疏化如何影响注意力机制的信息保真度；(2)这种信息损失如何与模型泛化行为相互作用。

Method: 首先通过JS散度刻画近似误差：假设注意力分数为i.i.d.次高斯随机变量（参数sigma），基于截断质量alpha的次序统计量集中分析，推导全注意力分布与稀疏注意力分布间JS散度的闭式表达。随后用Rademacher复杂度推导泛化界；并结合基于互信息的泛化界与稀疏假设类的熵和覆盖数分析，得到依赖稀疏度的泛化界。

Result: JS散度闭式形式为 log 2 + ((1 - alpha)/2) log(1 - alpha) - ((2 - alpha)/2) log(2 - alpha)。基于Rademacher复杂度的泛化界为 O(gamma * sqrt(M/n) * (sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(pi)/2))；基于互信息与覆盖数分析的稀疏依赖泛化界为 O(sqrt((M/(2n)) * (log(eL/M) + log(1 + 2/epsilon))))。

Conclusion: 稀疏性降低了所考虑假设类的复杂度，同时引入了可由JS散度刻画的近似误差。这些发现为稀疏Transformer架构中信息保真度与泛化能力之间的权衡提供了理论刻画。

Abstract: To mitigate the quadratic complexity bottleneck of the Transformer, sparse attention has emerged as a pivotal technology. Despite the extensive empirical success of sparse Transformers, the theoretical understanding of sparse attention remains fragmented. In particular, two fundamental questions remain unclear: (1) How does sparsification affect the information fidelity of attention mechanisms? (2) How does this information loss interact with the generalization behavior of the model? To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a systematic analysis of the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence and of the generalization gap of sparse attention mechanisms. Specifically, we first characterize the approximation error via the JS divergence. Through an order-statistics-based concentration analysis of the truncation mass alpha --- where the attention scores are assumed to be independent and identically distributed sub-Gaussian random variables with parameter sigma --- the JS divergence between the full attention distribution and the sparse attention distribution is shown to admit the closed form log 2 + ((1 - alpha)/2) log(1 - alpha) - ((2 - alpha)/2) log(2 - alpha). Subsequently, we derive a generalization bound through Rademacher complexity, quantified by O(gamma * sqrt(M/n) * (sqrt(log(3eL/M)) + sqrt(pi)/2)). Furthermore, building on a mutual-information-based generalization bound together with an entropy and covering-number analysis of the sparse hypothesis class, we obtain the sparsity-dependent generalization bound O(sqrt((M/(2n)) * (log(eL/M) + log(1 + 2/epsilon)))). Our analysis shows that sparsity reduces the complexity of the considered hypothesis class while introducing approximation error that can be quantified by the JS divergence. These findings provide a theoretical characterization of the trade-off between information fidelity and generalization in sparse Transformer architectures.

</details>


### [124] [UnAct: Gradient-Free Unlearning via Targeted Activation Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04426)
*Saeed Abdul Muizz,Aayat Rafiq,Iqra Altaf Gillani,Janibul Bashir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UnAct 是一种免梯度、无需标签和保留数据的类别遗忘方法，仅需对遗忘图像做前向传播即可从模型中移除类别影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免重训方法（如 SSD 和 LFSSD）虽然避免了完整重训，但仍需反向传播并在整个数据集上计算参数重要性。本文关注更现实的场景：删除请求仅提供少量待遗忘类别的图像时，这些方法会失效甚至导致网络崩溃。

Method: UnAct 通过前向传播对后层单元进行响应打分，衰减响应最强的连接，并最多迭代 20 轮；整个过程不使用梯度、不使用标签、也不使用保留数据。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10/20/100 上训练的 ResNet-18 上，UnAct 在全类遗忘任务中与 SSD、LFSSD 相当；在遗忘数据稀缺时不会崩溃。所有测试规模下，UnAct 的保留精度与重训相差不超过 2.5 个百分点，而 SSD 和 LFSSD 在某些类别上损失高达 86 个百分点。CIFAR-10 上用 5 张遗忘图像时，UnAct 与重训的距离为 0.21 个百分点，LFSSD 为 67，SSD 为 90；即便用 oracle 为 SSD 逐规模重选阈值也无法弥补差距。在 ViT-B/16 初步迁移中，UnAct 与重训距离为 11.5，SSD 为 33.7，且请求处理速度比在请求时计算重要性的 SSD 快 19 倍。

Conclusion: UnAct 在少量遗忘图像场景下显著优于 SSD 和 LFSSD，避免网络崩溃，保持接近重训的保留精度，并具备良好的迁移性与效率。

Abstract: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of designated training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Retrain-free methods such as Selective Synaptic Dampening (SSD) and its label-free variant LFSSD avoid full retraining but still require backpropagation and parameter importance computed over the entire dataset. We ask: what happens when a deletion request arrives with only a few images of the class to be forgotten? To answer this question, we introduce UnAct, a gradient-free class-unlearning method that needs only forward passes over the forget images. UnAct scores late-layer units by their responses, attenuates the most responsive connections, and repeats this for up to 20 rounds using no gradients, no labels, and no retained data. On ResNet-18 trained with CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20, and CIFAR-100, UnAct is competitive with SSD and LFSSD when forgetting entire classes and, unlike them, never collapses the network when forget data is scarce. On ResNet-18, across all tested sizes, UnAct's retain accuracy stays within 2.5 points of retraining, while SSD and LFSSD, at their full-class operating points, lose up to 86 points on some classes. With five forget images on CIFAR-10, UnAct's distance to retraining is 0.21 points, against 67 for LFSSD and 90 for SSD, and re-selecting SSD's threshold at each size with an oracle does not close the gap. In preliminary transfer to ViT-B/16, UnAct's distance to retraining is 11.5 against 33.7 for SSD, and a request is 19x faster than SSD when SSD computes its importance at request time. The code is available at https://github.com/abdulmuizz0903/UnAct

</details>


### [125] [COSMOS: Soft Mechanism Mixtures with Verifiable Routing for Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04427)
*Anupam Rawat,Manikandan Padmanaban,Jagabondhu Hazra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 COSMOS，一种软机制混合神经算子，通过四个过程偏置专家与学习门控的连续混合来建模复合PDE物理，并引入已知混合权重的算子分裂组合基准；实验显示稠密软路由优于硬top-1路由，但精度优势不稳定且路由标签与机制身份不对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子多为每个方程族和离散化学习单一映射，而真实系统具有组合性（输运、扩散、波动、反应可同时发生）。已有的专家混合算子通常采用稀疏top-K路由，但并发物理本质上是连续混合而非离散选择，因此需要软机制的混合方式。

Method: 提出 COSMOS（Cooperative Operator Specialists with Mechanism-level Operator Soft-routing）：四个过程偏置专家在每步均保持激活，由学习门控连续混合，特征经小型网络融合；专家共享粗潜网格，零初始化全分辨率残差恢复瓶颈丢失的细节。同时引入带每轨迹已知混合权重 w* 的算子分裂组合基准。

Result: 与族调优的FNO在20步滚动预测下相比：初测3种子时扩散-反应有提升、Navier-Stokes持平、浅水较弱；11种子复核显示扩散-反应增益不稳定，故无法可靠宣称精度胜利。消融表明均匀路由或移除专家混合会显著降低稳定区滚动表现。在标注基准上，稠密软路由误差比同融合的硬top-1低2.2倍；使用生成器权重 w* 推理可将滚动误差降至0.034，揭示学习门控的局限。但路由标签与专家预期机制不对齐。

Conclusion: COSMOS支持组合精度，但不支持机制身份识别；路由标签无法对应专家设计的物理机制。研究还强调小种子滚动比较的谨慎性，以及学习门控在识别真实混合权重方面的局限。

Abstract: Neural operators offer an efficient alternative to classical PDE solvers, but most learn a monolithic map per equation family and discretization. Real systems are compositional: transport, diffusion, wave, and reaction processes can act simultaneously. Existing mixture-of-experts operators typically use sparse top-$K$ routing, although concurrent physics is naturally a blend rather than a discrete choice.
  We propose COSMOS (Cooperative Operator Specialists with Mechanism-level Operator Soft-routing), a soft mechanism-mixture neural operator. Four process-biased specialists remain active at every step and are continuously mixed by a learned gate, with their features fused by a small network. Specialists share a coarse latent grid, while a zero-initialized full-resolution residual restores detail lost through the bottleneck. We also introduce an operator-splitting compositional benchmark with known mixture weights $w^\star$ per trajectory.
  Against family-tuned FNO under 20-step rollouts, an initial 3-seed evaluation suggested gains on diffusion--reaction, parity on Navier--Stokes, and weaker shallow-water performance. An 11-seed audit showed that the diffusion--reaction gain was unstable, motivating caution in small-seed rollout comparisons and precluding a reliable accuracy-win claim on these families. Ablations show that uniform routing or removing the specialist mixture substantially degrades stable-regime rollouts. On the labeled benchmark, dense soft routing yields $2.2\times$ lower error than hard top-1 routing at identical fusion; using generator weights $w^\star$ at inference further lowers rollout error to $0.034$, diagnosing limitations of the learned gate. However, routing labels do not align with the specialists' intended mechanisms: COSMOS supports compositional accuracy, not mechanism identity.

</details>


### [126] [LocusRL: Diagnosing LLM Reward and Policy Interventions in Competitive Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04441)
*Chengyu Luan,Bo Xin,Songyan Guo,Yuxiang Zuo,Ahmed Yazdan,Jiahang Li,Yicheng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出诊断框架 LocusRL，将 LLM 干预强化学习的评估从"看聚合性能"转向"追踪奖励与动作如何转化为学习信号"，揭示性能差异背后的机制并验证修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 可通过奖励设计与动作选择干预强化学习，但仅凭聚合回报无法说明干预的真实作用：相同回报可能掩盖不同机制，看似合理的奖励也可能诱发不良行为，因此需要可追踪、可验证的诊断方法。

Method: LocusRL 将受控的奖励—策略对比与多层面审计结合，审计对象包括奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标和实际执行动作；通过可执行规则与反事实回放，把性能差异追溯到可检验的解释，并检验针对性修正。评估覆盖 Connect Four 十个训练种子、Leduc 及 Goofspiel 的奖励验证实验。

Result: 在两个评估批次、十个 Connect Four 种子中发现干预效果随种子反转；追踪实际更新表明历史 Qwen 训练通过奖励加权的教师动作似然起作用。匹配的三种子奖励方向实验中，固定终端奖励时，符号反转的稠密 oracle 聚合胜率仅 2.8%，而仅终端训练为 57.2%、正向稠密 oracle 为 46.7%，说明奖励可强力影响学习却不提升性能。决策层面，反事实回放验证了对已诊断动作错误的获胜修正；Leduc 与 Goofspiel 实验进一步揭示参考标签定义与验证数据暴露会影响干预评估。

Conclusion: 评估 LLM 干预必须追踪其输出如何变成学习信号与动作；LocusRL 将聚合结果转化为可操作的诊断与可验证的修正。

Abstract: Large language models can intervene in reinforcement learning through both reward design and action selection, yet aggregate performance offers an incomplete account of what these interventions actually do. Similar returns can conceal different learning mechanisms, while plausible rewards can induce undesirable behavior. We introduce LocusRL, a diagnostic framework that connects controlled reward-policy comparisons with audits of reward judgments, signal delivery, optimization objectives, and executed actions. The framework traces performance differences to testable explanations and checks targeted corrections through executable rules and counterfactual replay.
  Across two evaluation batches covering ten Connect Four training seeds, we uncover seed-dependent reversals in intervention effects and show how tracing actual updates changes their interpretation: historical Qwen training operates through reward-weighted teacher-action likelihood. A separate matched three-seed reward-direction experiment distinguishes sensitivity to a learning signal from its usefulness. With terminal rewards held fixed, a sign-reversed dense oracle yields a 2.8% aggregate win rate, compared with 57.2% for terminal-only training and 46.7% for the positive dense oracle. Thus, a reward can strongly influence learning without improving performance. At the decision level, counterfactual replay verifies a winning correction to a diagnosed action error. Complementary experiments in Leduc and reward-validation studies in Goofspiel extend the analysis to imperfect-information settings, revealing how reference-label definitions and validation-data exposure affect intervention assessment.
  Together, these findings show why evaluating LLM interventions requires tracing how their outputs become learning signals and actions. LocusRL turns aggregate outcomes into actionable diagnoses and verifiable corrections.

</details>


### [127] [One-Step Generation via Riemannian Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04454)
*David Li,Chanhyuk Lee,Jaehoon Yoo,Nikita Gushchin,Floor Eijkelboom,Eric Moulines,Maxim Panov,Alexander Korotin,Seunghoon Hong,Jinwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文面向约束空间上的一步生成器，在统一训练框架下推导并比较多种几何感知的漂移场，实验表明不同数据结构下最优场各不相同，说明目标函数选择在实践中至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Drifting Models与Wasserstein梯度流主要针对连续欧氏空间（如图像空间）设计，粒子可进行无约束的加性更新；但在约束空间上，这类更新可能越出有效域或忽略其几何结构，因而不适合作为训练目标。已有针对约束空间的工作要么局限于特定流形/领域，要么缺乏充分的实证比较。

Method: 在一个面向一步生成器的统一训练框架下，推导并比较多种几何感知（geometry-aware）的漂移场。

Result: 在不同结构的数据上进行测试，各设定下均取得有竞争力的一步生成结果；表现最好的场因任务而异。

Conclusion: 约束空间生成中，几何感知目标的选择显著影响性能，实践中需根据具体任务选择合适的目标/漂移场。

Abstract: Recently, Drifting Models and Wasserstein Gradient Flows have attracted substantial attention because they move iterative distributional refinement to training and amortize it into a generator, enabling fast inference. However, existing formulations have been developed largely for continuous Euclidean domains, such as image spaces, where particles admit unconstrained additive updates. On constrained spaces, these updates can leave the valid domain or ignore its geometry, making them unsuitable targets for training. Recent work has adapted updates to these spaces, but has focused on particular fields or offered limited empirical comparison. We derive and compare several geometry-aware fields within a common training framework for one-step generators. We test the method on data with different structures and obtain competitive one-step results in each setting. The best-performing field varies by task, showing why the choice of objective matters in practice.

</details>


### [128] [Target-free Latent Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04467)
*Luoyu Chen,Weiqi Wang,Chenhan Zhang,Zhiyi Tian,Yuxian Huang,Shui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需目标的对抗训练框架，通过在隐空间中放大和多样化行为级偏移，无监督生成语义多样的对抗样本，缓解对抗样本行为单一问题，提升模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗训练方法在构造对抗样本时，通常采用固定的有害目标补全，或基于固定良性-有害数据对进行定向激活消融，导致生成的对抗样本行为高度同质化，无法反映真实越狱攻击所引发的行为多样性。这种行为层面的狭窄性从根本上限制了防御的鲁棒性，因此需要一种能够产生多样化对抗行为的训练框架。

Method: 提出无目标（target-free）对抗训练框架，以无监督方式生成对抗样本。核心做法是在模型隐空间中放大并多样化行为级偏移（behavior-level shifts），从而产生语义多样的对抗样本，引发范围广泛的有害行为，扩大行为覆盖以暴露更多失败模式。同时使用语义熵（semantic entropy）作为输出层面的对抗行为多样性度量指标。

Result: 实验表明，该方法能够在目标模型中引发多样化的有害行为，显著缓解行为狭窄性问题，并提升模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性；语义熵可有效量化对抗行为多样性。

Conclusion: 通过无监督、无目标地生成行为多样的对抗样本，可以扩大失败模式的覆盖范围，进而改善安全对齐效果，为对抗训练防御越狱攻击提供了一条提升行为多样性的新思路。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce harmful behaviors and circumvent safety alignment. To defend against such attacks, adversarial training paradigms have been proposed to first simulate failure modes and then train the model to correct them, yielding promising improvements in safety alignment. However, these methods typically construct adversarial samples either by encouraging fixed harmful target completions or by performing targeted activation ablation derived from fixed benign--harmful data pairs. As a result, the generated adversarial samples tend to induce homogeneous harmful behaviors that poorly reflect the diversity of behaviors elicited by real-world jailbreak attacks. This behavior-level narrowness fundamentally limits their robustness. To address this issue, we propose a target-free adversarial training framework that generates adversarial samples in an unsupervised manner. By amplifying and diversifying behavior-level shifts in the model's latent space, our approach produces semantically diverse adversarial samples that induce a wide range of harmful behaviors. This expanded behavioral coverage exposes more diverse failure modes and thereby improves safety alignment. To quantify this effect, we use semantic entropy as an output-level measure of adversarial behavioral diversity. Empirically, our method elicits diverse harmful behaviors in the target model, substantially mitigating behavioral narrowness and improving robustness to jailbreak attacks.

</details>


### [129] [BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04490)
*Chenhang Cui,Xu Xie,Linrui Xu,Xiaohao Liu,Xingyu Zhu,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BARQ方法，通过平衡拟合现有码本改进LLM权重量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型参数量增长导致模型存储和参数内存带宽成为高效部署的主要瓶颈。基于码本的权重量化虽能降低成本，但拟合过程中最近码字分配不均衡会使部分码字更新不足，限制了码本的有效利用率。

Method: BARQ通过平衡拟合现有码本提升量化质量：首先通过带均匀边际、曲率加权重建代价的熵正则化最优传输计算权重块与码字间的联合软分配，确保精确解中每个码字获得相等正拟合质量；随后通过分配加权的重心更新精炼码字，并证明其对固定分配最小化拟合目标；对有限Sinkhorn迭代，只要所有码字质量超过分母下限，所实现更新保持该最优性；最后丢弃软分配，用精炼后的码本进行标准硬最近码字编码。

Result: 分析建立了降低硬量化失真和评估损失的充分条件。在多个LLM上，BARQ在可比比特预算下取得比评估基线更低的困惑度和更高的平均零样本准确率。

Conclusion: BARQ通过平衡分配精炼有效提升码本利用率与量化质量，在多个大语言模型上验证了其优越性，代码已开源。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) grow in parameter count, model storage and parameter memory traffic have become major bottlenecks to efficient deployment. Codebook-based weight quantization reduces these costs, but imbalanced nearest-codeword assignments during fitting can leave some codewords insufficiently updated, limiting effective codebook utilization. To address this limitation, we propose Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization (BARQ), which improves quantization quality through balanced fitting of existing codebooks. Specifically, we first compute joint soft assignments between weight blocks and codewords through entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs, ensuring equal positive fitting mass for every codeword in the exact solution. We then refine the codewords through an assignment-weighted barycentric update, which we prove minimizes the fitting objective for fixed assignments. For finite Sinkhorn iterations, the implemented update retains this optimality provided all codeword masses exceed the denominator floor. Finally, we discard the soft assignments and use the refined codebook for standard hard nearest-codeword encoding, with our analysis establishing sufficient conditions for reducing hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across multiple LLMs, BARQ achieves lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated baselines at comparable bit budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/chenhangcuisg-code/BARQ.

</details>


### [130] [Understanding Clustering in Slot Attention via Particle Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04493)
*Vasudev Joy,Rajat Rasal,Avinash Kori,Anthea Monod,Ben Glocker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出简化槽注意力（SSA），一种无参数变体，其动力学与软k-means聚类相关，可为对象中心表示的出现提供机制性解释。在Pascal VOC上，SSA性能与槽注意力相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 槽注意力是一种用于对象中心图像分割与表示学习的方法，但其学习组件掩盖了聚类行为在多大程度上源于注意力动力学本身，因此需要一种更简化的方式来揭示其内在机制。

Method: 从交互粒子动力学的视角研究注意力，将这一视角扩展到槽注意力，提出简化槽注意力（SSA）——一种无参数变体，其动力学与软k-means聚类相关联。

Result: 在Pascal VOC数据集上，SSA达到了与槽注意力相当的性能。

Conclusion: 无需学习神经网络组件也能实现具有竞争力的对象中心分割，说明对象中心表示的出现可源于注意力动力学本身。

Abstract: Studying attention through the lens of interacting particle dynamics has shown how token clustering can emerge from the underlying dynamics. We extend this perspective to slot attention, a method for object-centric image segmentation and representation learning in which learned components obscure how much of the clustering behaviour is intrinsic to the attention dynamics. We therefore introduce simplified slot attention (SSA), a parameter-free variant whose dynamics are connected to soft $k$-means clustering and which provides a straightforward mechanistic explanation for the emergence of object-centric representations. On the Pascal VOC dataset, SSA achieves performance comparable to that of slot attention, demonstrating that competitive object-centric segmentation can be achieved without learned neural-network components.

</details>


### [131] [LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04507)
*Yueran Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LoRA适配器秩（rank）与双下降现象的关系，通过在4个视觉骨干网络和7B语言模型上采用MMRS秩扫描（配对种子、与全秩稠密微调对比），发现在标签噪声下LoRA存在第二次下降，但仅在失去参数优势后才追平稠密微调风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双下降现象近期备受关注，已有工作将其与数据、模型和学习配置关联。实际微调中常用在冻结预训练权重上训练小型适配器（如LoRA），其秩是决定容量的超参数，但秩与双下降的关系尚未被充分探索。

Method: 在4个视觉骨干网络和一个7B语言模型上，于标签噪声条件下进行实验。提出模块匹配秩扫描（MMRS），将秩扫描延伸至超过全秩，并把每个秩与相同模块的稠密微调按种子配对比较。

Result: 在DeiT-Tiny上，风险在秩为1时最低，随着适配器开始拟合噪声标签而急剧上升，形成插值悬崖；越过峰值后风险再次下降，但所有仍节省参数的峰后秩其风险都高于稠密微调。秩为1的LoRA在4个视觉骨干中的3个上优于稠密微调。LoRA在DeiT-Tiny上需达到稠密投影权重4倍时才追平稠密风险。

Conclusion: LoRA确实表现出第二次下降，但只有在失去参数优势后才追平稠密微调的风险，说明其小秩强正则化带来的优势与容量增加的代价之间存在权衡。

Abstract: Double descent has sparked considerable interest, with recent work relating it to the data, the model and the learning configuration. Practical fine-tuning commonly involves training a small adapter on top of frozen pretrained weights, as in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The adapter's rank is the hyperparameter that sets its capacity, yet how this rank relates to double descent has not been well explored. We quantify this relation under label noise on four vision backbones and a 7B language model with a module-matched rank sweep (MMRS), which extends past full rank and compares every rank with dense fine-tuning of the same modules, paired by seed. On DeiT-Tiny, risk is lowest at rank one and rises sharply as the adapter becomes able to fit the noisy labels, forming an interpolation cliff. Past the peak, risk falls again, but every tested post-peak rank that still saves parameters remains above dense risk. Rank-one LoRA outperforms dense fine-tuning on three of the four vision backbones, consistent with strong regularization at small rank. LoRA thus exhibits a second descent, but matches dense risk only after losing its parameter advantage, first on DeiT-Tiny at four times dense's projection weights. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lora-second-descent-C7B5.

</details>


### [132] [Length Generalization Needs Proper Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04518)
*Pavlo Vasylenko,Matthias Lindemann,André F. T. Martins,Marcos Treviso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现长度泛化不仅取决于位置编码、注意力机制等架构选择，也与训练过程（正则化）密切相关：权重衰减会阻碍外推，而合理放置的 dropout 能提升外推能力，并提出 VPAD 新策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长度泛化通常被归因于架构选择（位置编码、注意力机制），但本文认为训练过程本身同样关键，旨在探究正则化（权重衰减、dropout）对未见长度外推能力的影响。

Method: 研究正则化对长度泛化的影响；发现 dropout 的标准放置（层归一化之前）引入系统性分布失配，改为放在线性投影之前可缓解；并提出方差保持仿射 dropout（VPAD），减少激活前方差失配。

Result: 权重衰减阻碍外推；重新放置 dropout 可提升外推。改进后的 SmolLM3（滑动窗口注意力、用 dropout 继续预训练）在 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上可完美外推至 64×，在 RULER 和 HELMET 上远超预训练上下文长度；Mamba2 同样受益，表明问题与架构无关；VPAD 进一步降低方差失配并提升 Transformer 外推表现。

Conclusion: 长度泛化与训练过程相关，dropout 的放置方式是关键因素，且该问题具有架构无关性；VPAD 通过保持方差进一步改善外推，为提升长度泛化提供了训练层面的新思路。

Abstract: Length generalization is the ability of sequential models to perform well on context lengths unseen during training. In this work, we show that the challenge of achieving length generalization is related not only to architectural choices such as positional encoding and the attention mechanism but also to the training procedure itself. We study how regularization affects length generalization and find that weight decay can hinder extrapolation. In contrast, dropout improves extrapolation when its placement within the architecture is reconsidered. In that regard, we show that the standard placement of dropout before layer normalization introduces a systematic distributional mismatch, and that applying dropout just before the linear projection resolves this issue. For example, a modified SmolLM3 with sliding window attention, continually pre-trained with dropout, can extrapolate perfectly to 64$\times$ on Needle-in-a-Haystack and far beyond the pre-training context size on RULER and HELMET. Mamba2 also benefits from dropout, suggesting an architecture-agnostic nature of the problem. We further propose Variance-Preserving Affine Dropout (VPAD), a new dropout strategy that substantially reduces the resulting pre-activation variance mismatch, leading to further extrapolation improvements in transformers.

</details>


### [133] [Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04519)
*Ying Tang,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PCL-U 框架，能够直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量，从而在存在未测量混杂的情况下估计因果效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖"无未测量混杂假设"（NUCA），但该假设在现实中很少成立。近端因果学习（PCL）通过代理变量应对未测量混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量必须预先指定，限制了实用性。

Method: PCL-U 使用神经网络编码器将协变量分解为三类代理：诱导处理的代理、诱导结果的代理以及共享代理；分解过程由极小极大互信息目标引导；并通过一种实用的基于矩的风险函数获得因果估计。

Result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，PCL-U 达到或超过了现有基线方法。此外，在两类具有不同维度和混杂强度的合成数据集上，该方法保持了稳定的估计精度。

Conclusion: PCL-U 无需预先指定代理变量，即可从观测协变量中自动学习代理并实现稳健的因果效应估计，在多种设定下均表现良好。

Abstract: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

</details>


### [134] [Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04533)
*Cheng Xu,Pengxiao Lin,Zhangchen Zhou,Zhi-Qin John Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从NTK初始化出发，将权重衰减下的训练动力学刻画为快速拟合、幅度压缩与神经元凝聚三个阶段，解释权重衰减如何促进参数方向对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权重衰减虽是常用的正则化手段，但其对"神经元凝聚"（参数方向对齐）的作用机制尚不清楚，本文旨在给出动力学层面的理解。

Method: 以两层ReLU网络为对象，引入"残差相关场"分析神经元幅度与方向的演化；分三阶段研究训练动力学，并分析吸引极值点的漂移界与方向收缩。

Result: 快速拟合阶段残差趋于由权重衰减维持的准静态平衡且切核近似不变；幅度压缩早期核衰减放大残差相关场，其孤立吸引极值提供凝聚方向候选；幅度稳定后证明极值漂移有界及方向收缩，导致神经元凝聚。

Conclusion: 权重衰减不仅缩小参数范数，还通过分阶段动力学推动网络形成凝聚表示。

Abstract: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

</details>


### [135] [TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04547)
*Wannes Janssens,Matthias Bogaert,Dirk Van den Poel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时序模型无关元学习（TMAML），在TFT上实例化，实验显示其在三种冷启动场景中总体优于或持平标准ERM训练，但概率预测精度未稳定超越朴素方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冷启动预测需从极少数据中快速学习并借助相关序列信息泛化到未见序列。已有全局预测模型虽能利用跨序列共享信息进行冷启动预测，但并未针对训练集外泛化或短历史自适应进行优化。

Method: 将冷启动预测建模为少窗口学习问题，把最初用于神经网络少样本自适应的模型无关元学习算法改造为面向深度时序预测的TMAML。TMAML以时间一致的支持-查询窗口构建元任务，并配套时序元训练与元测试流程，使模型显式优化冷启动预测；在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化。

Result: 在三种冷启动场景下进行初步实证分析：TMAML一致优于或持平标准ERM训练的TFT；在三个场景中的两个上，其预测校准优于朴素方法；但在概率预测精度上未能稳定超越朴素方法。

Conclusion: TMAML为冷启动时序预测提供了显式的元学习优化框架，在点预测精度上具优势并部分改善校准，但概率预测精度仍有待提升，需进一步研究。

Abstract: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

</details>


### [136] [Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04559)
*Guoliang Xu,James E Corter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HB-NoisyKG 贝叶斯框架，将观测数据与 LLM 等来源的重复因果报告结合，通过特征条件 Beta 先验与共享误差矩阵建模报告可靠性，交替推断实现结构学习，显著优于无知识图谱基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部因果报告能改善有限观测下的结构学习，但不同来源与变量对的可靠性存在差异，因此需要一种能对报告可靠性进行建模与动态修正的方法。

Method: 将每条报告视为某一 DAG 隐含的直接配对状态的噪声观测；用特征条件 Beta 先验池化配对可靠性信息，用共享误差矩阵捕获系统性错误；采用交替推断，利用图后验精炼可靠性估计并影响后续图更新；报告似然仅依赖图的配对状态边缘，因此同一观测层支持离散与连续似然、仅图与联合推断。

Result: 在五个离散基准上，相比 80 次重启的无 KG 基线，HB 至多使用 80 次总重启即将平均 SHD 从 22.39 降至 16.06；在随机变量 ID 且保留描述的物理光隧道上，SHD 从 39.00 降至 27.30；在连续 Sachs 上，仅图 BGe 较无 KG Top-K 提升 AUROC 0.121；合成研究中持续更新降低了平均可靠性估计误差与留出报告对数损失。

Conclusion: HB-NoisyKG 通过联合建模与交替推断有效利用不可靠外部因果报告，在多种离散与连续场景下提升结构学习效果，并验证持续更新可靠性的必要性。

Abstract: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.

</details>


### [137] [Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04572)
*Tim Aebersold,Soheyl Massoudi,Mark Fuge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL)，仅用单次分离投影步骤即可实现精确约束满足，训练更快且更省内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在诸多领域部署学习模型时，精确满足约束是前提，需要修复程序修正原始神经预测。现有方法在训练中展开多步修复并软惩罚残余违反，计算和内存开销大，修复不收敛时鲁棒性差，且大部分约束满足工作被推给修复程序。

Method: 核心发现是：与常见做法相反，训练中仅需一次分离的投影步骤。据此提出 Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL)，利用该单步后的约束残差自适应地为原始预测上的约束惩罚加权。

Result: PAL 是唯一在极端非线性约束下仍保持近乎完美可行性的方法，在合成与工程基准上达到或超过现有方法。在其 ACOPF 基准上，训练速度比经典修复方法 DC3 快 2.5 倍；当约束评估昂贵（如通过神经代理）时，PAL 仍可训练，而现有展开方法内存不可行。

Conclusion: 单次分离投影加自适应加权损失足以实现精确约束满足，PAL 在性能、训练速度和内存效率上均优于现有修复展开方法。

Abstract: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

</details>


### [138] [DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04596)
*Karn Tiwari,Varnith Chordia,Prathosh A P*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiffGate：一种结果门控的目标函数，将GRPO与选择性、有界的教师指导结合，仅在失败轨迹上施加教师监督，提升大模型后训练性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy distillation (OPD)目标多为token局部且与结果无关，而RLVR（如GRPO）虽提供结果级监督却存在奖励稀疏和信用分配粗糙的问题。作者发现OPD与RLVR具有互补盲点：教师信号提供密集局部指导但与rollout正确性对齐弱，组相对奖励捕捉任务成功但token级信用粗糙且在全失败组中消失。

Method: 提出DiffGate，一种结果门控目标：将GRPO与选择性、有界教师指导结合。教师监督仅应用于失败轨迹，并按组难度缩放，且平滑有界以防止极端师生差异主导优化。验证器决定哪些轨迹接受教师指导，教师在这些轨迹内提供密集token级更新方向。

Result: 在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B学生模型上，DiffGate相比匹配的GRPO在代码任务上avg@8提升+1.7和+1.8分，pass@8提升+1.6和+5.7分。在数学任务上，avg@8与GRPO保持在0.5分以内，pass@8提升+1.1和+3.9分。总体在全部四个模型-领域设置中pass@8均有提升。

Conclusion: DiffGate在评估协议下展示了改进的解决方案覆盖率，通过结果门控机制有效结合了OPD的密集局部指导与RLVR的结果级监督，在代码和数学任务上均取得一致提升。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [139] [Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04600)
*Keqin Chen,Jie Bian,Yulian Wu,Vincent Y. F. Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究纯ε-差分隐私下的固定预算最优臂识别问题，证明了最优误差指数上界由隐私感知传输指数刻画，并提出达到该基准的自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在差分隐私约束下进行最优臂识别需要同时兼顾统计效率与隐私保护。既有工作多关注固定置信度下的停止时间分析，而固定预算设定下误差概率的最优衰减率及其与隐私的相互作用尚不明确，因此作者希望刻画隐私约束对统计效率的根本限制并设计匹配算法。

Method: 作者首先推导出误差概率最优指数衰减率的上界，得到一个依赖实例的、隐私感知的传输指数，该指数不同于Jourdan和Azize [2025] 用于固定置信度停止时间分析的对应量。随后提出AO-Pri-BAI算法：利用Laplace树机制维护私有运行估计，并通过硬备择与臂分配之间的min-max交互学习采样设计。

Result: 证明了AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私，且其失败概率的指数与隐私感知基准相匹配，从而在理论上达到最优。数值实验表明，即使在小样本（非渐近）情形下，AO-Pri-BAI在多种实例上均优于基准算法。

Conclusion: 该工作为差分隐私下的固定预算最优臂识别建立了隐私感知的理论基准，并给出了达到该基准的自适应算法，理论与实验相互印证，为隐私约束下的纯探索问题提供了新的分析视角与实用方法。

Abstract: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

</details>


### [140] [Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04604)
*Octavio Pappalardo,Nathan Herr,Tim Rocktäschel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将自动课程学习建模为序贯决策问题，指出常用局部学习信号与课程决策真正价值之间的差距，并提出结合在线学习进度估计与LLM信息（任务下游收益、直接训练是否见效）的方法，在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动课程学习能提升强化学习效果，但预测课程决策的后果很困难；局部学习信号所捕获的信息不足以反映决定课程决策价值的关键量，因此需要更丰富的信息来源。

Method: 将自动课程学习视为序贯决策问题进行分析；提出一种方法，把在线学习进度估计与LLM提供的两类估计相结合：(i) 在每个任务上学习的潜在下游收益，(ii) 当前直接训练某任务是否可能产生进展。在Craftax的256个文本目标自建基准上，针对不同课程目标进行评测。

Result: 在优化单个目标任务时获得最强收益；在面向完整任务集优化时，收益因学习者的跨任务迁移机制而异，从学习速度的适度提升到可持续到训练结束的较大增益不等。

Conclusion: LLM可提供比局部学习信号更丰富的信息，用于预判课程决策的后果；该方法在个体目标优化中效果最佳，而在全任务集优化中的收益依赖于学习者的跨任务迁移能力。

Abstract: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

</details>


### [141] [Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04624)
*Yida Pan,Muhammad H. Ashiq,Chanyong Jung,Yixuan Jia,Jonah M. Miller,Qing Qu,Ismail Alkhouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FunBCS（函数空间反向一致采样），一种在扩散模型输入空间优化的方法，用于从极端稀疏观测中恢复 PDE 系数场，理论证明其优于输出空间方法并能正确最小化未观测误差，实验显示误差降低 27-64% 且提速 1.4-2.1 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从极端稀疏观测恢复 PDE 系数场是严重病态的逆问题，依赖生成式模型（如扩散模型）编码先验。当前最先进的扩散求解器将先验提升到函数空间，在去噪器输出空间中寻找物理一致的解，但在不连续的 PDE 场景下，输出空间方法可能无法针对正确系数场恰当最小化未观测误差，导致重建失败。

Method: 提出 Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS)，一种输入空间优化方法：在采样过程中寻找最佳输入，使去噪器重建结果满足物理一致性。基于理论分析，还给出在整个采样过程中动态分配输入空间优化步数的策略。理论层面证明了在非连续 PDE 设定下输出空间方法存在缺陷，而 FunBCS 能恰当最小化未观测误差。

Result: 在四个 PDE 逆问题（包括不连续 Darcy 流）上的评估表明，相较于当前最先进方法，FunBCS 将重建误差降低 27-64%，同时运行速度提升 1.4-2.1 倍。

Conclusion: FunBCS 通过输入空间优化有效解决了输出空间方法在非连续 PDE 场景下的缺陷，理论与实验均验证其在精度和效率上优于现有最先进方法，为扩散求解器在 PDE 逆问题中的应用提供了更优方案。

Abstract: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

</details>


### [142] [The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04631)
*Abdelkader Baggag,Yousef Saad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，聚焦机器学习（尤其大语言模型LLM），面向数值线性代数（NLA）领域的研究者，一方面清晰讲解LLM的核心概念，另一方面梳理LLM技术所依赖的关键NLA概念并回顾近期NLA对LLM领域的重要贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLA长期推动科学发展，从空气动力学驱动的特征值问题（LR、QR算法）到稀疏线性系统求解，不断随科学浪潮演进。当前ML浪潮带来颠覆性变革，LLM等工具以矩阵和张量方法为基础，迈向AGI时矩阵方法将更关键。但变化速度之快让数值线性代数研究者难以适应，因此需要一篇连接两个领域的综述。

Method: 采用综述（survey）形式，围绕机器学习技术，特别是大语言模型展开。具体做法有二：一是以面向数值方法专家的可理解方式阐明LLM背后的核心概念；二是考察LLM技术所使用的主要NLA概念，并重点介绍NLA在LLM领域近期做出的若干重要贡献。

Result: 该综述旨在为NLA研究者提供对LLM概念的可及性解释，并系统梳理LLM所依赖的NLA概念以及NLA领域近期的相关重要工作，帮助其理解并参与这一交叉方向。

Conclusion: 随着ML/LLM浪潮持续并迈向AGI，矩阵方法将扮演更重要角色；数值线性代数研究者有必要理解LLM的核心概念及其中的NLA要素，而本文正是提供这一桥梁的综述性工作。

Abstract: Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt.
  This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.

</details>


### [143] [Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04638)
*Nianli Peng,Geoffrey J. Gordon,Kianté Brantley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RDA2C（正则化对偶平均 Actor-Critic），将经验回放赋予新的角色：历史优势估计直接进入 actor 目标，而非仅用于最近一次更新。算法通过对聚合数据集拟合对偶评分模型 $Z_\theta$，并用熵镜像映射导出当前策略，使回放定义了一个经验对偶目标。理论上给出了有限时间值差分解，实验上在 MuJoCo 与 Atari 上分别优于 PPO 及最接近的对偶平均基线 AAPDA，并在双 $Q$ 标签下与 SAC 持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 actor-critic 方法虽利用回放提升样本效率，但通常将历史数据视为针对当前策略改进更新的 off-policy 样本。作者希望改变这种"历史数据仅服务于最近一次更新"的视角，让累积的策略改进反馈（历史优势估计）直接参与 actor 目标，从而更充分地利用回放数据。

Method: 提出 Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic（RDA2C）：在正则化对偶平均框架下，后续策略由累积的策略改进反馈决定。具体做法是存储带 critic 估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，对聚合数据集拟合对偶评分模型 $Z_\theta$，再通过熵镜像映射（entropy mirror map）从累积评分模型导出当前策略，使回放定义一个用于计算策略的经验对偶目标。该方法可接受任意 critic 提供的优势标签（如 GAE、双 $Q$）。

Result: 理论上建立了有限时间值差分解，将正则化对偶平均项与若干误差项分离：陈旧回放的监督拟合误差、critic 偏差、有限缓冲方差和回放覆盖误差，并给出各项误差有界的假设条件。实验上，使用 GAE 标签时，RDA2C 在 8 个 MuJoCo 任务中的 6 个、12 个 Atari 游戏中的 8 个上优于 PPO；在 8 个 MuJoCo 任务中的 6 个上优于最接近的对偶平均基线 AAPDA；使用双 $Q$ 标签时，在匹配批大小和更新频率下与 SAC 相当。
