Conclusion: RDA2C 通过对偶平均重新定义了回放在 actor-critic 中的作用，使历史优势估计直接累积到策略目标中，并具备有限时间理论保证。实验表明其在连续控制与离散游戏任务上较 PPO 和 AAPDA 具有竞争力，在双 $Q$ 标签下可与 SAC 匹配，且其框架具有 critic 无关的通用性。

Abstract: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

</details>


### [144] [Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04644)
*Zhouyang Liu,Ning Liu,Yixin Chen,Jiezhong He,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了图编辑距离（GED）神经方法在跨图数据集迁移时的表现，发现集内性能与跨集迁移之间存在显著差距，多源训练可改善迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经GED方法多在同数据集内评测并取得良好效果，但对其跨图集合的迁移能力知之甚少，缺乏对泛化行为的全面理解。

Method: 在多个不同图数据集上使用精确GED监督，对多种代表性学习方法开展系统性的跨集合迁移研究，并比较单源与多源训练、零样本与有限监督等设置。

Result: 集内性能与跨集迁移之间存在明显差距；在训练集合上表现好的模型在结构不同的数据上常失去优势；多源训练显著提升零样本迁移，并为新目标集合的有限监督提供更好起点；迁移行为随源-目标方向和集合结构特征而变化。

Conclusion: 传统集内评测只能部分反映神经GED模型的泛化能力，需推动在异构图集合上进行更广泛的评估。

Abstract: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

</details>


### [145] [Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04649)
*Abdel Mfougouon Njupoun,Colin Bredenberg,Blake Aaron Richards,Guillaume Lajoie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GaTaP 算法，通过门控变量选择性调节网络模块，在缓解灾难性遗忘的同时实现对新任务组合的小样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习通常只关注获取新知识而不遗忘旧任务，但灵活的持续学习者还应能重用和重组已有知识，以快速解决由已知任务组成的新任务。现有方法在这两方面（抗遗忘与组合泛化）往往难以兼顾。

Method: GaTaP（Gated Target Propagation）引入任务特定的门控变量，通过闭式内循环更新学习，用于选择性地抑制或增强网络模块；网络参数则在外循环中以更慢的时间尺度学习，两者均使用相同的局部差分目标传播（difference target propagation）误差信号。推理时通过少样本的增益自适应实现任务适配。

Result: 在多任务增量学习的实验中，分别针对多层感知机（MLP）和卷积网络架构进行了验证。结果显示：对先前学习任务的性能保持较强，并能对未见过的任务组合实现组合泛化，且该泛化通过推理阶段的少样本增益自适应获得。此外，分析学习到的门控模式发现，相关任务呈现相似的门控模式，说明推断出的门控捕获了有意义、可重用的任务结构。

Conclusion: GaTaP 为同时缓解灾难性遗忘和小样本组合泛化提供了一个有潜力的统一框架。

Abstract: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.

</details>


### [146] [Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04652)
*Yang Dai,Longfei Zhang,Wei Tao,Li Shen,Jincai Huang,Qing Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出迁移性与不可感知性的冲突是固定预算评估的假象，并提出即插即用的原始-对偶包装器 ST，在保持或提升攻击成功率的同时显著增强隐蔽性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在同等的扰动预算下，更强的迁移攻击通常攻击成功率更高，但不可感知性下降。作者认为这一"权衡"并非内在矛盾，而是固定预算评估协议造成的假象：当在扫描 ε 得到的 ASR-不可感知性帕累托前沿上比较时，强迁移攻击在匹配 ASR 下反而更隐蔽。因此希望挖掘这一潜在优势。

Method: 提出 ST（Stealthy Transfer attack），一个即插即用的原始-对偶包装器。在标准约束目标上加入 L∞ 饱和正则项，通过两步原始-对偶更新求解：对扰动执行投影原始步，同时对对偶变量执行 L1 球投影，并借助 Fenchel 对偶吸收正则项。该方法无需辅助模型或手工设计的感知先验。

Result: ST 在多种基础攻击和额外代理架构上扩展了帕累托前沿。在 ε=16/255 时，相对各基础攻击平均在 LPIPS 上提升 17%、NIQE 上提升 14%，同时 ASR 保持不变或提高。在匹配的高 ASR 水平下，最强的 ST 变体进一步帕累托支配专门的隐蔽导向迁移攻击。

Conclusion: 强迁移攻击所隐藏的不可感知性优势可以通过原始-对偶优化包装器被释放，且不牺牲迁移性，说明迁移性与隐蔽性的冲突只是固定预算评估的产物。代码将开源。

Abstract: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

</details>


### [147] [Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04657)
*Lydia Mezrag,Semih Cantürk,Michael Perlmutter,Bastian Rieck,Guy Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PathLapPE，一种基于有向图路径拉普拉斯算子的谱位置编码，能编码方向性高阶结构，在节点级与图级任务上带来稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有向图广泛存在于引文网络、网页图和信息流网络等场景，但现有图学习方法多依赖对称化表示的消息传递或只部分利用边方向性的位置编码，难以充分刻画有向交互。

Method: 从有向图上的路径拉普拉斯算子出发，推导出新的谱位置编码 PathLapPE，同时提供节点级和边级特征，可嵌入标准图学习架构，并与方向感知的消息传递结合使用。

Result: 在节点级和图级基准任务上，PathLapPE 在多种架构中均取得一致提升，尤其在结合方向感知消息传递时效果更佳；与常用的磁拉普拉斯位置编码相比，无需额外微调方向性超参数，运行时间与性能具有竞争力。

Conclusion: PathLapPE 是一种更充分刻画有向图方向性高阶结构的谱位置编码，兼顾性能与易用性，可作为有向图学习的通用组件。

Abstract: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.

</details>


### [148] [Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04695)
*Aryan Chaudhary,Manikandan Padmanaban,Jagabondhu Hazra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将粗略有限差分法的近似特征值作为固定偏移量指导神经网络求解器训练，并提出更稳定的SIPMNN训练方法，在10维问题上比纯神经方法更准确且迭代次数减少8-10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子的特征值问题广泛存在于科学中。经典方法将算子离散化为矩阵求解，但在高维下细网格会带来巨大的内存和计算开销；而近期最先进的神经网络求解器虽避免了存储大网格，却需要数十万次训练步骤且难以找到目标特征值。作者希望结合两种方法以互补不足。

Method: 用粗略的有限差分法（FDM）计算作为算子谱的廉价数值模型，将其近似特征值作为固定偏移量（fixed shifts）用于神经网络求解器的训练，因为只需定位谱的相关部分。同时提出稳定逆幂法神经网络（SIPMNN），一种针对高维问题更稳定的训练过程。

Result: 在d=10的五个测试问题上，该组合方法整体上比测试的纯神经替代方法更准确，同时使用的迭代次数减少8到10倍。

Conclusion: 经典数值方法与神经网络方法可以相互促进；结合粗略FDM近似特征值作为固定偏移及SIPMNN，可在高维特征值问题中实现更高的精度与更低的训练成本。

Abstract: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.

</details>


### [149] [Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04696)
*Zeyang Li,Yunan Wang,Risheek Garrepalli,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，一种无需重要性采样或对采样轨迹反传即可训练生成模型采样非归一化密度的算法，用于在线强化学习的生成式策略训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型能为在线 RL 提供表达力强的策略类，但训练困难：critic 只给出未归一化的 Boltzmann 密度，无法直接采样，现有方法依赖重要性采样导致高方差、计算昂贵且训练不稳定。

Method: 通过强制自一致性学习目标流，绕过目标后验均值估计；联合利用目标 score 与流匹配结构，将自一致性要求表述为 score-calibrated 最优性条件（先对终端密度、再对可训练速度场），证明其唯一解即为目标密度及 CFM 在有目标样本时应收敛的理想流；将速度条件写成不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造 stop-gradient 目标，保持 CFM 的 sample-interpolate-regress 结构，端点由当前流生成。

Result: 在 RL 基准实验中，SCF 达到或超过最先进的生成式策略基线，同时显著减少训练时间。

Conclusion: SCF 为从非归一化密度训练生成式策略提供了一种简单高效、无需重要性采样的方法；在在线 RL 中，critic 梯度在生成动作处提供目标 score，形成直接的 actor 训练途径。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

</details>


### [150] [Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04703)
*Doudou Zhang,Wenwen Hou,Yilin Chen,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了 Drifting Models 中表征几何对生成质量的关键影响，提出持续表征学习（persistent representation learning），直接从像素学习判别性表征，无需预训练编码器即可大幅降低 FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始 Drifting Models 的像素空间漂移表现较差，而预训练特征空间能显著提升样本质量，但原因不明。作者旨在揭示这种差距的根源，并寻找无需预训练编码器也能取得良好效果的方案。

Method: 作者将差距归因于表征的判别性几何，其决定了 KDE 中的样本加权和漂移方向。为此提出持续表征学习，在生成器跨批次演化过程中持续学习更具判别性的表征几何。同时证明了在匹配条件下 KDE 比值损失与漂移回归损失具有当前步梯度等价性，从而将密度比优化与经验漂移联系起来，并据此直接控制漂移速度。此外还引入了速度裁剪策略。

Result: 在多个数据集上，该方法直接从像素学习有效的判别性表征，相比原始像素空间 Drifting Models 将 FID 降低约 82–95%，且无需预训练编码器。适配预训练表征并应用速度裁剪还能带来进一步增益。

Conclusion: 表征的判别性几何是决定 Drifting Models 生成质量的关键因素；通过持续表征学习可从像素直接获得有效表征，大幅提升一步生成质量，预训练表征与速度裁剪可进一步优化性能。

Abstract: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

</details>


### [151] [Localized Operator Learning with Adaptive Partition-of-Unity Mixture-of-Expert Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04708)
*Madison Cooley,Ramansh Sharma,Shandian Zhe,Robert M. Kirby,Varun Shankar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于单位分解（POU）的混合专家框架，用于局部算子学习，并给出残差式层级POU架构HiRefPOU，在异构PDE基准上提升精度与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepONets、FNO等算子学习方法在处理具有尖锐界面、非均匀系数和局部多尺度结构的PDE族时表现不佳，缺乏显式的几何局部化能力。

Method: 提出单位分解（POU）混合专家框架：几何感知门控网络生成平滑空间划分，融合局部专家网络贡献。核心贡献HiRefPOU是一种面向DeepONet的残差式层级POU架构，通过嵌套父子划分组织局部表示并保持全局连续性；同时将POU原理引入FNO以增加空间自适应性而不改动谱层。

Result: 在异构Darcy和反应扩散基准上，HiRefPOU误差显著低于全局DeepONet和静态POU-MoE基线；更广泛的实验表明局部化收益取决于PDE结构和所选神经算子骨干。学到的划分具有可解释性，与界面和快速变化区域对齐。

Conclusion: 显式几何局部化可同时提升神经算子学习的精度与可解释性。

Abstract: Operator learning methods such as DeepONets and FNOs often struggle with PDE families featuring sharp interfaces, heterogeneous coefficients, and localized multiscale structures. We introduce a partition-of-unity (POU) mixture-of-experts framework for localized operator learning, in which geometry-aware gating networks produce smooth spatial partitions which blend the contributions of local expert networks. Our main contribution is HiRefPOU, a residual-style hierarchical POU architecture for DeepONets that organizes localized representations through nested parent-child partitions while preserving global continuity. We also show that the same POU principle can be incorporated into Fourier Neural Operators to introduce spatial adaptivity without modifying the underlying spectral layers. On heterogeneous Darcy and reaction-diffusion benchmarks, HiRefPOU achieves substantially lower error than global DeepONet and static POU-MoE baselines, while the broader operator-learning experiments show that the benefits of localization depend on the PDE structure and the chosen neural-operator backbone. The learned partitions are interpretable and align with interfaces and regions of rapid solution variation. These results show that explicit geometric localization can improve both accuracy and interpretability in neural operator learning.

</details>


### [152] [FoSeRL: Formal Sequential Robustness Certification for Reinforcement Learning Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04754)
*Sara Taheri,Deep Kumar Ganguly,Jan Křetínský,Majid Zamani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FoSeRL框架可对随机环境中已部署的RL策略进行认证，抵御预先设定、时间稀疏的动作攻击，无需平滑或重训练，且仅需可重置模拟器支持共享随机性与独立单步后继查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署后的决策策略即使遭遇少量动作扰动也会显著性能下降。在随机环境中，回报本身波动，导致认证攻击造成的回报损失十分困难。

Method: 将攻击与未攻击两次运行共享初始状态与随机性，把运行回报差作为状态坐标，使其成为终端值，从而将轨迹级认证转化为终端安全性；再用增广状态上的时间相关障碍条件约束终端失败概率——精确满足时认证所有可容许的预先设定攻击，从采样轨迹学习并在留出数据上验证时在指定攻击回合设定下认证同一保证。

Result: 在六个随机连续控制环境和三种RL策略族（TD3、SAC、PPO）上，FoSeRL认证了非平凡的基数—幅度鲁棒性前沿，获得比策略平滑更大的认证预算，并揭示标称性能相近策略之间显著的鲁棒性差异。

Conclusion: FoSeRL为随机环境中抵御时间稀疏动作攻击的已部署RL策略提供了有效认证，能在指定概率与置信水平下保证攻击回合的回报损失不超过预设额度。

Abstract: Even a few action perturbations can substantially degrade the performance of a deployed decision policy. Certifying the resulting return loss is challenging in stochastic environments, where returns vary even without an attack. We introduce FoSeRL, a framework for certifying deployed RL policies against precommitted, temporally sparse action attacks. The deployed policy is unchanged, with no smoothing or retraining. Certification requires a resettable simulator supporting shared randomness and independent one-step successor queries, but no analytical dynamics model. FoSeRL certifies that an attacked episode loses no more than a prescribed amount of return relative to the same episode unattacked, with at least a target probability and at a user-specified confidence level. Both runs share the initial state and randomness, so the measured loss reflects the attack, not the episode; carrying the running return gap as a state coordinate makes it the terminal value, reducing trajectory-level certification to terminal safety. Time-dependent barrier conditions on the augmented state bound the terminal failure probability: satisfied exactly, they certify every admissible precommitted attack; learned from sampled trajectories and verified on held-out data, they certify the same guarantee under a specified attack-episode setting. Across six stochastic continuous-control environments and three RL policy families (TD3, SAC, and PPO), FoSeRL certifies non-trivial cardinality--magnitude robustness frontiers, achieves substantially larger certified budgets than policy smoothing, and reveals marked robustness differences among policies with comparable nominal performance.

</details>


### [153] [EasyClassifier: Honest, Reproducible Machine-Learning Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04758)
*Ahmad B. A. Hassanat,Ghada A. Altarawneh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EasyClassifier 是一个无需编程的 Python 工具包，通过默认强制正确的预处理与嵌套交叉验证流程，消除数据泄漏和选择偏差，使机器学习分类评分更可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习分类已广泛应用于医学、社会科学、经济学、教育学和工程等领域，许多使用者并不编程。此类工作中反复出现两类错误：在交叉验证前对所有行进行预处理学习（数据泄漏），以及报告在比较中胜出的分类器的交叉验证分数（选择偏差），二者都会使已发表结果过于乐观。作者希望让正确流程成为默认而非可选项。

Method: 作者提出 EasyClassifier，一个开源 Python 包，用户从 CSV 或 Excel 文件出发，通过一系列通俗语言的多选题完成分析，无需写代码。其设计将正确流程设为默认：每个预处理步骤都在每个训练折内学习；被选中的分类器通过嵌套交叉验证（最多 2,000 行）或未触碰的 20% 测试集获得独立的最终评分；分类器使用固定默认参数和固定随机种子运行；每次运行都会生成报告，包含可直接改编的方法段落、应引用的参考文献以及为发表准备的图表。

Result: 在来自七个领域的十个公开数据集以及一个随机标签对照上（数据集对半分，一半作为未触碰的外部测试），常见做法平均高估平衡准确率 2.9 个百分点（在小数据上最高达 9.9）；而 EasyClassifier 报告的分数平均有符号偏差为 +0.7 个百分点，平均绝对误差为 2.3 个百分点（单侧 Wilcoxon 检验 p = 3.2×10^{-4}，30 次运行）。在随机标签上，它报告 48.8% 的平衡准确率，而随机水平为 50%。

Conclusion: EasyClassifier 通过把防泄漏、防选择偏差的流程设为默认，显著降低了分类评分的乐观偏差，为非编程研究者提供了可靠的自动化分析工具。该软件以 MIT 许可证发布于 PyPI（pip install easyclassifier）、GitHub 和 Zenodo。

Abstract: Machine-learning classification is now used across medicine, the social sciences, economics, education and engineering, very often by researchers who do not program. Two errors recur in such work: preprocessing learned on all rows before cross-validation (data leakage), and reporting the cross-validation score of the classifier that won a comparison (selection bias). Both make published scores optimistic. We present EasyClassifier, an open-source Python package that guides a user from a CSV or Excel file to a finished analysis through a sequence of plain-language, multiple-choice questions, with no code. It makes the correct procedure the default rather than an option: every preprocessing step is learned inside each training fold; the selected classifier receives a separate final score from nested cross-validation (up to 2,000 rows), or an untouched 20% test set; classifiers run with fixed default parameters and fixed random seeds; and every run writes a report with a ready-to-adapt Methods paragraph, the references to cite, and figures prepared for publication. On ten public datasets from seven fields and a random-label control, split in half so that one half served as an untouched external test, the common practice overstated balanced accuracy by 2.9 percentage points on average (up to 9.9 on small data), whereas the score EasyClassifier reports had a mean signed bias of +0.7 points and a mean absolute error of 2.3 points (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 3.2 x 10^{-4}, 30 runs). On random labels it reported 48.8% balanced accuracy against a chance level of 50%. EasyClassifier is available under the MIT license from PyPI (pip install easyclassifier), GitHub, and Zenodo.

</details>


### [154] [Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04766)
*Zihao Zhao,Shuhan Zhang,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出即使精确的动作价值函数也远离方差最优，并提出无需额外oracle成本的闭式方差最小修正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在通过黑盒oracle（如人类、优化求解器、外部工具）学习时，常用动作价值函数作为控制变量来降低梯度估计方差；但作者发现这一做法存在根本性缺陷，需要更优的方差修正方法。

Method: 首先观察到精确动作价值函数可任意远离方差最优，原因在于价值函数只最小化每个动作自身梯度项的噪声，而动作仍可通过共享参数影响梯度估计的其余部分；进而提出一个无额外oracle成本的简单无偏修正，并证明残差方差可按动作精确分解且无交叉项，由此导出神经网络参数的闭式方差最小修正，可通过简单投影计算。

Result: 简单无偏修正可将方差降低任意大倍数；闭式方差最小修正在所有任务中一致地降低了价值函数残留的方差并改善学习效果。

Conclusion: 价值函数作为控制变量并非方差最优，通过动作分解得到的无交叉项闭式修正能有效进一步降低方差，实验验证其一致有效性。

Abstract: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

</details>


### [155] [Repeated-Measure Leakage, Distribution Shift, and Reliability under Partial Observation in Patient World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04778)
*Arjun Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一套"前置评估阶梯"，检验短时程数字生物标志物预测中患者世界模型所需的预测状态是否具备患者间泛化、抗分布漂移、抗缺失及可靠不确定性信号，结果显示这些前置条件在设定场景下仍不充分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者世界模型被越来越多地用于纵向预测、干预感知推理和临床试验模拟，但因果/临床干预有效性不同于预测泛化性与可靠性。在提出更强主张之前，需先验证底层预测状态能否跨患者泛化、能否在真实漂移与缺失观测下存活、能否通过有意义的不确定性信号暴露失效。

Method: 在刻意收窄的设定下（PhysioNet GaitPDB 短时程数字生物标志物预测，165名参与者、306段记录、51,129个上下文-未来对），使用 persistence、ridge、MLP、GRU、Transformer 与紧凑 JEPA 式预测器，构建逐步移除原始时间重叠、同记录熟悉度、同患者熟悉度的评估阶梯，最后测试未见患者泛化；并考察研究漂移、四倍预测间隔、部分观测与 50% 时间掩码下的表现。

Result: GRU 的 NMSE 从随机窗口划分的 0.1227 升至消除原始训练-测试重叠后的 0.1393，再到患者留出下的 0.1961。在 54 名有重复记录的参与者中，接触同患者另一段记录将 GRU NMSE 从 0.2177 改善至 0.1556，但参与者层面不支持"排除记录的身份假设"。患者留出下 MLP 与 Transformer 统计上不可区分。研究漂移、四倍预测间隔与部分观测进一步降低性能；50% 时间掩码下 Transformer NMSE 升至 0.611，而 MC-dropout 预测方差反而下降。

Conclusion: 作者不宣称构建了纵向或干预感知的模拟器，而是主张在信任更强的患者世界模型主张之前，应采用一套前置评估栈：患者分离、重复测量控制、漂移、缺失性与不确定性验证。

Abstract: Patient world models are increasingly proposed for longitudinal prediction, intervention-aware reasoning, and clinical-trial simulation. Causal or clinical intervention validity is distinct from predictive generalization and reliability; before making stronger claims, the underlying predictive state should generalize across patients, survive realistic shifts and missing observations, and expose failure through meaningful reliability signals. We evaluate these prerequisites in a deliberately narrow setting: short-horizon digital-biomarker forecasting from PhysioNet GaitPDB, comprising 165 participants, 306 recordings, and 51,129 context-future pairs. Using persistence, ridge, MLP, GRU, Transformer, and a compact JEPA-style predictor, we build an evaluation ladder that progressively removes raw temporal overlap, same-recording familiarity, and same-patient familiarity before testing unseen-patient generalization. For GRU, NMSE rises from 0.1227 under random-window splitting to 0.1393 after eliminating raw train-test overlap and to 0.1961 under patient holdout. Among 54 participants with repeated recordings, exposure to a different recording from the same patient improves GRU NMSE from 0.2177 to 0.1556, while a recording-excluded identity hypothesis is not supported at the participant level. Under participant-held-out evaluation, MLP and Transformer are statistically indistinguishable. Study shift, a four-times-longer prediction gap, and partial observation further degrade performance; under 50% temporal masking, Transformer NMSE rises to 0.611 while MC-dropout predictive variance falls. We do not claim a longitudinal or intervention-aware simulator. Instead, the results support a prerequisite evaluation stack of patient separation, repeated-measure controls, shift, missingness, and uncertainty validation before stronger patient-world-model claims are trusted.

</details>


### [156] [DASH: Fast, Valid Counterfactuals for Deep Networks via Batched Directional Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04783)
*Shraman Pal,Gabriel Medeiros,Clayton Escouper das Chagas,Can Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DASH是一种批量启发式搜索方法，用于为深度神经网络生成低延迟、近似最优、有效且可操作的对抗事实解释，在接近度和运行时间上优于多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗事实解释在低延迟、贴近原始输入、满足输入域/类别/可操作性约束时最有用，但深度神经网络同时满足这些目标很困难。启发式方法快但可能返回无效解释，精确方法能保证全局接近度却可能无法在实用时间内完成。

Method: DASH使用方向Lipschitz界和局部仿射模型生成锚点，然后通过批量网络评估对候选区域进行排序和扩展，以在ℓ1、ℓ2和ℓ∞目标下搜索接近、有效且可操作的对抗事实解释。

Result: 在四个表格数据集、网络深度2至32、共9,000个查询-范数案例中，DASH在94.6%的案例中返回距最佳启发式观测有效距离5%以内的有效对抗事实解释，中位CPU搜索运行时0.061秒；PGD-bisect在该标准下覆盖率为41.1%，中位运行时间0.298秒。PBMC3k上也评估了可扩展性。

Conclusion: 所提出的搜索方法在多种范数下保持较高的有效接近度，同时将搜索运行时间控制在实用范围内，兼顾了启发式速度与接近最优的有效性。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations are most useful when they can be generated with low latency, remain close to the factual input, and satisfy input-domain, categorical, and actionability constraints. Achieving these objectives simultaneously is challenging for deep neural networks. Heuristic methods are often fast but may return invalid counterfactuals, whereas exact methods can certify global proximity but may not finish within practical time limits. We introduce DASH, a batched heuristic search method for finding close, valid, and actionable counterfactuals for deep neural networks under $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, and $\ell_\infty$ objectives. DASH uses directional Lipschitz bounds and local affine models to generate anchors, then ranks and expands promising regions with batched network evaluations. We compare DASH against nine prior heuristic methods and time-limited exact mixed-integer baselines on four tabular datasets, with network depths from 2 to 32, and evaluate scalability on PBMC3k. Across 9,000 tabular query-norm cases, DASH returns a valid counterfactual within $5\%$ of the best heuristic-observed valid distance in $94.6\%$ of cases, with a median CPU search runtime of $0.061$ s. PGD-bisect, the baseline with the highest pooled within-$5\%$ coverage, meets this criterion in $41.1\%$ of cases, with a median runtime of $0.298$ s. These results show that the proposed search maintains high valid proximity across norms while keeping its search runtime practical.

</details>


### [157] [KALEIDO: Input-Space Adaptation of a Vision Model for Time-Series Forecasting Through Gated Fold Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04786)
*Xiangyu Shi,Qinghua Liu,Sam Heshmati,Zubin Abraham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Kaleido通过可控的渲染几何（折线折叠方式）适配ImageNet预训练掩码自编码器进行时序预测，仅训练LayerNorm即可显著提升零样本预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型依赖大规模时序语料实现零样本预测，而视觉模型无需如此，因为自然图像隐含了预测器需建模的模式。但渲染后的序列并非自然图像，二者之间存在差距，需要通过时序感知的适配来弥合。

Method: Kaleido检测主导周期，渲染一组规则生成的折叠几何，用凸的逐位置门控（仅在验证集上拟合）组合各修复结果，再以固定比例与零样本输出融合，除基线已发表的设置外无需任何逐数据集超参数。仅训练LayerNorm（0.05%）。

Result: 仅训练LayerNorm时，Kaleido在LTSF上将MSE较已发表零样本基线降低13%；冻结模型时降低6.6%。在GIFT-Eval上，MASE提升7.4%，CRPS提升19.3%。

Conclusion: 渲染几何是弥合渲染序列与自然图像差距的一个可控且可混合的适配轴，Kaleido以极低训练成本实现了对零样本基线的显著提升。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models buy zero-shot forecasting with large temporal corpora; a vision model needs none, since a natural image implicitly embeds the patterns a forecaster must model, and an ImageNet-pretrained masked autoencoder forecasts a series by inpainting a rendering of it. A rendered series is not a natural image, however, and closing that gap takes temporal-aware adaptation. We show that the rendering geometry - how the series is folded and drawn - is a controllable, mixable axis for it. Kaleido detects the dominant periods, renders a rule-generated set of fold geometries, combines the inpaintings with a convex per-position gate fit on validation only, and fuses the result with the zero-shot output at one fixed share, with no per-dataset hyperparameter beyond the baseline's published settings. Training only LayerNorm (0.05%), Kaleido lowers MSE by 13% against the published zero-shot baseline on LTSF and, frozen, by 6.6%; on GIFT-Eval it improves the baseline by 7.4% in MASE and 19.3% in CRPS.

</details>


### [158] [TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04795)
*Xinyu Guan,Zhirong Zhang,Hongyuan Liu,Pengcheng Xu,Yu Sun,Chen Song,Qianyang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIMBRE通过源感知表示、状态条件响应迁移和可靠性引导融合，在冻结预测头前整合事件证据以调整数值预测，但实验显示其优势主要来自对学习式响应迁移的敏感性，而非通用预测能力提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件驱动的预测需要将报告和历史响应转化为数值预测的调整。作者希望构建一个能在冻结预测模型前整合外部事件证据、并同时调整预测区间宽度的框架。

Method: 提出TIMBRE（Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence），包含三部分：源感知表示（source-aware representation）、状态条件响应迁移（state-conditioned response transfer）、可靠性引导融合（reliability-guided fusion），置于冻结预测头之前；另设独立读出模块调整区间宽度并保持中位数不变。实验为单种子、单轮次的13任务开发性研究，并做了关闭响应迁移的消融。

Result: 在13个任务中，TIMBRE相对普通融合在8个任务上改善MAE，但相对原生Chronos-2仅在2个任务上改善。在已训练模型中关闭响应迁移后，BTC与AULF的MAE分别下降47.04%和6.81%。

Conclusion: 结果表明TIMBRE的性能对学习式响应迁移高度敏感，而非带来通用预测优势。开发集部分得分缺失且未进行重训练消融，限制了对其各证据机制贡献的归因。

Abstract: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

</details>


### [159] [Multi-Agent Spectrum Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04802)
*Job Elliott,Graduate Student Member,IEEE,Justin G. Metcalf,Golnaz Habibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于元学习的多智能体认知雷达频谱共享方法，智能体独立决策发射位置与带宽，在真实SDR与仿真环境中均优于传统强化学习基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个认知雷达需在固定100 MHz频段内与其他无线电用户共享有限频谱，同时避免相互干扰。传统强化学习在多智能体频谱共享中难以平衡多项竞争目标，亟需灵活、可扩展的共享方案以支撑未来无线通信系统。

Method: 采用机器学习方法，每个设备基于对真实或仿真信号活动的分析，独立检测频谱的占用与空闲部分，据此自适应调整发射决策，避开拥挤频段并高效利用可用空间；核心为一种元学习（meta-learning）策略。

Result: 在基于空口软件定义无线电（SDR）录制数据与仿真环境的实验中，所提元学习方法在五个多智能体基准环境中取得最高的平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率和稳定的发射行为，全面优于主要基线强化学习算法。

Conclusion: 元学习方法能在多智能体频谱共享场景中持续更好地平衡相互竞争的目标，为未来无线通信系统提供了一种灵活、可扩展的频谱共享途径。

Abstract: This project explores how multiple cognitive radars can learn to share limited wireless spectrum with other radio users without interfering with one another. Using machine learning (ML), each device independently decides where and how widely to transmit within a fixed 100 MHz band. The system analyzes real or simulated signal activity to detect which parts of the spectrum are currently in use and which are open. Based on this information, the devices adapt their transmission choices to avoid crowded frequencies while making efficient use of available space. The goal is to develop a flexible, scalable approach to spectrum sharing that could support future wireless communication systems. Experimental results using both over-the-air software-defined radio (SDR) recordings and simulated environments demonstrate that the proposed meta-learning approach consistently balances competing objectives better than conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods in multi-agent spectrum-sharing scenarios. Across five multi-agent benchmark environments, our proposed method achieved the highest average reward among the primary baseline algorithms while simultaneously maintaining low collision rates and stable transmission behavior.

</details>


### [160] [Separating Decision Time from Decision Quality in the Real-Time Gap of Distilled Deciders: Evidence from a Game and a Conveyor Simulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04810)
*Chihoon Shin,Junyeong Lee,Kihyeok Jeong,Wonok Kwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将实时智能体与零延迟教师之间的性能差距拆分为"时间成分"与"质量成分"，发现在ViZDoom中二者量级相当，而Linux主机上时间成分可因跳帧消失，质量成分则持续存在，DAgger再训练能部分弥补该差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时智能体常在暂停世界或按整tick取整（tick conversion）的条件下评估，但tick转换几乎预测不出损失，而同一决策器在异步实时对局中的命中准确率却下降14.8个百分点，说明现有评估方式掩盖了真实延迟带来的影响，因此需要新的分解方法来厘清差距来源。

Method: 在ViZDoom中训练小决策器模仿脚本教师，按墙钟时间运行游戏，并设置"教师等待决策器服务器调用"的对照。将决策器与零延迟教师之间的差距拆为时间成分与质量成分，在Windows和Linux主机上做三项预注册研究；用DAgger在决策器自身轨迹的教师标注状态上再训练；并在带400 ms截止时间的传送带模拟器中检验延迟效应，另设与决策器延迟匹配的对照。

Result: Windows主机上时间成分为6.5–8.7 pp，质量成分为6.3–8.6 pp；Linux主机跳过0.08–0.09%的tick，时间成分消失（-0.1 pp，配对95% bootstrap区间[-0.4, 0.0]），质量成分仍为5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]。DAgger再训练在两台主机的新游戏上分别提升2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9]和3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]。对实时对局所有分支施加同一延迟表后，100个新游戏上仍有5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5]的质量成分；再训练把决策器在自身状态上与教师的分歧从22.7%降到14.9%。在400 ms截止时间的传送带模拟器中，超过截止时间的延迟消除了质量成分。

Conclusion: 实时智能体的性能损失可分解为时间与质量两部分，其中质量成分在不同环境下稳健存在，且可通过DAgger再训练部分改善；跳帧会掩盖时间成分；延迟匹配对照有助于判断应采用哪种补救措施。

Abstract: Real-time agents are often evaluated with the world paused, or with decision time rounded to whole ticks (tick conversion). Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

</details>


### [161] [GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04827)
*Xiaoyun Yu,Xiangfei Qiu,Yonggui Huang,Shixiang Tang,Nanqing Dong,Wanli Ouyang,Geguang Pu,Honggang Qi,Jilin Hu,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GRAM框架，通过检索并利用冻结时序基础模型的系统性预测偏差，实现零样本预测的逐horizon校正，在多个数据集和基础模型上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强方法用相似历史窗口的真实未来来校正TSFM预测，但真实未来中既包含基础模型已捕捉的预测成分，又包含难以迁移的样本特定随机波动。相比之下，预测误差中反复出现的系统性模型偏差更能刻画冻结TSFM的失效模式，是更有价值的校正信号。但有效利用该偏差面临两个挑战：不同数值水平下的预测误差因尺度差异难以比较；且反复出现的偏差需从被随机波动污染的错误中提取。

Method: GRAM包含三个组件：1）Amplitude Memory Module（AMM）按幅度对预测误差进行缩放，并将其聚合为可检索的原型；2）Prototype Graph Module（PGM）建模原型之间的关系，以聚合一致的偏差信息并抑制随机波动；3）在线预测时，GRAM检索并扩展与当前查询相关的原型，生成逐horizon的校正以优化原始TSFM预测。

Result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上的实验表明，GRAM能够持续稳定地提升预测性能。

Conclusion: GRAM作为面向冻结TSFM的通用检索增强框架，通过挖掘并利用系统性模型偏差而非真实未来，有效克服了尺度差异与随机波动的干扰，验证了基于偏差校正的检索增强思路的可行性与通用性。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

</details>


### [162] [Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04845)
*Minjae Lee,Kyunghyun Cho,Sangdon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MAESTRO，将多目标对齐（MOA）建模为对偏好分布的极小极大问题，用RL端到端训练单一提示条件化策略以对抗在线更新的偏好分布，在多个任务上以最低训练成本获得最佳帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类价值观是多面的（有用性、无害性、幽默感之间存在权衡），且不同用户想要不同权衡。多目标对齐需训练能提供帕累托前沿任意点的策略，但现有方法要么每个偏好训练一个模型、要么事后插值少数对齐专家、要么训练单一条件模型却不考虑应训练哪些偏好，导致偏好单纯形的困难区域训练不足，无法充分发挥单一模型的潜力。

Method: 提出MAESTRO（Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization），将MOA表述为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，用RL端到端训练单一的提示条件化策略，对抗一个对抗性偏好分布：该Dirichlet分布通过在线镜像下降朝向当前策略服务最差的偏好更新，而非使用固定分布。

Result: 在HH-RLHF、BeaverTails及一个摘要任务上，最多三个目标的情况下，MAESTRO在单次训练运行中于多数任务上取得最佳帕累托前沿，且训练成本在对比方法中最低。最大优势出现在固定偏好分布训练不足的困难区域。

Conclusion: 结果表明单一的提示条件化模型能够独立覆盖目标间的权衡；通过面向最差偏好的对抗性分布训练，可有效弥补困难区域训练不足的问题，实现高效的多目标对齐。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

</details>


### [163] [PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04850)
*Jae Won Choi,Ryoonki Hong,Alan Liang,Manjula Adiveppa Wader,Bingsong Zeng,Peiyang Tang,Longwei Liu,Ruishan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PIT-GCL是一个双塔结构感知框架，通过融合序列、Cα点云与持续同调拓扑描述子来独立编码蛋白，并用双向交叉注意力做潜空间软对接，实现可预计算、适合大规模筛选的蛋白结合预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白结合预测对靶点识别、治疗性结合剂设计和规模化筛选至关重要，但挑战在于结合同时依赖序列、三维几何和全局结构组织。AlphaFold3、Boltz-2等折叠模型的置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非为二分类结合预测设计，而专门的结构感知预测器通常需要结合态复合物结构，在筛选规模下无法获得。因此需要一种既结构感知、又能在筛选规模上高效使用的方法。

Method: 提出PIT-GCL双塔结构感知框架：每个蛋白塔从氨基酸序列、Cα点云和全局持续同调描述子出发独立编码。每塔将残基ESM-2嵌入与基于Vietoris-Rips过滤的H0和H1持续景观（persistence landscape）计算得到的拓扑摘要结合，输入结构感知Transformer，其中成对Cα距离作为可学习的注意力偏置。随后用双向交叉注意力模块在两蛋白表示之间进行潜空间软对接。训练目标为二元交叉熵与NT-Xent对比损失的组合。

Result: 在三个二分类相互作用预测基准上评估：PPIRef上的通用PPI、STAG上的TCRpMHC结合、PPB-Affinity上的全链配对。PIT-GCL在该评估下于通用PPI上优于代表性序列基、结构感知和任务专用基线；在PPB-Affinity上是唯一高于随机水平的方法；在TCR-pMHC上于固定决策阈值下领先，但被任务专用序列模型超越。

Conclusion: PIT-GCL通过序列、几何与拓扑信息的联合编码及软对接，提供了具有竞争力的蛋白结合预测能力。由于其第一阶段对每个蛋白独立编码，表示可预计算并在候选对之间复用，便于大规模筛选。局限在于TCR-pMHC任务上仍不及专用序列模型。

Abstract: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

</details>


### [164] [CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04851)
*Tao Feng,Fangxu Yu,Zijie Lei,Jiaru Zou,Changjiang Jiang,Yi Yan,Jiaxuan You,Pan Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CURIO，一种好奇心驱动的测试时学习框架，通过内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）为策略更新提供预测误差奖励，在数学发现与单细胞去噪任务上优于纯任务反馈强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式发现需要对已有尝试进行反复学习，同时继续探索价值尚未显现的方向。冻结LLM的搜索可复用上下文中的解，但无法从成败中更新模型；强化学习虽能自适应，却可能因过度偏好高奖励轨迹而过早抑制低奖励但有潜力的方向。

Method: CURIO在任务反馈之外引入内在好奇心世界模型（ICWM）。ICWM学习策略隐状态表示中的转移，并在策略top-k选择之外的采样token上提供预测误差奖励；通过epoch归一化和退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。

Result: 在6个数学发现任务和单细胞去噪任务上，使用8B到235B的Qwen3骨干模型，三次运行均值在5个数学目标上优于匹配的纯任务RL对照，在Circle Packing上达到最佳报告性能，并在所有测试规模下改善两个留出语料上的去噪Score和MSE。相对增益在Hadamard上达18.3%，去噪Score上达10.8%。代码多样性测量显示生成程序具有更大的结构变异。

Conclusion: 好奇心可作为开放式发现中补充性的探索信号，帮助模型在测试时持续学习并保持探索多样性。

Abstract: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.

</details>


### [165] [Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04867)
*Jihwan Moon,Sheir A. Zaheer,Jinmyoung Lee,Gunhee Kim,Chan Y. Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在125M与400M参数规模、Chinchilla最优预算下，系统比较了贪心分块局部学习（K=1,2,4）与端到端反向传播在自回归语言模型预训练中的损失差距，并探索了网络架构与训练目标两类辅助设计对差距的缩减效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部学习在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播媲美，在小Transformer上已知以更差的最优损失换取并行加速；但其在更大规模自回归语言模型预训练中的损失差距表现、以及哪些辅助设计能缩小该差距，此前尚未被测量。该性质与去中心化模型并行训练直接相关。

Method: 采用token预算匹配的实证研究，在125M与400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}分块、Chinchilla最优预算下进行预训练，将辅助设计分解为网络架构与训练目标两个维度进行消融对比。

Result: (i) 与端到端的差距从K=2到K=4扩大一倍以上，但在K=4时从125M到400M有所缩小；(ii) 用Transformer辅助模块替换MLP是有效的网络侧干预，可挽回22-41%的差距；(iii) 多token预测（MTP）目标在首个分块边界有益，而加在更深边界反而有害，仅限制在第一块时取得最佳K=4配置（400M下+0.062 vs +0.075 nats）；(iv) 部署式逐块执行可将激活内存最多降低2.2倍。

Conclusion: 本文将结果定位为有实证支撑的方法方向而非定型方法：局部目标应在各边界上有选择地施加未来预测压力，同时抵抗绕过预测内容的捷径。

Abstract: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

</details>


### [166] [Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04869)
*Ji Zhang,Zixin Liu,Yiran Ding,Jiayi Wang,Yilu Du,Weijia Xuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有时序链路预测评估忽略“谁发起行为”（源活跃度），并从理论与实验上证明这一盲点，提出仅有<20参数的源节点活跃度建模(SNAM)显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动、以及选择对谁行动。现有时序链路预测主要关注后者（选择目标），而标准负采样保留真实源、只替换目标，导致源活跃度信号从最优得分中被完全抵消，使模型无法因学习源活跃度而获得奖励。在历史/归纳负采样下源不同，该因子反而成为主导信号，但现有模型并未显式建模。

Method: 提出Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM)，将源活跃度建模为自激事件强度，用精确点过程似然拟合历史中已含的衰减交互计数；模型参数少于20个。SNAM可独立预测，也可加到TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD等冻结得分上而无需重训。

Result: 仅看源、不看目标时，SNAM在历史负采样下于5个数据集中的4个上超过DyGFormer和TPNet；作为附加项在多种骨干-数据集组合上几乎全部提升AP，最高提升25个点。完整模型在13数据集、3协议上对11个基线排名第一，百万级事件流上每epoch训练比TPNet和DyGFormer快9-100倍。

Conclusion: 源节点活跃度是时序链路预测的盲点，而SNAM提供了一种廉价且可迁移的解决方案来弥补该盲点，代码已开源。

Abstract: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

</details>


### [167] [ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04882)
*Penghui Yang,Long Xing,Xuanlang Dai,Ziyu Liu,Kai Chen,Yuhang Zang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ResOPD 通过“尾部残差化”在稀疏教师接口下实现无偏且低方差的在线策略蒸馏反向 KL 梯度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏需在长推理链上传输教师分布，通信与内存开销大，实际系统只能用稀疏接口（采样 token 分数或 Top-k）。但采样 token 估计虽无偏却梯度方差极大，直接优化 Top-k 又引入系统性偏差，二者形成两难。

Method: 提出 ResOPD：将未观测词表聚合成一个可观测的粗粒度“尾部事件”，计算其精确聚合梯度，仅对尾部内部细粒度残差进行采样；无需额外教师查询或前向计算。

Result: 在相同稀疏载荷下，ResOPD 在在线采样中提供无偏的全词表反向 KL 梯度估计，并显著降低梯度方差，稳定在线训练动态，提升下游性能（于所评估设置中）。

Conclusion: ResOPD 是一种高效、即插即用的稀疏在线策略蒸馏方差缩减原语。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

</details>


### [168] [SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04893)
*Amr M. Zaki,Farhoud Jafari,Honggeun Ji,Komal Sarda,Marin Litoiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SFlexRCA，一种面向资源受限 IIoT 环境的无拓扑根因分析框架，通过正交表示与共享轻量线性建模实现高效故障定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IIoT 系统产生高维传感器遥测数据，故障会跨组件传播；现有因果或图方法需要显式图构建、消息传递，并随变量或时滞增长参数，难以在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。

Method: SFlexRCA 将多元遥测转换为紧凑的正交表示，并采用共享的轻量线性模型，避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或时滞的参数增长。

Result: 在 BATADAL、SWaT、WADI 三个公开 IIoT 数据集上，与 10 个统计、因果及非因果基线对比 RCA 精度、训练效率、推理延迟与内存消耗；并在 Raspberry Pi 3/5 上评估推理效率与内存，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上测量能耗。进一步分析时间上下文敏感性、架构与损失组件及替代表示。SFlexRCA 在 BATADAL 训练数据有限的条件下仍保持较强定位性能，且共享紧凑架构避免了参数增长，支持边缘设备高效部署。

Conclusion: SFlexRCA 是一种无拓扑、可扩展且灵活的根因分析框架，在保证定位性能的同时显著降低参数与资源开销，适合资源受限的 IIoT 边缘环境部署。

Abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

</details>


### [169] [ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04905)
*Qingwen Zeng,Zehao Fu,Shuyu Meng,Linghan Huang,Jiayi Zhang,Chenglin Wu,Ling Chen,Huaming Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ScopeSAE，通过归一化梯度归因按 token 选择与预测最相关的 token-层状态作为建模子空间来训练稀疏自编码器，首次观察到"重构优于原始"现象，并提升特征有效性、可解释性与利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）主要按层训练，建模子空间由层身份固定，与真正驱动每个预测的 token-层状态无关。作者认为这一约束导致层式 SAE 出现特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏直接行为依据等问题。

Method: 提出 ScopeSAE：对每个预测，通过归一化梯度归因找出最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而为每个 token 选择建模子空间，并在该"预测相关子空间"上学习特征。

Result: 出现"重构优于原始"（reconstruction-better-than-original）效应：SAE 写回重构的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活，据作者所知此前未见报道。通过干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验，证明该效应源于预测相关子空间本身而非架构变化。相比层式基线，ScopeSAE 在有效特征数、可解释性、利用率和字典冗余方面均有改善。

Conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间，可得到更有用且具有行为意义的特征，表明建模子空间的选择对 SAE 质量至关重要。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

</details>


### [170] [Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04907)
*Luoyu Chen,Xiaoyu Ding,Weiqi Wang,Chenhan Zhang,Zhiyi Tian,Jianhuan Huang,Shui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究“潜意识学习”中数据需求来源，将潜意识引导向量蒸馏建模为含噪线性逆问题，发现软监督（KL）仅需数百条载体即可近乎精确恢复教师特质向量，而硬监督（NLL）在数万条载体下仍难以恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已发表的潜意识学习演示通常需要数万条载体样本，作者追问这一数据需求从何而来。通过设定教师特质为已知的残差流向量 Δ_T，作者希望直接以参数恢复程度衡量迁移效果，从而厘清数据规模对特质继承的真正作用。

Method: 在相同载体前缀下对比逐 token 的硬 NLL 监督与全分布的软 KL 监督；将引导向量蒸馏视为含噪线性逆问题，分析局部上载体任务通过 Fisher 矩阵 F 映射特质，使梯度指向 FΔ_T，并让梯度下降充当阻尼递减的 F 逆过程；在 Qwen2.5-7B 与 Gemma-2-9B 上验证四项预测。

Result: 初始化时两种目标梯度近乎共线且与 Δ_T 对齐较差；迭代优化后两者分道扬镳：软监督从数百条载体几乎精确恢复 Δ_T，硬监督即使数万条也显著低于该水平。实验确认四项预测：初始梯度的 Fisher 失真、按陡峭到平坦方向的恢复顺序、随数据规模移动的最优深度，以及固定提示池重采样完成与新增提示效果相当。

Conclusion: 大规模载体数据集的需求，与其说是为了揭示特质，不如说是为了压制 Fisher 逆过程放大的标签噪声。软监督能更高效地恢复低曲率方向上的特质，而硬标签会同时放大这些方向上的采样噪声，导致需要随独立载体数量增长的最优逆深度。

Abstract: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

</details>


### [171] [Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04918)
*Lin Qiu,Yao Liu,Diyi Hu,Hanqing Zeng,Onur Gungor,Chujie Chen,Jiayi Liu,Jianyu Wang,XueLin Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出残差视觉信用优化（RVCO），将token信用分配建模为守恒路由问题，在保持奖励与优势估计不变的前提下改进多模态推理的token级信用几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推理的可验证奖励强化学习只给出轨迹的总体结果奖励，无法说明该价值应如何分摊到产生它的各个决策（token）上，即缺乏合理的token级信用分配。

Method: 方法包括四部分：（1）通过受控视觉干预获得每个token的证据响应；（2）使用稳健的轨迹内坐标去除偶发尺度影响；（3）用带预算的熵路由器按感知依赖程度分配固定的序列效用；（4）残差支撑路径保证每个有效位置都有正信用，并用解析校正精确恢复规定的信用总量。

Result: 所得信用场具有选择性、有界性、满支撑，且对响应局部得分平移不变，并能将硬token选择作为极限情形恢复。在四个模型家族、七个推理基准上，RVCO相较强RLVR基线提升了准确率，同时保持后期优化稳定性、抗损坏鲁棒性和有竞争力的训练成本。

Conclusion: 奖励、rollout和组相对优势估计器均无需改动，仅改变token级信用的几何结构即可带来收益，为多模态推理的信用分配提供了一种通用且低侵入的改进方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

</details>


### [172] [TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04925)
*Baoxi Liu,Yi Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TSAE结构化稀疏自编码器用于时间序列预测表征的可解释分解，并配套TSEVAL评估协议，在三项ETT数据集上优于五种SAE基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测在能源调度、工业运营和环境监测等关键决策中至关重要，需理解模型依赖的模式以评估可靠性并识别失效。现有输入归因方法虽能识别重要变量与时间片段，但对内部特征洞察有限；而标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）目标未直接约束跨变量结构或时间连续性。

Method: 提出TSAE：通过共享字典与变量路由的私有字典组织跨变量结构；用门控编码将特征检测与幅度估计分离；依据原始片段相似性约束相邻稀疏编码变化。支持对变量上下文、激活强度与时间演化的分析。另用预测一致性微调提升对冻结预测器输出的保持，并提出TSEVAL协议分别审计保真度、特征一致性与物理校准。

Result: 在冻结PatchTST上对ETTh1、ETTh2、ETTm1进行三次随机种子实验：在可比的每token活跃度下，TSAE在五种SAE中取得最低的隐状态重构误差、归一化预测-重构误差（NFRE）和特征转移率；NFRE相对次优均值下降4.3–26.4%。选择性、物理相关性与校准存在数据集相关权衡。

Conclusion: 保真度与时间稳定性提升需独立的语义验证才能支撑特征解释，数据集相关的权衡表明单纯依赖重构指标不足以确立特征语义意义。

Abstract: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

</details>


### [173] [Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04928)
*Yi Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在1B规模上从估计器选择与奖励信号退化两个方向研究GRPO，发现提示词设计是首要因素，估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，离线策略中裁剪机制至关重要，且弱验证器对RL的损害远小于对测试时选择的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解GRPO在1B规模下的行为：估计器选择如何影响学习信号，以及退化的奖励信号如何影响所学内容，从而厘清哪些设计决策真正重要。

Method: 用从零实现的GRPO在GSM8K上训练OLMo-2-0425-1B，进行受控扫描，包括一个验证器质量实验（同时同等地退化训练奖励与测试时选择器），并对比在线与离线策略、不同裁剪方式及多种验证器噪声条件。

Result: 四点主要结果：(1)提示词是一阶决策，零样本提示下基础模型仅0.08%且梯度极少，3样本提示达18.3%使训练成功；(2)该规模下估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO在两个种子上均领先；(3)离线策略中裁剪是关键，无裁剪比率训练损失4-6分，GRPO式裁剪与GSPO完全恢复；(4)同样弱的验证器在RL中代价远低于测试时选择，10%翻转验证器下RL保留91%与106%收益而选择仅57%，仅格式验证器下RL保留16-30%而选择几乎为零。翻转噪声对期望奖励是仿射变换，组归一化优势配合Adam重缩放可精确消除，残余为二阶方差效应。

Conclusion: 在1B规模上，提示词设计比估计器选择更关键；离线策略中裁剪是核心；RL对弱验证器的鲁棒性显著优于测试时选择，且其机制可通过仿射变换与组归一化优势得到解释。

Abstract: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

</details>


### [174] [Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04931)
*Ying Han,Ling Liu,Fabio Soldo,Vu Nguyen,Danio Wang,Liz Kidd,Yongle Cao,Theodore Rose,Su-Lin Wu,Romer Rosales*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个在全球O(B)规模短视频平台上部署的实时缩略图优化系统，用自动化数据驱动的方式替代未人工挑选的静态默认帧，首次实现O(B)规模的在线多臂老虎机框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短视频中大量内容缺乏创作者人工精选的缩略图，导致存在大量未策展视频，传统静态默认帧无法有效支撑视频发现与消费。

Method: 提出端到端全自动框架：多阶段候选生成管线 + 低延迟服务基础设施；以深度视觉质量模型导出的图像先验初始化在线多臂老虎机探索框架，降低探索成本并在服务时动态选择最优缩略图。

Result: 全球部署验证显示，核心用户发现与参与度指标取得统计显著的提升。

Conclusion: 该工作证明在线多臂老虎机框架可在O(B)规模上成功部署于未策展短视频发现场景，为大规模实时缩略图优化提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

</details>


### [175] [Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04936)
*Amin Hosseininasab,Steven M. Shugan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并研究"局部少数类不平衡"(LMI)问题：少数类在特征空间某些区域被不成比例地少观测，与整体类别数量不平衡不同。作者发现现有不平衡缓解方法会在LMI下拟合观测偏差、泛化差，故提出基于树的递归分层集成方法，并在模拟LMI的表格数据集上验证其优于现有方法，同时提出无偏测试集的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统类别不平衡方法默认少数类是相对多数类均匀欠采样。但现实中少数样本可能在特征空间某些区域被不成比例地少观测（如破产小企业从记录中消失），形成局部少数类不平衡(LMI)。这一问题常被忽视，且超出整体类别数量不平衡的范畴，导致现有方法在欠观测区域泛化差。

Method: 提出基于树的递归分层(分层集成)方法：递归划分特征空间，目标是降低层内LMI畸变。对每个得到的层，将其多数类样本与全部观测到的少数类样本配对，训练一个基分类器，从而构成集成模型。

Result: 在模拟LMI的基准表格数据集上，所提分层集成方法优于常用及最先进的不平衡缓解技术。此外，引入使用无偏测试集的金标准评估协议，证明基于同样LMI偏置数据的常规留出评估会严重误导性能判断。

Conclusion: 在不平衡学习中，不平衡的成因与纠正方法同样重要。识别并针对LMI的成因进行建模，能显著改善在欠观测区域的表现，同时也需要无偏评估协议才能真实衡量模型性能。

Abstract: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

</details>


### [176] [D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04938)
*Jieke Wu,Qijie Zhu,Weimin Wu,Zeqi Ye,Minshuo Chen,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D-DOIT：一种无需训练、基于离散Doob h-变换的离散扩散模型通用奖励适配方法，通过重加权反向转移概率实现采样引导，在调控DNA设计与蛋白质逆折叠任务上超越免训练引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型（尤其是掩码离散扩散）在生成任务中应用广泛，但其对通用奖励的适配（引导采样）研究不足。现有免训练引导方法多针对连续扩散设计，依赖连续状态更新或奖励梯度，难以直接迁移到离散扩散的类别式token揭示转移过程，因此需要一种适配离散扩散的、无需训练且高效的通用奖励引导方法。

Method: 提出D-DOIT（Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation）。将适配建模为从奖励倾斜的目标分布中采样，通过离散扩散反向核的Doob h-变换实现该输运，仅使用奖励值而非奖励梯度。不同于连续扩散的漂移修正，D-DOIT推导出离散Doob h-变换，通过重加权反向转移概率来引导采样。为使变换实用，避免昂贵的未来滚动：每步采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头将各候选补全为干净序列，用奖励oracle评估各补全结果，并按与奖励成正比的概率重采样下一状态。此外提供可选的后期best-of-K精修，仅在去噪接近末尾时分枝轨迹以提升样本质量，避免全轨迹K倍开销。

Result: 在调控DNA设计与蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT优于免训练引导基线：提升了增强子活性与细胞类型特异性，同时保持序列自然度；在蛋白质逆折叠任务中取得最高成功率。

Conclusion: D-DOIT为离散扩散模型提供了一种高效、无需训练的通用奖励适配方案，通过离散Doob h-变换在反向转移概率层面进行引导，配合候选补全与晚期best-of-K精修，在不牺牲效率的前提下显著提升生成质量与任务指标。

Abstract: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

</details>


### [177] [A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04939)
*Adwait Patkhedkar,Alifaraz Lakhani,Prathmesh Mohite,Abhijeet Salunke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出GIIT工具，用计算物理依赖图追踪科学模型内部的物理对应关系，发现时间外推OOD下映射会发生层级漂移和功能对应减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者质疑在训练条件下发现的、模型内部的物理有意义对应关系，在离开训练条件后是否仍然成立，即物理可解释性在分布外是否可靠。

Method: 提出GIIT（Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool）：将支配物理表示为计算物理依赖图，通过灵敏度和趋势发现将图节点映射到网络内部组件，并在定向干预下检验映射。在时间外推OOD（严重程度递增）场景评估。
