Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

</details>


### [317] [Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06008)
*Noortje I. P. Schueler,Hans van Gorp,Ruud J. G. van Sloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出检索诱导的潜在转移模型，将超声操作引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索，无需探头追踪硬件，颈动脉目标视图到达率达86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声成像质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求增长快于合格技师供给，需要引导系统帮助经验较少的用户将探头移动至目标视图，从而缩小供需缺口。

Method: 以V-JEPA 2.1为骨干，将观测编码到解剖相关视图彼此接近的潜在空间；从含潜在状态及对应探头位姿的参考数据库中检索相似视图；不学习参数化转移函数，而直接使用数据库中实际执行的物理转移构建非参数化的检索诱导转移模型，支持滚动时域规划；部署时仅依赖实时超声图像，无需探头追踪硬件，并通过蒸馏在CPU上实时运行。

Result: 颈动脉超声回顾性闭环实验中，规划器在86%的回合到达目标视图，优于两个代表性基线的52%和43%，并在所有目标视图上均表现更优，包括较难的颈内与颈外动脉纵向视图；在未见志愿者上的前瞻性可行性研究以CPU实时运行，目标视图到达率为83%。

Conclusion: 由于规划由任意可编码目标潜在的接近度驱动，同一世界模型可导航回任何先前采集的患者特定帧，支持围手术期或随访监测等可重复的纵向成像。

Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

</details>


### [318] [Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06012)
*Giulio Viganò,Simone Melzi,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从谱几何与算子理论视角研究Transformer注意力，将每个注意力头视为Hilbert空间之间的泛函映射，推导出Token Difference Operator，并用其谱结构刻画token空间信息的路由过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准欧氏谱结构会受sink（注意力汇聚）偏置影响，将质量集中与真实路由能力混淆，因此需要一个能剥离sink效应、统一解释注意力机制的框架。

Method: 把注意力头建模为token序列上函数空间的泛函映射，推导Token Difference Operator；在注意力诱导的内在概率几何（非欧氏几何）中重新刻画token空间，从而将sink效应与路由能力解耦。

Result: 该内在概率几何下的token difference谱能够分离sink效应与路由容量，并给出注意力头输出维度的谱刻画；由此提出一种新的基于注意力的不确定性估计器，在长上下文输入上增益最大。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了统一分析注意力图的算子理论框架，可解释sink、路由坍缩与输出维度，并将注意力启发式方法建立在谱几何基础上，补充了基于概率的评分方法。

Abstract: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

</details>


### [319] [Adaptive Expert Guidance for Efficient On-Policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06019)
*Daniele Affinita,Ming Xu,Rudolf Reiter,Davide Scaramuzza,Pascal Fua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种让学习者与次优专家在训练回合内交替控制的方法，将专家的控制份额设为单一可学习参数，并与策略联合优化。随着学习者能力提升，专家份额自动衰减至零，从而兼顾早期引导与最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从零开始的强化学习（如PPO）样本效率低，且浪费了可能存在的次优专家（启发式、模型控制器或相关任务策略）。这类专家常用于引导早期训练，但其次优性会限制最终性能，关键挑战是平衡专家引导与奖励学习。现有方法通过混合权重、调度或评估驱动课程来设定专家影响，或借助额外学习组件（如专家动作critic、辅助智能体）来调整，但都没有用与策略相同的on-policy目标来优化这一影响。

Method: 让学习者和专家在每一个训练回合内交替控制环境；专家的控制份额被设计为一个单一的可学习参数，与策略一起进行联合优化。该参数依据on-policy目标自动调整。

Result: 在两个基准的34个任务上验证，涵盖离散与连续动作空间，并使用学习型与模型型专家。方法在样本效率上优于有引导和无引导基线，同时所需超参数变化极小。专家份额随学习者提升而衰减至零，即在专家不再有用时消失。

Conclusion: 通过在相同on-policy目标下联合优化专家控制份额，方法实现了早期专家引导与后期自主学习的自动平衡，最终让学习者独立运行并超越次优专家，且对超参数不敏感。

Abstract: With massively parallel simulation, on-policy Reinforcement Learning methods such as PPO have become standard in many domains. However, learning from scratch is sample-inefficient and fails to exploit the potential existence of a suboptimal expert, such as a heuristic, a model-based controller, or a policy trained on a related task. Such an expert is often available and can guide early training, but its sub-optimality limits final performance. The challenge then becomes balancing expert guidance against learning from rewards. Existing methods set the expert's influence through a blending weight, a schedule, or an evaluation-driven curriculum. Alternatively, they adapt it with additional learned components such as critics over expert actions or auxiliary agents. However, none optimizes it using the same on-policy objective as the policy itself. We propose a method in which the learner and the expert alternate control within each training episode, and the expert's share of control is a single learnable parameter optimized jointly with the policy. The learner benefits from the expert early in training, but its share of control declines as the learner becomes more competent, until eventually vanishing completely. This leaves the learner acting alone and better than the suboptimal expert. We evaluate our method on 34 tasks across two benchmarks, spanning discrete and continuous action spaces, using both learned and model-based experts. Our method improves sample efficiency over guided and unguided baselines while requiring minimal hyperparameter variation. The expert's share decays to zero as the learner improves, vanishing when the expert is no longer useful.

</details>


### [320] [Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06023)
*Andrea Cavallo,Samuel Rey,Antonio G. Marques,Elvin Isufi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出PNN与PNN-Joint，通过交替优化联合学习稀疏精度矩阵与图神经网络权重，实现任务感知的图推断，在低数据量下稳健且可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从数据中挖掘有意义的潜在结构是信号处理与机器学习的核心挑战。PCA与协方差神经网络（VNNs）基于协方差矩阵，只能捕捉直接与间接相关性；而精度矩阵（逆协方差）能显式编码条件独立性，但有限样本估计极不稳定，且正则化估计器与任务无关。

Method: 提出PNN-Joint框架，通过交替优化方案，联合估计稀疏且具统计基础的精度矩阵与图神经网络权重；并引入更广泛的精度神经网络（PNNs）类，即运行在精度估计器上的图卷积网络，建立其与PCA、VNNs的谱联系，并分析其对有限样本误差的稳定性。

Result: 在合成数据以及真实世界的神经影像与运动传感器数据集上的大量实验表明，PNN-Joint能生成高度可解释的任务感知图，在低数据量情形下具有显著稳健性，并在真实任务中持续取得最优或次优表现。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了任务感知图推断这一难题，将精度矩阵估计与图神经网络训练统一起来，兼顾统计意义与任务导向，为可解释、低数据量稳健的图学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Exploiting meaningful latent structures from data to solve downstream tasks is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and machine learning. While Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) successfully leverage the covariance matrix to process data, they inherently capture both direct and indirect correlations. The precision matrix (inverse covariance) overcomes this by explicitly encoding conditional independencies, making it largely studied in graphical lasso and graph topology identification. However, finite-sample precision estimates are notoriously unstable, and regularized estimators remain task-agnostic. In this work, our principal contribution is tackling the challenging problem of task-aware graph inference. We propose Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint), a framework that jointly estimates a sparse, statistically grounded precision matrix alongside graph neural network weights via an alternating optimization scheme. As a foundational framework to support this, we introduce Precision Neural Networks (PNNs), a broader class of graph convolutional networks operating on precision estimators, and establish their spectral connections to PCA and VNNs alongside their stability to finite-sample errors. Extensive empirical evaluations on synthetic data, as well as real-world neuroimaging and motion sensor datasets, demonstrate that PNN-Joint yields highly interpretable task-aware graphs, exhibits remarkable robustness in low-data regimes, and consistently achieves the best or second-best performance among competitors on real-world tasks.

</details>


### [321] [MercerFlow: Flow Matching in a Kernel-Induced Latent Space for Probabilistic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06039)
*Ilya Kuleshov,Egor Serov,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究条件流匹配（CFM）时间序列预测中，线性潜在映射与先验之间的关系，提出使用先验核的Mercer特征基作为潜空间映射，使MLP骨干网络在性能与效率上均优于序列模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率流匹配预测受益于数据匹配先验，但吸收局部相关性的序列架构（RNN、S4、Transformer）耗显存和时间。MLP潜在空间流匹配更廉价，而先验与线性潜映射的关系在CFM预测中研究不足，且该关系强烈影响性能：Fourier/DCT仅对OU先验良态，PCA映射虽强但依赖训练集、对训练-测试漂移敏感。

Method: 提出使用先验核的Mercer特征基作为潜空间线性映射：该基可精确对角化中心化协方差，与训练数据解耦，并能适应非平稳和周期性先验；随后在潜空间用表格MLP（将序列视为特征集合）学习流。

Result: 在五个GluonTS基准（ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）上，采用与TSFlow相同的协议，所得MLP在CRPS上持平或超越TSFlow，同时训练显存约减少4.7倍，每epoch时间约减少3.5–4.4倍。

Conclusion: 先验核的Mercer特征基是CFM时间序列预测中更优的潜空间映射选择，能在保持或提升预测精度的同时显著降低训练显存与时间开销。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that probabilistic flow matching for time series forecasting benefits from a data-matched prior. The resulting prior introduces local correlations, which a sequential architecture usually absorbs: a recurrent neural network (RNN), a structured state-space model (S4), or a Transformer. However, such a backbone costs GPU memory and time per epoch. A cheaper alternative is MLP-based latent-space flow matching: embed the time series via an invertible map to a single latent vector and learn the flow there, so a tabular MLP can treat the series as a set of features. The relationship between the prior and the choice of linear latent map is understudied in conditional flow matching (CFM) forecasting, yet we found it strongly affects performance. Fixed transforms such as Fourier or discrete cosine (DCT) are only well-conditioned for Ornstein--Uhlenbeck priors, while a principal-component (PCA) map fit to the data is a strong but training-set-dependent reference sensitive to train--test shift. Instead, we propose to use the Mercer eigenbasis of the prior kernel: it diagonalises the centred covariance exactly, decouples from training data, and adapts to non-stationary and periodic priors. On five GluonTS benchmarks (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) under a shared protocol with TSFlow, the resulting MLP matches or beats it on CRPS at about $4.7\times$ less training memory and $3.5\times$--$4.4\times$ less time per epoch.

</details>


### [322] [GO-Based Clustering for Learning Cluster-Level Causal Gene Regulatory Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06042)
*Azlaan Mustafa Samad,Wei Zhang,Adèle H Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GO4CD算法，利用基因本体（GO）构建多粒度、生物学有意义的基因划分，以支持簇级因果发现，显著提高划分的可采纳性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维基因调控网络（GRN）中因果关系发现计算困难且难以解释；将基因分组为功能模块可提升可处理性与生物学可解释性。但现有簇级因果发现方法依赖预定义的可采纳划分，要求簇间图无环，而构造此类划分本身非常困难。

Method: GO4CD基于Gene Ontology构建多粒度基因划分：将参与同一生物过程的基因归为一组，并通过本体层级传播基因注释以获得不同粗细粒度的划分，同时优先选择更可能可采纳的划分。该算法与簇级因果学习算法CLOC集成，在条件独立预言机以及模拟基因表达数据（多变量条件独立检验）下评估真实马尔可夫等价类的恢复情况。

Result: 在多个大肠杆菌调控子网络上评估，GO4CD的不可采纳率仅为18.1%，而基于语义相似度的基线方法为65.3%–82.3%。

Conclusion: GO4CD更适合学习定义在具有生物学意义的基因簇上的因果GRN，为簇级因果发现提供了更可靠的划分方案。

Abstract: Discovery of causal relationships in high-dimensional Gene Regulatory Networks (GRN) is computationally challenging and often difficult to interpret due to dense connections. Therefore, grouping genes together into functional modules can improve tractability and biological interpretability. However, existing cluster level causal discovery methods assume access to a predefined admissible partitions, requiring the graph over clusters to be acyclic. Constructing such partitions is therefore challenging. In this work, we introduce GO-based Clustering for Causal Discovery (GO4CD), an algorithm that uses Gene Ontology (GO) to construct biologically meaningful gene partitions at multiple levels of granularity, while favoring those more likely to be admissible for causal discovery. GO4CD groups together genes participating in a shared biological process, and propagates gene annotations through the ontology hierarchy to achieve different granularity of partitions. Furthermore, we integrate GO4CD with Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) algorithm and evaluate recovery of true Markov equivalence class both with an oracle of conditional independencies and on simulated gene expression data using multivariate conditional independence tests. We evaluate GO4CD on multiple E.coli regulatory subnetworks and find that it is inadmissible in 18.1% of the cases, compared with 65.3-82.3% for the semantic-similarity baselines. Our results indicate that GO4CD is substantially better suited to learning causal GRNs defined over biologically meaningful gene clusters.

</details>


### [323] [Pay to Learn, Share to Earn: Incentivized Federated Multi-Player Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06062)
*Pavamana K J,Chandramani Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种带激励机制的联邦多玩家多臂老虎机框架，玩家共享信息获得奖励、购买信息需付费，并设计 Buying-UCB 算法以平衡个体探索与协作学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦老虎机框架通常假设所有玩家自愿与服务器共享观测，但在实际中玩家是自利的，若无明确激励可能不愿参与协作。因此需要引入激励与成本机制来建模真实的合作行为。

Method: 提出激励感知的联邦老虎机框架：玩家共享信息获奖励、购买信息付出成本。基于 UCB 开发 Buying-UCB 算法，将共享激励与信息获取成本纳入学习过程，以平衡个体探索与协作学习。

Result: 理论上推导出群体遗憾和购买成本的上界，并刻画了完全协作联邦学习与完全独立学习之间的权衡；大量数值实验验证了理论结论，并在不同协作与定价机制下展示了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 激励感知框架能够刻画自利玩家在联邦老虎机中的参与决策，Buying-UCB 在理论上具有遗憾与成本保证，实验表明其在不同协作与定价情形下均有效。

Abstract: Federated multi-player multi-armed bandit problems model collaborative sequential decision-making where multiple players interact with a common bandit environment and share information through a central server to accelerate learning. Existing federated bandit frameworks typically assume that all players willingly share their local observations with the server. However, this assumption is often unrealistic in practical settings where players are self-interested and may not participate in collaboration without explicit incentives. To address this challenge, we propose an incentive-aware federated bandit framework in which players receive rewards for sharing information with the server and incur costs when buying information from the server. We develop a UCB-based algorithm, termed Buying-UCB, that balances individual exploration and collaborative learning by incorporating both sharing incentives and information acquisition costs into the learning process. We theoretically analyze the proposed algorithm and derive upper bounds on the group regret and buying cost. Our analysis further characterizes the trade-off between fully collaborative federated learning and completely independent learning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework under different collaboration and pricing regimes.

</details>


### [324] [Boosting Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06083)
*Zexin Li,Ruili Yao,Yiming Zeng,Xiaoxue Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究深度强化学习（DRL）的迁移式黑盒攻击，提出轨迹级攻击方法，通过滚动时域优化扰动序列，在CartPole-v1上优于单步攻击和随机噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DRL对抗攻击多假设白盒访问受害策略，实际中难以满足，因此需要研究迁移式黑盒攻击。作者发现直接移植图像分类的可迁移攻击（FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM）配合单步目标所生成的扰动虽可迁移，但强度不超过同预算的随机噪声，说明单步思路不足。

Method: 将攻击建模为每步扰动预算下的回报最小化问题。提出轨迹级攻击：通过可微环境模型和温度平滑的替代策略，在滚动时域上优化一段扰动序列，并使用与图像攻击相同的优化器。

Result: 在CartPole-v1上，使用十个DQN和DDQN智能体、100组替代-受害策略对，轨迹级攻击在白盒、跨模型和跨算法三种设置下均优于单步攻击和随机噪声。

Conclusion: 单步迁移攻击在DRL中效果有限，而轨迹级优化能有效提升黑盒迁移攻击的强度，为DRL黑盒对抗攻击提供了新思路。

Abstract: Most adversarial attacks on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) assume white-box access to the victim policy, which rarely holds in practice. This paper studies transfer-based black-box attacks on DRL: the attacker crafts observation perturbations on a white-box surrogate agent and feeds them to an unknown victim. We formulate the attack as return minimization under a per-step perturbation budget. We first show that transplanting transferable image-classification attacks (FGSM, MI-FGSM, and NI-FGSM) with a per-step objective yields perturbations that transfer but are no stronger than random noise of the same budget. We then propose a trajectory-level attack that optimizes a sequence of perturbations over a receding horizon through a differentiable model of the environment and a temperature-smoothed surrogate policy, with the same optimizers. On CartPole-v1 with ten DQN and DDQN agents and 100 surrogate--victim pairs, the trajectory-level attack outperforms per-step attacks and random noise in the white-box, cross-model, and cross-algorithm settings.

</details>


### [325] [Rethinking Least-Core Computation in Contextual-Distractor Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06087)
*Hiroshi Kera,Toshinori Yamauchi,Sai Ganesh Nagarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究最小核心归因中收益选择与联盟采样对伤害玩家识别的影响，并提出熵最小核心（ELC），一种唯一极小点连续趋近核仁的光滑近似方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小核心能揭示在稀有高价值情境中造成重大伤害的玩家，优于Shapley式平均；但其分配通常不唯一，分配选择会影响解释结果，因此需研究收益选择与联盟采样的影响。

Method: 通过实验考察不同选择器与采样对最小核心归因的影响；提出ELC，基于熵的光滑近似，其唯一极小点随温度沿连续路径收敛到核仁；采用全联盟约束与良好定义的选择器进行高效计算，并探索GPU加速。

Result: 选择器选择对区分有用与有害贡献很重要；采样即使在有用玩家仍可识别时也会降低有害玩家识别；ELC比基于LP的核仁求解器更快地近似核仁，收益误差小，规模较大时GPU加速更明显；在测试的全联盟语境干扰博弈中，ELC的识别准确率与最小范数选择器相当，且更能按伤害对干扰项排序。

Conclusion: ELC提供了一种快速、稳定且定义良好的最小核心归因方法，能有效近似核仁并在伤害排序上表现良好。

Abstract: Game-theoretic attribution explains a model by assigning credit to its features or training examples. The least core has attracted interest as an alternative to Shapley-style averaging because it can expose players that cause substantial harm in rare, high-value contexts. However, least-core allocations are generally nonunique, and the choice of allocation can affect the resulting explanation. In this study, we investigate how payoff selection and coalition sampling affect least-core attribution. Our experiments show that selector choice matters for distinguishing useful and harmful contributions, and that sampling can degrade harmful-player identification across the tested selectors even when useful players remain well identified. These observations motivate efficient computation with all coalition constraints and a well-defined selector. We introduce entropic least core (ELC), a smooth approximation whose unique minimizer follows a continuous path along the temperature to the nucleolus, a classical refinement of the least core. Our experiments show that ELC approximates the nucleolus faster than an LP-based nucleolus solver while retaining small payoff errors, with further GPU acceleration at larger problem sizes. In the tested full-coalition contextual-distractor games, ELC matches the minimum-norm selector in identification accuracy and more accurately ranks distractors by harm.

</details>


### [326] [Lossy Compression of PDE Training Inputs: Field Reconstruction Error Does Not Order the Cost to a Trained Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06095)
*Huy Hoang Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 压缩输入场时,场的重建误差不能决定下游算子精度;真正起作用的是方程对输入扰动的衰减(平滑)程度,该衰减跨PDE族相差两个数量级以上,可仅用前向传播测得。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子学习基准以全精度存储、已达TB量级,率失真理论只能回答"存这个场需要多少比特",而实践者真正关心的是"在压缩数据上训练出的算子有多准"。作者要证明前者并不能决定后者,并找出决定后者的量。

Method: 只压缩输入场,目标与测试输入保持全精度;用一个已在全精度下训练好的代理模型,把压缩场前向传过去,测量该代理传递了多少输入扰动,得到"传输因子"。对比场重建误差、相对L2目标下的表现,并在一次全精度训练后仅用前向传播评估整条率曲线;跨多种编解码器与架构验证。

Result: 重建误差在衰减之前计算,看不到该衰减;跨PDE族传输分数相差逾两个数量级。对用MSE训练的算子,重建误差在104次代价比较中反转了36次,而同批前向传播构建的探针只反转12次。PDEBench中以相同初始条件存储的两个族,在相同场误差下下游相差三倍。相对L2目标下分离度收窄,但族级中位传输因子的排序不变。探针能在不同编解码器与架构间一致地对数据集和码率排序,但其数值幅度不能跨设定迁移。

Conclusion: 压缩的比特需求与算子精度由不同机制决定;失败与否的关键是捕获输入的物理衰减,而非场重建。仅靠前向传播的探针可低成本、稳健地评估整条率曲线并排序,但幅度不可迁移,需在具体设置下重新标定。

Abstract: Operator-learning benchmarks are stored at full precision and have grown to terabyte scale. Rate-distortion theory says how many bits the stored field needs, while a practitioner needs to know how accurate an operator trained on the compressed data will be. We show that the first does not determine the second, and measure why, compressing the input fields while targets and test inputs stay at full precision. A solution operator attenuates a perturbation of its input. Pushing a compressed field through a surrogate already trained at full precision measures how much of the perturbation that surrogate transmits. The fraction is consistent with the smoothing behaviour of the underlying equation, and it spans more than two orders of magnitude across PDE families. Field reconstruction error is computed before the attenuation and cannot see it. For operators trained with mean squared error it inverts 36 of 104 cost comparisons across datasets, where a probe built from the same forward passes inverts 12. Two families that PDEBench stores with identical initial conditions differ threefold downstream at identical field error. Under the relative-L2 objective of the reference recipe the separation narrows, while the ordering of the family-level median transmission factors is unchanged. After one full-precision training run, the probe evaluates an entire rate curve by forward passes alone. It ranks datasets and rates consistently across the codecs and architectures we test, while its magnitude does not transfer between them.

</details>


### [327] [On the Geometry of Multimodal Saturation: Riemannian VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06096)
*Nessim Ben Abbes,Duc Han Le,Sabri Mtibaa,Van-Tam Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 三模态自监督学习反而常比最佳双模态子集差（称"多模态饱和"），原因是对齐几何问题，作者提出岭回归VICReg（R-VICReg）缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习通常认为增加第三模态应提升或至少保持性能，但作者发现实际情况相反，需要揭示并提出解决方案。

Method: 在9个图像-文本-表格数据集上，用VICReg与SimSiam进行配对实验；提出Riemannian VICReg，通过可学习负曲率乘积因子上的测地线距离平方对齐视图，曲率趋于零时退化为经典VICReg。

Result: VICReg下55.6%的配对运行中三模态模型劣于最佳双模态子集，SimSiam下为51.1%；R-VICReg在45次配对运行中将第三模态带来提升的概率从44.4%提高到64.4%。

Conclusion: 多模态饱和源于对齐几何缺陷，采用黎曼几何对齐（R-VICReg）可有效提升第三模态的增益，改善集中在VICReg饱和的情形。

Abstract: In self-supervised learning, a third modality should improve, or at least preserve, performance. Across nine image-text-tabular datasets, we show that it instead harms performance: the trimodal model underperforms its own best bimodal subset in 55.6% of paired runs under VICReg. The same failure occurs in 51.1% of paired runs under SimSiam. We call this failure multimodal saturation. We propose that the failure lies in the alignment geometry. Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg) generalizes classical VICReg: it aligns views by squared geodesic distance on learnable negative-curvature product factors and recovers VICReg exactly as curvature vanishes. Over the same 45 paired runs, R-VICReg raises the probability that the third modality helps from 44.4% to 64.4%, with gains concentrated where VICReg saturates.

</details>


### [328] [Flash-OPD: Fast On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06105)
*Wei Chen,Junle Chen,Yitong Yang,Zhaoyang Xu,Jiaxin Lin,Yuxuan Liang,Xiaofang Zhou,Kai Wang,Rui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Flash-OPD，将 on-policy distillation 的轨迹长度控制转化为轨迹级可靠性边界验证，实现 2.2×–7.5× 加速且精度不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation 需要对学生生成的轨迹进行密集教师监督，但长 rollout 的生成与评估成本高。现有加速方法（开环 rollout 调度、闭环 horizon 自适应）难以适配不同轨迹的异质可靠长度：过短会截断有用监督，过长则浪费计算。

Method: 核心洞见是无需在生成前预测轨迹的可靠性边界。将可靠性视为累计的低教师-学生兼容性事件的首次到达（first-passage），边界在采样前未知，但可由已观测前缀精确判断是否到达。Flash-OPD 将 rollout-horizon 控制转为轨迹级边界验证，交替进行缓存生成与教师验证，按观测到的兼容事件独立停止每条轨迹；近期事件率仅用于安排下一次验证点，实际停止决策依赖精确累计计数，从而分离估计误差与终止决策。

Result: 在多种数据集与教师-学生设置下，相比标准 OPD 取得 2.2×–7.5× 加速，同时保持或提升准确率。

Conclusion: 通过将监督长度问题重构为可在线精确验证的轨迹级边界判定，Flash-OPD 在保证监督质量的同时显著降低 on-policy distillation 的训练成本。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but generating and evaluating long rollouts incurs substantial training cost. Existing acceleration methods reduce this cost through open-loop rollout schedules or closed-loop horizon adaptation. However, supervision compatibility can vary substantially across trajectories, making a single rollout horizon difficult to match their heterogeneous reliable lengths: an overly short horizon may truncate useful supervision, while an overly long one wastes computation beyond reliable regions. Our key insight is that the trajectory-specific reliability boundary need not be predicted before generation. By viewing reliability as the first-passage of accumulated low teacher--student compatibility events, the boundary is inherently unknown before sampling, yet whether it has been reached can be determined exactly from the observed prefix. Building on this insight, we propose *Flash-OPD*, which shifts from rollout-horizon control to adaptive trajectory-level boundary verification. *Flash-OPD* interleaves cached generation with teacher verification and independently stops each trajectory according to its observed compatibility events. To reduce verification overhead, the recent event rate is used only to schedule the next verification point, while the actual stopping decision always relies on the exact cumulative count. This separation prevents estimation errors from causing premature termination while enabling efficient verification during generation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and teacher--student settings show that *Flash-OPD* achieves $2.2\times$--$7.5\times$ speedups over standard OPD while maintaining or improving accuracy.

</details>


### [329] [ORCA: The Annealed Spectral Conditioning Optimizer for Faster, Better LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06116)
*Yuanshi Liu,Boyuan Jiang,Liang Hou,Xin Tao,Pengfei Wan,Zhouchen Lin,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 ORCA（Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After），在训练初期对权重矩阵施加强但临时的软正交正则化，后期移除，从而兼顾早期宽谱收益与后期自由适配，在 130M-8B 的 LLaMA、Qwen3 及细粒度 MoE 模型上取得比 Muon 更低的验证损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 LLM 优化器（如 Muon）常产生比 Adam 更高有效秩的权重矩阵，但进一步的谱控制只带来有限收益。作者指出背后存在一个张力：集中的谱会抑制耦合权重矩阵中的梯度方向、拖慢优化；而全程维持的约束又会限制任务特定适配、抬高可达损失下界。因此需要一种既能在早期获益、又不长期束缚权重的方法。

Method: ORCA 是一种极简的优化器干预：在训练早期施加较强但临时的软正交正则化，使权重在早期获得更宽的谱，随后移除该正则化，让权重在后期自由适配。它不需要改动模型架构，开销极小。

Result: 在 LLaMA、Qwen3 以及细粒度 MoE 模型（130M 至 8B 参数）上，ORCA 的最终验证损失低于 Muon；其相对 Muon 的损失下降幅度达到或超过 Muon 相对 Adam 的下降幅度。消融实验支持“早期塑形、后期释放”的设计。

Conclusion: ORCA 通过“先强后撤”的软正交正则化，在保持无架构改动、低开销的前提下，稳定优于 Muon，说明优化器谱控制的关键在于时机而非持续约束。

Abstract: Modern LLM optimizers such as Muon often produce weight matrices with higher effective rank than Adam, yet further spectral control has delivered only modest gains. We identify a tension behind this result: concentrated spectra can suppress gradient directions in coupled weight matrices and slow optimization, while constraints maintained throughout training can limit task-specific adaptation and raise the attainable loss floor. We introduce ORCA (Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After), a minimal optimizer intervention that applies strong but temporary soft orthogonality regularization early in training, then removes it. This allows the weights to benefit from a broader spectrum early on and adapt freely afterward. Across LLaMA, Qwen3, and fine-grained mixture-of-experts models ranging from 130M to 8B parameters, ORCA achieves lower final validation loss than Muon. Its loss reduction relative to Muon matches or exceeds Muon's reduction relative to Adam. Ablations support the early-shaping, later-release design. Further, ORCA requires no architectural changes and adds minimal overhead.

</details>


### [330] [Mind the Drift: Diagonal Linear Networks Under Large Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06120)
*Aniket Sanyal,Tom Jacobs,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大学习率下对角线性网络的训练动力学，揭示"增益"(Gain)与"漂移"(Drift)两种隐式偏置的竞争机制，二者共同决定回归解的稀疏性，并证明大学习率可通过干预用于控制隐式偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大学习率会使神经网络训练偏离经典梯度流行为，Edge of Stability (EoS) 提供了理解此类动力学的视角。作者希望理解大学习率如何影响隐式偏置与解稀疏性，纠正"大学习率必然损害稀疏恢复"的直觉。

Method: 以对角线性网络为研究对象，在回归设定下分析梯度下降相对梯度流的平均离散化误差（Gain），并推导出与之密切相关但被忽视的量——Drift，用以刻画不同离散化误差间的不平衡及优化轨迹的系统性偏移；进一步设计干预手段主动操控Gain。

Result: 发现Gain与Drift两种隐式偏置存在竞争关系。Gain在某些区域单调增长，倾向更稠密、更平坦的插值解；Drift的影响取决于其与潜在解的对齐方向，可抵消或强化Gain效应，尤其在早期训练阶段主导模型选择。通过主动引导Gain的实验干预，成功恢复了更尖锐、更稀疏的解。

Conclusion: 大学习率并非普遍阻碍稀疏解的恢复，反而可以被利用来调控训练的隐式偏置，为理解和控制优化动力学提供新视角。

Abstract: Large learning rates can qualitatively change the trajectory of neural network training, often pushing optimization into regimes far from classical gradient-flow behavior. The Edge of Stability (EoS) offers a valuable lens on the dynamics such learning rates induce. We study corresponding dynamics in diagonal linear networks, where we uncover a competition between two distinct implicit biases that jointly determine the sparsity of the recovered solution in regression settings. Complementary to the Gain, which captures the average discretization error accumulated by Gradient Descent relative to Gradient Flow, we derive a closely associated but overlooked quantity: the Drift. Under large learning rates, it describes an imbalance between different discretization errors and represents a systematic shift in the optimization trajectory. While the Gain grows monotonically in certain regimes, and can bias towards denser, flatter interpolators, the impact of the Drift depends on its alignment with potential solutions, which can either counteract or reinforce the effect of the Gain. Consequently, its behavior drives model selection, particularly during early training epochs. To validate our theoretical insights, we introduce an intervention that actively steers the Gain to recover sharper, sparser solutions. Thus, our analysis reveals that large learning rates do not universally hinder the recovery of sparse solutions. On the contrary, they can be harnessed to control the implicit bias of training.

</details>


### [331] [Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06128)
*Abhishek Srinivasan,Juan Carlos Andresen,Sepideh Pashami,Anders Holst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个概率融合框架，将基于磨损的退化模型与基于传感器的数据模型通过失效概率分布整合，从而获得不确定性感知且自适应加权的RUL预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测性维护需要可靠的剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计。现有方法主要分为两类：基于磨损的老化模型（捕捉累积退化）和基于传感器的数据模型（反映瞬时健康状态），两者各自只提供部分信息，因此需要一种能够整合二者优势的方法。

Method: 在明确的结构性假设下，建立磨损、潜在健康、传感器观测与失效之间的联系，并据此推导出一个有原则的组合规则，实现对两个分量的不确定性感知整合与自适应加权。实验中，磨损分量用参数化生存模型学习，传感器分量用一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）配合事后不确定性模型学习。

Result: 在多个N-CMAPSS数据集上的评估表明，融合模型相比单独使用任一分量，提高了点预测精度，保持了C-index，并产生更窄且校准良好的预测区间。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了基于磨损的生存模型与基于传感器的深度学习模型之间的互补作用，表明二者的概率融合为在整个寿命周期内实现更稳健、更一致的预测提供了一条结构化路径。

Abstract: Predictive maintenance requires reliable remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: wear-based aging models that capture cumulative degradation and sensor-driven data models that reflect instantaneous health conditions, each providing only partial information. In this work, we propose a probabilistic fusion framework that integrates wear-based and sensor-based prognostic components through failure probability distributions. Based on explicit structural assumptions linking wear, latent health, sensor observations, and failure, we derive a principled combination rule that enables uncertainty-aware integration with adaptive weighting of the components. Experimentally, we assess this combination rule by learning the wear-based component using a parametric survival model and the sensor-based component using a 1D convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a post-hoc uncertainty model. Evaluation on multiple N-CMAPSS datasets demonstrates that the fused model improves point accuracy, preserves the C-index, and produces narrower yet well-calibrated prediction intervals compared to either component alone. The results highlight the complementary roles of wear-based survival model and sensor-based deep learning model, and show that their probabilistic integration provides a structured pathway toward more robust and consistent prognostics over the life-time.

</details>


### [332] [Machine learning for journal entry testing: A type-aware evaluation of anomaly detectors under a review budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06133)
*Jan Gronewald,Michel Scherer,Nijat Mehdiyev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出类型感知评估框架，揭示高命中率检测器存在系统性盲点，反馈学习会强化既有检测模式而不扩大覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统日志条目异常检测评估在全量数据上使用ROC-AUC、精确率和召回率，忽略了复核预算约束以及检测到的异常类型，导致高命中率可能掩盖系统性的类型盲区。

Method: 提出类型感知评估指标：按类型召回率、公平份额类型召回率（FSR，将每类贡献上限限定为其预算份额）、类型覆盖率与首次命中排名。在四个真实客户账本（注入类型化异常）和一个公开合成账本上，评估九种无监督检测器、一个监督参考基线，以及反馈驱动的DeepSAD半监督异常检测方法。

Result: 最大客户账本上，PCA、AE、VAE在前100条记录中平均命中98个异常，但其中至少95.8个属于单一类型。FSR则更偏好kNN检测器，并在四个客户账本中的三个上改变了排名第一的检测器。编码方式影响显著：one-hot编码能暴露未见账户，频率编码则基本无法检测未见对方账户。公开账本上，HBOS和ECOD在1,386条内覆盖全部八种标记，而kNN虽在1,000条时命中最多，却要到第4,641条才首次触及交叉清算标记，监督行级参考在1,000条内也未能命中该标记。DeepSAD复核协议将每100次复核的平均命中数从40.0提升至68.3，但类型覆盖率仅从2.7升至3.0。

Conclusion: 高命中率可能掩盖系统性盲点；反馈机制能提高命中效率，但可能强化既有检测模式，而无法扩大异常类型的覆盖范围。

Abstract: Journal entry anomaly detectors are commonly evaluated on the full population with ROC-AUC, precision and recall, ignoring the review budget and which anomaly types are found. We propose a type-aware evaluation combining per-type recall, fair-share type recall (FSR), which caps each type's credit at its budget share, type coverage and first-hit rank. We evaluate nine unsupervised detectors, a supervised reference and feedback-driven Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (DeepSAD) on four real client ledgers with injected typed anomalies and a public synthetic ledger. On the largest client ledger, principal component analysis (PCA), an autoencoder (AE) and a variational autoencoder (VAE) each place on average 98 anomalies among the first 100 postings, but at least 95.8 belong to one type. FSR instead favours a nearest-neighbour (kNN) detector and changes the top-ranked detector on three of four client ledgers. Representation also matters: one-hot encoding exposes unseen accounts, whereas frequency encoding leaves unseen contra accounts largely undetected. On the public ledger, the Histogram-Based Outlier Score (HBOS) and Empirical Cumulative Distribution-Based Outlier Detection (ECOD) reach all eight markings within 1,386 entries, whereas kNN, the hit leader at 1,000 entries, first reaches cross-linked clearing at rank 4,641, and the supervised row-level reference misses this marking within 1,000 entries. There, the adaptive DeepSAD review protocol raises mean hits per 100 reviews from 40.0 to 68.3 but type coverage only from 2.7 to 3.0. These findings show that high hit rates can conceal systematic blind spots and suggest that feedback can reinforce existing detection patterns without broadening anomaly coverage.

</details>


### [333] [Co-Optimizing Graph Sparsification and Approximate Computing for Energy-Efficient FPGA-Based GCN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06138)
*Nathaniel Kaye Mellor,Shreejith Shanker,George Floros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于FPGA的GCN加速器，结合DSpar图稀疏化、8比特量化与近似乘法器，在AMD Kria KV260上实现高效低功耗图卷积推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCN虽为图结构数据学习的强大框架，但在资源受限的边缘平台上部署面临稀疏图聚合带来的计算与内存需求挑战，因此需要高效的加速方案。

Method: 在AMD Kria KV260上设计FPGA-based GCN加速器，融合DSpar图稀疏化、8-bit量化与近似乘法器，并在Cora、LastFM Asia、Amazon Photo三个不同密度图上评估稀疏化与近似计算的交互作用。

Result: 近似算术的有效性由GCN计算中的累加深度决定；近似乘法器在稀疏聚合操作中最为有效，图稀疏化通过降低聚合深度进一步提升其可行性。组合方案在Amazon Photo上实现最高9.88倍加速且保持86.6%准确率，在Cora上实现1.52倍加速与77.0%准确率，总功耗低于1W。

Conclusion: 图稀疏化与近似计算是互补技术，其协同优化可在边缘FPGA平台上实现高效低功耗的GCN推理。

Abstract: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the computational and memory demands of sparse graph aggregation. This work presents an FPGA-based GCN accelerator that combines DSpar graph sparsification, 8-bit quantization, and approximate multipliers on the AMD Kria KV260. Evaluated on Cora, LastFM Asia, and Amazon Photo, the design explores the interaction between sparsification and approximation across graphs with widely varying densities. Results show that the effectiveness of approximate arithmetic is governed by accumulation depth within GCN computations. Approximate multipliers are most effective when applied to sparse aggregation operations, while graph sparsification further improves their viability by reducing aggregation depth. The combined approach achieves up to 9.88$\times$ speedup while maintaining 86.6\% classification accuracy on Amazon Photo, and 1.52$\times$ speedup with 77.0\% accuracy on Cora, with total power consumption below 1 W. These results demonstrate that graph sparsification and approximate computing are complementary techniques whose co-optimization enables efficient low-power GCN inference on edge FPGA platforms.

</details>


### [334] [TIGER: Time-Series Classification with In-Context-Learning Gated Ensemble of Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06156)
*Johann Faouzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TIGER，一种基于“表示家族集成 + 自适应元分类”的时间序列分类方法，在 142 个 UCR 数据集上取得优于 HIVE-COTE 2.0 等六个算法的平均精度、平衡精度和 F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成多种表示家族是当前时间序列分类最准确的方向，但现有最先进集成方法（如 HIVE-COTE 2.0）为每个表示家族搭配专门分类器，并使用固定的、非自适应的融合规则，缺乏灵活性。

Method: TIGER 将同一小组的三个通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、Naive Bayes）应用于来自四个不同家族的四种表示，将 12 个基学习器的预测堆叠为元特征矩阵；最终预测由自适应元分类规则产生，该规则依据每类平均训练样本数，在每个数据集上独立选择加权硬多数投票或 TabICLv2（作为元分类器进行上下文学习的预训练表格基础模型）。

Result: 在来自 UCR 档案的 142 个数据集基准上，TIGER 在六个对比算法（含 HIVE-COTE 2.0）中取得最佳平均精度、平衡精度和 F1，并显著优于其余五个算法；其自适应规则也明显优于单独使用的两种元分类方法；仅用 20 个数据集开发子集调优的单一超参数可泛化到完整评测基准。

Conclusion: TIGER 通过通用分类器组合与自适应元分类规则，在时间序列分类中实现了优于现有最先进集成方法的表现，并通过大量消融实验刻画了其设计选择并报告了被舍弃的替代方案。

Abstract: A representation family is a distinct way of extracting features from time series. Ensemble algorithms that combine several representation families remain the most accurate approach to time series classification. Current state-of-the-art ensembles, most notably HIVE-COTE~2.0, pair a bespoke classification algorithm with each representation family and combine their predictions using a fixed, non-adaptive rule. We present TIGER (Time-series classification with In-context-learning Gated Ensemble of Representations), which instead applies the same small portfolio of three general-purpose classifiers (Ridge, Extra Trees, and Naive Bayes) to four representations from four distinct families, stacking the resulting twelve base learners' predictions into a meta-feature matrix. The final prediction is produced by an adaptive meta-classification rule that chooses, independently for each data set, between a weighted hard majority vote and TabICLv2, a pretrained tabular foundation model used in-context as a meta-classifier, based on the mean number of training samples available per class. On a 142-data-set benchmark drawn from the UCR time series classification archive, TIGER obtains the best mean accuracy, balanced accuracy, and F1-score among six compared algorithms, including HIVE-COTE~2.0, and significantly outperforms each of the other five individually. TIGER's adaptive rule also meaningfully outperforms either of its two constituent meta-classification methods used alone, and its single hyperparameter, tuned using only a twenty-data-set development subset, is shown to generalize to the full evaluation benchmark. We further characterize TIGER's design through an extensive set of ablation experiments and report the design alternatives that we investigated and ultimately discarded.

</details>


### [335] [Anosognosia in LLMs: Probing Self-Awareness of Quantized Computational Substrate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06174)
*Yoshihiro Izawa,Gouki Minegishi,Yoko Yamakata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文借鉴神经学中的"病感缺失"现象，探究LLM能否识别自身计算基底因量化而产生的退化。结果显示模型无法自我报告量化状态，生成文本几乎不携带量化痕迹，但内部表征包含清晰的、与量化方法相关的指纹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受神经学"病感缺失"（患者无法识别自身能力损伤）启发，作者想检验LLM是否具备对自身计算基底退化（量化引起的）的自我监控与觉察能力，并探索实现这种觉察的可行路径。

Method: 先测试现有模型能否自我报告量化状态（包括提供自身生成文本作为外部线索）；用线性探针分析生成文本与内部表征中是否包含量化信息；通过训练让模型识别严重退化输出；并联合训练跨量化级别的共享LoRA以读取内部指纹，同时测试其对新量化方法的泛化能力。

Result: 模型无法自我报告量化状态，即使给出自身生成文本作为外部线索也如此；线性探针显示生成文本几乎不含量化痕迹，而内部表征存在清晰的、与特定量化方法绑定的指纹。经训练后模型能通过对比识别严重退化（如4-bit）输出，但仍无法从单一输出中判别。共享LoRA能读出内部指纹，但在未见过的量化方法上失败，只是将方法特定的指纹映射到标签。

Conclusion: 与人类病感缺失中外部自我观察有时可恢复觉察不同，本文结果表明让LLM获得此类觉察更有前景的途径在于其内部表征，同时揭示了LLM自我监控在泛化性上的根本局限。

Abstract: Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate? Inspired by anosognosia, a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization. We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue. Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints. Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output. A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels. Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations. Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.

</details>


### [336] [Anlu: Enabling In-Context Time Series Anomaly Detection in Foundation Models via Counterfactual Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06180)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出参考条件下的时序异常检测任务与反事实监督方法，并设计Anlu模型，在TSB-AD-U上将VUS-PR从0.542提升至0.607。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序模式是否异常常取决于被监控过程的运行工况：同一缺失事件在某工况下是故障，在另一工况下可能是常规现象，而仅凭查询本身无法判断适用哪种工况。因此需要引入参考记录提供的期望行为证据。

Method: 将TSAD建模为参考条件检测的上下文学习问题，模型参数在推理时保持冻结。提出反事实监督：为同一查询配两个支持不同正常规则的参考并分别标注；在标签不一致的位置，忽略参考的检测器无法同时拟合两个目标。Anlu在冻结的时序基础模型（TSFM）上添加参考记忆与零初始化门控适配器。

Result: 在350条TSB-AD-U评估序列上，Anlu将冻结TSFM的平均VUS-PR从0.542提升至0.607；将参考替换为零向量后，分数降至0.499。

Conclusion: 仅提供参考不足以促使模型利用它；反事实监督可有效强制模型依赖参考信息，且Anlu能显著提升冻结基础模型的异常检测性能，参考信息对结果具有实质性贡献。

Abstract: Whether a time-series pattern is anomalous often depends on the operating regime of the monitored process. A missing event can signal a fault in one regime and be routine in another, and the query alone may not reveal which regime applies. We study in-context learning (ICL) for time series anomaly detection (TSAD) through reference-conditioned detection, where a reference record provides evidence about expected behavior and model parameters remain fixed at inference. Supplying the reference is not enough: when training anomalies are recognizable from the query alone, the detector can fit its targets while ignoring the reference. We therefore introduce counterfactual supervision, which pairs one query with two references that support different normal rules and labels the query under each. At positions where the two labels disagree, no detector that ignores the reference can fit both targets. Anlu learns from this supervision by adding a reference memory and zero-initialized gated adapters to a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM) pretrained for anomaly detection. On the 350 TSB-AD-U evaluation sequences, Anlu raises the mean VUS-PR of the frozen TSFM from 0.542 to 0.607. Replacing the reference with zeros lowers Anlu's score to 0.499.

</details>


### [337] [Two-Point Local Optimality in $k$-Means via Boundary-Point Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06182)
*Wenlong Lyu,Xujie Xiao,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 r-点局部最优性，针对 r=2 设计 BPS-2PLS 方法，通过结构定理筛选候选点，将两点认证成本从 O(n^2(k^2+d)) 降低，在多数基准上取得最低 WCSS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lloyd 算法与 D-local 优化方法仅提供较弱的局部最优性保证，且解的质量对初始化敏感，因此需要更强的局部最优性概念与更高效的认证方法。

Method: 提出 r-点局部最优性（r=2）并证明两条结构性质：(i) D-local 最优点的改进两点移动必涉及两次重分配共享的簇；(ii) 只有证书定义的边界点才能参与改进对。据此提出 Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS)。

Result: 在固定 k,d 且簇占用不消失时，保留候选数 m=O_P(log n)；十二个基准中十个取得最低平均 WCSS；子采样实验中平均仅保留 0.10%–2.81% 的样本。

Conclusion: BPS-2PLS 能终止于两点局部最优，显著降低两点认证计算成本，并在多个基准上优于现有方法。

Abstract: Lloyd's algorithm and the discrete local (D-local) optimization method (Li et al., 2025) for $k$-means provide only weak local-optimality guarantees, and their solution quality remains sensitive to initialization. In this paper, we introduce $r$-point local optimality, under which no reassignment of at most $r$ samples decreases the objective function, and focus on $r=2$. The main computational obstacle is the $\mathcal{O}(n^2(k^2+d))$ cost of exhaustive two-point certification for $n$ samples in $d$ dimensions and $k$ clusters. To address this challenge, we prove that (i) every improving two-point move of a D-local optimum must involve a cluster shared by both reassignments, and (ii) only certificate-defined boundary points can participate in an improving pair. Exploiting this structure, we propose Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS), which terminates at a two-point local optimum. For fixed $k,d$ and nonvanishing cluster occupancy, the number $m$ of retained candidates satisfies $m=\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}}(\log n)$ under i.i.d. sampling from a bounded-support distribution with bounded density or from a Gaussian mixture. Across twelve benchmarks, BPS-2PLS attains the lowest available mean WCSS on ten. In a subsampling study, screening retains 0.10% to 2.81% of samples on average at the largest tested sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/lwl-learning/BPS-2PLS.

</details>


### [338] [Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06195)
*Akshay Chandrasekhar,Pavlo Melnyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“被动探针”（passive probes），即对训练中表征施加固定、未训练、与属性无关的随机投影，用以观察表征几何本身的变化，而非探针的适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络学到的特征表征常包含超出最终任务输出直接所需的结构。作者希望研究这种结构，并区分“表征几何变化”与“探针自身适应”带来的影响，因此需要一个固定、与所研究属性无关的观测器。

Method: 从S^2上的预测任务出发，比较等价的向量参数化与Hermitian参数化，发现一个额外的、对损失不变的迹坐标，由此推广出一般构造：用固定随机投影作为学习特征的观测器。由于观测器对损失不变且独立于被研究属性，可达性的变化反映的是表征相对于固定观测器的变化。作者进一步用被动探针集成来反映目标对齐等任务相关信息。

Result: 在作者构造下，“最终难度”的可达性在不同任务中演化不同：在表面法向估计和图像修复这两个回归任务中，训练期间可达性上升；而在图像分类中，它基本保持在初始水平。与学习到的线性探针比较，可恢复性与被动可达性在训练中可以有不同演化。

Conclusion: 被动探针能够分别刻画表征几何的变化以及最终任务难度的可达性，为理解深度网络表征结构提供了一种新工具。

Abstract: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

</details>


### [339] [Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning: How can we learn to safely control a nuclear power plant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06211)
*Perceval Beja-Battais,Alain Grosset{ê}te,Nicolas Vayatis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究行为克隆模型在核反应堆负荷跟踪任务中"部件级准确率≠系统级安全性"的差距，提出按时间尺度分离隐空间的结构化架构，并证明将其用作NMPC热启动比独立部署更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业控制的学习模型通常以聚合精度为评价标准，但组件级精度在嵌入实际系统后并不能保证安全性。作者希望在压水堆（PWR）负荷跟踪这一具有严格安全约束的任务上，研究行为克隆模仿NMPC专家策略时"精度与可行性"之间的落差。

Method: 提出一种结构化架构：将不同时间尺度的变量编码到各自独立的隐空间中，以反映系统的物理分解特性，然后在乘积隐空间上训练控制器模仿专家策略。以共享嵌入作为基线进行对比，并做敏感性分析考察表示的可解释性；最后将学习模型用于NMPC优化器的热启动，而非独立控制。

Result: 在长时程 rollout 中，分离嵌入相较共享嵌入基线同时提升了精度与可行性；敏感性分析显示模型学到了与系统物理一致的可解释表示。不过，无论采用何种架构，独立部署仍有百分之几的轨迹不可行；将其用于热启动 NMPC 后，可行性完全恢复、成本接近最优，且计算时间相较专家控制器减少约15%，在工况突变时减少更多。

Conclusion: 组件级准确率无法保证系统级安全，学习控制器的价值可能更多体现在加速而非替代传统优化控制：按时间尺度分离的隐空间结构化建模能改善精度与可行性，而将学习模型作为NMPC热启动可兼顾可行性、最优性与计算效率。

Abstract: Learned models for industrial control are usually judged by aggregate accuracy, but accuracy at the component level does not guarantee safety once it is embedded in the system it is meant to serve. We study this gap on a behavior-cloning task: imitating an expert Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) policy for load-following of a Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR), an industrial system with tight safety constraints. We propose a structured architecture encoding variables from each timescale into separate latent spaces, reflecting the physical decomposition of the system, before training a controller to imitate the expert on the product latent space. On long-horizon rollouts, separated embeddings improve both accuracy and feasibility compared with a shared-embedding baseline. Sensitivity analysis further shows that our model yields interpretable representations aligned with the system's physics. However, standalone deployment still leaves several percent of trajectories infeasible regardless of the architecture. Using our method to warmstart the NMPC optimizer rather than acting standalone, we recover full feasibility and near-optimal cost while still cutting computation time by $\sim$15% relative to the expert controller, and even more for abrupt operating changes.

</details>


### [340] [Sampling Allocation of LinUCB: Optimal Design Limits in the Small-Gap Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06213)
*Yujie Liu,Vincent Y. F. Tan,Yunbei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LinUCB在小间隔（small-gap）区域（奖励间隔至多 $n^{-1/2}$）的采样分配，从平均场视角证明其经验采样分布收敛到D-最优设计集合，并由此细化渐近遗憾常数、建立正则化最小二乘估计的中心极限定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小间隔区间正是最坏情况遗憾下界所对应的困难实例，LinUCB在此区间接近最优（至多相差对数因子）；而此前对其具体采样分配行为、遗憾常数精细刻画以及参数统计推断的理解仍不充分，作者希望将遗憾驱动的在线学习与信息高效的实验设计联系起来。

Method: 采用平均场（mean-field）视角，用随时间平均自适应决策效果的经验采样分布这一宏观对象刻画采样分配，并求其 $n\to\infty$ 的极限；分析该极限与D-最优设计集合的关系，并在此基础上推导渐近遗憾的首阶常数与估计量的极限分布。

Result: 证明在small-gap区域LinUCB诱导的经验采样分布收敛到D-最优设计集合；据此细化其渐近遗憾分析并刻画首阶常数；同时证明尽管采样自适应，正则化最小二乘估计在该区域仍满足中心极限型定理，可用于奖励参数的有效统计推断。

Conclusion: 小间隔区间下LinUCB不仅达到近似最优的极小极大遗憾，其采样分配对学习奖励参数也是渐近信息高效的，从而把遗憾驱动的在线学习与信息高效的实验设计连接起来，并为奖励参数提供有效统计推断。

Abstract: We study the sampling allocation of LinUCB in the small-gap regime, where the reward gaps are of order at most $n^{-1/2}$ over the decision horizon $n$. This scaling captures the hard instances underlying worst-case regret lower bounds, for which LinUCB is known to be near optimal up to logarithmic factors in $n$. Using a mean-field perspective, we characterize this allocation through the empirical sampling distribution, a macroscopic object that averages the effect of adaptive decisions over the horizon, and identify its limit as $n\to\infty$. We establish that in this regime, the empirical sampling distribution induced by LinUCB converges to the set of D-optimal designs. This central result reveals that, in the small-gap regime, LinUCB not only achieves near optimal minimax regret but also allocates samples in a way that is asymptotically efficient for learning the reward parameter, thereby connecting regret-driven online learning with information-efficient experimental design. Building on the optimal design limit, we obtain two useful consequences. First, we refine the asymptotic regret analysis of LinUCB in the small-gap regime by characterizing its leading-order constant in the limit. Second, we show that, despite LinUCB's adaptive sampling strategy, the regularized least-squares estimator satisfies a central-limit-type theorem in the small-gap regime, thereby enabling valid statistical inference for the reward parameter.

</details>


### [341] [LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06226)
*Benjamin Robson,Santeri Mentu,Wenshuai Zhao,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LeAVJEPA 首次将无崩溃的 LeJEPA 目标用于音视频编码器，用单一早期融合 ViT 处理音频、视频与联合输入，通过模态丢弃实现隐式跨模态对齐，在多项冻结与微调评测上取得良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往音视频自监督方法依赖 EMA 目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等复杂机制，架构冗余度高，本文希望以更简洁的目标实现有效的音视频对齐。

Method: 采用单个早期融合 Vision Transformer 处理音频、视频及联合音视频输入；将缺失模态视为同一事件的另一视图，通过模态丢弃使跨模态对齐隐含在目标中；对齐全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入，并用 SIGReg 防止表征崩溃；通过受控消融验证模态丢弃的关键作用。

Result: 冻结评估下在 AudioSet-20K 达 36.0 mAP，ESC-50 达 91.3% 准确率；微调后在 VGGSound 达 61.1% 准确率；其嵌入还支持零样本音视频检索。

Conclusion: 在无 EMA、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等复杂组件的简洁架构下，LeAVJEPA 仍能取得具竞争力的音视频表征，表明模态丢弃是实现跨模态对齐的核心机制，为音视频自监督学习提供了更简化的方案。

Abstract: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

</details>


### [342] [SO(3)-RoPE for Spherical Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06229)
*Christian Libner,Chase van de Geijn,Alexander S. Ecker,Maurice Weiler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SO(3)-RoPE相对位置编码，将球面几何通过SO(3)酉表示引入Transformer注意力，构建SO(3)等变的SO3ViT，在旋转球面浅水动力学预测中精度更高、运行时间更短。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球面数据在科学计算中广泛存在，但现有球面Transformer常忽略球面域的内禀几何，导致扭曲以及在极点附近出现坐标奇异性。因此需要一种既尊重球面几何又能保持Transformer效率的位置编码方法。

Method: 提出SO(3)-RoPE，一种相对位置编码，通过酉SO(3)表示将球面几何融入Transformer注意力机制。该形式具有SO(3)等变性，并与FlashAttention兼容，从而保留原始Transformer的计算效率。基于此构建了SO3ViT模型。

Result: 在旋转球面上的浅水动力学预测任务中，SO3ViT优于S2Transformer基线，误差更低且运行时间减少。

Conclusion: SO(3)-RoPE能够在保持Transformer效率的同时有效编码球面几何与等变性质，为球面数据建模提供了更优方案。

Abstract: Spherical data arise in many scientific applications. Often spherical transformers disregard the geometry of the underlying spherical domain, causing distortions and coordinate singularities near the poles. We introduce SO(3)-RoPE, a relative positional embedding that incorporates spherical geometry into transformer attention through unitary SO(3) representations. Our formulation is SO(3)-equivariant and compatible with FlashAttention, retaining efficiency of vanilla transformers. On shallow water dynamics prediction over a rotating sphere, our SO3ViT outperforms an S2Transformer baseline with lower errors and reduced runtime.

</details>


### [343] [Parameter Estimation in Machining Dynamics with Regenerative Delay and Nonsmooth Friction using Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06230)
*Meiyazhagan Jaganathan,Vikram Pakrashi,Aasifa Rounak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多域扩展物理信息神经网络(XPINN)框架求解非光滑时滞微分方程(DDEs)，首次按时滞整数倍划分子域并渐进训练，在切削动力学模型上验证优于通用PINN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非光滑时滞微分方程(DDEs)存在非光滑性与大时滞，通用PINN(SPINN)难以准确重构解与估计参数，尤其在大时间域和非恒定历史函数情形下表现不佳。

Method: 构建多域XPINN框架，将时间域按时滞特征时间的整数倍划分为多个子域，各子域配属子网络并渐进训练，同时冻结已学参数；采用含再生效应与非光滑摩擦效应的切削动力学模型验证，并用含高斯测量噪声的参考数据评估逆问题XPINN(I-XPINN)的鲁棒性。

Result: 相比通用SPINN，所提框架在DDEs解重构与参数估计上更优；在大时间域和非恒定历史函数下表现尤佳；I-XPINN对测量噪声具有鲁棒性，物理约束引导网络准确恢复潜在动力学。

Conclusion: 首次证明该框架可对具有非光滑性和大时滞的DDEs进行可靠参数辨识，彰显其在含非光滑、大时滞动力系统建模与反演中的潜力。

Abstract: A multi-domain eXtended Physics-Informed Neural Network (XPINN) framework is developed for nonsmooth Delay Differential Equations (DDEs). This is the first implementation to demonstrate the efficacy of partitioning the temporal domain into subdomains of integer multiples of the characteristic time delay and progressively training the associated subnetworks while freezing previously learned parameters. The efficacy of the proposed framework is demonstrated using a machining dynamics model that incorporates both regenerative and nonsmooth frictional effects. Results demonstrate that the proposed multi-domain XPINN framework leads to better solution reconstruction in DDEs and improved parameter estimation compared to a generic PINN (SPINN) formulation. The proposed method works particularly well for extended temporal domains and non-constant history functions. The robustness of inverse XPINN (I-XPINN) is also assessed using reference data contaminated with Gaussian measurement noise. Results indicate that I-XPINN remains resilient to measurement noise and the physics-informed constraints guide the network toward accurately recovering the underlying dynamics. This demonstrates, for the first time, the potential of the proposed framework for reliable parameter identification in DDEs characterised by nonsmoothness and large time delays.

</details>


### [344] [Certification-Enhanced Generalization Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06238)
*Leo Elmecker-Plakolm,Matthew Wicker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将算法稳定性视为可验证的规范，利用可达性分析为学习算法提供紧致且可靠的泛化界，并开发新的集中不等式连接样本特定稳定性与分布泛化，在从玩具数据集到大型语言模型微调的多种规模上取得比现有方法紧致数个数量级的正式保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的算法稳定性分析在推导泛化界时往往依赖严格的分析假设，导致结果受限甚至空洞。作者希望借助形式化方法，在不依赖分析假设的前提下，获得紧致且可靠的泛化界，从而扩展既有泛化界理论的适用范围并提升其实用性。

Method: 作者将算法稳定性重新表述为待验证的规范，利用最近的可达性分析技术对给定模型和算法在样本数据集上计算可证明的泛化界。由于样本特定的算法稳定性不足以约束通常的分布泛化概念，作者提出一种新的集中不等式，将形式化认证算法的样本特定结果与期望泛化间隙的分布分析相连接。该方法在常数次算法运行中计算期望泛化间隙的可靠界，且不对算法作任何分析性假设；要获得非空洞的界，仅需认证的可达参数集有界，而这一条件并非假设，而是通过形式化验证得到的。

Result: 实验表明，该框架提供的正式泛化保证比其它可靠的数值方法紧致数个数量级，适用范围涵盖从玩具数据集到在现代大型语言模型之上微调分类头的任务。作者还实现了若干著名稳定性结果的形式化认证增强版本。

Conclusion: 该工作表明形式化方法可为学习算法提供紧致、可靠的泛化界，且具有跨规模的实际可行性；未来扩展有望进一步收紧界并促进其在现代泛化界谱系中的实际应用。

Abstract: We investigate the use of formal methods to provide tight and sound generalization bounds for learning algorithms. By casting the traditional notion of algorithmic stability as a specification to be verified, we demonstrate that recent advances in reachability analysis can yield provable bounds on the generalization of a given model and algorithm on a sample dataset. As sample-specific algorithmic stability is insufficient to bound the usual distributional notion of generalization, we develop a novel concentration inequality to connect the sample-specific results of formal certification algorithms to the required distributional analysis for bounding the expected generalization gap. The resulting framework enables the analysis of prior generalization bounds to extend far beyond their original restrictive assumptions. Our approach computes sound bounds on the expected generalization gap in a constant number of algorithm runs without making any analytical assumptions on the algorithm; to achieve non-vacuous bounds we only require that the certified reachable parameter set is bounded --- a condition that we do not assume but formally verify. In practice, we demonstrate that our framework provides formal generalization guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter than alternative sound computational approaches at scales ranging from toy datasets to fine-tuning classification heads on top of modern large language models. While we implement certification-enhanced versions of several well-known stability results, future extensions of our approach will enable tighter bounds and enhanced practical adoption across the spectrum of modern generalization bounds.

</details>


### [345] [Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06241)
*Guilherme Silva,Pedro Silva,Gladston Moreira,Eduardo Luz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出仅原型头部自适应方法，用于TinyML心电设备个性化，无需反向传播即可在单片机上高效实现患者特异分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴与床旁心电监护需适配患者个体形态以维持心律失常检测精度，但现有离线个性化无法应对个体生理、电极位置与记录漂移，而在微控制器类医疗设备上做反向传播式在线自适应成本过高。

Method: 离线在MIT-BIH数据库按患者间协议训练1-D CNN（1314参数、每搏72.6k MAC），冻结为特征提取器并部署到PSoC 6；个性化仅计算32维嵌入空间的闭式类均值，无需卷积反向传播、迭代优化，每个支持搏仅一次前向。

Result: 1/5/10-shot下患者间宏F1由0.635/0.639/0.646提升至0.731/0.771/0.797，各shot数均优于线性SGD头部微调；PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F上18个one-shot片段设备端回放宏F1为0.798与主机一致，每搏11.39 ms、5.2 KB flash、22.2 KB SRAM；仅用被动缓存窦性搏更新正常类原型的受限变体获得稳定+0.05宏F1增益。

Conclusion: 仅原型头部自适应是面向TinyML心电系统的紧凑个性化原语，在极低资源下实现有效患者适配并降低标注负担。

Abstract: Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial

</details>


### [346] [RoSA: Rotational Sparse Adaptation for Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06243)
*Muhammad Azeem Lodhi,Chao Zhou,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoSA（Rotational Sparse Adaptation），一种在训练中逐步冻结靠近输入的层、并轮换可训练层块的微调策略，能降低优化器状态内存、缩短反向传播，同时保持较强微调性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数高效微调（PEFT）通过只训练少量参数来降低基础模型适配成本。本文希望在此基础上进一步减少适配范围，从"参数维度"转向"层维度"来压缩训练开销。

Method: RoSA 在训练全程冻结靠近输入的底层，并在后续层上轮换一个可训练层块，逐步增加靠近输入的冻结层数。该设计减少优化器状态内存、缩短反向传播；若缓存最后一个冻结层的激活，还可缩短前向传播。由于与可训练参数化方式正交，RoSA 可在每个活跃块内与 PEFT 方法或稀疏优化器结合使用。

Result: 在多种 LLM 架构和任务上的实验表明，RoSA 降低了峰值内存，同时保持了较强的微调性能。

Conclusion: RoSA 通过轮换式层冻结提供了一种与现有 PEFT 方法互补的高效微调思路，在内存效率和性能之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting foundation models by focusing training on a small parameter subset. Complementary to this idea, we introduce RoSA (Rotational Sparse Adaptation), which narrows adaptation to a subset of layers at a time. RoSA freezes lower layers close to the input throughout training and rotates a trainable block over later layers, progressively increasing the number of frozen layers close to the input. This design reduces optimizer-state memory, shortens backpropagation, and even forward propagation if activations at the last frozen layer are cached. Because RoSA is orthogonal to the choice of trainable parameterization, it can be combined with PEFT methods or sparse optimizers within each active block. Experiments across multiple LLM architectures and tasks show that RoSA reduces peak memory while maintaining strong fine-tuning performance.

</details>


### [347] [Constrained Goal-directed Planar Graph Generation with Grammar-based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06244)
*Nicolas Hochuli,Lorenzo Miele,Kristina Shea,Tino Stankovic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需数据集的平面图嵌入生成方法，结合参数化图文法与安全强化学习，在生成过程中满足硬性结构与几何可行性约束，并优化任务特定目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面图在科学与工程中应用广泛，但现有生成器对硬性结构/几何可行性约束下的目标导向生成支持有限，且经典生成器与深度生成模型往往缺乏目标导向控制或约束满足较弱。

Method: 将生成过程建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，由图文法定义状态与动作空间；结合参数化图文法与安全强化学习；引入动作投影，将采样动作映射到状态相关的安全集，以提升训练中的约束满足。

Result: 在所有基准任务上，该方法持续优于基线方法，同时满足所设定的约束；并提出了一个面向约束与目标导向的平面图生成基准套件及经典与深度生成基线。

Conclusion: 该方法可在生成过程中直接构造可行的平面图嵌入，实现了约束满足与目标导向优化，并提供了相应基准，性能优于现有基线。

Abstract: Planar graphs are central to applications across science and engineering, yet existing generators provide limited support for goal-directed generation under hard structural and geometric feasibility constraints. We propose a dataset-free method for generating planar graph embeddings by combining parametric graph grammars with safe reinforcement learning to optimize generic task-specific objectives while satisfying constraints during construction. We formulate the generation process as a constrained Markov decision process, where the graph grammar defines the state and action spaces. We further introduce an action projection that maps sampled actions toward state-dependent safe sets, improving constraint satisfaction during training. In contrast to classical graph generators and deep generative models, which typically offer limited goal-directed control or rely on weak constraint satisfaction, our method constructs feasible planar graph embeddings directly during generation. We also introduce a benchmark suite for constrained and goal-directed planar graph generation, together with classical and deep generative baselines. Across all benchmark tasks, our method consistently outperforms baselines while satisfying the formulated constraints.

</details>


### [348] [Generative World Models Enable Predictive Control of Laser Melt Pool Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06250)
*Yiyang Yan,Markus Bambach,Mohamadreza Afrasiabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向激光熔池的生成式世界模型，能预测候选动作下熔池演化，并可微分化用作预测控制对象，通过梯度优化激光调度并蒸馏为单次前向传播的摊销策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将世界模型引入制造领域，可在高保真仿真难以达到的时间尺度上支持工艺决策；针对局部高动态激光熔池，需在瞬态激光输入下实现准确的递归预测与控制。

Method: 构建生成式世界模型，从温度与相形貌历史预测候选动作下的熔池演化；以生成式潜动力学刻画未解析熔流效应；利用可微动力学作为预测控制对象，通过想象未来的梯度优化激光调度，并蒸馏为摊销策略以实现单次前向控制。

Result: 在瞬态激光输入下，模型递归展开比确定性回归器更准确；优化后的激光调度可在未见过的几何、路径与初始化条件下调节熔池深度；摊销策略实现单次前向传播输出控制动作。

Conclusion: 该工作给出面向制造的生成式世界模型控制概念验证，展示可微世界模型用于预测控制与机载实时部署的可行性。

Abstract: World models, which learn how environments respond to actions, are emerging as a powerful paradigm for planning through imagined futures, transforming decision-making across games, robotics and autonomous driving. Bringing this capability to manufacturing could enable process decisions on timescales inaccessible to high-fidelity simulation. Here we introduce a generative world model for localized highly dynamic laser melt pool that predicts evolution from histories of temperature and phase morphology under candidate actions. Its generative latent dynamics capture the effects of unresolved melt flow, enabling more accurate recursive rollouts than deterministic regressors under transient laser inputs. Because the learned dynamics are differentiable, the model can serve directly as a predictive control plant. Gradients through imagined futures optimize laser schedules that regulate melt-pool depth over previously unseen geometry, path, initialization. We further distil this optimization into an amortized policy that produces control actions in a single forward pass, providing a proof of concept for real deployment on machines.

</details>


### [349] [Lipschitz Thinking: Ten Years of Certifiable-by-Design Robust Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06252)
*Fabio Brau,Giorgio Piras,Maura Pintor,Battista Biggio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于Lipschitz有界神经网络的教程，介绍其基本概念、约束层原理、边界实现机制，以及如何通过一次前向传播获得鲁棒性证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络对输入扰动敏感，而Lipschitz性质可直接度量这种敏感性；若能显式控制Lipschitz常数，就能以有原则的方式限制误差传播并提升鲁棒性。过去十年间，Lipschitz有界层被引入越来越具表现力且性能更强的深度模型，逐步缩小了经验鲁棒性与形式化、设计即保证的稳定性之间的差距。

Method: 本文采用教程形式，系统介绍Lipschitz有界神经网络的基础概念，阐述Lipschitz约束层背后的原理、用于施加其边界的机制，以及这些机制如何以仅需一次前向传播的代价提供鲁棒性证书（robustness certificates）。

Result: 该教程整合了Lipschitz有界层的理论基础与实现机制，说明其在可控成本下（单次前向传播）即可获得形式化鲁棒性保证，并展示了该方法在表达力与性能上的持续进步。

Conclusion: 文章最后讨论了新兴与开放的研究方向，强调Lipschitz控制可作为提供"设计即保证"稳定性的通用框架。

Abstract: The Lipschitz property of a deep neural network provides a direct measure of its sensitivity to input perturbations and, when explicitly controlled, offers a principled way to limit the propagation of errors and improve robustness. Over the past decade, Lipschitz-bounded layers have been incorporated into increasingly expressive and high-performing deep models, narrowing the gap between empirical robustness and formal, by-design guarantees of stability. This article introduces the fundamental concepts underlying Lipschitz-bounded neural networks, explaining the principles behind Lipschitz-constrained layers, the mechanisms used to enforce their bounds, and how they yield robustness certificates at the cost of a single forward pass. The tutorial concludes by discussing emerging and open directions, highlighting Lipschitz control as a general framework for offering guaranteed, by-design stability.

</details>


### [350] [SimAuthor: Harnessing Foundation Models for Persistent Scientific Simulator Authoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06257)
*Yishan Wang,Ran Piao,Mathias Funk,Aaqib Saeed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SimAuthor，一种面向"弱经验反馈"下科学模拟器编写的持久化修订框架，在六项生物医学信号任务上优于 PUCT 分数搜索与文本策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型虽能生成科学代码，但编写科学模拟器（编码机制假设的可执行程序）需要迭代精炼；科学充分性通常没有唯一实现或精确检验，模拟器只能对照有限真实观测来评判，因此需要研究这种弱经验反馈下的模拟器编写问题，且目标对象是模拟器本身而非仅其生成样本。

Method: 提出 SimAuthor：一个持久化编写框架，保留并修订可执行模拟器，将标量搜索分数与结构化差异反馈相分离，并累积可复用的实现机制。评估覆盖六项生物医学任务，涉及心音与呼吸音、PPG 与 ECG，在固定 100 次尝试预算下与 PUCT 分数搜索、文本策略优化进行对比。

Result: 在固定 100 次尝试预算下，SimAuthor 在全部六项任务上优于 PUCT 分数搜索，总体优于文本策略优化，并在六项中的五项取得最高终点分数；编写的模拟器在未见录音上也有提升，可迁移至独立预训练表征，并在下游 ECG 分类中带来显著的分布外增益；在审计的 138 次修订中，有 111 次改变了程序结构，贡献了 86.1% 的带符号分数提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，持久化修订能够从有限的实证证据中，逐步将基础模型知识转化为更优的可执行科学模拟器。

Abstract: Foundation models can generate scientific code, but authoring a scientific simulator (an executable program encoding hypotheses about how mechanisms generate observable signals) requires iterative refinement. Scientific adequacy rarely admits a unique implementation or exact test, so simulators must instead be judged against limited real observations. We study this setting as scientific simulator authoring under weak empirical feedback, where distributional comparisons between simulated and real signals guide revision, and the target is the simulator itself rather than only its generated samples. We introduce SimAuthor, a persistent authoring harness that retains and revises executable simulators, separates scalar search scores from structured discrepancy feedback, and accumulates reusable implementation mechanisms. We evaluate SimAuthor on six biomedical tasks spanning cardiac and respiratory audio, photoplethysmography (PPG), and electrocardiography (ECG). Under a fixed 100-attempt budget, SimAuthor outperforms PUCT score search on all six tasks, generally outperforms textual-strategy optimization, and achieves the highest endpoint score on five of six. The authored simulators also improve on unseen recordings, transfer to independent pretrained representations, and yield substantial out-of-distribution gains in downstream ECG classification. Finally, 111 of 138 audited revisions alter program structure and account for 86.1% of the signed score improvement. These results suggest that persistent revision can progressively convert foundation-model knowledge into better executable scientific simulators from limited empirical evidence.

</details>


### [351] [OCL-PDE: A Generative Framework for PDE Inverse Problems with Observation-Complementary Latents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06259)
*Ding Yang,Chuqi Chen,Chang Ma,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对PDE反问题的病态性与细节难恢复问题，提出学习"观测互补"的隐表示，并构建OCL-PDE生成框架，在反演重建与前向预测上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE反问题通常病态，观测信息有限，导致细尺度细节难以恢复。作者希望分离并补足观测中缺失的细粒度信息，从而在保持大尺度结构的同时提升细节重建质量。

Method: 引入一种学习得到的"观测互补隐表示"，使其保留与重建相关的信息并与观测结合以重建未知场。在此表示基础上提出OCL-PDE生成框架：让观测引导大尺度结构，隐表示提供互补的细尺度细节。框架基于物理感知自编码器（physics-aware AE）与条件Flow Matching，同时支持反演重建与前向PDE预测。

Result: 实验表明，与所评估的基线方法相比，OCL-PDE在重建精度和细粒度细节恢复方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过学习观测互补的隐表示并采用生成式条件建模，可有效缓解PDE反问题的病态性，实现更好的细尺度细节恢复，并能统一支持反演与前向预测任务。

Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems are often ill-posed, making fine-scale details difficult to recover. We address this problem by introducing a learned observation-complementary latent representation that preserves reconstruction-relevant information and is combined with the observation to reconstruct the unknown field. Building on this representation, we propose OCL-PDE, a generative framework that encourages the observation to guide large-scale structure and the latent to supply complementary fine-scale details. OCL-PDE is built on a physics-aware autoencoder (AE) and conditional Flow Matching, supporting inverse reconstruction as well as forward PDE prediction. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and fine-detail recovery compared with the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [352] [Ramp Metering Control via Hybrid State Deep Reinforcement Learning in Partially Observable Connected Vehicle Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06266)
*Youcef Mehamlia,Nadir Farhi,Meriem Bouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出融合宏观交通测量与双通道（连通车存在性、速度）网格编码的混合观测表示，用Dueling Double DQN学习匝道控制绿灯时长，在部分连通车可见度下显著优于ALINEA与仅宏观DRL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速公路匝道合流是拥堵的主要来源，带来显著经济与环境成本。现有DRL匝道控制方法主要依赖聚合的宏观数据，而连通车虽能提供车辆级观测，却因渗透率有限而微观信息不完整。作者希望利用宏观与稀疏微观观测的互补性来提升学习型匝道控制的性能。

Method: 提出混合观测表示：宏观交通测量 + 双通道网格编码（编码连通车是否存在及其速度）。采用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network处理该输入，输出匝道控制的绿灯时长。在不同交通需求与连通车渗透率下训练控制器，并在SUMO中与ALINEA、仅宏观DRL变体进行对比评估。

Result: 在50个匹配评估场景中，部分连通车可见度下混合控制器相比ALINEA将报告的总行程时间降低11.4%，平均排队溢出持续时间降低84.9%。在完全连通车可见度下评估同一策略，行程时间进一步降低约1.6%。跨渗透率分析表明，随着微观观测更完整，性能差距逐渐缩小。

Conclusion: 结果支持将互补的宏观观测与稀疏微观观测结合用于学习型匝道控制。源代码已开源于GitHub。

Abstract: Freeway on-ramp merges are major sources of congestion, causing significant economic and environmental costs. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a promising solution for ramp metering, existing approaches rely primarily on aggregated macroscopic data. Connected vehicles (CVs) provide vehicle-level observations that can complement aggregate traffic measurements, but their limited penetration produces incomplete microscopic information. This paper proposes a hybrid observation representation combining macroscopic traffic measurements with a two-channel grid encoding observed CV presence and speed. A Dueling Double Deep Q-Network processes these inputs to select ramp-metering green durations. The controller is trained under varying traffic demands and CV penetration rates and evaluated against ALINEA and macroscopic-only DRL variants in SUMO. Across 50 matched evaluation scenarios, the hybrid controller under partial CV visibility reduces the reported total travel time by 11.4 % and mean spillback duration by 84.9 % relative to ALINEA. Evaluating the same trained policy with full CV visibility yields a further travel-time reduction of approximately 1.6 %. Analysis across penetration rates suggests that the performance gap decreases as microscopic observations become more complete. These results support the use of complementary macroscopic and sparse microscopic observations for learning-based ramp metering. The source code implementation of the model is available at: https://github.com/youcefMehamlia/Multimodal-DRL-RMC

</details>


### [353] [What May an Agent Change About Itself? A Containment Floor for Self-Configuring Agent Runtimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06274)
*Sajib Hossain,Moeen Uddin Mahmud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究部署式、模型无关的智能体运行时中，智能体可通过配置工具修改自身限制（如可写目录、消息来源、监听地址、认证方式、风险写入闸门）从而自我扩权的风险，并提出并验证"能力字段可改、限制字段永不可改"的遏制底线规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多智能体运行时会向智能体提供编辑自身配置的工具，其中部分配置赋予能力（如启用某工具），而另一部分设定智能体的界限（可写目录、消息来源、监听网络地址、调用方认证方式、风险写入闸门）。若智能体可编辑这些界限，一次普通请求就可能把界限放宽。作者希望研究这一安全风险，并寻找一种不依赖模型的通用防护方式。

Method: 在已部署、模型无关的运行时中，作者提出规则"智能体可修改赋予能力的字段，但绝不可修改设定其界限的字段"，并将该规则作为遏制底线强制实施在配置工具内部。随后以有无该底线进行对照测量，并对比系统提示形式的禁止（列出受保护字段名的提示 vs 描述禁止效果的提示），同时对工具的其他绕过路径进行搜索。

Result: 无底线时，前沿模型在72次赋予改设置权限的普通请求中有25次写入了受保护值，且请求往往并未点名该字段。系统提示形式的禁止以可预测的方式失败：列出受保护字段名的提示能拦住所有使用这些字段名的请求（36次中0次得逞，无提示时为17/36），但拦不住仅描述目标的请求（36次中10次得逞 vs 无提示8次）；描述禁止效果的提示则效果相反。加入底线后，167次受保护写入中0次得逞，尽管模型在其中65次曾尝试写入。搜索其他绕过路径仅发现一条（固定 shell），而该路径已被底线的作用域声明排除。

Conclusion: 在配置工具内部设置"限制字段不可改"的遏制底线，可有效阻止智能体的自我扩权写入，优于依赖系统提示的禁止策略。研究覆盖两个模型与单一智能体，作者明确说明了该结论支持与不支持的范围。

Abstract: Many agent runtimes give the agent a tool for editing its own configuration. Some of that configuration grants abilities, such as enabling a tool. Other parts set the agent's limits: which directories it may write to, who may send it messages, which network address it listens on, how callers authenticate, and the gate that blocks risky writes. If the agent can edit those limits, a single ordinary request can widen them. We study this in a deployed, model-agnostic runtime.
