We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.

</details>


### [390] [What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06666)
*Yassine Ouali,Adrian Bulat,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出隐性推理应满足五个要求（有用、多样、可解释、可随计算量精化、高效），认为流匹配（flow matching）最有希望满足这些要求，并给出 FLaRe 配方，在五项要求及算术基准上均优于已有隐性方法，以四分之一延迟达到显式CoT的97%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为有效的隐性思维（latent thought）必须满足五项要求：有用（真正帮助产生正确答案而非仅改变答案）、多样（重采样产生不同推理轨迹）、可解释（解码出的思维链反映答案实际遵循的推理）、可精化（随推理计算量增加而改进）、高效（在相近准确率下成本低于显式思维链）。现有方法往往只学到问题到答案的捷径、把显式CoT蒸馏进权重、或逐token模仿，难以同时满足这些要求。

Method: 作者聚焦于在学习到的隐空间中进行流匹配（flow matching），并识别出使其有效训练的关键选择，提出 Flow-based Latent Reasoning（FLaRe）配方，涵盖：隐空间编码什么内容、如何塑造该空间、在何处训练流、如何读出答案，以及最后一个阶段——在模型自己验证过的思维（verified thoughts）上进行训练。

Result: 针对每项要求设计的探针（probe）显示，FLaRe 在全部五项要求上都优于先前的隐性方法；在算术基准上也表现更优，同时以四分之一延迟达到显式CoT准确率的97%。

Conclusion: 有效的隐性推理需要同时满足有用、多样、可解释、可精化和高效五项要求，流匹配是满足这些要求的最佳候选族；FLaRe 通过一套简单的训练配方设计实现了这一点，在隐性推理质量与效率之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

</details>


### [391] [Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06671)
*Juan Garcia Giraldo,Matteo Santelmo,Eduard Durech,Imanol Schlag,Valentina Pyatkin,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出熵感知混合（Entropy-Aware Mixing），按学生预测熵动态逐token插值师生分布，缓解学生模仿分布外推理轨迹时的"自信冲突"，稳定蒸馏并兼顾域内外数学推理与通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小模型常以更强教师的推理轨迹进行后训练以高效学习新技能，但token级模仿落在学生预期分布之外的轨迹时会产生"自信冲突"：学生虽处于低熵状态、对另一续写高度自信，却被要求模仿它认为低概率的续写。这会损害泛化能力并导致灾难性遗忘。

Method: 提出熵感知混合：以学生预测熵为门控，对学生与教师分布做逐token动态插值。实现了凸插值与几何插值两种形式，并应用于两种场景——离线轨迹生成（经推测解码后再SFT）与在策略前向KL蒸馏。

Result: 熵感知混合能稳定蒸馏，在分布内与分布外数学推理上均有提升，且比固定教师监督更好地保留通用能力。但最优熵调度依赖于训练来源：离线生成的轨迹偏好凹形调度（整体教师影响更大），而在策略训练偏好线性或凸形调度（教师影响集中在高熵状态）。

Conclusion: 通过以学生熵为门控的师生分布插值可有效缓解自信冲突、稳定蒸馏并兼顾推理与通用能力；且应根据训练来源（离线轨迹生成 vs. 在策略蒸馏）选择相应熵调度，凹形适合离线，线性/凸形适合在策略。

Abstract: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).

</details>


### [392] [Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06674)
*Srija Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种联合Black Marble M波段与昼夜波段(DNB)信号的机器学习框架，构建跨区域、跨季节、跨异常类别的集成异常检测器，提升夜间灯光异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有夜间灯光异常检测方法主要依赖热红外波段，对较弱信号的敏感性不足。NASA Black Marble产品同时包含热辐射与可见光/近红外信号，但尚未被充分利用，因此需要一种能联合多波段、具有时空泛化能力的检测框架。

Method: 构建一个新颖的机器学习框架，联合建模Black Marble的M波段与昼夜波段(DNB)信号，迭代式地构建多个检测器，形成泛化的、时空稳健的集成异常检测器。该集成可跨区域、跨季节、跨异常类别扩展，并覆盖陆地与海洋。基于相关波段及检测器一致性，生成不同置信度水平的检测结果集合。

Result: 相比现有方法，该框架提高了真实检测率(true detection rate)，同时减少了虚假检测(spurious detections)，并在自然 hazard 监测与能源开采等应用中展现出较强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 联合M波段与DNB的机器学习集成方法可有效提升夜间灯光异常检测的灵敏度与稳健性，具备跨区域、跨季节、海陆通用的泛化能力，可应用于自然灾害监测与能源开采等场景。

Abstract: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

</details>


### [393] [Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06675)
*Xiaochuan Gong,Ang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了在线性可分数据上使用大常数步长的梯度下降（GD）训练逻辑回归的收敛速度。作者证明了在任意维度下，GD 以大步长 η=1/ε 能在 O(ln^p(1/ε)) 步内达到损失 ε，其中 p 仅依赖于数据的间隔（margin）和秩（rank）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的分析表明，采用激进步长时 GD 达到损失 ε 的加速率为 Õ(1/√ε)，但损失可能初始振荡。对振荡动态的更紧控制此前仅限于二维数据。作者希望将更快的收敛率推广到任意维度。

Method: 作者将 GD 的振荡阶段拆分为递归嵌套的区间。数据的 margin 和 rank 限定了嵌套深度，并通过计数论证限制每一深度的区间数量，二者结合共同给出多项式对数（polylogarithmic）的步数复杂度。证明还改进了 GD 从振荡阶段过渡到稳定阶段的过渡时间界。

Result: 在任意维度下，GD 以大步长 η=1/ε 能在 O(ln^p(1/ε)) 步内达到损失 ε，其中 p 仅依赖于 margin 和数据的秩。相比已有的 Õ(1/√ε) 速率有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在任意维度上大步长 GD 训练逻辑回归具有多项对数级别的步数复杂度，并改进了一直以来仅在二维情形下才有的对振荡动态的更紧控制。

Abstract: We study gradient descent (GD) with a large constant stepsize for logistic regression on linearly separable data. Existing analysis shows an accelerated rate of $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrtε)$ to reach loss $ε$ with an aggressive stepsize, although the loss may initially oscillate. Tighter control of the oscillatory dynamics has been available only for two-dimensional data. We prove a substantially faster rate in arbitrary dimension: GD with a large stepsize $η=1/ε$ reaches loss $ε$ within $O(\ln^{p}(1/ε))$ steps, where $p$ depends only on the margin and the rank of the data. Our proof improves the bound on the transition time of GD from the oscillatory to the stable phase, after which the loss decreases monotonically. We split the oscillatory phase into recursively nested intervals. The margin and the rank bound the nesting depth, and a counting argument bounds the number of intervals at each depth, together yielding the polylogarithmic step complexity.

</details>


### [394] [How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06677)
*Tomás Brogueira,Marcos Treviso,Miguel Couceiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏概率映射（entmax、sparsemax、normmax）在MoE路由器中的稀疏性在训练后是否存活，发现路由分数与概率映射会协同适应，映射自身的置零能力并不能决定专家参与度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE路由器通常用softmax加top-K，每个token固定使用K个专家。sparsemax、entmax、normmax等稀疏映射理论上可自适应置零、实现随token变化的专家参与，但作者想探究这种稀疏性在训练后是否以及如何存活，从而理解自适应路由的实际机制。

Method: 训练匹配的300M和1B规模top-2 MoE语言模型，分别使用softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax和2-normmax四种概率映射，对比训练后的概率质量分配、专家参与度、分数分布与top-2分数间隙，并测试推理时改变K的敏感度。

Result: 在1B规模下，entmax丢弃的概率质量比softmax少30%却几乎从不丢弃已选专家；sparsemax保留最多质量；normmax把21%的token路由到单一专家。每个映射只有当选中的两个最大分数间隙达到固定阈值时才丢弃专家，且entmax路由器学到的分数分布宽度约为softmax的一半。稀疏映射均未改善验证损失，但使模型对推理时增加专家数远不敏感：sparsemax在K=2训练、K=8推理时仅损失0.02 nats，而softmax损失0.58 nats。

Conclusion: 路由分数会与概率映射协同适应，映射产生零的能力本身并不能决定专家参与度。自适应MoE路由设计必须围绕概率映射与所学分数的联合行为，而非仅围绕映射本身。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.

</details>


### [395] [Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06679)
*Yoel Zeldes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出激活对齐方法，用完整上下文训练轻量线性变换，使仅用部分上下文的学生模型接近完整上下文教师模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习预测，需在每次前向传播中处理全部训练样本，推理成本高；而限制样本数量虽降低成本却显著损害性能。

Method: 不丢弃上下文，而是在合成无标签数据上训练轻量线性变换（对齐器），将数据受限的"学生"（使用部分上下文）的中间激活映射到"完整上下文教师"（使用全部数据）的激活上。对齐器训练无需GPU，在普通硬件上数秒至数分钟收敛。

Result: 在TabArena基准的38个分类数据集上，使用TabPFN-3和TabFM两个领先表格基础模型评估。在所有上下文预算下，对齐后的学生模型相比未对齐基线均有广泛且统计显著的提升；在低数据场景下，对齐恢复了教师预测优势的近一半。

Conclusion: 该方法为在达到紧凑上下文的推理速度的同时，缩小与完整上下文教师之间相当一部分性能差距，提供了一种实用、低开销的途径。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

</details>


### [396] [Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06685)
*Jiawen Du,Arshan Ali Khan,Chenhao Zhang,Zachary Plotkin,Li Shen,Qi Long,Yun Li,Can Chen,Tianlong Chen,Nicholas Konz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MM-KG（多模态知识图谱），将多模态患者证据与生物医学知识表示为同一类型化图中的两个独立层，用显式对齐边连接，使临床问答的推理链可检索、可追溯、可消融检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床问题往往需要把患者的多模态证据与外部生物医学知识联系起来，但现有预测系统很少显式表示这种联系，因此既无法追溯到证据来源，也无法通过删除来测量各部分的贡献。

Method: 构建单张类型化图，患者观测与生物医学概念分层存放并以对齐边相连。流程包括：（1）模态专用协调器，把 EHR 文本、影像、基因组、生物样本数据转成映射到 UMLS 概念的类型化观测；（2）路由优先级对齐器，将观测链接到生物医学知识图谱；（3）查询条件化检索，为 LLM 或 GNN 选出紧凑子图。在 MIMIC-IV 与 ADNI 上构建 MM-KG，并用 2x2 设计分离患者证据、生物医学知识及其交互作用。

Result: 在需要两类信息的问题上，单靠任一来源都远高于随机水平有限，而二者结合得到药物受控 AUROC 交互效应：MIMIC 上 +0.194，ADNI 上 +0.299。在五候选留出排序中，MM-KG 比 MindMap 高 +0.131 Hits@1，并在需查阅患者的题目上优于改造后的 GraphCare；从检索包中删除唯一承载答案的关系后，Hits@1 回落到无知识基线。查询条件化检索以 6.8 倍更少上下文达到 0.731 AUROC，而静态知识图谱上下文在普通结局预测上没有一致增益。

Conclusion: 知识图谱对临床大模型的价值不在于背景上下文，而在于显式连接多模态患者证据与问题所需的关系；MM-KG 使这些链接可检索、可追溯、可检验。

Abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.

</details>


### [397] [OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06686)
*Ashkan Shahbazi,Chayne Thrash,Soheil Kolouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OVAL-KV，一种输出感知的页编码方法，用于长上下文推理中的页稀疏注意力，在保持与仅键谱表示相同存储和解码评分成本的前提下提升检索质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中，KV 缓存不断增大导致注意力计算成本高昂。页稀疏注意力通过紧凑表示每个 KV 页并仅检索子集来降低成本，但现有检索方法仅估计注意力分数或页相关性，其目标未直接考虑近似误差如何影响最终的值加权注意力输出。

Method: 提出 OVAL-KV：一种基于键和值联合结构的输出感知页编码，同时保留准确检索所需的键信息。该方法无需训练，推理时也不需要额外的依赖值的统计量；构建后的存储表示在大小与解码时评分成本上与仅键谱表示相同。

Result: 在长推理、长上下文理解和长生成基准上，OVAL-KV 一致优于仅键谱基线，并与近期 KV 缓存压缩与检索方法表现相当。在长推理基准上跨模型-基准对取得较强的 avg@k 性能，并在多个长上下文理解与生成场景中匹配或超越领先基线，解码开销适中。

Conclusion: OVAL-KV 通过输出感知的页编码，在不增加存储与评分成本的情况下有效提升页稀疏注意力的检索质量，为长上下文推理提供了一种免训练且实用的方案。

Abstract: Long context inference with large language models becomes increasingly expensive as attention must operate over an ever growing KV cache. Page sparse attention reduces this cost by representing each KV page compactly and retrieving only a subset for each query. Existing retrieval methods are designed to estimate attention scores or page relevance, but their objectives do not directly account for how approximation errors affect the resulting value weighted attention output. We introduce \method{}, an output aware page encoding derived from the joint structure of keys and values while preserving the key information needed for accurate retrieval. \method{} is training free and requires no additional value dependent statistics at inference time. Once constructed, its stored representation has the same size and decode time scoring cost as a key only spectral representation. Across long reasoning, long context understanding, and long generation benchmarks, \method{} consistently improves over the key only spectral baseline and performs competitively with recent KV cache compression and retrieval methods. On long reasoning benchmarks, it achieves strong avg@\(k\) performance across model benchmark pairs, while matching or surpassing leading baselines on several long context understanding and generation settings with modest decoding overhead. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv}.

</details>


### [398] [Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06693)
*Maximilian Bershtman,Niv Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将PFN（先验数据拟合网络）表示用于表格数据异常检测，提出无需微调的ZEN（基于近邻距离打分）和微调的FOCUS（利用参考集微调以增强正常/异常可分性），在ADBench上均超过所有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度特征已革新图像与视频异常检测，但对表格数据影响有限，主要因缺乏强深度表示。PFN近期成为表格数据的有力表示来源，但其表示如何适配异常检测尚不清楚。该任务难点在于：部署前无异常样本可供监督调参，且定义正常行为的参考集本身可能已包含待检测的异常。

Method: 首先使用冻结的TabPFN特征，通过样本在特征空间中到最近邻的距离进行打分，并确定适用的层与特征提取流程；为进一步提升，利用参考集对模型进行微调，使所得特征更好地区分正常样本与异常。

Result: 在ADBench基准上，免微调方法ZEN的平均AUROC高于所有基线；微调方法FOCUS在ZEN基础上进一步提升，且方法可跨不同PFN模型泛化。

Conclusion: PFN表示可有效适配表格异常检测，简单近邻打分即具强竞争力，而基于参考集的微调能进一步改善特征可分性并取得最优性能。

Abstract: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection. The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deploy- ment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sam- ple by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine- tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models.

</details>


### [399] [To Learn is to Wander: Learning Across Graphs and Tasks with Random Walks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06694)
*Louis Tichelman,Xingyue Huang,Jinwoo Kim,İsmail İlkan Ceylan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Wander 图基础模型，用随机游走统一接口把异质图、多关系图等不同图学习任务都转化为"部分观测图的补全"，单一预训练权重可跨图模态与任务通用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图基础模型通常只能在特定图模态或特定任务内泛化，无法在单一检查点中同时跨越不同图、特征空间、关系模式和预测任务。

Method: 从先验-预测视角把图学习表述为部分观测图的补全；通过基于随机游走的统一接口实现该任务通用视角，使同一模型可处理同质图与多关系图，并适应不同特征、标签与关系模式。推理时可在不改变已学参数的情况下扩大结构上下文。

Result: 在适当假设下，Wander 可对有限连通图上的贝叶斯最优预测器实现通用逼近；单个预训练检查点在节点分类、同质图链接预测和知识图谱链接预测上达到最优或极具竞争力的结果。跨图模态与任务的联合预训练在保持专门场景性能的同时，带来正向迁移和推理时可组合分别学到的能力。

Conclusion: Wander 展示了以随机游走为统一接口、将图学习统一为图补全任务，可构建跨模态、跨任务的通用图基础模型，并支持推理时灵活扩展结构与能力组合。

Abstract: Graph foundation models aim to transfer across graphs, feature spaces, relational schemas, and prediction tasks, yet existing approaches typically generalize only within particular graph modalities or tasks. We propose Wander, a graph foundation model designed to operate across these settings within a single pretrained checkpoint. Following the prior-predictive perspective, we formulate graph learning as completion of a partially observed graph. We realize this task-general view through a common interface based on random walks, allowing the same model to operate across homogeneous and multi-relational graphs with varying features, labels, and relational schemas. Wander can increase its structural context at inference time without changing its learned parameters and, under suitable assumptions, universally approximates the corresponding Bayes-optimal predictor on bounded connected graphs. Empirically, a single pretrained checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results across node classification, homogeneous link prediction, and knowledge-graph link prediction. Moreover, joint pretraining across graph modalities and tasks preserves performance in specialized settings while enabling positive transfer and the composition of separately learned capabilities at inference time.

</details>


### [400] [BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06725)
*Gang Fu,Adel Javanmard,MohammadHossein Bateni,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出BRANCH-MoE，将专家置于二叉决策树叶节点，通过基于指数移动平均的节点分叉概率实现层次化路由，无需辅助负载均衡损失即可平衡专家利用，并理论上证明可防止路由质量塌缩、控制收敛率与跨设备通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扁平MoE路由器存在专家利用不均衡问题，且将专家视为无结构集合，其索引不具备拓扑含义，难以支持局部化专家协同与通信优化。

Method: 将E个专家放在深度为log₂E的二叉决策树叶节点上；每个内部节点的分叉概率以到达该节点流量的加权平均得分为中心，用指数移动平均估计该均值；专家按树前缀分配到设备。

Result: 在Criteo CTR预测、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD上，使用E=16、top-4路由和5个随机种子，与Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias、Skywork logit-normalized、deterministic hash路由对比，结果表明层次化路由能在保持任务质量与平衡利用的同时，形成支持局部专家共激活并减少通信的拓扑。

Conclusion: 层次化MoE路由可在不依赖辅助负载均衡损失的情况下实现专家利用均衡，并带来利于共激活与通信缩减的专家拓扑结构。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.

</details>


### [401] [Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06726)
*Marco Morik,Jesse Palarus,Carmen Vidaurre,Klaus-Robert Müller,Shinichi Nakajima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双流框架，将全局时序表征学习与逐时刻空间精修解耦，用Transformer编码整段EEG并结合固定逆算子生成条件，显著提升源定位精度与跨头模泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG源定位是严重病态的逆问题。现有深度学习方法存在两难：逐帧模型丢失时间上下文，而完整4D时空网络在重建精度与推理成本之间难以兼顾，因此需要一个既保留全局时序信息又控制计算开销的架构。

Method: 采用双流设计：1）基于Transformer的时序条件编码器，通过因式分解的时空注意力处理整段EEG序列，保留传感器分辨特征；2）固定逆算子将这些特征映射为源索引条件，输入到逐时刻的源空间Transformer或体卷积精修器。训练中跨多种leadfield并引入显式算子不匹配。

Result: 在逼真合成数据上，该时序先验大幅提升空间定位，优于经典方法与时空基线，在高噪声与多源场景尤为明显；跨leadfield与算子失配训练改善了对未见头几何的迁移，使模板式重建接近个体化逆解。仅用合成EEG训练的模型应用于真实EEG，基于睁眼/闭眼源功率差异的logistic回归成功解码年龄组。

Conclusion: 显式解耦全局时序建模与逐点空间精修，能有效缓解重建精度与推理成本的权衡；合成数据训练的模型具备向真实数据与个体化头模迁移的潜力，并为下游应用（如年龄组解码）提供可行路径。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.

</details>


### [402] [Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06745)
*Federico Larroca,Paola Bermolen,Marcelo Fiori,Bernardo Marenco*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出双曲空间中分层图嵌入的梯度学习在大半径处数值失效，并提出将极坐标角度步长缩放因子视为可选的优化预条件子族，通过两阶段组合不同曲率预条件子显著降低损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层图在双曲空间中嵌入的失真低于欧氏空间，因为双曲空间具有负曲率。然而在大半径处，庞加莱球和洛伦兹双曲面模型存在数值问题，导致基于梯度的学习受阻。极坐标虽可避免该问题，但其双曲度量将角度步长按半径的双曲正弦缩放，使角度运动被冻结。作者观察到这一缩放因子实际上是一种被现有实现默默固定的选择，因此希望探索其他选择是否可能且更优。

Method: 作者将极坐标中的角度步长缩放因子视为可选择的优化预条件子，构造了一个从曲率 -1 到 0 的单参数预条件子族，同时保持嵌入本身曲率为 -1。其中欧氏切空间参数化对应使用半径本身的预条件子，作为该族的一个端点。作者进一步提出两阶段优化策略：先用欧氏预条件子建立布局，再用中间曲率预条件子进行细化。

Result: 欧氏预条件子擅长重新排列布局但细化能力较差，而中间曲率预条件子在布局已建立后能进行更好的细化。将二者分两阶段组合使用，在真实世界树结构数据上将损失相比最佳单一曲率降低了 46-74%。

Conclusion: 角度步长的缩放因子并非唯一选择，而是一个可调优化预条件子族的端点。不同曲率的预条件子在不同优化阶段各有优势，通过两阶段组合可显著提升双曲分层图嵌入的学习效果。

Abstract: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.

</details>


### [403] [MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06751)
*Dwaipayan Saha,Jacob Feitelberg,Kyuseong Choi,Raaz Dwivedi,Anish Agarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MatrixFormer 是一个矩阵原生预训练 Transformer，能一次前向传播为所有缺失元素预测完整分布，在因果推断、表格插补、推荐系统等任务上实现零样本竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型将矩阵补全当作逐元素预测，为每个目标重复使用上下文，且丢弃矩阵的二维结构信息，效率低且未充分利用矩阵结构。

Method: 提出 MatrixFormer，一个预训练的矩阵原生 Transformer，单次前向即对所有缺失元素预测完整分布；完全在合成的低秩与潜在因子矩阵上、覆盖多种缺失模式进行训练。

Result: 以零样本方式和相同模型权重，在因果推断面板数据任务、语言模型基准分数补全、表格插补和推荐系统矩阵补全上均取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 结果表明 MatrixFormer 可作为矩阵补全的通用基础模型。

Abstract: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

</details>


### [404] [Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06795)
*Eraldo Pereira Marinho,Caetano Mazzoni Ranieri,Fabricio Aparecido Breve*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RTKNNC是一种基于图的聚类方法，可在多个邻域尺度上发现簇结构且无需预先指定簇数，通过在递归正反向遍历中保留KNN关系的双向性实现，并可选标签无关的高斯子群细分精炼。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常先将KNN图转为无向，丢失了"谁选择谁"的方向信息；且图连通性可能通过稀疏桥或小重叠区把不同组错误连接。作者希望保留双向邻接关系以在多尺度上发现簇结构，并解决误连通问题。

Method: RTKNNC保留KNN关系的两个方向：某点选择了哪些点及哪些点选择了它。将"被选择"视为加权投票，决定递归正反向遍历中哪些局部连接保留。对递增的K增大重复此过程，观察簇的持续与合并（参考逆平方模型下簇只合并不分裂）。另加可选的无标签精炼：检验已形成分量是否更适合由2或3个高斯子群描述，仅当子群足够大且与可见KNN图一致时才接受细分。

Result: 在8个合成数据集、K=2至16下，独立的C与Python实现于全部120次参考运行中产生完全一致的分区。精炼使变量密度基准的ARI从0.7817提升至0.9627，稀疏桥基准从0.8083提升至0.9853。与7种外部聚类方法比较显示具有竞争力，同时保持无标签的簇构建过程。

Conclusion: RTKNNC通过保留KNN双向关系和递归正反向遍历，实现了无需预设簇数的多尺度聚类，可选地无标签精炼显著提升了在变量密度与稀疏桥情形下的表现，性能与现有方法相比具有竞争力。

Abstract: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.

</details>


### [405] [Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06804)
*Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Seyedarmin Azizi,Arya Fayyazi,Saeid Shokoufa,Mehdi Kamal,Souvik Kundu,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OPPD方法，让模型在单次生成中直接产出经幂分布锐化后的高质量答案，无需多次采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型常给正确答案更高概率却仍采样出错误答案，因为错误答案总概率更大；幂分布锐化虽能改善推理，但需对每个查询评分大量候选。

Method: On-policy power distillation (OPPD)：运行顺序蒙特卡洛采样器，被训练模型生成候选，冻结教师的幂分布为其加权；相同概率用于最大似然更新中给每个答案加权。损失系数可调节模型吸收的锐化指数。

Result: 单次生成精度较未训练模型在MATH500提升至多23.0点、GSM8K提升27.3点；单次生成比已发表的64候选幂采样高2.4和3.5点，恢复16候选给未训练模型增益的94%。相比同检查点同预算、带验证奖励的GRPO，OPPD在MATH500、GSM8K、AIME上分别高3.8、4.0、5.4点（无需参考答案），二者互补，GRPO后再用OPPD最多再加9.3点。仅在数学上训练，HumanEval提升至多5.3点。锐化指数可在1.19至2.02间移动（普通on-policy蒸馏为1.14）。增益跨模型家族和规模成立。

Conclusion: OPPD通过蒸馏幂分布锐化效应，使模型单次生成即获得多候选采样式推理增益，无需参考答案，跨模型规模有效，且与GRPO等方法互补。

Abstract: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/OPPD.

</details>


### [406] [H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06805)
*Wancong Zhang,Basile Terver,Michael Rabbat,Yann LeCun,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出H-JEPA，端到端训练由动作条件JEPA组成的分层世界模型，每层在各自潜空间预测更远未来，自上而下规划生成子目标，在导航与操作任务中显著优于平坦JEPA并降低规划算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程规划需要在不同时间尺度和抽象层次上推理，但现有任务无关JEPA世界模型只在单一时间尺度预测，或仅在共享潜空间内使用多步预测，难以有效分解时间结构。

Method: 端到端训练一组动作条件JEPA的层级结构，每层在自己的学习潜空间中预测更远的未来；规划自上而下进行，顶层优化朝目标推进，每层预测作为下一层规划器的子目标。当数据因素按不同时间尺度演化时，高层丢弃快速不可预测细节，保留缓慢且任务相关的状态。结合逆动力学监督可扩展到真实机器人视频（DROID）。

Result: 在四个仿真导航与操作环境中，分层规划优于平坦JEPA；在Visual AntMaze上，三级层次将成功率从18%提升到73%，且规划算力更少。消融表明增益来自时间分解与高层目标表征两方面。在DROID真实机器人视频上，层次结构在更低规划算力下提升离线规划保真度。

Conclusion: 分层、多时间尺度的JEPA世界模型能有效支撑长时程规划，兼顾成功率与计算效率，并可通过逆动力学监督迁移到真实机器人数据。

Abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

</details>


### [407] [Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06809)
*Emre Acartürk,Pranamya Kulkarni,Puranjay Datta,Karthikeyan Shanmugam,Burak Varıcı,Ali Tajer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究干预式因果表征学习（CRL），在更弱的干预假设下建立可辨识性保证，得到因果变量的分块解耦，并将其用于具身视觉状态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CRL的可辨识性保证多依赖高度理想化假设，难以直接应用于真实问题；而CRL作为无标签推断方法，在缺乏标签的场景中极具吸引力。因此需要在更现实的干预假设下建立理论保证，并验证其实际有效性。

Method: 论文有双重目标：一是在显著更弱的干预假设下建立可辨识性保证，得到因果变量的分块解耦，其中块结构取决于现实中可获得的干预机制；二是将该分块解耦框架用于具身视觉状态估计，即在无标注数据下直接从图像和视频中恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量。

Result: 理论部分给出了在弱化假设下的可辨识性保证；应用部分表明，即便存在进一步的假设违背，所得目标在受控的具身场景中仍然有效，实现了从理论到实践的桥接。

Conclusion: 分块解耦理论与具身视觉状态估计应用互补：理论刻画了弱假设下的可辨识性，应用证明了方法在现实违例下的有效性，为无标签CRL走向实际问题提供了理论到实践的桥梁。

Abstract: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.

</details>


### [408] [Private online learning and prediction for Littlestone classes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06822)
*Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私在线学习与在线预测在可实现对手下的错误界，证明两者样本复杂度相差一个随T增长的因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 了解差分隐私下在线学习与在线预测复杂度差异，填补过往工作遗留的δ区间下界空白。

Method: 提出新的私有在线学习下界与私有预测上界，针对Littlestone维数d的类进行分析。

Result: 私有在线学习错误下界为Ω((d/ε)(log T)^{2/3})；私有预测错误上界为2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}log^2(2/(εδ))，与T无关。

Conclusion: 固定有限Littlestone维数类，当δ=Θ(1/log T)时，私有学习需Ω((log T)^{2/3})错误，而私有预测仅需O((log log T)^2)，两问题复杂度分离。

Abstract: We study mistake bounds for differentially private online learning and online prediction under oblivious realisable adversaries. Online learning requires the learner to release a hypothesis at each time step whereas in online prediction, the learner only needs to make predictions without releasing a hypothesis. Using a novel lower bound for private online learning and an upper bound for private prediction, we show that the sample complexity of these two problems are separated by a factor that grows with the time horizon for every class of finite Littlestone dimension $d$. First, we prove that every $\br{ε,δ}$-private online learner has a deterministic realisable stream of length $T$ on which the mistake bound is at least $\bE\bs{M_T}=\Om{\frac dε\log\br{ T}^{2/3}}$. In particular, this is the first non-trivial lower in the range $1/T<δ<1/\log T)$ left open in earlier works[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]. Second, we prove that for every class of of Littlestone dimension $d$, there exists an $(ε,δ)$-jointly private predictor with at most $2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}\log^2\br{2/\br{εδ}}$ expected mistakes, independently of $T$, for some absolute constant $c>0$. Thus, for every fixed class of finite Littlestone dimension when $δ=Θ\br{1/\log T}$, private learning requires $\Om{\br{\log T}^{2/3}}$ expected mistakes, whereas private prediction admits $\bigO{\br{\log\log T}^2}$.

</details>


### [409] [Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06823)
*Tanbin Islam Rohan,Pranjol Sen Gupta,Tanusree Debi,Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SeqSmoother——一种基于 transformer 的时序校正器，用于从腕部加速度计信号估计睡眠心率；通过引入 Nightbeat 频率锚点与物理启发的次谐波特征，在精度与可用性之间形成权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型纵向队列常采集腕部加速度数据但缺少光学心率传感，因此希望从睡眠期间已采集的运动信号中恢复心脏信息，以充分利用现有数据。

Method: SeqSmoother 结合频谱描述符、Nightbeat 派生的中间频率锚点，以及用于识别谐波频率锁定的物理启发次谐波特征；所有推理特征均来自腕部加速度，ECG 仅用于构造参考心率标签与训练标签质量权重。采用 13 个参与者互斥的留出折进行评估，并与官方 Nightbeat 在匹配的 60 秒窗口、15 秒步长协议下比较。

Result: 所有折外预测中，SeqSmoother 的参与者宏平均 MAE 为 1.60 bpm；在 Nightbeat 保留的匹配区间上，Nightbeat 绝对误差更低（0.615 对 1.091 bpm），但 Nightbeat 仅覆盖 SeqSmoother 可用折外网格的 72.85%，SeqSmoother 覆盖范围更大；所提次谐波比在识别参考定义的谐波锁定候选上 AUROC 达 0.972。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了学习型时序建模与质量门控信号处理之间的精度—可用性权衡，并为基于加速度计的睡眠心率估计中识别频率跟踪失效提供了物理信息方法的实证支持。

Abstract: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.

</details>


### [410] [Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06833)
*Benhao Huang,Chufan Shi,Junlin Chen,Shicheng Wen,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric Xing,Xuezhe Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用循环语言模型中循环状态趋近不动点的特性,实现训练截断反向传播、解码终端KV共享、加速预填充与RL更新,并改进深度先验与输入注入,在100M至1.6B规模上降低困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型每次循环都会在训练、解码、预填充和强化学习中增加成本。作者观察到循环状态越接近不动点,到达该状态的路径就越不重要,因此希望利用这一特性降低各环节开销,同时改进塑造不动点的深度先验与输入注入两个训练组件。

Method: 利用状态趋近不动点的性质,采用截断反向传播训练、终端KV共享解码、蒸馏学生模型加速预填充,以及从保存的rollout状态计算RL梯度。对深度先验,从预测反馈中学习先验并用熵项保持其广度;对输入注入,采用正交注入移除状态沿输入方向的分量。

Result: 终端KV共享解码几乎无精度损失;蒸馏学生预填充最高快1.79倍;RL梯度计算比通过重放轨迹反向传播快2倍。在100M到1.6B参数规模上,学习先验与正交注入相比Huginn先验和现有注入方案在每个规模都降低困惑度。在1.6B上,学习先验配合3倍小的KV缓存可达到固定深度训练全缓存的平均下游性能。

Conclusion: 循环状态趋近不动点的特性可有效降低训练、解码、预填充与RL成本,学习深度先验与正交输入注入能持续提升各规模下的性能,并支持更小的KV缓存。

Abstract: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matters. This enables truncated backpropagation in training; terminal key-value (KV) sharing for decoding with almost no loss in accuracy; a distilled student that prefills up to 1.79x faster; and RL updates that compute gradients from saved rollout states, 2x faster than backpropagating through the replayed trajectory. We therefore improve the two components of training that shape these fixed points: the depth prior and input injection. Fixed-depth training breaks KV sharing, and Huginn's broad depth prior supports sharing but dilutes supervision at the target depth more than sharing requires; we learn the prior from prediction feedback, with an entropy term that keeps it broad. Existing injection schemes let the state's component along the input amplify or cancel the injection; we remove this component with orthogonal injection. From 100M to 1.6B parameters, the learned prior and orthogonal injection lower perplexity at every scale relative to Huginn's prior and existing injection schemes, respectively. At 1.6B, the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

</details>


### [411] [Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06851)
*Sophie L. Wang,Amil Dravid,Rulin Shao,Kevin Farhat,Sewon Min,Alexei A. Efros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基座模型回复起始token线索与后续推理行为之间的关联：固定特定起始token可大幅提升数学与代码推理表现，且这种线索效应可通过数据干预在训练数据中被因果性地创建或消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望理解训练数据如何塑造基座模型回复起始token与随后推理行为之间的关联，并探究RL训练提升推理能力是否部分源于强化了这些起始线索的作用。

Method: 先测试固定特定起始token（如".\n\nOkay"、"Alright,"）时基座模型在MATH-500等任务上的表现并与RL微调模型比较；再检验RL是否提高这些线索的出现概率，并固定线索以恢复性能增益；随后进行因果数据干预，将任意词（如"chicken"）变为有效推理线索或消除已有线索效果；同时对提示指令做类似编辑；并分析不同线索诱导的隐藏状态表示与训练集中文档类型的相关性；最后以安全领域（拒绝与顺从行为）为案例进行扩展研究。

Result: 固定线索"\.\n\nOkay"使Olmo-3-7B的MATH-500 pass@1准确率从42%升至78%，"Alright,"使Qwen3-14B从72%升至87%，达到与RL训练版本相当的水平；RL提高线索出现概率，固定线索可恢复其相对基座模型的大部分性能增益；因果数据干预可创造或消除线索效果，类似编辑使"Think duck duck goose"与"Think step by step"一样有效；不同线索的隐藏状态表示与不同训练文档类型相关；安全案例中不同线索引发不同的拒绝与顺从行为，对应不同类型训练数据。

Conclusion: 基座模型的推理行为受回复起始token线索显著影响，且这些线索效应根植于训练数据，可通过数据干预因果性地创建、消除或迁移；该机制也延伸至安全行为，表明起始token线索是连接训练数据与下游行为的重要中介。

Abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [412] [Learning Robust Personalized Prompts for LLM-Driven Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03923)
*Xiaolin Zheng,Qiyong Zhong,Jiajie Su,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 LRPRec 可学习提示框架，通过个性化提示注入与语义漂移约束，在保持语义有效性的同时实现参数高效的用户级自适应，消除手工模板调优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的序列推荐以自然语言提示做自回归生成，但语义等价提示的微小措辞变化会导致性能大幅波动，鲁棒性差且依赖昂贵的人工提示工程。连续提示学习虽减少模板依赖，却面临两个问题：共享任务级指令缺乏用户专属推理引导；梯度更新可能将连续提示推出 LLM 的有效语义空间，而注入个性化信号会进一步加剧语义漂移。

Method: LRPRec 从离散模板初始化连续指令提示，引入两个互补机制：一是个性化提示注入，将用户行为编码为偏好嵌入并加性注入共享提示，实现参数高效的用户级自适应；二是语义漂移约束，将共享提示正则化在初始锚点附近的信任域内，以在优化中保持语义有效性。通过约束共享分量、允许加性个性化，解耦稳定性与表达力。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，LRPRec 在强基线上取得一致提升，同时无需人工调优背景模板与任务推断模板。

Conclusion: LRPRec 通过共享提示约束与个性化注入的互补设计，兼顾稳定性与表达力，提升了 LLM 序列推荐的鲁棒性与效果，并免除了手工提示工程。

Abstract: LLM-driven sequential recommendation formulates next-item prediction as autoregressive generation conditioned on natural-language prompts. However, minor wording changes in semantically equivalent prompts can cause substantial performance fluctuations, undermining robustness and requiring costly manual prompt engineering. Continuous prompt learning reduces template dependence but faces two interacting challenges: shared task-level instructions lack user-specific reasoning guidance, while gradient updates can push continuous prompts outside the LLM's effective semantic space. Injecting personalized signals can further amplify this semantic drift. To address these challenges, we propose LRPRec, a learnable prompting framework that initializes continuous instruction prompts from discrete templates and introduces two complementary mechanisms. Personalized prompt injection encodes user behavior into a preference embedding and additively injects it into shared prompts, enabling parameter-efficient user-level adaptation. A semantic drift constraint regularizes the shared prompts within a trust region around their initialization anchors to preserve semantic validity during optimization. By constraining the shared component while allowing additive personalization, LRPRec decouples stability from expressiveness. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines while eliminating the need for manual tuning of background and task inference templates.

</details>


### [413] [FICO: Find-Then-Compute for Corpus-Level Spreadsheet Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03958)
*Sandarsita Guntupalli,Lu He,Kang Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出FiCo框架，先检索定位正确工作簿再在完整表上执行受限SQL，在DataBench与MiMoTable上大幅超越RAG基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子表格集合问答需先找到正确的工作簿，再对完整表格进行计算；现有RAG方法难以兼顾语义源选择与精确计算。

Method: FiCo（Find-then-Compute）：检索文档摘要、消歧相似工作簿，并对选中完整表执行受约束的SQL。

Result: DataBench（80数据集、1810题）达76.2%，超强TableRAG基线（66.3%）9.9点、超前缀RAG（12.8%）63.4点；MiMoTable 508题达79.7%（前缀RAG 22.2%）。给基线金标工作簿可从66.3%升至76.3%，暴露10.0点源选择代价。文档召回95.1%、SQL可执行98.5%，但金标工作簿上仅81.3%可执行。

Conclusion: FiCo的优势来自将语义源选择与基于模式的精确计算相结合。

Abstract: Question answering over spreadsheet collections requires finding the correct workbook and computing over complete tables. We introduce Find-then-Compute (FiCo), which retrieves document summaries, disambiguates similar workbooks, and executes constrained Structured Query Language (SQL) over the selected full table. On DataBench (80 datasets, 1,810 questions), FiCo reaches 76.2% accuracy: 9.9 points above a strong TableRAG-style baseline on the same frozen workbook choices (66.3%) under the tracks' prespecified evaluators, and 63.4 points above prefix RAG (12.8%). On 508 MiMoTable questions, FiCo reaches 79.7%, versus 22.2% for prefix RAG. Giving the strong baseline the gold workbook raises it from 66.3% to 76.3%, exposing a 10.0-point source-selection cost under fixed compute. Despite 95.1% document recall and 98.5% executable SQL, only 81.3% of questions execute on the gold workbook. FiCo's advantage comes from integrating semantic source selection with exact, schema-grounded computation.

</details>


### [414] [Multimodal Dual-Encoder Retrieval for Automated ICD Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04263)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段ICD编码预测框架：第一阶段用门控融合的多模态双编码器检索ICD码，第二阶段用LLM重排前k个候选并给出临床解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前ICD预测方法存在三大问题：(1)无法理解多模态患者数据（仅依赖结构化EHR或非结构化临床笔记之一）；(2)难以扩展到大规模ICD码（ICD-9有9000+码），传统分类器需稠密输出层且在长尾罕见病上泛化差；(3)缺乏临床使用所需的透明度。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段通过门控融合整合结构化与非结构化患者数据，使用多模态双编码器检索模型检索ICD码；第二阶段用LLM重排器对检索到的top-k候选进行精排，并给出临床相关的解释。

Result: 实验表明，与多模态双融合分类器基线相比，该方法在Micro-F1和Precision上均有提升。

Conclusion: 将门控多模态检索系统与LLM重排相结合，是稠密多标签分类用于自动ICD编码的实用替代方案。

Abstract: Accurate International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding is crucial for large-scale clinical research, documentation, and billing. There are three primary problems with current ICD prediction methods: (1) They are unable to comprehend multimodal patient data because they rely on either structured EHR data or unstructured clinical notes. (2) They also struggle with scalability to a larger amount of ICD codes (9K+ codes in ICD-9), as traditional classifiers need dense output layers and often do not generalize well to long tail rare diseases. (3) They lack transparency for clinical use. To address these challenges, this research proposes a two-stage framework that first retrieves ICD codes using a multimodal dual-encoder retrieval model, where structured and unstructured patient data are integrated through gated fusion. The second stage refines the top-k retrieved candidates with an LLM-based re-ranker that provides ranked codes with clinically relevant explanations. Our experiments show that the proposed approach improves Micro-F1 and Precision over a multimodal dual-fusion classifier baseline. These improvements demonstrate that combining a gated multimodal retrieval system with LLM-based re-ranking is a practical alternative to dense multi-label classification for automated ICD coding.

</details>


### [415] [From Valid to Useful: Post-Verification Acquisition for Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04302)
*Tonmoy Hasan,Taylor Foust,Shao Tang,Leonardo Neves,Aman Gupta,Hiroto Udagawa,Helder Dias,Daniel Silva,Rohan Ramanath*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出"验证后获取"（post-verification acquisition）问题，并给出DA-RSIR方法：对每个源序列的已验证序列按模型预测分歧度排序并限制单源贡献，从而决定哪些已验证序列用于训练下一轮模型，在24项比较中全部优于保留全部（retain-all）基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列推荐器可通过自我改进循环生成合成交互序列并递归重训练，但存在误差累积问题。现有方法仅通过"验证"筛除偏离用户真实交互的生成序列，却未解决"哪些已验证序列应当用于训练下一模型"的问题。若将所有已验证序列都用于训练，那些产生更多已验证序列或更长续写的源序列会获得更大影响，但这些数量并不代表其对下一模型的帮助程度。

Method: 将"哪些已验证序列用于训练下一模型"形式化为验证后获取问题，并提出DA-RSIR。该方法：1）对每个源序列的贡献设定上限；2）依据模型在其增强交互上的预测分歧度对已验证序列排序；3）排序分数源自BALD（Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement），并用蒙特卡洛（MC）dropout估计。方法无需额外标签、教师模型或质量评分器。

Result: 在4个数据集、3种推荐模型、2项指标共24项比较中，DA-RSIR全面优于retain-all，并在其中23项取得最高均值；两项指标上的总体提升均具统计显著性。单轮DA-RSIR的增益超过retain-all在五轮递归中的最佳增益。

Conclusion: 研究确立了验证后获取作为递归自我改进中独立的控制点，将"哪些序列通过验证"与"哪些已验证序列用于训练下一模型"区分开来，为提升序列推荐器自我改进循环的效果提供了新思路。

Abstract: Sequential recommenders can generate synthetic interaction sequences and retrain on the augmented corpus in a recursive self-improvement loop. To limit error accumulation, current methods verify each generated sequence remains predictive of the user's real interactions and discard those that drift away from it. Verification does not, however, determine which verified sequences should train the next model. With every verified sequence used for training, source sequences yielding more verified sequences or longer continuations have more influence, although neither quantity indicates how much those sequences will help the next model.
  We formulate the decision of which verified sequences are used to train the next model as \emph{post-verification acquisition} and introduce {\bf Disagreement-Aware Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation (DA-RSIR)}. DA-RSIR caps each source sequence's contribution and ranks its verified sequences by how much the model's predictions disagree over their augmented interactions. It uses a score derived from Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (BALD) and estimated with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout.
  DA-RSIR requires no extra labels, teacher model, or quality scorer. Across four datasets, three recommender models, and two metrics, it improves on the retain-all approach in all $24$ comparisons and attains the highest mean in $23$ of $24$ overall; the aggregate improvement is statistically significant on both metrics. A single DA-RSIR round exceeds the retain-all approach's best gain over five recursive rounds. These findings establish post-verification acquisition as a separate control point in recursive self-improvement, separating which sequences pass verification from which verified sequences are used to train the next model.

</details>


### [416] [Query Generation with Direct Preference Optimization for Document Expansion in E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04352)
*Kaihao Li,Feng Liu,Juexin Lin,Xunfan Cai,Zhen Yang,Tony Lee,Ciya Liao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出QGDPO方法，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进文档扩展模型，减少不相关和重复生成，并结合相关性模型过滤，提升检索相关性，已部署于Walmart.com。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Doc2Query等文档扩展技术虽能缓解信息检索中的"词汇不匹配"问题，但其序列到序列模型常生成与文档无关的幻觉内容或文档中已有的重复内容，如何生成高质量、新颖且相关的token仍是重大挑战。

Method: 首先微调基础序列到序列模型；再用相关性模型对其预测打分；基于分数构建"胜出/失败"预测对，作为相关性偏好用于DPO训练；此外，用相关性模型过滤低质量预测，仅保留最相关的生成内容用于索引。

Result: 相比Doc2Query基线，QGDPO有效消除50%的不相关预测，相关性过滤器再额外去除14.61%；该方案已成功在Walmart.com全流量上线，显著提升了相关性和用户参与度。

Conclusion: QGDPO通过DPO和相关性过滤相结合，有效提升文档扩展的生成质量与检索相关性，并已在工业级大规模搜索场景中得到验证。

Abstract: Doc2Query, a popular document expansion technique, leverages sequence-to-sequence models to generate relevant queries, effectively addressing the "vocabulary mismatch" problem in information retrieval. However, these models often suffer from generating either hallucinations unrelated to the document or repetitive content already present in the document. Training sequence-to-sequence models to produce high-quality, novel, and relevant tokens remains a significant challenge. To address these issues, we introduce a novel approach, QGDPO, that employs direct preference optimization (DPO) to guide the generation process. We first fine-tune a base sequence-to-sequence model and subsequently utilize a relevance model to score its predictions. Based on these scores, we construct pairs of winning and losing predictions as relevance preferences for the DPO training. Furthermore, we enhance our pipeline by using the relevance model to filter out poor predictions, retaining only the most relevant generated content for indexing. QGDPO effectively eliminates 50% of irrelevant predictions comparing against Doc2Query baselines, while the relevance filter removes an additional 14.61%. This feature has been successfully deployed to production on Walmart.com for full traffic, with a substantial improvement in relevance and user engagement.

</details>


### [417] [ModelLakeFishing: Efficient Retrieval over Million-Scale Model Lakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04904)
*Xiaoyang Liu,Zhengyuan Dong,Renée J. Miller*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 ModelLakeFishing 模型检索框架，在百万级模型湖中为给定数据集、任务和指标高效检索合适模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放模型湖可能包含数百万可复用模型，为新数据集寻找合适模型代价高昂。

Method: 将元数据与历史评测整合为模型-数据集-任务证据图，用关系感知图编码器学习模型与查询嵌入，并用 HNSW 索引模型嵌入；查询时 HNSW 检索 1000 个候选，再由训练侧任务先验按目标指标重排，返回前 10。

Result: 在含 3,016,439 个模型和 247,803 个观测性能对的模型湖上评估，采用三种 root-aware 划分；gold@10 达 0.2968，即 29.68% 的合格查询在前 10 中恢复观测最优模型，保留穷举基线 gold@10 的 93.47%；给定预计算查询嵌入，检索与重排中位耗时 0.747 ms，95 分位 1.102 ms。

Conclusion: 结果表明可从稀疏关系证据出发，在百万级模型湖上实现高效检索。

Abstract: Open model lakes may contain millions of reusable models, making it costly to identify suitable models for a new dataset. We present ModelLakeFishing, a model-retrieval framework for queries specifying a target dataset, prediction task, and evaluation metric. It consolidates metadata and historical evaluations into a model-dataset-task evidence graph, learns model and query embeddings with a relation-aware graph encoder, and indexes model embeddings using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) search. At query time, HNSW retrieves 1,000 candidates without scoring every model, after which a training-side task prior reranks candidates for the requested metric and returns the top 10. We evaluate on a lake of 3,016,439 models and 247,803 observed model-dataset performance pairs using three root-aware splits that hold test performance edges out of representation learning and retrieval. ModelLakeFishing achieves a mean eligible-query gold@10 of 0.2968, recovering the observed-best model in the top 10 for 29.68% of eligible queries and retaining 93.47% of the gold@10 of an exhaustive baseline using the same scoring and reranking procedure. Given precomputed query embeddings, retrieval and reranking take 0.747 ms median and 1.102 ms at the 95th percentile. These results demonstrate efficient retrieval over million-model lakes from sparse relational evidence.

</details>


### [418] [Do We Still Need Gazetteers in the Era of LLMs? Chaining Retrieval with a Spatial Neuro-Symbolic Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05028)
*Horde-Vo Alexis,Duckham Matt,He Estrid*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文评估"文本编码器可充当可靠空间-语义索引"这一假设，发现无约束稠密检索易产生严重空间错误，而层次约束虽改善粗粒度地理定位，但细粒度定位仍受限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理信息检索需消解歧义地名。传统方法依赖地名词典做显式索引，近期无词典方法用稠密检索借助文本编码器捕捉上下文，但隐含假设"学习到的表示可作为可靠的空间-语义索引"，本文旨在检验该假设。

Method: 构建空间-语义索引评测：给定带上下文的地名提及，检索由地名词典知识图谱文本表示的对应实体。对五个冻结文本编码器基准测试，采用两种检索策略——对实体表示做暴力最近邻检索，以及用约束检索的神经符号层次束搜索（与词典层次链式结合）。

Result: 结果揭示明显的"粗-细"权衡：无约束稠密检索频繁出现灾难性空间错误；层次约束改善粗粒度地理定位，但对细粒度定位指标收益有限——普通文本编码器无法捕捉词典中编码的细尺度空间保真度。

Conclusion: 文本编码器作为空间-语义索引的假设并不完全成立，其细粒度空间保真度不足；层次约束可部分缓解粗粒度问题，代码已公开。

Abstract: Geographic information retrieval (GeoIR) tasks require systems to interpret ambiguous toponyms for downstream applications. Traditionally, toponym resolution relies on gazetteers to provide an explicit index of place entities and spatial relationships. Recently, gazetteer-free approaches seek to reduce dependence on handcrafted searches: dense retrieval utilizes text encoders to capture rich context, moving beyond the limitations of lexical search. However, text encoders implicitly assume that learned representations can function as reliable spatial-semantic indexes. In this paper, we evaluate this assumption through a spatial-semantic indexing setup: given a contextualized toponym mention, we retrieve the corresponding gazetteer entity represented by text derived from a gazetteer knowledge graph. We benchmark five frozen text encoders under two retrieval strategies: brute-force nearest-neighbor retrieval over entity representations, and a neuro-symbolic hierarchical beam search that constrains retrieval (i.e. chaining the search with gazetteer hierarchy). Experimental results reveal a distinct coarse-versus-fine trade-off. Unconstrained dense retrieval frequently incurs catastrophic spatial errors. Conversely, hierarchical constraints improve coarse geographic grounding, but still yield limited benefit for fine-grained localization metrics: vanilla text encoders fail to capture the fine-scale spatial fidelity encoded in gazetteers. Our code is publicly available at: https://doi.org/10.25439/rmt.31094269

</details>


### [419] [Agentic RAG Evaluation: Budget Allocation Across Questions, Trajectories, and Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05034)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过检索反馈对比实验，在代理式RAG中量化评估预算（问题数、搜索轨迹、重复读取）的分配精度、读取效率与成本边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理式检索增强生成的评估预算分布于问题、搜索轨迹和重复答案三个维度，但缺乏对预算如何分配、读取效率及成本边界的系统性度量。

Method: 在HotpotQA和MuSiQue上开展检索反馈对比实验，考察问题数、搜索轨迹与重复读取的不同配置，采用嵌套与Q-only预测模型进行分配预测，并做深度子集审计与温度零实验。

Result: 在34.14–34.39M模型token下，更广的问题覆盖使标准误较五次读取降低33%、较三条轨迹降低12.6%；存档的嵌套与Q-only预测误差分别为4.0%和3.5%。超过两条轨迹后深度子集无明确预测优势。单次读取相对拟合最优的方差惩罚为0–9.9%，Pro不确定性较大。在记录费用下，搜索价格0–1美元/千次请求时增加问题优于增加轨迹。温度零使答案分歧从14.3%降至3.4%，比较精度基本不变。

Conclusion: 问题覆盖比搜索轨迹和重复读取更具评估效率，是代理式RAG预算分配的关键杠杆；问与读的费用排序仍未确定。

Abstract: Evaluation budgets in agentic retrieval-augmented generation span questions, search trajectories, and repeated answers. We measure allocation precision, reading efficiency, and cost boundaries using a retrieval-feedback comparison on HotpotQA and MuSiQue. At 34.14--34.39M model tokens, broader question coverage lowers standard error by 33\% versus five reads and 12.6\% versus three trajectories. Archived nested and Q-only forecasts predict these allocations within 4.0\% and 3.5\%, respectively. Depth subsets establish no clear forecasting advantage beyond the two-trajectory audit. One-read variance penalties relative to the fitted optimum at the same token budget are 0--9.9\%, with substantial Pro uncertainty. Under recorded model fees, more questions beat more trajectories at search prices of \$0--1 per 1,000 requests; question-versus-read fee rankings remain unresolved. Temperature zero cuts answer disagreement from 14.3\% to 3.4\% while comparison precision stays similar. \par\medskip\noindent\textbf{Keywords:} Agentic RAG; Evaluation budget; Generalizability theory; Repeated sampling.

</details>


### [420] [SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05107)
*Congfeng Cao,Lipeng Zuo,Konstantinos Papakostas,Qiwei Xu,Songwei Xu,Lun Zhou,Zhaochun Ren,Yougang Lyu,Xiaohui Yan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出SearchJev，一种快速且校准良好的System-1模型，将搜索决策从System-2推理与生成中分离，通过直接对合法选项打分而非自回归生成，并配合软标签学习实现校准决策，同时构建SearchDecision-Bench基准进行训练与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索代理需要反复做出关于相关性、证据充分性和搜索动作的短决策。使用生成式语言模型做这些决策会带来延迟且置信度不可靠，因此需要一种快速且校准良好的决策方式。

Method: 提出SearchJev，给定搜索状态和决策schema直接对合法选项打分，无需自回归输出生成；提出Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD)从不确定监督中学习决策概率并校准置信度；在双系统搜索代理中，SearchJev负责短决策，不确定判断委托给System 2（负责规划、查询生成与答案撰写）；并构建SearchDecision-Bench统一六类搜索决策的基准。

Result: 在SearchDecision-Bench上，SearchJev相比同规模Qwen3.5自回归模型提升决策质量，决策速度快5.2-5.3倍，平均期望校准误差降低41-74%；在BrowseComp-Plus上，双系统代理活跃搜索时间提速3.7-4.7倍，答案准确率从45%提升至最高54%。

Conclusion: 通过将搜索短决策与System-2推理生成分离，SearchJev在速度与校准性上显著优于同类自回归模型，且双系统代理在大幅加速的同时提升了答案准确率，验证了该方法在搜索代理决策中的有效性。

Abstract: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.

</details>


### [421] [Quality-Aware Cross-Model Computation Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05285)
*Jin Cheng,Xiangxiang Dai,Maoli Liu,Ziyi Han,Zhuohua Li,John C. S. Lui*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文将跨模型计算复用建模为在线决策问题，提出QARS算法，在质量不确定与耦合调度双重挑战下实现近似最优的复用调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一个模型产生的中间结果可被其他模型复用以完成各自任务，但现有工作侧重实际执行，缺乏对复用决策优化的理论分析。该优化面临两大挑战：质量不确定性（复用对任务质量的影响因模型而异）与耦合调度（任务需分摊准备可复用结果的成本）。两者相互交织：质量需在线学习，但共享准备结构使调度即便在质量已知时也是NP难问题，破坏了现有方法的关键假设。

Method: 将跨模型计算复用形式化为在线决策问题，提出质量感知复用调度算法QARS。针对质量不确定性，QARS从被选中且可能延迟的反馈中学习任务相关的复用质量，并用乐观估计指导决策；针对耦合调度，联合选择准备哪些结果以及哪些任务使用它们，并根据剩余质量不确定性自适应调整调度精度。理论上将遗憾分解为学习误差与优化误差，量化调度精度与计算量之间的权衡，并设计质量感知停止规则。

Result: 完成质量感知停止规则后，算法在保持可行性的同时达到$\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$遗憾界。实验表明QARS能有效优化跨模型复用，将计算与质量损失的综合成本最多降低18.0%，相比最强调度基线平均遗憾降低63.9%。

Conclusion: QARS为跨模型计算复用提供了兼具理论保证与实证效果的在线调度方案，弥补了复用决策优化在理论上的空白，并通过遗憾分析刻画了学习与调度的内在权衡。

Abstract: An intermediate result computed by one model can be reused by other models to perform their tasks. Existing work mainly focuses on practical execution, leaving a theoretical gap in optimizing reuse decisions. This optimization faces two challenges: quality uncertainty, because the effect of reuse on task quality is uncertain across models, and coupled scheduling, because tasks need to share the cost of preparing reusable results. These challenges compound each other: quality must be learned online, but the shared preparation structure makes scheduling NP-hard even with known quality, breaking the key assumption in existing methods. We formulate cross-model computation reuse as an online decision problem and develop the Quality-Aware Reuse Scheduling (QARS) algorithm to address it. For quality uncertainty, QARS learns task-dependent reuse quality from selected, possibly delayed feedback and uses optimistic estimates to guide decisions. For coupled scheduling, it jointly chooses which results to prepare and which tasks should use them, adapting scheduling accuracy to the remaining quality uncertainty. For the considered problem, our analysis separates learning and optimization error in regret and quantifies the tradeoff between scheduling accuracy and computation. Completing the quality-aware stopping rule yields $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret while preserving feasibility. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of QARS in optimizing cross-model reuse, reducing the combined cost of computation and quality loss by up to 18.0%, and mean regret by 63.9% over the strongest scheduling baseline.

</details>


### [422] [Search Engines Never Say No: How Frozen Agents React When the Retrieval Tool Refuses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05348)
*Ramraj Chandradevan,Sayontan Ghosh,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究当检索工具主动"拒答"（返回缺失信号而非无关文本）时，冻结的搜索智能体的行为变化。实验在21M段落BM25索引的"索引空洞"测试集（257个NQ、300个HotpotQA问题）上进行，给七种智能体五种拒答措辞。一句未预告的拒答能将Qwen3-8B/32B的弃答率从23%提升到97%，Claude Haiku 4.5从28%到57%，几乎一对一减少错误答案。不同模型反应差异显著，措辞方式也很关键，且现实触发器的召回率远不及理想判官。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索工具从不拒答：即使索引中没有答案，它也会返回top-k段落，导致智能体看到无关文本而非"未命中"信号。作者想知道当工具拒绝回答时，冻结的搜索智能体会如何反应，以及弃答信号能否有效减少幻觉式错误答案。

Method: 构建"索引空洞"测试集（257个NQ、300个HotpotQA问题，分别在包含与不包含金标段落的21M段落BM25索引中运行）。让七个智能体接受五种拒答措辞。对比无拒答、系统提示指令、不同类型触发器（轻量分数预测器、LLM接地判官）的效果，并分析措辞、解释与指令等变量的影响。

Result: 未预告的一句拒答使Qwen3-8B/32B的弃答率平均从23%升至97%，Claude Haiku 4.5从28%升至57%，错误答案几乎一对一减少，平均比系统提示指令高51分。Search-R1忽略拒答并捏造检索；Claude Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5凭记忆作答（弃答仅+2分），但对系统提示指令有反应（+16）。措辞影响明显：解释优于裸标记，观测内的指令对Haiku起决定作用，软警告无效。现实触发器（分数预测器、LLM判官）远不及理想判官，且都落在收益-信号质量曲线上。

Conclusion: 对顺从型智能体而言，瓶颈在于工具内部的检测器而非智能体本身。收益-信号质量曲线以固定误拒预算下的召回率来定价任何触发器，为未来检测器研究指明了每提升一点召回率的价值。

Abstract: A search tool never says no: it returns its top-k passages even when the index holds no answer, so the agent sees irrelevant text instead of a miss signal. We ask what frozen search agents do when the tool refuses instead. On an index-hole testbed (257 NQ and 300 HotpotQA questions run with and without their gold passages in a 21M-passage BM25 index), seven agents receive one of five refusal wordings. An un-announced one-sentence refusal raises abstention on unanswerable questions from 23% to 97% on average for Qwen3-8B/32B and from 28% to 57% for Claude Haiku 4.5, cutting wrong answers almost one-for-one and beating a system-prompt instruction by 51 points on average. Search-R1 ignores the refusal and fabricates retrievals; Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer from memory (abstention +2 points) and obey a system-prompt directive instead (+16). We also found that wording matters: an explanation beats a bare token; a directive inside the observation is decisive for Haiku; a soft warning is useless. Realistic triggers, from a lightweight score-based predictor to an LLM grounding judge, fall well short of the oracle, and all land on a benefit-versus-signal-quality curve that prices any trigger by its recall at a fixed false-refusal budget: for compliant agents the bottleneck is the detector inside the tool, not the agent, and the curve tells future detector work what each point of recall is worth.

</details>


### [423] [OpticalRec: Unified Optical Vision-Language Representation for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05432)
*Yueqi Wang,Zitian Guo,Yupeng Hou,Yifei Wang,Kibum Kim,Zhenrui Yue,Shuo Xing,Haodong Li,Heming Xia,Renrui Zhang,Zhengzhong Tu,Julian McAuley*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出OpticalRec，首个面向多模态协同过滤的视觉空间统一编码范式，将文本元数据渲染为视觉字形以在视觉编码器内实现原生图文交互，显著提升推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法对视觉和语言模态独立编码后进行拼接等刚性晚期融合，忽略了原生视觉-语言交互，导致跨模态语义失真，难以准确学习物品表示和用户-物品匹配。

Method: 将物品文本元数据渲染为视觉字形，在视觉编码器（感知编码层）内实现原生图文交互，再由语言解码器（语义编码层）处理表示，从而利用现代视觉-语言模型的双注意力机制；并通过互信息分析提供理论支撑。

Result: 在多个强基线和基准上取得优越性能；作为即插即用模块，成本极低，对渲染文本的字体、颜色和布局等具有鲁棒性，可无缝集成到现有多模态协同过滤模型。

Conclusion: OpticalRec通过视觉空间统一编码范式有效解决了多模态推荐中的跨模态交互缺失问题，兼顾高效性与通用性，为多模态协同过滤提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language modeling have substantially improved multimodal encoding, retrieval and reasoning. Yet for multimodal recommendation, encoding rich item vision-language semantic interactions remains a long-standing bottleneck, which hampers accurate item representation learning and user-item matching. Mainstream approaches primarily adopt independent encoding of vision and language modality followed by rigid late fusion such as concatenation, inherently omitting native vision-language interactions and introducing cross-modal semantic distortion. To address this challenge, we propose OpticalRec, the first visual-space unified encoding paradigm for multimodal collaborative filtering, a fundamental recommendation setting. Instead of isolated modality-specific encoding, OpticalRec renders item textual metadata as visual glyphs, enabling native image-text interaction within the visual encoder - the perceptual encoding level. The resulting representations are further processed by the language decoder - the semantic encoding level, allowing OpticalRec to exploit the dual-attention mechanism of modern vision-language models that previous encoding methods omitted. OpticalRec's efficacy is theoretically supported by mutual information analysis and empirically demonstrated through superior performance across strong baselines and benchmarks. As a plug-and-play module, OpticalRec (1) introduces minimal cost, (2) is robust against rendered text font, color and layout, etc., and (3) integrates seamlessly into existing multimodal collaborative filtering models.

</details>


### [424] [SCOUT: Supply-Aware Cold-Start Proactive Query Suggestion for Travel Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05619)
*Hao Li,Shashank Reddy,Kedar Bellare,Ashish Jain,Stephanie Moyerman*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SCOUT框架，用供给侧反馈替代缺失的需求侧数据，通过GRPO优化实现供给感知的主动查询建议，IMR@18提升12.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式查询建议方法依赖用户偏好（点击、转化）对齐，适用于聊天机器人等开放场景。但旅游搜索受两大限制：一是受物理库存约束，同一查询在不同目的地结果差异巨大，仅对齐用户偏好无法保证可供给；二是旅游平台多采用分面搜索界面，缺乏自由文本查询日志，导致冷启动问题，无需求侧数据对齐且无种子查询可用。

Method: SCOUT将搜索系统建模为强化学习环境，用供给侧系统反馈替代缺失的需求侧用户反馈，从生产环境重排序器的查询-列表匹配分数中导出稠密奖励，并采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练策略，从结构化上下文主动生成建议。

Result: SCOUT使库存匹配率（IMR@18）提升12.3%，同时保持多样性，在零边际推理成本下达到与计算密集的best-of-8策略相当的效果。

Conclusion: SCOUT使供给感知的查询建议可部署于实时旅游搜索路径，解决了冷启动与供给约束问题。

Abstract: Generative query suggestion, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), has become increasingly popular in search and conversational systems to reduce user friction and guide intent formulation. Existing approaches align suggestions with user preferences (e.g., clicks or conversions). This works for open-ended applications like chatbots and personal assistants, where the result space is unconstrained or historical user free-text queries are abundant.
  However, applying these methods to travel search presents two limitations. First, travel search is fundamentally constrained by physical inventory; a query (e.g., "romantic beachfront villa") may yield abundant results in Bali but few in Tokyo, so aligning with user preferences is not by itself grounded in what can be offered. Second, travel platforms traditionally rely on faceted search interfaces with no free-text queries. This creates a cold-start problem: without historical query logs there is no demand-side data for alignment, and without a seed query at request time, suggestions must be generated proactively from structured context alone.
  To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT, a bootstrapping framework for supply-aware proactive query suggestion.
