SCOUT overcomes the data gap by substituting missing demand-side user feedback with supply-side system feedback. It treats the search engine as a reinforcement learning environment, deriving a dense reward from the production reranker's query-listing match scores, and optimizes the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SCOUT improves inventory match rate (IMR@18) by 12.3% while preserving diversity, matching a compute-intensive best-of-8 policy at zero marginal inference cost and making supply-aware suggestion deployable on a real-time travel search path.

</details>


### [425] [Generate What You Can Trust: Content Credibility in Generative Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05670)
*Zhuo Cai,Guanghao Wu,Shoujin Wang,Peilin Zhou,Victor W. Chu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出首个可信生成式推荐模型CreGR，从分词和生成两阶段联合处理内容可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐(GR)主要优化准确性，忽视所生成推荐的可信度，会使用户接触虚假内容(如假新闻)，带来用户不信任、平台声誉受损和社会不稳定等后果。

Method: CreGR在分词阶段设计可信度感知分词器，为可信与不可信物品学习有区分度的token以在token层解耦可信信号；在生成阶段提出基于离散扩散的保准确且面向可信的生成器，采用非对称掩码概率降低策略，选择性削弱不可信内容相关token的贡献，同时保留用户偏好token以维持准确性。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上的实验证明了CreGR的有效性。

Conclusion: CreGR首次将可信度引入生成式推荐，通过分词与生成两阶段的联合建模，在保持推荐准确性的同时提升推荐可信度。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with semantic IDs (i.e., discrete token sequences) and generates target item tokens as recommendations. Despite its promising results, existing methods predominantly optimize for accuracy while neglecting the credibility of the recommendations they generate. This oversight inevitably exposes users to uncredible content (e.g., fake news) with serious societal consequences, including user distrust, reputation harm to platforms, and broader social instability. To address this critical yet underexplored challenge, we propose CreGR, the first credible GR model that jointly tackles content credibility across the two core stages of GR: tokenization and generation. In the tokenization stage, we design a new credibility-aware tokenizer that explicitly encourages the model to learn discriminative tokens respectively for credible and uncredible items, thereby disentangling credibility signals at the token level. Building on this, in the generation stage, we propose a novel accuracy-preserving and credibility-oriented generator grounded in discrete diffusion. Specifically, we introduce an asymmetric masking probability reduction strategy that selectively diminishes the contribution of tokens associated with uncredible content to the generation process, while leaving tokens encoding user preference signals unaffected so as to preserve recommendation accuracy. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of CreGR.

</details>


### [426] [Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05750)
*Reza Esfandiarpoor,Radek Osmulski,Yauhen Babakhin,Gabriel de Souza P. Moreira,Oliver Holworthy,Jie He,Ronay Ak,Jiarui Cai,Ryan Chesler,Bo Liu,Even Oldridge*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究“agentic retrieval”（智能体检索），将大语言模型的推理能力与检索器的高效语料探索结合在 ReAct 智能体循环中，以解决复杂检索任务。实验表明其效果优于标准稠密检索且泛化性强，但代价是显著更高的延迟与 token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代信息系统（包括许多智能体工作流）使用稠密检索来探索大量非结构化数据，但稠密检索依赖表层语义相似度，对日益复杂的搜索应用而言不够充分。因此需要一种能够结合推理能力与高效语料探索的检索方式。

Method: 提出 agentic retrieval：在 ReAct 智能体循环中，将大语言模型的推理能力与检索器的高效语料探索相结合，用于解决复杂检索任务。

Result: 在使用相同嵌入模型的情况下，agentic retrieval 比标准检索更有效，nDCG@10 提升 8.7 个点；同时在 ViDoRe v3 和 BRIGHT 两个榜单上均取得有竞争力的结果，展现出较强的泛化性。但代价高昂：平均耗时 107.4 秒（标准检索为 0.67 秒），每查询消耗 764.1K 输入 token 和 5.8K 输出 token。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了 agentic retrieval 在现代数据系统中的有效性，并推动未来针对大规模部署、更具成本效益的检索智能体的研究。

Abstract: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data. However, dense retrieval relies on surface-level semantic similarity, which is insufficient for increasingly complex search applications. Here, we investigate agentic retrieval that combines the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the efficient corpus exploration of retrievers in a ReAct agentic loop to solve complex retrieval tasks. In our experiments, we show that agentic retrieval is more effective than standard retrieval, improving nDCG@10 by 8.7 points using the same embedding model. Moreover, while specialized retrieval methods struggle on out-of-domain tasks, agentic retrieval is highly generalizable: the same pipeline achieves competitive results on both the ViDoRe v3 and BRIGHT leaderboards. However, this improvement comes at a cost. On average, agentic retrieval takes 107.4 seconds, compared to 0.67 seconds for standard retrieval, and consumes 764.1K input and 5.8K output tokens per query. In short, our study demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic retrieval in modern data systems and motivates future work on more cost-efficient retrieval agents for large-scale deployment.

</details>


### [427] [Constraint-Aware Conversational Job Recommendation in Code-Mixed Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05787)
*Md Arman Hossain,Mubashir Jawad,Fariha Khandaker Moon,Sonia Binte Siraj,Masfiqur Rahaman,Raihan ul Islam,Ahmed Wasif Reza,Nafis Sadeq*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 JobCCC，一个面向孟加拉国的低资源、代码混合会话式职位推荐基准，并比较稀疏检索、稠密检索、硬约束过滤与所提 W-SCAR 排序框架的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 会话式职位推荐需同时建模语义相关性、用户偏好、资格要求与真实职业讨论中的噪声语言，在低资源、代码混合场景尤为困难，且严格约束匹配可能错误剔除合适职位。

Method: 构建包含 22,410 条结构化职位与 988 段多轮职业咨询对话的数据集，标注动态求职者偏好并关联真实职位，提供英语与罗马化孟加拉语-英语两种语义等价版本；对比 BM25、多语言稠密检索及其硬约束过滤版本，并提出结合词汇相关性、语义相关性与经验、地点、教育、薪资分级效用的 W-SCAR（基于 TOPSIS）多准则排序框架。

Result: 实验显示严格过滤持续损害检索性能，因不完整抽取与脆弱属性匹配会不可逆地移除相关职位；W-SCAR 避免破坏性剪枝，在两种语言条件下表现更均衡，英语与 Banglish 的 Hit@10 分别为 37.37% 和 38.43%。

Conclusion: 硬约束过滤不适用于此场景，软约束感知的多准则排序能更好平衡跨语言性能；代码与数据集已公开。

Abstract: Conversational job recommendation requires jointly modeling semantic relevance, user preferences, eligibility requirements, and the noisy language used in real-world career discussions. These challenges are especially pronounced in low-resource, code-mixed settings, where strict constraint matching can incorrectly eliminate otherwise suitable jobs. We introduce JobCCC, a conversational job recommendation benchmark for Bangladesh comprising 22,410 structured job postings and 988 multi-turn career-advice dialogues derived from regional Reddit communities. Each dialogue is annotated with evolving seeker preferences and linked to a ground-truth job, and is evaluated in semantically equivalent English and Romanized Bangla--English variants. We compare sparse BM25 retrieval, multilingual dense retrieval, and their hard-constraint-filtered counterparts against Weighted Soft-Constraint-Aware Ranking (W-SCAR), our multi-criteria ranking framework that combines lexical relevance, semantic relevance, and graded utilities for experience, location, education, and salary using the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS). Experiments reveal that strict filtering consistently degrades retrieval because incomplete extraction and brittle attribute matching irreversibly remove relevant jobs. W-SCAR avoids destructive pruning and achieves more balanced performance across the two language conditions, obtaining 37.37% and 38.43% Hit@10 on English and Banglish, respectively. The code and dataset are publicly available at \href{https://github.com/M-Jawad01/Conversational-Job-Recommendation-System-LLM}{GitHub} and \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/Armans33115/JobCCC-Conversational-Job-Recommendation-Bangladesh}{Hugging Face}, respectively.

</details>


### [428] [MATE: Adaptive Long- and Short-Term User Memory for LLM-Based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06050)
*Yu Hou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MATE是一个面向LLM增强序列推荐的自适应用户建模框架，通过双时间视角评估新交互，动态更新长短期记忆，在离线和在线阶段分别优化，实验证明其性能显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM增强的推荐系统虽能利用丰富物品语义，但仅凭语义表示无法区分哪些历史行为反映持久偏好、哪些主要反映近期兴趣，用户理解方面存在关键缺口。受LLM推理中可利用新信息精炼内部状态这一原理启发，作者提出自适应用户建模以解决该问题。

Method: MATE从两个时间视角评估每个新观察到的交互：是否被历史行为反复支持、是否与近期交互一致。由此产生的时间证据控制两个用户专属记忆的更新——长期记忆保守地保存持久偏好，短期记忆快速适应近期兴趣。每次推荐时，近期上下文表示动态决定两个记忆对当前用户表示的贡献强度。离线训练时将下一物品预测与时间监督联合优化；在线适应时共享模型固定，仅更新两个用户记忆。

Result: 在MovieLens-10M、Amazon Luxury Beauty和KuaiRec上，MATE相比最强外部基线将平均NDCG@10提升7.0–13.2%。进一步分析支持其既能适应近期兴趣，又能保留关于反复出现的早期偏好的有用信息。

Conclusion: MATE通过时间证据驱动的双记忆机制有效解决了LLM增强推荐中持久偏好与近期兴趣难以区分的问题，在多个数据集上取得显著性能提升，验证了其自适应用户建模的有效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-enhanced recommender systems leverage rich item semantics to support personalized recommendation. However, semantic representations alone do not determine which historical behaviors reflect persistent preferences and which mainly indicate recent interests, leaving an important aspect of user understanding unresolved. Recent advances in LLM inference show that newly available information can be used to refine the internal state during inference, thereby improving subsequent predictions. Inspired by this principle, we propose MATE (Memory Adaptation with Temporal Evidence), an adaptive user modeling framework for LLM-enhanced sequential recommendation. MATE first evaluates each newly observed interaction from two temporal perspectives: whether it is repeatedly supported by historical behaviors and whether it is consistent with recent interactions. The resulting temporal evidence controls the updates of two user-specific memories, where the long-term memory conservatively preserves persistent preferences while the short-term memory rapidly adapts to recent interests. For each recommendation, a recent-context representation dynamically determines how strongly the two memories contribute to the current user representation. During offline training, next-item prediction is jointly optimized with temporal supervision, while during online adaptation, the shared model remains fixed and only the two user memories are updated from newly observed interactions. Experiments on MovieLens-10M, Amazon Luxury Beauty, and KuaiRec show that MATE improves mean NDCG@10 over the strongest external baseline by 7.0--13.2%. Further analyses support its ability to adapt to recent interests while retaining useful information about recurring earlier preferences.

</details>


### [429] [Beyond States: Investigating the Effects of Context on User Modeling with Feature-Conditioned Markov Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06060)
*Jana Isabelle Friese,Andreas Konstantin Kruff,Timo Breuer,Philipp Schaer,Norbert Fuhr*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种特征条件化的马尔可夫式用户模型，将转移概率建模为位置、内容与交互特征的函数，从而在保持状态模型简洁高效的同时实现情境感知决策；通过多层次框架评估预测拟合与行为保真度，发现情境特征能提升仿真真实感，但其效果取决于搜索场景与建模目标，需针对任务和场景选择特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户行为仿真常用于评估交互式信息检索系统，但经典基于状态的方法（如马尔可夫模型）难以融入对决策有用的情境信息，限制了仿真的真实性与适用性。

Method: 提出特征条件化的马尔可夫式用户模型，将转移概率表示为位置特征、内容特征与交互衍生特征的函数，实现情境感知决策并保留状态模型的结构简洁性与计算效率；采用多层次评估框架，在多个数据集、搜索设置与特征配置下考察不同情境信息来源对仿真的贡献，评估预测拟合与行为保真度。

Result: 引入情境特征能够提升模型复现真实用户交互关键方面的能力，但其有效性依赖于具体搜索场景与建模目标；不存在通用方案，有效的仿真需要针对任务与场景选择特征。

Conclusion: 该研究为特征选择提供了实用且可解释的依据，说明情境增强的状态模型是提升用户仿真真实感的可行路径，但需结合具体任务与场景进行定制化设计。

Abstract: User behavior simulation is widely used to evaluate interactive information retrieval systems, but classical state-based approaches (e.g., Markov models) have limited ability to incorporate contextual information relevant for decision-making. We address this limitation by introducing a feature-conditioned Markov-style user model, in which transition probabilities are modeled as functions of positional, content-based, and interaction-derived features, enabling context-aware decision making while preserving the structural simplicity and computational efficiency of state-based models. Applying a multi-level framework that assesses predictive fit and behavioral fidelity, we analyze how different sources of contextual information contribute to realistic user simulation across multiple datasets, search settings, and feature configurations. Our results show that incorporating contextual features improves the models' ability to reproduce key aspects of real user interactions, but that their effectiveness hinges on search scenario and modeling objective. Instead of a one-size-fits-all solution, effective simulation requires task- and setting-specific feature selection. Our framework provides a practical and interpretable basis for making these choices.

</details>


### [430] [Commercial Intent in Human-AI Conversations: A Corpus Audit and Architecture for Website Sales Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06205)
*Benjamin Tannenbaum*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文对Aiso提供的725,219条会话记录进行元数据普查，并提出面向会话销售代理的参考架构与质量规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 会话销售代理需区分产品询问与购买承诺、保留显式需求，并基于当前业务信息确定下一步动作，因此需要澄清数据构成与设计边界。

Method: 对725,219条记录进行聚合普查，统计商业(41,800,5.76%)与交易(2,387,0.33%)标签及并集(44,187,6.09%)，分析语言、深度与批次分布；提出结合业务知识、带来源的会话状态与受限下一步动作策略的架构，并制定质量规范。

Result: 商业类中54.31%标注为英语，41.59%深度≥2，13.51%深度≥4；商业标签流行度在三批来源间为4.87%–6.35%。

Conclusion: 研究属元数据审计与技术设计，不验证标签准确性、训练规模或销售转化；强调语料清单、商业相关性、训练资格与业务结果的显式分离，且不发布原始文本与个人标识。

Abstract: Conversational sales agents must distinguish questions about products from purchase commitments, preserve explicit requirements, and ground the next action in current business information. We report an aggregate census of 725,219 records in an accessible conversation table provided by Aiso and develop a reference architecture for this setting. All records have distinct non-null conversation hashes. Existing metadata labels identify 41,800 commercial records (5.76%) and 2,387 transactional records (0.33%); their union contains 44,187 records (6.09%). Within the commercial category, 54.31% are labeled English, 41.59% have recorded depth of at least two, and 13.51% have depth of at least four. Commercial-label prevalence varies from 4.87% to 6.35% across three source batches. These measurements motivate explicit separation of corpus inventory, commercial relevance, training eligibility, and observed business outcomes. The proposed architecture combines business-grounded knowledge, provenance-bearing conversation state, and a constrained next-action policy. A quality specification addresses source rights, privacy, label validation, deduplication, and training-test separation. The study is a metadata audit and technical design, not a validation of label accuracy, model training volume, or sales conversion. No raw conversation text or personal identifiers are released.

</details>


### [431] [SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06590)
*Justin Hangoebl,Marta Moscati,Alessandro B. Melchiorre,Shah Nawaz,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SPRIG，将内容派生的语义ID整合进知识图谱路径推理，实现参数更少、算力更省且性能有竞争力的生成式推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐存在两条互补但各有局限的路线：语义ID（SID）用内容派生的层级量化离散码替代随机初始化的不透明嵌入，但缺乏关系性支撑；知识图谱（KG）路径推理能生成实体-关系路径来锚定推荐，将物品、属性与外部实体间的结构化关系纳入其中，但物品仍被表示为与庞大嵌入表绑定的任意不透明token，限制了参数共享与泛化能力。二者优势互补，因此有必要将内容派生的SID与KG路径推理融合。

Method: 提出SPRIG生成式推荐模型，把内容派生的语义ID（SID）整合进知识图谱（KG）路径推理中。模型在信息丰富的KG路径上进行训练，路径终止于以离散、内容派生token表示的物品，从而同时具备SID的内容语义优势与KG的结构化关系优势。在电影与音乐推荐数据集上，与顺序语言模型、KG增强方法及SID类方法等基线进行对比评估。

Result: 在电影和音乐推荐数据集上，SPRIG相较顺序语言模型、KG增强方法与SID类基线，取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时使用更少的参数和更低的计算成本。代码已开源。

Conclusion: SPRIG表明，将内容派生的语义ID与知识图谱路径推理相结合，可在降低参数量与算力开销的同时保持有竞争力的推荐性能，为生成式推荐提供了一条兼顾内容语义与结构化关系的高效路径。

Abstract: Recommender systems leveraging generative models often generate item identifiers directly, rather than ranking catalog items by a recommendation score. Recent work extends beyond pure sequential interaction signals by incorporating item content and structured relationships among items, with two distinct directions emerging. Semantic IDs (SIDs) enrich item representations by replacing opaque, randomly initialized embeddings with hierarchically quantized discrete codes derived from item content. Knowledge-graph (KG) path reasoning instead generates entity-relation paths that ground recommendations in structured relationships between items, attributes, and external entities, thereby enriching the relational context. These two lines have complementary limitations: SID-based models lack relational grounding, while KG-based generative recommenders still represent items as arbitrary, opaque tokens tied to large embedding tables, limiting parameter sharing and generalization. We propose SPRIG, a generative recommender that integrates content-derived SIDs into KG path reasoning. SPRIG is trained on information-rich KG paths that terminate in items represented as discrete, content-derived tokens, combining the advantages of both approaches. We evaluate SPRIG on movie and music recommendation datasets against baselines spanning sequential language models, KG-augmented methods, and SID-based approaches. Our results show that SPRIG achieves competitive performance over prior generative models while using fewer parameters and a lower compute cost. Code: https://github.com/justinhangoebl/semantic-id-knowledge-graph-recommender

</details>


### [432] [Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06703)
*Manousos Linardakis,Georgios Alexandridis*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SAGA-CDR是一个两阶段跨域推荐框架，通过条件GAN迁移情感嵌入并利用大模型进行效价-唤醒象限匹配，实现与书籍情绪相配的音乐推荐，在Amazon和Douban数据集上取得最优评分预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与文本情绪相匹配的背景音乐能增强读者沉浸感并改善阅读体验，这推动了"书籍-情绪匹配音乐"推荐系统的需求。然而跨域情感对齐与个性化音乐推荐仍面临挑战，本文旨在解决这一问题。

Method: 提出两阶段跨域推荐框架SAGA-CDR。第一阶段：基于Transformer构建评论情感嵌入，通过条件生成对抗网络实现跨域映射，其掩码条件生成器可处理缺失的情感成分并注入随机性以丰富偏好迁移；随后用紧凑的评分神经网络将情感交互分数与协同过滤先验融合来预测音乐评分。第二阶段：利用大语言模型将每本书分类到效价-唤醒情感象限，并据此过滤候选曲目。

Result: 在英文Amazon和中文Douban数据集上，SAGA-CDR在Amazon上取得最佳评分预测精度（RMSE 0.98），在Douban上取得最低RMSE（0.91），排序性能与最强的情感感知基线相当，且在跨语言场景下同样有效。

Conclusion: SAGA-CDR验证了结合生成对抗网络的情感跨域迁移与大模型情感象限匹配在书籍-音乐推荐中的有效性，兼具高精度与跨语言泛化能力。

Abstract: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [433] [BitIR: Cross-Architecture Fault Injection for Resilience Analysis of Heterogeneous GPU Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04037)
*Maisy Dunlavy,Michael Papka,Zhiling Lan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出BitIR跨架构故障注入框架，在LLVM IR层注入确定性单比特故障，于Polaris、Aurora、Frontier三台超算上对比NVIDIA、Intel、AMD GPU的故障行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GPU容错研究多局限于单一架构，而异构HPC系统采用多厂商GPU栈，导致跨后端故障行为差异不明。

Method: 在LLVM IR层注入确定性单比特故障，保证后端降低前的语义等价性，从而实现跨厂商（NVIDIA、Intel、AMD）直接对比；在三台超算上使用异构基准开展大规模注入实验，将结果分为屏蔽、静默数据损坏（SDC）与失败三类。

Result: 相同故障在不同厂商表现迥异：Intel最常见屏蔽故障，但故障逃逸屏蔽时更易挂起；NVIDIA更多暴露可检测的硬失败；AMD视基准与故障位置在SDC主导与失败主导间切换。

Conclusion: 容错性并非后端无关，需发展后端感知与负载感知的故障缓解机制。

Abstract: Modern GPU-based HPC systems rely on heterogeneous vendor stacks, yet resilience studies are largely limited to single architectures, leaving it unclear how faults behave across different GPU backends. We present \emph{BitIR}, a cross-architecture fault injection framework that injects deterministic single-bit faults at the LLVM IR level, ensuring semantically equivalent perturbations prior to backend lowering and enabling direct cross-vendor comparison across NVIDIA, Intel, and AMD GPUs. We evaluate BitIR on three production supercomputers -- Polaris (ALCF, NVIDIA A100), Aurora (ALCF, Intel GPU Max 1550), and Frontier (OLCF, AMD Instinct MI250X) -- representing the full spectrum of current leadership-class GPU architectures. Using representative heterogeneous benchmarks, we conduct large-scale injection campaigns across all three systems and classify outcomes into masked results, silent data corruptions (SDCs), and failures. Our results show that identical faults produce markedly different behaviors across vendors: Intel most often masks faults but exhibits more hangs when faults escape masking, NVIDIA exposes more detectable hard failures, and AMD alternates between SDC-dominant and failure-dominant behavior depending on the benchmark and fault site. These findings demonstrate that resilience is not backend-invariant, underscoring the need for backend-aware and workload-aware fault mitigation.

</details>


### [434] [OACM: Optimistic Asynchronous Communication Model for Large-Scale SNN Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04236)
*Guangnan Feng,Yangle Zeng,Honghui Liang,Zhiguang Chen,Yutong Lu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出OACM乐观异步通信模型，通过乐观混合SNN仿真、单边异步通信和自适应消息聚合路由三项创新，显著提升大规模分布式脉冲神经网络仿真的可扩展性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模分布式脉冲神经网络（SNN）仿真存在严重可扩展性瓶颈：时间驱动仿真器同步开销频繁，乐观PDES方法存在大量次级回滚，且通信模式低效，无法充分利用网络带宽。

Method: OACM包含三项关键设计：(1) 乐观混合SNN仿真，结合时间驱动方法的实现简便性，并通过同步窗口内的策略性回滚机制降低同步频率；(2) 基于UNR库实现异步单边通信，消除握手延迟并实现计算与通信的完全重叠；(3) 在2D-HyperX虚拟拓扑中开发自适应消息聚合与路由策略，优化小消息流量的带宽利用率。

Result: 在高性能计算集群上的实验表明，OACM在模拟多区域狨猴脑模型（规模达174个计算节点）时，相比原始CORTEX仿真器最高获得1.4倍加速，相比NEST获得超过22.6倍加速。

Conclusion: OACM通过乐观异步通信机制有效缓解了SNN大规模仿真的同步与回滚瓶颈，并优化了通信带宽利用，为分布式神经形态计算仿真提供了高效可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Network (SNN) simulation serves as a crucial tool for understanding brain dynamics and advancing neuromorphic computing, but faces significant scalability challenges in large-scale distributed implementations. The primary bottlenecks arise from frequent synchronization overhead in time-driven simulators and extensive secondary rollbacks in optimistic PDES approaches, compounded by inefficient communication patterns that underutilize network bandwidth. In this paper, we propose OACM, an Optimistic Asynchronous Communication Model that addresses these challenges through three key innovations. First, we design Optimistic Hybrid SNN Simulation that combines the implementation simplicity of time-driven approaches with reduced synchronization frequency through strategic rollback mechanisms within synchronization windows. Second, we implement asynchronous one-sided communication using the UNR library, eliminating handshake latency and achieving complete computation-communication overlap. Third, we develop adaptive message aggregation and routing strategies within a 2D-HyperX virtual topology to optimize bandwidth utilization for small message traffic. Experimental evaluation on a high-performance computing cluster demonstrates that OACM achieves up to 1.4x speedup over the original CORTEX simulator and over 22.6x speedup compared to NEST when simulating a multi-area marmoset brain model at scales of up to 174 compute nodes.

</details>


### [435] [SyclKittens: A Tile Programming Model for Programmers and Coding Agents on Intel GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04277)
*Yehong Jiang,Sheng Chen,Fangwen Fu,Yen-Kuang Chen,Xinmin Tian,Stuart H. Sul,Simran Arora*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出面向 Intel GPU 的硬件感知 tile 编程模型 SyclKittens，通过编码已知最优方法将智能体生成的 GEMM 内核性能从 oneDNN 的 57.5% 提升至 82.1%，联合调优后套件达 ~96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 加速器往往先于高效内核出现，因为达到峰值性能需要架构相关的操作数流水线与数据搬运专业知识。编码智能体已能自主编写、编译和调优内核，因此可大幅加速内核开发。但智能体的产出取决于所给的接口：接口既可暴露机器原始能力，也可编码利用硬件特性的已知最优方法。本文旨在检验这两类接口对性能的影响。

Method: 在 Intel GPU 上开展受控实验，使用三种编码模型、三个内核进行对比。对照组采用原始 SYCL 加执行反馈；实验组采用 SyclKittens——一种硬件感知的 tile 编程模型，其算子将操作数置于矩阵引擎布局、通过 L1 缓存预取，并经连接 GPU stack 的 fabric 通信。两组的智能体、任务和反馈预算保持一致。

Result: 最强模型 Opus 4.8 在原始 SYCL 下仅写出达 Intel 调优后 oneDNN 57.5% 的单 GPU GEMM 内核；同一智能体在 SyclKittens 下达到 82.1%。工程师与智能体联合精化调度后，内核套件在多种 GEMM 形状上的几何平均约达 oneDNN 的 96%。该套件运行 Llama-3.1-8B 推理，比 torch.compile 单 GPU 快 1.59 倍，比基于 Intel oneCCL 的多 GPU 解码路径快至 2.91 倍。

Conclusion: 接口所编码的已知最优方法能把硬件原始能力转化为实际性能，而工作负载特定的策略仍保持可编程。SyclKittens 已开源，地址为 https://github.com/intel/SyclKittens。

Abstract: New AI accelerators arrive before the kernels that make them fast, because peak kernel performance requires architecture-specific expertise in operand pipelines and data-movement techniques. Coding agents can now write, compile, and tune kernels on their own, so they could greatly accelerate kernel development and optimization. What agents produce depends on the interfaces they are given. These interfaces may expose a machine's raw capabilities or encode the known-good methods for exploiting its hardware features efficiently. We test the performance impact of these two interfaces on Intel GPUs through controlled experiments with three coding models on three kernels. With raw SYCL and execution feedback, Opus 4.8, the strongest of the three models tested, writes a single-GPU GEMM kernel reaching only 57.5% of Intel's tuned oneDNN library. We present SyclKittens, a hardware-aware tile programming model for Intel GPUs that encodes these known-good methods, so its operations place operands in matrix-engine layouts, prefetch through the L1 cache, and communicate over the fabric that links GPU stacks into a node. With SyclKittens under the same agent, task, and feedback budget, the agent reaches 82.1%, showing that encoded methods turn hardware capabilities into performance. Workload-specific policies stay programmable, and engineers and agents jointly refine these schedules in SyclKittens to build a kernel suite that reaches ~96% of oneDNN in geometric mean across GEMM shapes. The suite runs Llama-3.1-8B inference 1.59x faster than torch.compile on one GPU and up to 2.91x faster than a matched multi-GPU decode path on Intel's oneCCL. SyclKittens is open source and available at https://github.com/intel/SyclKittens.

</details>


### [436] [Budget-Constrained Fault-Tolerant Mutual Visibility for Autonomous Robots under the Mobility Fault Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04402)
*Prakhar Shukla,Animesh Maiti,Shivam Kumar,Subhash Bhagat*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究在移动预算约束与移动性故障模型下，透明移动机器人集群的相互可见性问题，并提出一种仅用12种光色的确定性分布式算法，在无坐标系统一、非刚性移动的SSYNC模型下同时保证相互可见、预算约束、无碰撞，且能容忍任意数量故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人是透明的，三点共线时中间者会遮挡两端视线；同时机器人能量有限（移动预算），且可能因移动性故障永久静止。已有相互可见性算法通常未同时考虑移动预算约束与任意数量故障，因此需要设计能在这些限制下仍保证所有非故障机器人实现无遮挡可见性的分布式方案。

Method: 在带公共固定参考点、无局部坐标系统一、非刚性移动的SSYNC模型下，采用发光机器人（仅用12种光色）设计确定性分布式算法，指挥非故障机器人协调移动，在遵守各自有限移动预算且不发生碰撞的前提下完成相互可见。

Result: 所提确定性分布式算法可容忍任意数量的移动性故障，保证非故障机器人实现相互可见，遵守每个机器人的移动预算，提供无碰撞移动，并仅使用12种光色。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，即便存在任意数量移动性故障、能量预算受限、无坐标系统一等苛刻条件下，仍可用极少的通信资源（12种光色）确定性地解决透明机器人集群的相互可见性问题。

Abstract: We investigate the mutual visibility problem for a swarm of $n\ge3$ autonomous mobile robots under the budget-constrained mobility fault model. The robots are opaque, so if three robots are collinear, the middle robot obstructs the visibility between the other two. Each robot is assigned a finite movement budget, reflecting its limited energy, that bounds the total distance it may traverse during the execution. Moreover, an arbitrary number of robots may become permanently immobile due to mobility faults. The objective is to design a distributed algorithm that enables the non-faulty robots to coordinate their movements so that, within a finite time, every non-faulty robot attains unobstructed visibility of all robots in the system, including the faulty ones, while respecting the prescribed movement budget. We consider luminous robots operating under the $\mathsf{SSYNC}$ model with non-rigid movements, without any agreement on their local coordinate systems, and equipped only with a {\it common fixed reference point}. We present a deterministic distributed algorithm that solves the problem despite an arbitrary number of mobility faults. The algorithm guarantees mutual visibility for the non-faulty robots, respects the movement budget of every robot, provides collision-free movements for the robots, and uses only 12 light colors.

</details>


### [437] [AID: A Framework for AI Infrastructure Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04801)
*Abi Aryan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 AID（AI Infrastructure Dynamics）框架，用于描述耦合物理、计算、网络与服务过程的 AI 推理基础设施学习问题，并给出预测误差下界与可控状态约简的充分条件，以及一套验证协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 推理基础设施建模往往未明确系统状态、观测者可用信息以及模型需支持的决策，导致表示与预测/控制目标脱节。作者希望建立统一框架，明确学习问题的边界，并区分不同目标的表示能力。

Method: 构建 AID 框架，支持结构化与可变规模状态、异步观测、多物理时间尺度以及随服务变化的需求；区分三类表示：在既有策略下支持预测的表示、在动作变化下保持服务结果的表示、以及识别干预响应的表示。并借助信息论与状态抽象原理给出理论分析，同时设计针对缓存表示、工作负载历史、测量可用性与施加动作的验证协议。

Result: 得到两个分析结果：当可用观测无法区分模型时，预测误差存在下界；以及精确可控状态约简的一个充分条件。这些结果将已有的信息与状态抽象原理应用于 AI 基础设施场景。

Conclusion: AID 为 AI 推理基础设施的学习建模提供了结构化框架，明确了表示目标与观测限制之间的关系，并通过验证协议支持缓存、工作负载与测量等关键要素的实证检验。

Abstract: A useful model of AI inference infrastructure must specify the system state, the information available to an observer, and the decisions the model is intended to support. We introduce AID (AI Infrastructure Dynamics), a framework for describing this learning problem across coupled physical, computational, networking, and serving processes. The formulation allows structured and variable-size state, asynchronous observations, multiple physical timescales, and demand that responds to service. We distinguish representations that support prediction under an existing policy from those that preserve service outcomes under changed actions, and separate both from identifying intervention responses. Two analytical results describe a lower bound on prediction error when available observations cannot distinguish models and a sufficient condition for exact controlled state reduction. These results apply established information and state-abstraction principles to AI infrastructure. We then describe a validation protocol for cache representations, workload histories, measurement availability, and imposed actions.

</details>


### [438] [Min-Max Uniform Circle Formation by Asynchronous Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05008)
*Animesh Maiti,Prakhar Shukla,Subhash Bhagat*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究在 ASYNC 模型下最小化最大移动距离的圆形成与均匀圆形成问题，并给出确定性、分布式、无碰撞算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀圆形成是群体机器人中的基础协调任务，但现有文献未解决形成过程中最大个体位移的优化问题。

Method: 在 ASYNC 模型下，机器人自主、匿名、同质、 oblivious、silent，采用 Look-Compute-Move 模型与非刚性运动；先给出确定性解的必要条件，再设计算法。

Result: 提出确定性、分布式、无碰撞算法，可在有限时间内形成圆与均匀圆，同时最小化最大移动距离，并确保机器人到达圆上不同位置，均匀情形下等间距分布。

Conclusion: 该工作为最小最大圆形成与均匀圆形成问题提供了在 ASYNC 模型下的确定性分布式解决方案。

Abstract: Given a set of point robots $\mathcal{R}$ in the Euclidean plane and a target circle $\mathbf C$ enclosing all robot positions, the \textsc{Min-Max Uniform Circle Formation (MMUCF)} problem requires the robots to move to distinct positions on $\mathbf C$ such that the final configuration forms a regular $n$-gon while minimizing the maximum distance traveled by any robot. Uniform circle formation is a fundamental coordination task in swarm robotics with applications in perimeter monitoring, surveillance, boundary coverage, and pattern formation. The literature does not address the optimization of the maximum individual displacement during the formation process.
  In this work, we study the min--max versions of the circle formation and uniform circle formation problems, where the goal is to minimize the maximum distance traveled by any robot. We consider these problems under the $\mathcal{ASYNC}$ model, where robots are autonomous, anonymous, identical, homogeneous, oblivious, and silent, and operate under the \textit{Look--Compute--Move} model with non-rigid motion. We first give necessary conditions for a deterministic solution and then present deterministic, distributed, and collision-free algorithms that form a circle and a uniform circle in finite time while minimizing the maximum movement. The algorithms ensure that robots reach distinct positions on the circle and, in the uniform case, equally spaced positions on $\mathbf C$ under the considered model.

</details>


### [439] [You Only Convert Twice: Ozaki Scheme II for Chained Tensor Mode Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05059)
*Xuanzhengbo Ren*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出 OzII-RescaleBE，在 Ozaki scheme II 中保持中间张量为余数形式，实现链式张量模式积的持续执行，减少浮点转换开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式张量模式积若每步都转回浮点表示，会带来重复的中间转换开销。作者希望在余数域中直接完成缩放与基扩展，从而只在链首转换、链尾重构。

Method: 在余数表示上直接执行 rescaling 和 base extension，使中间张量保持 residue 形式；使用 CuTe DSL 与 INT8 Tensor Cores 实现，并与 GEMMul8-Composed（逐模式组合）和 GEMMul8-KRON（稠密 Kronecker 积形式）进行对比。

Result: 在三种数据集上，链深 d=3 至 7 时，范数相对误差为 2.5e-16 至 2.6e-15；d=8 时误差升至 7e-14 至 6e-13。模式尺寸 n=8 至 256 时吞吐为 1.47 至 4.42 GDoF/s，在 n=8、12 时与 GEMMul8-KRON 相差 12% 以内，较大尺寸时超过它；相比 GEMMul8-Composed，在 n≤128 时吞吐为 2.1 至 60 倍，但 n=256 时低 6%–12%。设备内存占用也低于 GEMMul8 基线。

Conclusion: 缩放与基扩展能够在余数域中支持高精度张量链运算，避免重复的中间浮点转换，同时保持较好的精度、吞吐和内存表现。

Abstract: This work proposes OzII-RescaleBE, a method that enables persistent execution of chained tensor mode products in Ozaki scheme II, keeping the intermediate tensors in residue form. By performing rescaling and base extension directly on the residue representation, it requires conversion to residues only at the beginning of the chain and reconstruction only at the end. An implementation using CuTe DSL and INT8 Tensor Cores is provided for verification and evaluation. The method is compared with per-mode composition of Ozaki scheme~II (GEMMul8-Composed) and a dense Kronecker-product formulation (GEMMul8-KRON), both implemented using the GEMMul8 library. Across three datasets with different input distributions, OzII-RescaleBE achieves normwise relative errors ranging from $2.5\times10^{-16}$ to $2.6\times10^{-15}$ for chain depths $d=3$ through $7$. The corresponding errors range from $10^{-16}$ to $10^{-15}$ for GEMMul8-KRON and from $1\times10^{-16}$ to $3\times10^{-16}$ for GEMMul8-Composed and the FP64 chain. At $d=8$, the errors of OzII-RescaleBE increase to between $7\times10^{-14}$ and $6\times10^{-13}$. For mode sizes $n=8$ to $256$, OzII-RescaleBE achieves throughputs ranging from 1.47 to 4.42\,GDoF/s. Its throughput is within 12\,\% of GEMMul8-KRON at $n=8$ and $12$ and exceeds it at larger tested sizes. Compared with GEMMul8-Composed, OzII-RescaleBE achieves $2.1$--$60\times$ the throughput for $n\leq128$, but has 6--12\,\% lower throughput at $n=256$. It also uses less device memory than the GEMMul8 baselines in the measured memory comparisons. These results demonstrate that rescaling and base extension enable accurate residue-domain tensor chains while avoiding repeated intermediate conversions to floating point.

</details>


### [440] [CommuteProp: Decoupled Training for Communication Bound Split LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05105)
*CHEN Ding,LUO Haochen,LIU Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出异步拆分学习算法 CommuteProp，通过将训练解耦为并发的跨块前向-反向传播与块内权重更新两阶段，重叠通信与计算，把边际周期时间从各阶段延迟之和降至主导计算瓶颈，并提供异步误差与收敛分析及 NS 预条件器以缓解陈旧性噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拆分学习是隐私保护 LLM 微调的有前景范式，但其实际部署受制于顺序的通信-计算瓶颈。在传统同步流水线中，客户端需等待服务器端梯度而处于空闲状态，导致训练效率显著低下。因此需要一种能重叠通信与计算、提升训练吞吐的方法。

Method: 提出 CommuteProp 异步拆分学习算法，将训练过程解耦为两个并发阶段：跨块的前向-反向传播与块内权重更新，从而让计算与通信重叠。同时给出严格的异步误差与收敛分析，并基于该分析推导出 NS 预条件器方法，以进一步缓解陈旧性带来的噪声。

Result: 综合实验表明，该算法在保持与同步方法相当精度的同时，实现了显著的吞吐量提升；此外，它可作为即插即用模块，不仅能兼容现有隐私增强方法，还能对其起到增强作用。

Conclusion: CommuteProp 通过异步解耦与通信-计算重叠有效缓解了同步拆分学习的效率瓶颈，在保证精度的前提下大幅提升吞吐，并可即插即用地增强现有隐私保护方法，具备良好的实用部署价值。

Abstract: Split learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for privacy-preserving LLM fine-tuning, yet its practical deployment is severely hindered by the sequential communication-computation bottleneck. In conventional synchronous pipelines, clients remain idle while waiting for server-side gradients, resulting in substantial training inefficiency. We propose CommuteProp, an asynchronous split-learning algorithm that decouples the training process into two concurrent phases: a cross-block forward-backward pass and an in-block weight update. By overlapping computation with communication, CommuteProp reduces the marginal cycle time from a sum of all stage latencies to the dominant computational bottleneck. We provide a rigorous asynchronous error and convergence analysis. Moreover, we derive an NS preconditioner method based on our analysis to further mitigate staleness-induced noise. Comprehensive experiments indicate that our algorithm achieves substantial throughput gains while maintaining accuracy comparable to synchronous methods; furthermore, it functions as a plug-and-play module that not only accommodates but actively enhances existing privacy enhancement methods.

</details>


### [441] [HiNa-MoE: High-Performance, Non-Intrusive MoE Inference on CPUs with Matrix Engines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05123)
*Weiling Yang,Junwen Zhang,Dezun Dong,Jianbin Fang,Enda Yu,Zhe Bai,Xiaopeng Deng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 HiNa-MoE，一个面向 Intel AMX CPU 的高性能、非侵入式 MoE 推理算子库，通过标准权重布局下的 AMX 微内核优化、页交错策略的 NUMA 感知任务划分，以及将解码阶段矩阵-向量运算转为小矩阵-矩阵运算，在保持即插即用的同时显著提升推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 推理越来越多地部署在本地和私有环境中，专家参数常超出 GPU 显存。在低延迟、低并发场景下，从 CPU 内存反复向 GPU 传输被路由的专家权重代价过高，导致被路由专家的 FFN 成为多插槽 CPU 上的关键路径。现有 CPU 加速方案多依赖侵入式、硬件或拓扑特定的要求（如 AMX 专用权重布局或手动 NUMA 感知放置），降低了可移植性并增加了与标准 CPU-GPU 卸载流水线集成的复杂度。

Method: HiNa-MoE 采用三项技术：(1) 利用 Intel AMX，设计优化微内核，保持专家权重为标准布局，将轻量级布局变换融合进 token 收集与存储过程；(2) 在简单页交错策略下实现 NUMA 感知的任务划分，无需修改框架分配器；(3) 将解码阶段的内存矩阵-向量运算转换为小矩阵-矩阵运算以充分利用 AMX。

Result: 在多个 MoE 模型上，HiNa-MoE 相较当前最优基线，FFN 内核最高取得 3.37 倍加速，端到端推理最高取得 2.09 倍加速，同时与现有框架和部署工作流保持即插即用兼容。

Conclusion: HiNa-MoE 以非侵入式方式在 CPU 上高效加速 MoE 推理，兼顾高性能与可移植性，能够无缝集成到现有框架与部署流程中。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference is increasingly deployed in local and on-premise environments, where expert parameters often exceed GPU memory capacity. In latency-sensitive, low-concurrency settings, repeatedly staging routed-expert weights from CPU memory to the GPU can be prohibitive, leaving routed-expert feed-forward networks (FFNs) on the critical path of multi-socket CPUs. Existing CPU accelerations often rely on intrusive, hardware- or topology-specific requirements, such as AMX-specific weight layouts or manual NUMA-aware placement. These requirements reduce portability and complicate integration with standard CPU-GPU offloading pipelines. We present HiNa-MoE, a high-performance, non-intrusive operator library for MoE inference on CPUs with Intel AMX. HiNa-MoE (1) exploits AMX with an optimized micro-kernel that keeps expert weights in standard layouts and instead fuses lightweight layout transforms into token gathering and stores; (2) applies NUMA-aware task partitioning under a simple page-interleaved policy without modifying the framework allocator; and (3) converts decode-phase memory matrix-vector operations into small matrix-matrix execution to utilize AMX. Across multiple MoE models, HiNa-MoE achieves up to 3.37x speedup for FFN kernels and up to 2.09x end-to-end inference speedup over state-of-the-art baselines, while remaining plug-and-play with existing frameworks and deployment workflows.

</details>


### [442] [Characterizing Parallelism Strategies in LLM Inference: Fundamental Compute-Communication Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05305)
*Javad Mirzaei,Jeebak Mitra*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出统一分析框架，建模TP、PP、HB三种分布式LLM推理并行策略的端到端延迟，涵盖计算、通信和流水线气泡开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理成为主流负载，需在多GPU上通过TP、PP或混合并行来部署。但并行策略选择受计算、通信、流水线利用率、序列长度、批大小和模型架构等多因素复杂交互影响，现有方法依赖经验评估，缺乏对这些策略权衡的分析性洞察，尤其是prefill与decoding阶段的差异。

Method: 提出统一分析框架，将端到端延迟分解为计算、GPU间通信和流水线气泡开销三部分；推导出刻画TP集合通信、PP点对点通信及流水线利用率的解析模型，将其表达为硬件、模型和负载特征的函数；进一步刻画prefill与decoding的不同执行行为。

Result: 分析了为何面向PP的配置更适合计算密集型的prefill，而面向TP的配置通过消除流水线气泡来降低decoding延迟。在多GPU平台上用现代LLM进行实验，验证了模型并确认了各并行策略间基本的计算-通信权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架为并行策略选择、容量规划和未来LLM服务系统的优化提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference has become the dominant workload in modern AI systems, requiring serving infrastructures to maximize throughput while meeting strict latency Service-Level Objectives (SLOs). Since state-of-the-art LLMs exceed the compute and memory capacity of a single GPU, inference is commonly distributed across multiple GPUs using tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), or hybrid parallelism (HB). However, selecting the most effective parallelism strategy remains challenging due to complex interactions among computation, communication, pipeline utilization, sequence length, batch size, and model architecture. Existing approaches largely rely on empirical evaluation and provide limited analytical insight into the trade-offs among these strategies, particularly across the distinct prefill and decoding phases of inference. In this paper, we present a unified analytical framework for modeling distributed LLM inference under TP, PP, and HB. The framework decomposes end-to-end latency into computation, inter-GPU communication, and pipeline bubble overhead, and derives analytical models that capture TP collective communication, PP point-to-point communication, and pipeline utilization as functions of hardware, model, and workload characteristics. The model further characterizes the differing execution behavior of prefill and decoding, explaining why PP-oriented configurations favor compute-intensive prefill while TP-oriented configurations reduce decoding latency by eliminating pipeline bubbles. Experiments with modern LLMs on multi-GPU platforms validate the model and confirm the fundamental compute-communication trade-off across parallelism strategies. The framework provides practical guidance for parallelism selection, capacity planning, and optimization of future LLM serving systems.

</details>


### [443] [Optimistic Reliable Broadcast in Three Steps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05445)
*Nikita Polyanskii*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究无签名异步可靠广播在乐观两步交付下的延迟权衡，给出了在3f+1≤n<4f时改进的构造与匹配下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有Opt-RBC可实现最大乐观预算但延迟为(2,4,4)，而Bracha协议延迟(3,3,2)。作者希望探究：最大乐观性是否能与最优三步good-case兼容，以及最大乐观性是否必须以totality延迟增加为代价。

Method: 在n方、至多f拜占庭、乐观故障预算b≤f的异步模型中，定义延迟三元组(乐观延迟、诚实广播者含f故障延迟、totality延迟)。构造两个无签名可靠广播协议，均使用二次消息并容忍自适应腐化，同时证明totality延迟的下界。

Result: 第一构造将Opt-RBC的(2,4,4)改进为(2,3,4)，保持最大乐观预算b*=⌊n/2⌋−f。下界表明：当b≥n−3f时totality延迟至少为3。第二构造达到(2,3,3)，在f≥2且⌈(10f−3)/3⌉≤n<4f时匹配该下界。

Conclusion: 最大乐观性与最优三步good-case兼容；在匹配范围内，最大乐观性相对Bracha的(3,3,2)恰好增加一个totality步，而未增加good-case延迟。

Abstract: We study the latency tradeoffs of signature-free asynchronous reliable broadcast with optimistic two-step delivery. We consider $n$ parties, of which at most $f$ are Byzantine. An optimistic fault budget $b\le f$ guarantees two-step delivery with an honest broadcaster and at most $b$ faults, while correctness tolerates $f$ faults. We write $(d_o,d_s,d_t)$ for optimistic latency, honest-broadcaster latency with up to $f$ faults, and totality delay-the elapsed time from first to last honest delivery.
  For $3f+1\le n<4f$, our first construction improves Opt-RBC's $(2,4,4)$ guarantees to $(2,3,4)$, preserving its maximal optimistic budget $b_*=\lfloor n/2\rfloor-f$. Thus maximal optimism is compatible with the optimal three-step good case.
  We prove a complementary lower bound: for $3f+1\le n<4f$, every deterministic reliable broadcast protocol in our asynchronous model with two-step optimistic budget $b\ge n-3f$ has totality delay at least three, even when the broadcaster is honest. Our second construction achieves $(2,3,3)$, matching this lower bound at maximal optimism when $f\ge2$ and $\lceil(10f-3)/3\rceil\le n<4f$. Both constructions use quadratic messages and tolerate adaptive corruption. In the matching range, maximal optimism therefore costs exactly one totality step relative to Bracha's $(3,3,2)$, without increasing good-case latency.

</details>


### [444] [Rethinking Streaming-Perception Evaluation on Heterogeneous Edge Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05578)
*Misun Yu,Jinyoung Moon,Jemin Lee*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文指出多摄像头流式感知的加速器放置不应仅用孤立单流实验和平均sAP评估，因为GPU-NPU异构平台上共驻工作负载引发的竞争会改变最优放置策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多摄像头流式感知日益部署在与共驻工作负载共享的异构边缘平台上，但加速器放置常通过孤立的单流实验和平均流式平均精度（sAP）来评估，这可能忽略部署时的资源竞争，导致评估结论与实际部署表现不符。

Method: 在单GPU–NPU平台上使用两个端到端流水线，分别在孤立条件、延迟实验、资源竞争实验以及四流场景下进行对比，并引入GPU饱和的视觉–语言共驻任务，考察不同放置策略下的最差流sAP与截止期错失情况。

Result: 孤立评估偏好GPU流水线，但GPU局部竞争会导致截止期错失、检测陈旧，甚至在GPU完全饱和前就反转最优放置；NPU流水线在孤立条件下对中小目标精度较低，但在大目标上几乎与GPU相当；延迟和竞争实验中最大绝对sAP损失出现在大目标上；四流实验中，最优放置取决于哪条路径变陈旧，GPU侧竞争增加会使最佳放置从All-GPU转向All-NPU；在GPU饱和的视觉–语言共驻任务下，All-NPU的最差流sAP达到All-GPU的5.2倍。

Conclusion: 平均sAP可能掩盖严重的单流性能退化，因此评估应同时报告竞争扫描、两条路径的截止期错失率以及最差流sAP，并与平均sAP一起呈现。

Abstract: Multi-camera streaming perception is increasingly deployed on heterogeneous edge platforms shared with co-resident workloads, yet accelerator placement is often evaluated using isolated single-stream experiments and mean streaming average precision (sAP). Using two end-to-end pipelines on a single GPU--NPU platform, we show that isolated evaluation can mis-rank deployment-time placement. Although the GPU pipeline is preferred in isolation, GPU-localized contention introduces deadline misses that make detections stale and can reverse the preferred placement before full GPU saturation. The NPU pipeline is less accurate than the GPU pipeline on small and medium objects in isolation, but nearly matches it on large objects. The largest absolute sAP losses in our latency and contention experiments occur for large objects. In our four-stream experiments, the preferred placement depends on which path becomes stale, and increasing GPU-side contention shifts the best placement from All-GPU to All-NPU. Under a GPU-saturating vision--language co-tenant, All-NPU achieves $5.2\times$ the worst-stream sAP of All-GPU. Because mean sAP can hide severe single-stream degradation, evaluation should report contention sweeps, deadline-miss rates on both paths, and worst-stream sAP alongside mean sAP.

</details>


### [445] [Handling Missing Data in Performance Portability Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05605)
*Ami Marowka*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该研究针对高性能计算性能可移植性研究中性能效率数据缺失的问题，评估多种插补方法，在真实数据集上分析精度、鲁棒性与计算成本的权衡，并给出实用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 性能可移植性评分依赖完整的性能效率集合，但基准测试不完整、硬件限制或实现缺口常导致缺失值。现有多数可移植性指标缺乏缺失值处理机制，会造成分析不完整甚至无法计算分数。

Method: 评估一系列用于填补缺失性能效率的插补方法和算法，为每种方法提供示例说明，并将其应用于真实的HPC性能可移植性数据集。

Result: 结果揭示了不同插补方法在准确性、鲁棒性和计算成本之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 为希望减轻缺失数据对性能可移植性评估影响的研究人员提供了实用建议。

Abstract: Missing data is a common challenge in many real-world datasets, often leading to biased results or reduced accuracy. Missing data is a pervasive problem in performance efficiency datasets, particularly in high-performance computing (HPC) performance portability studies. Performance portability scores rely on complete sets of performance efficiencies as inputs to their respective metrics; however, missing values can arise due to incomplete benchmarking, hardware constraints, or implementation gaps. Many established performance portability metrics lack mechanisms for handling missing inputs, which can result in incomplete analyses or the inability to compute scores altogether.
  In this study, we evaluate a range of imputation methods and algorithms for addressing missing performance efficiencies. We present illustrative examples for each approach and apply them to real-world HPC performance portability datasets. Our results highlight the trade-offs between accuracy, robustness, and computational cost, offering practical recommendations for researchers seeking to mitigate the impact of missing data in performance portability assessments.

</details>


### [446] [Nexus: An Execution Fabric for AI Agents Across Cloud, Edge, and Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05709)
*Cary Chang,Jialin Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Nexus是一个云边协同平台，将每次agent调用视为持久化任务，通过OpenWrt运行时、运行域授权委派和持久化记录，实现跨云边环境的生命周期管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型agent框架以云端为中心，面临三大局限：集中式执行增加故障影响、扩展压力和计算成本；跨计算机、移动设备与边缘环境需要统一的执行抽象与权限控制；长时间运行需要一致的故障、恢复、结果、用量与结算的生命周期管理。

Method: Nexus采用基于OpenWrt的运行时支持分布式服务；使用运行域（run-scoped）授权委派实现对Computer和Mobile环境的安全访问；通过持久化记录跨云边组件追踪执行、输出、故障、恢复、用量与计费。

Result: 在受控、跨设备及模型驱动工作负载上评估：10个Computer-Android工作流全部成功；6个撤销测试均阻止后续写入并保留先前授权读取；worker丢失时日志机制将重复追加从每任务6次降至0次，正常路径平均开销0.933秒；24对匹配任务中Nexus完成24个，Dify完成22个，共同成功对中位数快3.88秒；在另一负载下Nexus运行内存上限更低（16 vs 64 MiB），但Dapr成功调用延迟更低。

Conclusion: 本地性、操作域权限和持久化结果标识可支撑具有负载相关成本的云边agent服务。

Abstract: Language-model agents are evolving into long-running services that interact with models, tools, computers, mobile devices, and distributed environments. Existing agent frameworks simplify reasoning and tool invocation. However, cloud-centric designs face three limitations: centralized execution increases failure impact, scaling pressure, and compute cost; extending agents across computers, mobile devices, and edge environments requires a unified execution abstraction with permission control; and long-running executions require consistent lifecycle management across failures, recovery, results, usage, and settlement. We present Nexus, a cloud-edge platform that treats each invocation as a persistent task. Nexus uses an OpenWrt-based runtime for distributed serving, run-scoped delegation for authorized access to Computer and Mobile environments, and persistent records to track execution, outputs, failures, recovery, usage, and charging across cloud and edge components. We evaluate Nexus on controlled, cross-device, and model-driven workloads. All ten Computer-Android workflows succeed, and all six revocation tests block subsequent writes while preserving prior authorized reads. Under worker loss, journaling eliminates duplicate appends (six to zero per task), adding 0.933 s mean normal-path overhead. Across 24 matched task pairs, Nexus completes 24 tasks versus Dify's 22 and is a median 3.88 s faster on jointly successful pairs. In a separate workload, Nexus operates under a smaller tested incremental-runtime memory ceiling than Dapr (16 versus 64 MiB), although Dapr achieves lower successful-call latency. These results demonstrate how locality, operation-scoped authority, and persistent result identity support cloud-edge agent services with workload-dependent costs.

</details>


### [447] [MOLT: A Fine-Grained GPU Memory Sharing System for LLM Serving with Opportunistic Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05748)
*Jaehoon Yang,Yongbeom Kim,Hojoon Kim,Seung Yul Lee,Jae W. Lee*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MOLT 是一个细粒度 GPU 显存共享系统，允许推理任务在数秒内回收 PEFT 调优步骤中保存的单个激活值显存，调优步骤继续执行并在反向传播时重算这些激活值，从而在不损害推理 SLO 的前提下完成更多调优工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型服务中，副本数量虽随负载扩展，但副本内部 GPU 显存仍存在闲置。新增副本需要数分钟，而副本所需显存却在数秒内变化，即使即时自动扩缩容也无法回收闲置显存，因为最小移除单位是整个副本。将 PEFT 与推理共置可利用这部分显存，但推理必须在延迟 SLO 被突破前的数秒内回收它。现有共置系统要么保持调优显存常驻，要么以整个训练样本为粗粒度回收，且每次回收都会丢弃正在进行的调优步骤。

Method: MOLT 实现细粒度显存共享，让推理回收运行中调优步骤为反向传播保存的单个激活值的显存；调优步骤不中断，反向传播时重算被回收的激活值。系统仅回收没有在途 GPU 工作仍可访问的显存，并正确处理 CPU–GPU 异步与张量并行场景。

Result: 在 H100 SXM 与 B200 GPU 上、跨四种模型部署（24B–70B）、基于 trace 驱动的工作负载中，MOLT 将推理 SLO 达成率保持在 99.7% 及以上，并完成比基于丢弃的显存共享多 1.9–3.3 倍的调优工作量。

Conclusion: MOLT 通过激活值级别的细粒度显存回收与重算机制，解决了推理与 PEFT 共置时的显存利用与 SLO 冲突，在保持推理服务质量的同时显著提升调优吞吐。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving scales its replica count with the request load, yet GPU memory still stands idle inside the replicas. Adding a replica takes minutes, while the memory that a replica needs changes within seconds. Even instant autoscaling could not return this idle memory, because the smallest unit that it can remove is a whole replica. Colocating parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) with inference can use this memory, but inference must be able to reclaim it within seconds, before requests that wait for memory exceed their latency service-level objective (SLO). Existing colocation systems either keep the tuning memory resident or let inference reclaim it at the coarse granularity of a whole training sample. Each such reclamation also discards the running tuning step. To address these limitations, we present MOLT, a fine-grained memory sharing system that lets inference reclaim the memory of individual activations that a running tuning step has saved for its backward pass. The step continues, and its backward pass recomputes those activations. Inference reclaims only memory that no in-flight GPU work can still access, even under CPU--GPU asynchrony and tensor parallelism. On four model deployments (24B--70B) across H100 SXM and B200 GPUs under trace-driven workloads, MOLT keeps inference SLO attainment at or above 99.7% and completes 1.9--3.3x the tuning work of discard-based memory sharing.

</details>


### [448] [Serve Now or Improve Later? Scheduling Self-Evolution in Online Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06212)
*Yangbo Wei,Junhong Qian,Zhen Huang,Zhenyu Su,Qifan Wang,Shaoqiang Lu,Rumin Zhang,Chen Wu,Lei He*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 LearnSched，一种状态感知调度器，将能力复用窗口与计算资源及时回收统一到同一投资模型中，通过一步反事实 rollout 在推进、检查点与等待间做选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线智能体可通过构建可复用工具、指导或模型状态来改进未来服务，但这会与当前请求争夺同一批 GPU。利用空闲算力进行自我进化存在系统性约束：收益只有在产物发布并被使用后才出现，而暂停进化又会让服务容量等待内存释放与运行时恢复。因此，一项值得完成的投资可能反而值得推迟。

Method: LearnSched 将候选进展、检查点开销和当前恢复路径纳入动作价值；在相同信息与容量约束下，使用一步反事实 rollout，相对于完全计价的窗口策略，选择推进、检查点或等待。作者通过独立的 A100 组件测量刻画交接成本，并在 1920 个配对的有限模型场景中评估动作选择。

Result: 当冷恢复代价高昂时，等待更长执行窗口可通过避免交接提升净价值；在评估的温恢复场景中，强窗口策略已能达到相同价值。保留可恢复状态可缩短容量归还时间，并降低对复杂进化调度的需求。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，调度自我进化与在线服务之间的权衡需纳入恢复成本与复用窗口；在冷恢复昂贵时等待更优，而在温恢复下简单窗口策略已足够，保留可恢复状态还可简化调度需求。

Abstract: Online agents can improve future service by constructing reusable tools, guidance, or model states, but this work competes with current requests for the same GPUs. Exploiting idle compute for self-evolution faces a fundamental systems constraint: benefits arrive only after an artifact is published and used, while pausing evolution leaves service capacity waiting for memory release and runtime recovery. An investment worth completing may therefore be worth postponing. We present LearnSched, a state-aware scheduler that brings the reuse window of a capability and the timely return of compute into a common investment model. LearnSched incorporates candidate progress, checkpoint overhead, and the current recovery path into action values. Under the same information and capacity constraints, it uses one-step counterfactual rollout to choose progress, checkpointing, or waiting relative to a fully costed window policy. We characterize handoff costs through independent A100 component measurements and evaluate action selection in 1920 paired finite-model scenarios. When cold recovery is expensive, waiting for longer execution windows can improve net value by avoiding handoffs; in evaluated warm-recovery scenarios, the strong window policy already achieves the same value. Retaining recoverable state can shorten capacity return and reduce the need for complex evolution scheduling.

</details>


### [449] [Acceleration of Data Analytics on Heterogeneous Supercloud Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06291)
*Georgios Zacharopoulos,Ilias Bournias,Lukas Cavigelli*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出面向异构超级云的计算模型与性能估计技术，通过ReDSEa工具链自动化映射、负载均衡、调度、并行与计算重叠，在鲲鹏920 CPU与昇腾910加速器上实现CH分解最高17倍、SVD最高88倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构超级云正在变革数据分析，需在不同资源间实现可扩展、高效的任务分配，而Dense Cholesky分解与SVD等分析任务在异构平台上的加速缺乏专门的计算模型与性能估计方法。

Method: 提出针对异构超级云的计算模型与性能估计技术；开发ReDSEa工具链，自动化映射、负载均衡、调度、并行化与计算重叠；基于LLVM的编译器工具链，针对递归、迭代与分块计算采用新颖的性能模型；硬件平台为鲲鹏920 ARM CPU与昇腾910 AI加速器。

Result: 相比完全优化的48核CPU实现，CH分解最高获得17倍加速，SVD最高获得88倍加速。

Conclusion: 所提出的计算模型、性能估计与ReDSEa工具链能有效加速异构超级云上的CH与SVD分析任务，显著超越多核CPU基线。

Abstract: Heterogeneous Supercloud systems are transforming data analytics by enabling scalable and efficient task distribution across diverse resources. This paper presents computational models and performance estimation techniques tailored for accelerating Dense Cholesky (CH) Decomposition and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based analytics on Heterogeneous Superclouds. Our ReDSEa tool-chain automates mapping, load balancing, scheduling, parallelism, and computation overlap. Implemented on a heterogeneous system with a Huawei Kunpeng 920 ARM CPU and an Ascend 910 AI accelerator, our LLVM compiler tool-chain employs novel performance models for recursive, iterative, and blocked computations, achieving up to 17x speedup for CH and 88x for SVD over fully optimized 48-core CPU implementations.

</details>


### [450] [Fine-Tuning a 3B-Parameter LLM on a Smartphone: Characterizing Sustained Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06325)
*Andrew Geyko,Marius Mosbach,André Brinkmann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文首次系统刻画了在手机端微调数十亿参数级LLM的完整训练过程，覆盖内存、每步耗时、热行为与能耗，并验证了端侧训练适配器的个性化效果可与服务器训练相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数十亿参数的LLM已能在手机上推理，端侧训练可让个性化数据不离开手机，但此前工作只测量了单步训练，缺乏完整训练过程的表征，也未验证端侧适配器是否真正提升个性化效果。

Method: 在iPhone 17 Pro上对一个30亿参数LLM进行完整微调表征，测量内存、单步时间、热行为与能耗；测试多种暂停与突发调度策略；审计十个其他运行时对冻结基座模型反向传播的加速支持，发现Apple MLX的对应kernel未被调度且实现有误，并加以修复。

Result: iPhone 17 Pro可在单次充电内完成30亿参数LLM的个性化微调，所得适配器的个性化提升与服务器训练相当；持续训练会因发热将吞吐降至约初始一半，且所测调度方案均无法恢复；每一步几乎全部耗时在冻结基座模型上，主要在后向传播，多数运行时未加速该部分；修复后的MLX使适配器训练提速1.47倍、能耗降低约三分之一。

Conclusion: 端侧微调在当前手机上已可行，但要实现高效，需要运行时与操作系统将训练视为一等公民工作负载。

Abstract: Multi-billion-parameter LLMs now run on phones for inference, and training them on the device would personalize them without user data leaving the phone. Prior work has measured individual training steps of such models on phones, but not complete training runs, and not whether adapters trained on the device improve personalization. We present the first systematic characterization of a multi-billion-parameter LLM fine-tuned on a mobile device, covering memory, per-step time, thermal behavior, and energy. An iPhone 17 Pro can fine-tune a 3B-parameter LLM to a typical user within one battery charge, and the resulting adapters improve personalization as much as adapters trained on a server. Sustained training throttles the phone to about half its initial throughput, and none of the pausing or burst schedules we tested recovers it. Nearly all of each training step is spent in the frozen base model, most of it in the backward pass, which nine of the ten other runtimes we audited do not accelerate. Apple's MLX had a kernel for it that was never dispatched and was incorrect, and our repair, now merged upstream, trains an adapter 1.47x faster on a third less energy. On-device fine-tuning is feasible on current phones, and making it efficient requires runtimes and operating systems to treat training as a first-class workload.

</details>


### [451] [From a Last-Week Add-On to First-Day Practice: Three Years of Integrating MPI Performance Analysis into HPC Education with EduMPI Suite](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06352)
*Anna-Lena Roth,Jonas Posner*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文报告了EduMPI Suite在HPC教育中三年集成的经验，显示其能降低MPI性能分析门槛，使学生对其评价优于传统工具，支持将性能分析贯穿MPI教学全程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 性能分析对可扩展MPI程序至关重要，但工具与工作流复杂，常被推到并行编程课程末尾甚至被忽视。作者希望降低入门门槛，让学生从第一个程序起就接触并理解MPI通信与性能分析。

Method: EduMPI Suite自动化集群执行、测量与近实时分析，并可视化MPI通信。作者将其集成到HPC教学中，开展三年经验研究，结合未公开的历史调查证据与2025年个人问卷数据进行分析。

Result: 早期学生认为性能分析不必要、困难或不直观。最终研究中，所有学生都建议在课程早期引入EduMPI Suite。33名学生中有29-33人对它在理解程序行为、解读通信、识别瓶颈、获得视觉反馈和工具导航方面评价高于传统工具。

Conclusion: 研究表明，应将性能分析嵌入MPI教育的全过程，在学生进入专业环境之前就培养其性能分析意识与能力，而EduMPI Suite是实现这一目标的有效工具。

Abstract: Performance analysis is essential for scalable MPI programs, yet tool and workflow complexity often relegates it to the end of Parallel Programming courses. EduMPI Suite lowers this entry barrier by automating cluster execution, measurement, and near-real-time analysis while visualizing MPI communication from the first program. This paper presents a three-year experience report on its integration into HPC education. We trace the transition of performance analysis from a last-week add-on to a recurring element of MPI development, using unpublished historical survey evidence and individual 2025 questionnaire data. Earlier cohorts perceived performance analysis as unnecessary, difficult, or unintuitive. In the final study, all students recommended introducing EduMPI Suite early in the course. Of 33 students, 29-33 rated it higher than conventional tools for understanding program behavior, interpreting communication, identifying bottlenecks, obtaining visual feedback, and navigating the tool. These findings support embedding performance analysis throughout MPI education before transitioning learners to professional environments.

</details>


### [452] [DIALER: A Case for Improving Rare-Class Accuracy in Retraining-Free Edge Video Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06358)
*Dongyoon Ryu,Sungho Jeon,Xinyue Ma,Di Wang,Jonghyun Choi,Minjia Zhang,Myeongjae Jeon*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: DIALER利用免重训视觉基础模型节省的算力，通过离线构建的多阶段纠正流水线，在线动态修正稀有类误判，在不影响实时推理的前提下将稀有类准确率最多提升14.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘视频分析中轻量模型会因实时视频流的持续分布漂移而精度下降；持续学习虽能应对漂移，却严重挤占本就为推理配置的边缘算力。实证研究发现视觉基础模型可免重训地提供高平均精度并大幅节省算力，但会把关键的稀有类误判为视觉相似的常见类，这是一个亟待解决的痛点。

Method: DIALER针对主要的"稀有类→常见类"混淆对，离线预先构建多阶段纠正流水线；运行时将纠正候选路由到对应流水线，并依据空闲GPU余量执行尽可能多的阶段，从而利用免重训VFM推理释放出的空闲算力。

Result: 在四个真实驾驶数据集上，DIALER将稀有类准确率最多提升14.0%，且不干扰多流分析场景下的实时VFM推理。

Conclusion: 合理利用免重训VFM推理释放的空闲算力进行定向稀有类纠正，可在几乎零额外开销下显著提升边缘视频分析中关键稀有类的准确性。

Abstract: Edge video analytics with lightweight models is prone to accuracy degradation due to persistent distributional shifts in live video streams. While continuous learning (CL) addresses such data drift, it heavily strains the limited compute resources of edge servers originally provisioned for inference. Our empirical study reveals that emerging vision foundation models (VFMs) offer a practical, retraining-free alternative that delivers high average accuracy with remarkable compute savings. However, VFMs frequently misclassify specific rare classes, which often represent critical objects, as visually similar common classes. We design DIALER, a system that exploits the spare compute cycles freed by retraining-free VFM inference to mitigate rare-class misclassifications. Specifically, DIALER pre-builds multi-stage correction pipelines for dominant rare-to-common confusion pairs offline. At runtime, it routes correction candidates to the corresponding pipelines and executes as many stages as idle GPU headroom permits. Evaluation on four real-world driving datasets shows that DIALER improves rare-class accuracy by up to 14.0% without interfering with real-time VFM inference for multi-stream analytics.

</details>


### [453] [GPU-Initiated Discrete Simulated Bifurcation: Low-Latency Requests and Streaming Dense Couplings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06622)
*Yaocheng Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出基于NVIDIA DOCA GPUNetIO的离散模拟分岔(dSB)架构，通过常驻服务和流式求解两种模式，解决GPU优化中频繁请求协调与超内存密集模型传输两大瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU优化面临两个通信瓶颈：一是协调频繁的请求，二是传输超过设备内存容量的密集模型。现有方案难以同时高效应对并发负载与超大模型。

Method: 基于NVIDIA DOCA GPUNetIO构建dSB架构，含两种模式：(1)常驻模型模式——持久服务接收字段更新，在单个GPU线程块内执行求解并返回结果，采用精确整数耦合求和、GPU工作队列与批处理传输，使接收-求解-回复路径全部留在设备端，无需专用CPU数据通路核心；(2)超内存模型模式——流式求解器将动力学状态保留在GPU上，并在副本间复用传入的耦合瓦片，用64MiB数据包缓冲处理12.5TB逻辑矩阵。

Result: 与相同求解器的socket服务器相比，最大延迟增益出现在并发负载下。负载从40万升至80万请求/秒时，中位往返延迟仅上升6%。最高测试负载下，中位与99百分位延迟为189μs和218μs，而调优的常驻CPU代理为288μs和609μs。流式求解器以约307Gb/s评估千万变量密集二值矩阵，通过64MiB缓冲消费12.5TB逻辑矩阵。植入实例的基态恢复及与参考执行的一致性验证了计算正确性。

Conclusion: 两种模式共同将dSB扩展至并发请求场景与超出GPU内存的密集模型，显著降低高并发下的延迟并实现超大模型的高吞吐求解。

Abstract: GPU-based optimization faces two communication bottlenecks: coordinating frequent requests and delivering dense models that exceed device memory. We present a discrete simulated bifurcation (dSB) architecture that addresses both through NVIDIA DOCA GPUNetIO. For resident models, a persistent service receives field updates, executes each solve within one GPU thread block, and returns the result. Exact integer coupling sums, GPU work queues, and batched transmission keep the receive--solve--reply path on the device without a dedicated CPU data-path core. In comparisons with socket-based servers using the same solver, the largest latency gains occur under concurrent load. As the offered load increases from 400 to 800 thousand requests per second, median round-trip latency rises by only 6\%. At the highest tested load, median and 99th-percentile latencies are 189 and 218~$μ$s, compared with 288 and 609~$μ$s for the tuned persistent CPU proxy across repeated runs. For models larger than device memory, a streaming solver retains dynamical state on the GPU and reuses incoming coupling tiles across replicas. It evaluates ten-million-variable dense binary matrices at approximately 307~Gb/s, consuming a 12.5-TB logical matrix through a 64-MiB packet buffer. Ground-state recovery on planted instances and agreement with reference executions verify the computation. Together, the two modes scale dSB to concurrent requests and dense models beyond GPU memory.

</details>


### [454] [OrigaMIG: MIG-Aware VM Placement with a Neighborhood-Restricted BILP and Live Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06646)
*Ahmad Siavashi,Mahmoud Momtazpour*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 OrigaMIG，一种面向 NVIDIA MIG 的 GPU 虚拟机放置优化器，通过将 MIG 感知的 VM 放置建模为 BILP 问题，并结合轻量贪心规则与按需求解邻域子问题，实现高效的多租户 GPU 资源管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU 在云计算中被广泛使用，LLM 服务与多租户需求推动了 GPU 资源管理方案的发展。NVIDIA 的 MIG 技术虽支持共享 GPU 并提供隔离实例，但其放置规则常导致碎片化和次优资源分配，因此需要更好的 MIG 感知放置策略。

Method: 本文将 MIG 感知的 VM 放置形式化为二进制整数线性规划（BILP）问题，目标为最大化请求接受率、整合资源并降低迁移开销。基于该建模提出 OrigaMIG：先用轻量贪心规则即时放置到达请求，仅当无法放置或某类 GPU 出现碎片化时调用求解器；每次求解仅在物理机的小邻域上求解 BILP，其余数据中心保持不变，并以实时迁移执行解。

Result: 仿真中与默认放置及两种先进 MIG 感知策略对比，覆盖六种负载、十一种工作负载与硬件变体，数据中心规模高达 4096 台 PM。在 128 台 PM 上的 256 块 A100 和 A30 GPU 上，OrigaMIG 在 30 次配对运行中的 29 次保持更少的活跃 PM，同时迁移 VM 减少 29%–49%，且在每种负载下单位已接纳 GPU 小时的能耗最低。相比默认放置，活跃 PM 最多减少 12.5%，接纳的请求 GPU 内存最多提高 7.8 个百分点。在小型数据中心中，其活跃 PM 数量与最优解差距在 4.1% 以内。

Conclusion: OrigaMIG 通过 BILP 建模与邻域按需求解相结合，在保持低迁移开销的同时显著提升 GPU 资源整合效率、请求接受率和能耗表现，是面向 MIG 多租户云环境的有效放置优化方案。

Abstract: The extensive use of GPUs in cloud computing, accelerated by the spread of large language model (LLM) services, and the growing need for multitenancy have driven the development of innovative solutions for efficient GPU resource management. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) technology from NVIDIA enables shared GPU usage in cloud data centers by providing isolated instances, which are offered as MIG-backed virtual GPUs (vGPUs). However, MIG placement rules often lead to fragmentation and suboptimal resource allocation. In this work, we formally model the MIG-aware virtual machine (VM) placement as a binary integer linear programming (BILP) problem aimed at maximizing request acceptance, consolidating resources, and reducing migration overhead. Building upon this formulation, we propose OrigaMIG, a MIG-aware placement optimizer. OrigaMIG places each arriving request at once with a lightweight greedy rule and calls the solver only when a request cannot be placed or the GPUs of a class become fragmented. Each call solves the BILP on a small neighborhood of physical machines (PMs), keeps the rest of the data center fixed, and executes the solution as live migrations. We compare OrigaMIG with the default placement and with two state-of-the-art MIG-aware policies in simulation, across six loads, eleven variants of the workload and the hardware, and data centers of up to 4096 PMs. On 256 A100 and A30 GPUs in 128 PMs, OrigaMIG keeps fewer PMs active than the stronger policy in 29 of 30 paired runs while migrating 29% to 49% fewer VMs, and it uses the least energy per admitted GPU-hour at every load. Against the default placement, it keeps up to 12.5% fewer PMs active and admits up to 7.8 percentage points more of the requested GPU memory. On small data centers, it stays within 4.1% of the optimal number of active PMs.

</details>


### [455] [One Global Beam Across Many GPUs: High-Throughput Beam Search at Billion-Record Frontier Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06718)
*Ivan Litvak*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出并证明一种分布式束搜索(beam search)流水线：状态与候选留在GPU上，CPU只接收控制与谱系记录；在单键全局归约与无竞争路由条件下，抽象分布式流水线返回与单体实现相同的reduced-key top-B。在8块H200上完成Cube4深度8（B_eff≈29亿，931.266秒，约7474.6万对/秒）；另有两T4 Megaminx与八RTX-3060的速度测量，但任务与硬件不同，不构成强扩展性证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单体束搜索（生成子节点、去重、保留top-B）在保留集超出单设备内存时无法进行，需要一种跨多GPU、不把状态搬回CPU的分布式方案。

Method: 状态与候选保留在GPU上，CPU仅接收小的控制与谱系记录；采用抽象分布式流水线，每个键执行一次全局归约并进行无竞争路由；对历史单T4实现的静态审计检查跨缓冲唯一性与多rank散射风险。

Result: 在8块H200上，Cube4在深度8、B_eff=2,900,361,216下用时931.266秒，名义父-生成器对为69,608,669,184，推导速率约74.746百万对/秒（未解出，深度9按用户要求停止）；两T4 Megaminx在B_eff=82,837,504下测得30.274百万逻辑子节点/秒；单台八RTX-3060主机上固定计数八GPU加速比为7.487（通用配置）与5.605（精选稳定配置），弱实际工作量吞吐增益为6.113与7.295。

Conclusion: 在给定假设（整数分数、Hash128等价、明确的物理布局平局顺序）下，分布式流水线与单体实现等价；历史单T4实现的跨缓冲唯一性未解决及多rank散射风险均为静态审计发现而非复现故障，其他版本既不继承缺陷也不自动继承正确性；不同任务与硬件的速率不可用于推断强扩展性。

Abstract: Beam search repeatedly makes many children, removes duplicates, and keeps the best $B$. We show how many GPUs can perform these steps as one search even when the retained set does not fit on one device. States and candidates stay on the GPUs; the CPU receives only small control and ancestry records. We prove that an abstract distributed pipeline returns the monolithic reduced-key top-$B$ for the same complete candidates, integer scores, Hash128 equivalence, and a fully specified physical-layout tie order, provided that its implementation performs one global reduction per key and race-free routing. A static audit of the historical one-T4 pin leaves cross-buffer uniqueness unresolved and identifies a separate multi-rank scatter risk; neither is a reproduced failure, and other revisions inherit neither defects nor correctness without comparison. On eight H200 GPUs, a Cube4 run completed saturated depth 8 at $B_{\rm eff}=2{,}900{,}361{,}216$ in $931.266$ s: $69{,}608{,}669{,}184$ nominal parent--generator pairs, or a derived $74.746$ million pairs/s. The puzzle remained unsolved and depth 9 was stopped at user request. A separate two-T4 Megaminx run measured $30.274$ million logical children/s at $B_{\rm eff}=82{,}837{,}504$. Those tasks and hardware differ, so they do not establish strong scaling. Separately, on one eight-RTX-3060 host, fixed-count eight-GPU speedup was $7.487$ under a common execution profile and $5.605$ under selected stable profiles; weak actual-work throughput gain was $6.113$ and $7.295$. These profile-sensitive ratios use each series' own one-GPU baseline.

</details>
